tei:titleStmt.tei:title: pod sa pa)o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa'i gter mtha' skyong ba gter chen padma rgyal po gar dbang 'gro 'dul rtsal gyi zab gter las/cha shas kha skong gi tshul du
pod sa pa)o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa'i gter mtha' skyong ba gter chen padma rgyal po gar dbang 'gro 'dul rtsal gyi zab gter las/cha shas kha skong gi tshul du

tei:div.tei:p: pod sa pa) o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa'i gter mtha' skyong ba gter chen padma rgyal po gar dbang 'gro 'dul rtsal gyi zab gter las/ cha shas kha skong gi tshul du bzhugs pa'i them byang bzhugs so/ sde gsum yongs kyi srol 'byed gnubs chen nyid/ /de yang gtsug lag dpal dge zhang khrom dang*/ /dri med kun dga' rtsa gsum gling pa sogs/ /srol 'byed gter chen du ma'i rol gar bsgyur/ /phyi mo gar dbang gnam lcags rdo rje rtsal/ /deng dus gter chen pad rgyal gling par shar/ /de ltar gong 'og zab gter 'phro mthud phyir/ /gong gi bka' bzhin cha shas 'dir bzhugs gsol/ /de la sprul pa'i gter chen rtsa gsum gling pa'i zab gter mtha' skyong ba gter chen padma rgyal po gar dbang 'gro 'dul rtsal 'di nyid yin la/ des na gter kha gong ma gnam lcags dang*/ phyi ma sku gsum dgongs 'dus 'di nyid yin phyir gong 'og 'phro mi chad pa'i ched du gnam lcags zab gter gyi khongs su 'di nyid cha tshang 'jug par ma nus kyang*/ gal che ba khag gcig 'dir zur 'jug gi tshul du 'god par byed pa la/ thog mar ka) bla ma'i thugs sgrub sku gsum dgongs 'dus las: gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i lam bzang padma'i snying po'i rgyud/

1-61 kha) sku gsum dgongs 'dus las/ dbang bzhi ye shes char 'bebs khrigs su bsdebs pa skal ldan smin byed/ 62-91 ga) sku gsum dgongs 'dus las byang chung ba'i brgyud 'debs byin rlabs bcud 'dus/ 92-93 nga) bla ma'i thugs sgrub sku gsum dgongs 'dus las: yang gsang bla ma'i sgrub thabs phyag rgya gcig pa phrin las rdo rje snying po/ 94-117 ca) sku dgongs las byang 'bring po'i sman mchod bsdus pa/ 118-119 cha) sku gsum dgongs 'dus las/ rtsa sgrub bla ma'i las byang rgyun khyer dngos grub 'dod 'jo/ 120-130 ja) sku gsum dgongs 'dus las: tshe sgrub 'chi med srog ster/ 131-137 nya) sku gsum dgongs 'dus las bka' srung ma mgon gsol bsdus/ 138-139 ta) sku gsum dgongs 'dus las/ rdor sems padma gsang thig gi don dbang bsdus pa/ 140-151 tha) sku dgongs rdor sems padma gsang thig gi tshe dbang zur rgyan rdo rje'i phreng mdzes/ 152-160 da) rdor sems brgyud 'debs khyab bdag dang po'i sogs/ 161-162 na) sku gsum dgongs 'dus las/ nang sgrub rdor sems padma gsang ba'i thig le'i phrin las 'og min gsang lam/ 163-194 pa) bdud rtsi lag mchod/ 195-196 pha) sku gsum dgongs 'dus las: rdo rje sems dpa'i tshe sgrub ye shes bcud len/ 197-200 ba) sku gsum dgongs 'dus las: bskang bshags rdo rje sems dpa'i dgongs rgyan/ 201-221 ma) sku gsum dgongs 'dus las: snang gsal smon lam ye shes gsang rdzogs/ 222-223 tsa) rdor sems padma gsang thig gi dgos bskang*/ 224-226 tsha) rdor sems tshogs bsdus/ 227-227 dza) sku gsum dgongs 'dus cha lags tshogs glu dbyar rnga'i sgra dbyangs/ 228-230 wa) sku gsum dgongs 'dus las/ nang sgrub rdor sems padma gsang ba'i thig le'i bdag 'jug gi cho ga dngos grub 'dod 'jo/ 231-247 zha) sku gsum dgongs 'dus las: gsang sgrub rdo rje sems dpa'i sgo nas gnas 'dren lcags kyu rnon po/

248-277 za) sku dgongs nang sgrub rdor sems padma gsang thig gi gnas 'dren zur 'debs mthong ba don gsal/ 278-297 'a) gnas 'dren skabs rgyas par 'dod yon lnga so sor bsngo ba/ 298-301 ya) sku gsum dgongs 'dus las/ nang sgrub rdor sems gnas 'dren bsdus pa thar lam myur 'byin/ 302-324 ra) rdor sems sogs sbyong byed kyi lha gang la'ang sbyar chog pa'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga zla ba'i 'od zer/ 325-354 la) sku gsum dgongs 'dus la: gu ru ratna thod phreng rtsal gyi sgos dbang*/ 355-358 sha) sku gsum dgongs 'dus las/ sgos sgrub thod phreng sde lnga'i spyi ching sngon rjes mtshams sbyar/ 359-370 sa) sku gsum dgongs 'dus la: gu ru ratna thod phreng rtsal gyi sgos sgrub/ 371-378 ha) sku gsum dgongs 'dus las: gu ru ratna thod phreng rtsal gyi g.yang sgrub nor bu 'od 'bar/ 379-414 a) g.yang gi sgo 'byed gser skyems/ 415-415 ki) sku gsum dgongs 'dus las/ ratna thod phreng rtsal gyi sgo nas bkra shis gter bum sgrub pa'i man ngag 'dod rgu kun 'byung*/ 416-446 khu) sku gsum dgongs 'dus las: padma thod phreng rtsal gyi sgos dbang*/ 447-449 ge) sku gsum dgongs 'dus la: padma thod phreng rtsal gyi sgos sgrub dang 'brel ba'i las sbyor dbang gi me mchod/ 450-453 ngo) padma thod phreng brgyud 'debs/ 454-454 ci) sku gsum dgongs 'dus las/ gu ru padma thod phreng rtsal gyi sgos sgrub khrigs chogs su bkod pa padma'i chun 'phyang*/ 455-470 chu) bla ma sku gsum dgongs 'dus las: rab gnas ye shes rab 'bar/ 471-477 je) sku gsum dgongs 'dus las: rab gnas ye shes rab 'bar gyi lhan thabs/ 478-497 ༈ gnam lcags thor bu'i skor/ nyo) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: lha mo 'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs/ 498-511 ti) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: rten dang dkyil 'khor rab gnas rdo rje'i ri bo/

512-525 thu) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: ri bstod gsas mkhar lha khang brtsegs pa'i gsol mchod bkra shis lha'i ghandho/ 526-541 de) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: gtum po khyung sham can sgrub thabs klu 'dul nag po/ 542-547 no) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: 'dzam lha dkar phyogs kyis gsur mchod/ 548-551 pi) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: dmar gsur dregs pa'i tshims byed/ 552-558 phu) dpal chen dregs pa zil gnon las/ gtor bzlog gi las rim 'grigs chags su bkod pa gnam lcags thog rgod/ 559-641 ) tshe sgrub rdo rje'i go khrab las: las byang 'ja' lus drwa ba/ 'di ma tshang*/ 648-657 bcas bzhugs so// bla ma'i thugs sku gsum dgongs 'dus las: gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i lam bzang padma'i snying po'i rgyud zhes bya ba bzhugs so: /: : rgya gar skad du: ma hā gu hya badzra ya na dha na bha dra ka mā tsitta tant+ra na maḥ bod skad du: gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i lam bzang padma'i snying po'i rgyud zhes bya ba: bcom ldan 'das snang ba mtha' yas la phyag 'tshal lo: dus gsum dus med rang snang ka dag dus: don gyi 'og min padma drwa ba ru: rang rig ston pa 'od snang mtha' yas kyis: rig rtsal ma 'gags rang gsal 'khor tshogs la: dgongs pa'i klong nas chos 'khor bskor ba'i dus: rdo rje na dā gsang ba'i tshig bstan tshe: sems dpa' padma'i spyan gyis slar zhus pa: e ma gsang chen rdo rje'i theg mchog gi: lam bzang rmad byung padma'i snying po'i rgyud: bzung ba'i tshul dang rnam grangs ji ltar lags: zhes gsol ston pa dgyes pa'i 'dzum bstan te: brjod med chos nyid rang sgras 'di skad gsungs: legs so legs so sems dpa' padma'i spyan: legs par ston to 'di ltar bzung bar gyis: rnam par gsum du yang dag shes bya ste: rgyud kyi ngo bo nges tshig dbye ba'o:

ngo bo gdod nas ti la stong gsal nyid: chos kun ye nas spros mtshan las 'das pa: ye sangs rgyas la dang po rgyu med pa: de bzhin rkyen dang tha ma thog ma med: mtha' dang dbus med zung 'jug bde chen nyid: zab zhi 'od gsal 'dus ma byas par bstan: sa ma ya: gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i lam bzang padma'i snying po'i rgyud las: rgyud kyi gleng gzhi dang ngo bo bstan pa'i le'u ste dang po'o: ྂ/: sems dpa' padma'i spyan gyis slar zhus pa: nges pa'i tshig dang dbye ba ji ltar lags: zhes gsol ston pa 'od snang mtha' yas kyis: brjod med chos nyid rang sgras 'di skad gsungs: don la gzung 'dzin 'khrul pa las 'das kyang : gzhi snang ma 'gags thugs rje'i 'char tshul las: ma rig gnyis 'dzin 'khrul dbang 'khor bar 'khyams: de ldog slad du bskyed dang rdzogs pa'i tshul: snang stong thabs shes gnyis su med par nges: dbye ba sku dang gsung dang thugs yon tan: phrin las lnga sogs ye shes klong dgur dbye: sgrub thabs yan lag lo 'dab me 'bras tshul: chos nyid don la tha dad ma mchis kyang : chos can ma 'gags theg pa rim pa dgu: ma nges gdul bya'i blo dang 'tshams pa yi: gang 'dul sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i 'khor lo ni: sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs rje tshad med phyir: byung dang 'byung gyur don du yang dag ston: sa ma ya: gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i lam bzang padma'i snying po'i rgyud las: rgyud kyis nges tshig dang dbye ba bstan pa'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o: ྂ/: sems dpa' padma'i spyan gyis slar zhus pa: rgyud kyi rtsa ba sdong po ji ltar 'dzin: zhes gsol ston pa 'od snang mtha' yas kyis: brjod med chos nyid rang sgras 'di skad gsungs: rdo rje theg pa'i rtsa ba dbang la 'dzin: dbang ma thob la dngos grub skal pa dben: dngos grub rtsa ba bla ma spyi bor 'dzin: bla ma ma bsten sangs rgyas gang ma byon: gsang sngags lta sgom dag pa'i slob dpon gyis:

slob ma'i snod brtag nga rgyal chung ba dang : dad brtson shes rab snying rje blo stobs ldan: rgyud drang ngang 'jam blo brtan gsang ba'i snod: thun mong blo sbyangs thun min lam mchog gi: rtsa ba skyabs su 'gro ba'i gzhi bzung ste: smon 'jug byang chub sems kyi bslab bya dang : phyi nang sngags kyi rtsa ba sku gsung thugs: ma hā gu hya sa ma ya 'bum gyi: dam tshig gnad bsgrags sdom gsum yang dag snod: phyi nang phan nus dbang dang dbang bzhi'i bcud: sbyong ba'i skabs thob so sor sbyin pas smin: sa ma ya: gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i lam bzang padma'i snying po'i rgyud las: lam gyi rtsa ba dbang gis slob ma rjes su 'dzin par bstan pa'i le'u ste gsum pa'o: ྂ/: sems dpa' padma'i spyan gyis slar zhus pa: grol byed lam gyi bgrod tshul ji ltar 'dzin: zhes gsol ston pa 'od snang mtha' yas kyis: brjod med chos nyid rang sgras 'di skad gsung : bum dbang rjes 'brel ma hā yo gar bstan: de yang rtsa ba dang ni yan lag go: dang po rtsa ba sdong po lta bu ni: ngo bo dri med mkha' ltar dag pa las: rang bzhin gzhi snang dbang po'i gzhu ltar bkra: thugs rje'i kun khyab nyi zla'i dpal bzhin du: ye shes sku gsum lhun grub chen po ste: chos sku skye med stong pa snang mtha' yas: rtsal snang ma 'gag longs sku snying rje'i lha: zung 'jug sprul sku rang byung padma skyes: tshogs brgyad rnam dag sgyu 'phrul tshom bu brgyad: rigs drug dong sprugs sprul pa'i gu ru drug: mi rtogs bde chen rdo rje he ru kaḥ spyi dpal dbang chen rta skad dbyangs su len: khams gsum dbang sdud ma mo bran du bkol: mi gnas shes rab phag mo yum dang sbyor: bde ba chen po byang chub sems kyi sprin: bdun brgya nyer lnga 'khor lo lnga ru sdom: sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i bkod pa bsam yas pa: dag rdzogs smin pa'i phyag rgyar yang dag shar:

yul gsum gyad gyur rtsa ba'i rig pa sngags: oṃ a mi dhe wa hrīḥ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas dgongs pa'o: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐: longs sku thugs rje chen po'i dgongs pa'o: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma siddhi hūm̐: sprul sku padma 'byung gnas dgongs pa'o: oṃ āḥm hā gu ru birya sarba siddhi hūm̐: rdo rje'i rig 'dzin rnams kyi dgongs pa'o: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru buddha badzra ratna padma karma thod phreng rtsal badzra sa ma ya dzaḥ siddhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ rigs mchog thod phreng sde lnga'i dgongs pa'o: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu hya dzñā na shrī badzra kro ta ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐ phaṭḥ zhi khro sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i dgongs pa'o: hrīḥm ha ri ni sa ra tsa hri ya tsitta hriṃ hriṃ dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ 'jig rten 'das dang ma 'das srid pa yi: pho rgyud mo rgyud kun gyi srog snying ngo : gang gis bzlas pas sangs rgyas 'grub par byed: dus gsum rgyal bas dbang bskur byin brlab zhing : las dang nyon mongs shes bya'i sgrib kun 'byang : ma lus mchog dang thun mong dngos grub 'thob: las bzhi'i phrin las rab 'byams thogs pa med: sa ma ya: gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i lam bzang padma'i snying po'i rgyud las: rtsa rgyud sdong po lta bu'i nges don dang snying po bstan pa'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o: ྂ/: sems dpa' padma'i spyan gyis slar zhus pa: ma 'dres so sor dbye ba'i nges don dang : rang rang sgrub pa'i snying po ji ltar 'dzin: zhes gsol ston pa 'od snang mtha' yas kyis: brjod med chos nyid rang sgras 'di skad gsungs: oṃ: chos rnams mnyam nyid ye shes klong yangs las: rin chen khros pas nga rgyal dbyings su gcod: gzung 'dzin dregs pa dbyings su bsgral ba las: gnyis su med pa'i ye shes gcig tu rdzogs: 'jam dpal gzhon nu mnyam pa nyid kyi sku: ngo bo ka dag spros pa'i mtha' dang bral:

rang bzhin lhun grub gang gis 'dus ma byas: thugs rje'i cho 'phrul sna tshogs mkha' dang mnyam: sku gsum dbyer med rig stong rjen pa las: chos zhes gzhan med thig le nyag gcig ste: klong las ma g.yos skye ba med pa las: skye ba'i cho 'phrul srid zhi'i rtsal snang la: bdag 'dzin 'khrul pa lu gu rgyud du 'khor: bde sdug bsam yas sangs rgyas sems can snang : dbyings kyi cho 'phrul dbyings la bzang ngan med: rtsol bas ma byas lhun grub ngo mtshar che: rgyu 'bras las 'das blang don chos las 'das: mnyam nyid don la mnyam par ma rtogs pas: gzung 'dzin a 'thas bag chags brtas pa las: nga rgyal rang rgyud gshin rje'i tshogs rnams kun: dbyings su 'joms mdzad bcom ldan 'jam dpal dbyangs: srid gsum za byed tshe bdag he ru kaḥ ya manta ka gshin rje gshed chen po: 'khor 'das kun khyab sgyu 'phrul drwa bar snang : rdo rje'i phung khams rgyal ba rtag pa ste: ye shes sku can sku mchog 'jam dpal gyi: gnyis med 'khor lo snang stong lhun gyis rdzogs: yum gsum gyad gyur rtsa ba'i rig pa sngags: oṃ ka ya manta ka ha na ma tha bhandha hūm̐ phaṭḥ 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed kyi dgongs pa 'di: bzlas pas snang srid dregs pa dbyings su 'joms: 'jam dpal ye shes gzhon nu mngon du gyur: sa ma ya: gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i lam bzang padma'i snying po'i rgyud las: 'jam dpal sku'i rgyud kyi nges don dang snying po bstan pa'i le'u ste lnga pa'o: ྂ/: sems dpa' padma'i spyan gyis slar zhus pa: de bzhin padma'i rigs mchog ji ltar 'dzin: zhes gsol ston pa 'od snang mtha' yas kyis: brjod med chos nyid rang sgras 'di skad gsungs: hrīḥ chos rnams sor rtogs ye shes klong yangs las: padma khros pas 'dod chags dbyings su gcod: gzung 'dzin dregs pa dbang du bsdus pa las: gnyis su med pa'i ye shes gcig tu rdzogs:

padma dbang chen rta skad dbyangs su len: snang stong zung 'jug nyag gcig thig le'i klong : mi 'gyur rig stong chos kun mnyam par rdzogs: g.yo med don gyi ye shes ma rtogs nas: gzung 'dzin snang char zhen pa'i 'gro ba rnams: sgrol phyir theg pa kun las myur ba'i lam: dbang chen rta mchog rgyal po'i myur 'gros kyis: rta skad thengs gcig sgrog pas chos so cog: gnyis med bde ba chen po'i dbyings su rdzogs: bde chen klong du chos rnams dbang du bsdus: 'dod pa'i yon tan ma spangs rol bzhin du: yang dag sangs rgyas chags med padma'i rigs: rta mgrin dbyangs glus ḍā ka ḍā ki bsdud: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub rgya mtsho 'gugs: tshad med thugs rjes rgyal kun phrin las bskul: thugs rje chags pas 'gro khams dbyings su sdud: ngag rlung 'gro 'ong rta bzhad nā da'i sgras: ma lus theg pa'i chos sgo mtha' yas 'byed: ma chags chags bral bde chen dbang gi rgyal: sgyu 'phrul drwa ba bde ba'i 'khor lor rdzogs: yul gsum gyad gyur rtsa ba'i rig pa sngags: oṃ padmanta kri ta hya ghṛ wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭḥ rta mchog he ru ka yi dgongs pa 'di: bzlas pas sa lam rta mchog 'gros ltar myur: snang srid dbang sdud dngos grub thogs med 'thob: sa ma ya: gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i lam bzang padma'i snying po'i rgyud las: padma gsung gi rgyud kyi nges don dang snying po bstan pa'i le'u ste drag pa'o: ྂ/: sems dpa' padma'i spyan gyis slar zhus pa: de bzhin yang dag thugs mchog ji ltar 'dzin: zhes gsol ston pa 'od snang mtha' yas kyis: brjod med chos nyid rang sgras 'di skad gsungs: hūm̐: chos rnams me long ye shes klong yangs las: rdo rje khros pas zhe sdang dbyings su gcod: gzung 'dzin rtog tshogs dbyings su bsgral ba las: gnyis su med pa'i ye shes gcig tu rdzogs: yang dag sangs rgyas sgrub pa gcig pu nyid:

yang gsang sangs rgyas bde chen kun 'dus pa: mkha' 'gro sgyu ma bde mchog zhes bya ba: chos sku de bzhin nyid dbyings ti la kaḥ longs sku'i rol rtsal ye shes sgyu ma'i tshul: sprul sku yang dag thugs kyi dkyil 'khor rdzogs: sangs rgyas sems can mnyam sbyor bde chen nyid: srid zhi kun khyab rtag pa de kho na: chos dbyings rnam dag rang byung ye shes che: thams cad gnyis med mnyam pa gcig pu ru: bde chen klong 'dir chos kun dbyings su rdzogs: byang chub sems la skye 'chi ye nas bral: gzung 'dzin ka dag mi bskyod rdo rje'i thugs: brjod bya'i yul 'das rang bzhin bab gyi ngang : grwa zur gnyis med thig le chen por bzlum: yang dag rdo rje thugs kyi dkyil 'khor pa: byang sems thabs shes gsang gsum phyag rgya bzhi: ye lnga phyin drug kha sbyor yan lag bdun: 'phags lam theg dgu dbang stobs sa bcu gcig: la sogs mtshon pa'i sgyu 'phrul drwa ba rdzogs: yul gsum gyad gyur rtsa ba'i rig pa sngags: oṃ shrī he ru ka ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐: yang dag he ru ka yi dgongs pa 'di: bzlas pas sgrib 'byang phung po lhag med 'grub: mchog gi dngos grub tshe 'dir dka' ba med: sa ma ya: gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i lam bzang padma'i snying po'i rgyud las: yang dag thugs kyi rgyud kyi nges don dang snying po bstan pa'i le'u ste bdun pa'o: ྂ/: sems dpa' padma'i spyan gyis slar zhus pa: de bzhin bdud rtsi yon tan ji ltar 'dzin: zhes gsol ston pa 'od snang mtha' yas kyis: brjod med chos nyid rang sgras 'di skad gsungs: swāḥ oṃ: chos rnams chos dbyings ye shes klong yangs las: sangs rgyas khros pas gti mug dbyings su gcod: gzung 'dzin rtog tshogs dbyings su bsgral ba las: gnyis su med pa'i ye shes gcig tu rdzogs: bya byed yid chos rnam dag kun tu bzang : yab yum gnyis med ye nas mnyam par sbyor:

spros med byang chub snying po'i dkyil 'khor pa: zhi khro rab 'byams 'dus pa'i spyi dpal che: kun bzang he ru ka yi dgongs pa ni: mnyam nyid don rtogs thams cad bdud rtsi che: ye sangs rgyas la sdug bsngal ming med kyang : 'khrul dbang 'gro rnams sdug bsngal rgya mtshor bying : thabs mkhas thugs rjes 'brel ba'i rgyal kun gyis: rnam rtog nad rnams bsal ba'i dam chos sman: chos sgo rab 'byams phan bde'i gsos gyur kyang : ches cher yang dag don gyi bdud rtsi ni: mnyam nyid rdzogs chen ngang du chos kun rdzogs: gtsang sme bzang ngan blang dor med par mnyam: yang dag don gyi bdud rtsi'i don mthong na: bdud rtsir ma gyur chos gzhan ga la srid: de tshe bde chen ye shes rtsis thebs pas: dug lnga 'byung lnga phung lnga dbang po lnga: sman lnga la sogs ye shes lnga dang ldan: sgo gsum rnam dag zag bcas 'od kyi skur: rab smin rdo rje nyi ma bdud rtsir 'char: snang srid rnam dag bde chen ye shes che'i: rang bzhin dkyil 'khor gsum gyi phyag rgyar rdzogs: yul gsum gyad gyur rtsa ba'i rig pa sngags: oṃ sarba ma hā shrī he ru ka hūm̐: che mchog he ru ka yi dgongs pa 'di: bzlas pas bde chen ye shes mngon 'gyur nas: sku lnga ye shes lhun gyis 'grub par 'gyur: sa ma ya: gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i lam bzang padma'i snying po'i rgyud las: yon tan bdud rtsi'i rgyud kyi nges don dang snying po bstan pa'i le'u ste brgyad pa'o: ྂ/: sems dpa padma'i spyan gyis slar zhus pa: de bzhin phrin las phur pa ji ltar 'dzin: zhes gsol ston pa 'od snang mtha' yas kyis: brjod med chos nyid rang sgras 'di skad gsungs: hāḥ chos rnams bya grub ye shes klong yangs las: phrin las khros pas phrag dog dbyings su gcod: bdag 'dzin bdud bzhi dbyings su bsgral ba las: gnyis su med pa'i ye shes gcig tu rdzogs:

dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi dgongs pa'i dbyings: ma bcos ngang nyid rdo rje chos dbyings las: ye shes 'bar ba'i khro bo mi zad pa: ma hā shrī badzra ku ma ra: de kho na yi nyid dbyings rdzogs pa che: rig pa byang chub sems kyi phur pa nyid: mi phyed rdo rje gzhon nu bgres rgud bral: bde gshegs snying pos khyab pa'i 'gro rgyud la: chos nyid rgyun tu bzhugs par ma shes pas: 'khrul dbang spyod pa'i sna tshogs gdul bya'i ngor: thabs mkhas spyod pa'i 'gro ba kun don du: byams dang snying rje gang la gang 'dul bas: dus gsum sangs rgyas phrin las rab rdzogs pa'i: srid pa rdo rje phur bzhi'i dgongs pa nyid: yul dus gnas skabs so sor rgyas theb tshe: phrin las rta rgyal rdo rje thal 'byin no: gnyis med phyag rgyas gdul dka'i srog 'phrog cing : mkha' gsang bde chen byang chub sems kyi sprin: sras mchog khro bcu za gsod pho nya'i tshogs: srid gsum sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i 'khor lor rdzogs: yul gsum gyad gyur rtsa ba'i rig pa sngags: oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya sarba bighnān baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ dzaḥhūm̐ āḥ dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i dgongs pa 'di: bzlas pas rno dbal thal 'byin rnam pa bzhis: don gnyis mthar phyin sku bzhi mngon du 'gyur: sa ma ya: gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i lam bzang padma'i snying po'i rgyud las: phrin las phur pa'i rgyud kyi nges don dang snying po bstan pa'i le'u ste dgu pa'o: ྂ/: sems dpa' padma'i spyan gyis slar zhus pa: de bzhin ma mo rbod gtong ji ltar 'dzin: zhes gsol ston pa 'od snang mtha' yas kyis: brjod med chos nyid rang sgras 'di skad gsungs: bhyoḥ chos rnams klong gyur ye shes klong yangs las: padma khros pas 'dod chags dbyings su gcod: gzung 'dzin 'khrul snang dbyings su bsgral ba las: gnyis su med pa'i ye shes gcig tu rdzogs: don la rang byung byang chub sems nyid las:

ma g.yos mi g.yo g.yos par mi 'gyur bas: bde chen btsun mo'i bha ga'i klong chen las: g.yos pa ltar snang ma rig las rlung gis: phyi yi bkod pa snod kyi 'jig rten dang : nang ltar phung po'i rtsa rlung thig le'i 'gros: rten 'brel bslu med 'khor 'das lam gsum chos: bde sdug sna tshogs bden med sgyu ma'i tshul: yum lnga'i mkha' las cir yang 'char ba ni: srid pa spyi 'gros dbang chen ma mo zhes: de brten ye shes las dang 'jig rten gyi: phrin las rab 'byams thogs med sgrub pa'i mthu: phra rags phyi nang rtsa rlung thig le'i 'gros: gang zhig rlung sems rang dbang thob pa'i tshe: ma mo mkha' 'gro'i srog la rang dbang 'thob: chos rnams zung 'jug byang chub sems kyi klong : las rlung dbu mar tshud pa'i rten 'brel gyis: 'jig rten dregs pa phyi yi ma mo dang : sde brgyad dregs pa'i tshogs kyang bran du bkol: bskyed 'jig bsad gso la sogs las rab 'byams: thogs pa med par ma mo'i phrin las myur: rtsa rlung thig le rnam par dag pa'i dbyings: rang shar ma mo mngon rdzogs rgyal mo zhes: nyid bzhi bde mchog mu kha le chen mo'i: sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las lnga'i: sgyu 'phrul drwa ba gdod nas rdzogs par shar: phul gsum gyad gyur rtsa ba'i rig pa sngags: oṃ ma mo yo gi ni gu hya hūm̐: oṃ gu hya dzñā na shrī he ru ka gu hye dzñā na kro ti shwa ri satwaṃ ma ma yo gi ni ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐: ma mo mngon rdzogs rgyal mo'i dgongs pa 'di: bzlas pas rlung sems snang ba dbu mar thim: bde chen mngon gyur phrin las thogs med 'grub: sa ma ya: gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i lam bzang padma'i snying po'i rgyud las: ma mo mngon rdzogs rgyal mo'i rgyud kyi nges don dang snying po bstan pa'i le'u ste bcu pa'o: ྂ/: sems dpa' padma'i spyan gyis slar zhus pa: de bzhin 'jig rten mchod bstod ji ltar 'dzin:

zhes gsol ston pa 'od snang mtha' yas kyis: brjod med chos nyid rang sgras 'di skad gsungs: hūm̐: chos rnams dbyings grol ye shes klong yangs las: rdo rje khros pas zhe sdang dbyings su gcod: gzung 'dzin rtog tshogs dbyings su bsgral ba las: gnyis su med pa'i shes gcig tu rdzogs: rags pa khu rdul las rlung g.yo ba'i khams: g.yo med thig le'i dbyings su thim pa las: kun rtog gzung 'dzin gnyis snang 'khrul pa'i sems: gnyis med mnyam nyid mi shigs thig le'i sku: sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs mchog bla na med: bcom ldan dpal chen dregs pa kun 'dus zhal: de don ma mthong srid na dbang ldan pa'i: snang srid dregs pa'i sde dpon chen po rnams: mchod cing bstod tshe legs nyes stangs 'dzin cing : bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor kun gyi grogs: bstan pa bshig pa'i dam nyams kun gyi gshed: 'bod rbad myur mgyogs stobs tshe chos nyid de: ye shes las dang dregs pa'i tshul snang yang : don la sems las 'das pa'i chos med pas: sems nyid dag na dregs pa rang dbang 'gyur: lha 'dre gnyis 'dzin sems kyi cho 'phrul te: de phyir snang srid lha ma srin zhes pa'i: ya ma zung gi ming tshig gis mtshon te: chu snod dwangs mar zla ba'i bzhin ras ltar: rten 'brel bslu med sgyu ma lta bu ste: raksha srin po phyi nang sde brgyad tshogs: rol rtsal ma 'gags dregs pa'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs: yul gsum gyad gyur rtsa ba'i rig pa sngags: oṃ badzra tsand+ra sarba duṣṭaṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ aḥyaḥmaḥduḥruḥtsaḥshaḥnaḥhūm̐ phaṭḥ bzlas pas snang srid dregs pa dbang du bsdus: mngon spyod la sogs phrin las thogs pa med: sa ma ya: gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i lam bzang padma'i snying po'i rgyud las: mchod bstod dregs pa'i rgyud kyi nges don dang snying po bstan pa'i le'u ste bcu gcig pa'o: ྂ/: sems dpa' padma'i spyan gyis slar zhus pa:

de bzhin dmod pa drag sngags ji ltar 'dzin: zhes gsol ston pa 'od snang mtha' yas kyis: brjod med chos nyid rang sgras 'di skad gsungs: eḥ chos rnams mtha' grol ye shes klong yangs las: rin chen khros pas nga rgyal dbyings su gcod: gzung 'dzin rtog tshogs dbyings su bsgral ba las: gnyis su med pa'i ye shes gcig tu rdzogs: phyi ltar rnam rtog 'khrul pa'i dgra bo dang : nang ltar las rlung gyis dkrugs nyon mongs tshogs: mnyam nyid 'od gsal dbyings su gsod pa yis: sgyu rtsal mtshon chen rab rnon dmod pa'i dbal: drag sngags bdag po stobs ldan nag po'i zhal: mngon sum mjal te rnam rtog dgra sod tshe: srid pa gsum gyi dgra sde dus gcig sod: rtsa ba sems las ma byung chos med pas: sems byung rtsa ba chod tshe 'khor 'das kyi: stong srog thob pas snang srid bran du bkos: de don ma rtogs 'jig rten srid pa na: rtogs pa'i gdeng dang snying rje'i thabs bral bas: lha dang drag srong rig sngags mthu che yang : rgyu 'bras bslu med srid pa'i duḥkha bskyed: 'od gsal rdzogs chen lta ba'i gdeng ldan tshe: nga rgyal gnas dag gtum chen e dbyings su: sgrol ba med de khams gsum dbyings bsgral bas: sgrol ba'i rgyal po dpal chen stobs ldan nag: sde dpon sum cu pho nya'i dkyil 'khor pa: phas rgol bud shing bsreg pa'i me chen spar: yul gsum gyad gyur rtsa ba'i rig pa sngags: oṃ badzra sarba duṣṭaṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ sarba duṣṭaṃ eḥdzā bhyoḥ dpal chen stobs ldan nag po'i dgongs pa 'di: bzlas pas srid gsum gdug pa dbyings su sod: mchog gi he ru ka dpal mngon du byed: sa ma ya: gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i lam bzang padma'i snying po'i rgyud las: dmod pa drag sngags 'bar ba'i rgyud gyi nges don dang snying po bstan pa'i le'u ste bcu gnyis pa'o: ྂ/: sems dpa' padma'i spyan gyis slar zhus pa:

bskyed rdzogs lam gyi sngon 'gro ji ltar 'dzin: zhes gsol ston pa 'od snang mtha' yas kyis: brjod med chos nyid rang sgras 'di skad gsungs: bum pa'i dbang nod dam tshig la gnas pa'i: ri rtse gangs khrod mtsho gling nags tshal ljongs: dur khrod la sogs rab dben bkra shis gnas: bzang por bse ru lta bur rang gcig pus: thun mong blo sbyong nges shes lam du long : kye ma hoḥ srid 'dir rnyed dka'i snying po dal 'byor rten: cis kyang mi rtag srid pa'i chos nyid de: stong log pha rol 'gro ba shin tu blun: dkar nag las 'bras bslu ba med pa'i phyir: so sor smin phyir blang dor ma nor gces: srid na srid pa'i sdug bsngal kun 'byung dang : 'gog pa lam gyi bden pa rnam pa bzhis: thun mong dang ni thun min lam mchog gi: rtsa ba rnam gsum skyabs 'gro sems gnyis bskyed: bla ma'i ngo bo rdor sems spyi bor sgom: gnyen po stobs bzhi'i bshags sdom yang dag gnad: sku gsum maṇḍal tshogs gnyis rdzogs par spel: byin rlabs lam byed bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsnyen: rtsa ba dad mos drag pos thugs rgyud bskul: lam dbang yang yang len pa srog ltar gces: thugs yid bsres pas rang sems bla mar mjal: shin tu nye lam sa lam dus gcig chod: gcig shes kun grol rig pa gcig char par: lam gzhan mi ltos lam mchog 'di yis 'tsheng : gang zag rim gyis pa la spros par bshad: bskyed rdzogs gang gi'ang sngon 'gro 'di med tshe: bris pa rmang bral mkhar las lta bu'o: sa ma ya: gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i lam bzang padma'i snying po'i rgyud las: bskyed rdzogs sngon 'gro bstan pa'i le'u ste bcu gsum pa'o: ྂ/: sems dpa' padma'i spyan gyis slar zhus pa: bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug lam rim ji ltar 'dzin: zhes gsol ston pa 'od snang mtha' yas kyis: brjod med chos nyid rang sgras 'di skad gsungs: ting 'dzin rnam gsum dag pas khog phub ste:

mngon byang lnga yis dam tshig 'khor lo bskyed: ye shes 'gugs bstim mchod cing sgyu mar bstod: nyin zhag phrag rer thun bzhir cha bgos pa'i: dang po lha sku'i gsal snang tshad du 'don: gnyis par rang bzhin dag pa'i phyag rgyas btab: gsum pa zung 'jug dbyer med nga rgyal bstan: bzhi par bskyed rdzogs dbyer med dngos gzhir 'bad: sgra bcas sgra med rtsa ba'i bzlas pa dang : lus sbyong rnam bzhi dag pa'i 'khrul 'khor bskor: ngag sbyong rdo rje gsum gyi bzlas pa dang : yid sbyong phyi dang nang dang gsang ba yi: stong ra la gnas srog gi rtsol ba ni: kha sbyor bum can rlung gi rnal 'byor gyis: yas bab mas brtan bde chen 'bar 'dzag gis: dga' bzhi'i ye shes bde drod rab tu spel: mthar thug rim bsdu nā da chos skur blta: rjes thob ltar snang mtha' gnyis dri ma bsal: 'byongs bas phyi nang yon tan brjod las 'das: lus kyi las dang rtsa yi sgrib pa dag: dang por skal mnyam rnam smin rig 'dzin brnyes: phrin las zhi ba 'bras bu sprul sku thob: sa ma ya: gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i lam bzang padma'i snying po'i rgyud las: bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug gi lam rim bstan pa'i le'u ste bcu bzhi pa'o: ྂ/: sems dpa' padma'i spyan gyis slar zhus pa: gsang dbang lam gyi sbyong tshul ji ltar 'dzin: zhes gsol ston pa 'od snang mtha' yas kyis: brjod nyid chos nyid rang sgras 'di skad gsungs: gnyis pa'i lam sbyong a nu yo gar bstan: dri med pad dkar bzhad pa lta bu ste: 'khor ba'i gdams kyis nam yang ma gos pa: nyon mongs ma spangs ye shes lam du khyer: bde gsal stong pa dbyer med zung 'jug che: lus kyi 'khrul 'khor dag pa'i rlung sbyor bcas: rang lus thabs ldan yid kyis phyag rgya mar: e waṃ mnyam sbyor byang sems 'bar 'dzag gis: yas mas bab bzung ldog 'dren dgram pa yis: bde stong dga' bzhi'i ye shes lam du bya:

rtsal 'byongs phyi nang yon tan brjod las 'das: ngag gi las dang rlung gi sgrib pa dag: brgyad par skal mnyam tshe dbang rig 'dzin brnyes: phrin las rgyas pa 'bras bu longs sku thob: sa ma ya: gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i lam bzang padma'i snying po'i rgyud las: lung a nu yo ga'i nyams len bstan pa'i le'u ste bco lnga pa'o: ྂ/: sems dpa' padma'i spyan gyis slar zhus pa: gsang dbang lam gyi sbyong tshul ji ltar 'dzin: zhes gsol ston pa 'od snang mtha' yas kyis: brjod med chos nyid rang sgras 'di skad gsung : gsum pa'i lam mchog thugs kyis rdo rjer bstan: sgyu ma mkhan gyi rdzas sngags lta bu ste: med bzhin sna tshogs gzugs su ston pa ltar: khams gsum sems can bde chen yang dag snang : bde mchog rgyal po phyag rgya'i padmor gnas: bcud 'gugs pas ni bde chen yang dag gsal: ma ni padma can mchog sring mo ni: dung can mar grags bu mo ri dwags can: snag gi gnyen mtshams glang sna bran mor bshad: ri mo can dang rnam pa lnga ru shes: dug sman nor bas nyen che thabs kyis brtags: rang rang rigs ldan rdzas sngags thabs kyis dbang : thun mong thun min lam zhugs gnyis ka'i rgyud: rab sbyang ting 'dzin las su rung ba na: ā ma kwa yi nga rgyal mchog bstan pas: rtsa dang rlung gis 'khrul 'khor yang dag sbyangs: sha lnga bdud rtsi rab bza' khams gso spel: dben par 'o byed pas ni dga' byas la: 'khyud pas bde chen don la yang dag bskul: rab tu chags pa'i glu yis sil snyan sbyor: bung ba padmar brtses tshul rdo rje ni: bdud rtsi'i rab tu gtam pa ā ra li: ji ltar rus sbal 'gros kyi dal bar bsrubs: ngal bso pa dang yang yang bskyal byas la: mkha' gsang e dang haṃ yig gis mtshan pa: padma badzra yang dag shes bya ste: sems can don la rjes su rab chags pas: bzod med chags pa'i me chen rab tu sbar: khams g.yos pa na mi g.yo sems bzung ste:

yas 'bebs gnas bzhir dga' bzhi'i don la blta: ma ṇi'i rtser son dbab bskyel mnyam par bzhag: rmad byung bde 'phel rtog tshogs rags pa thim: de tshe rlung gi gzhu la ting 'dzin mda': hūm̐ gdangs rgyud dang lus kyi 'khrul 'khor gyis: dwangs ma skad cig gyen la drangs shing 'gram: bde mchog bde chen haṃ dang mi phyed pas: sum bcu rtsa gnyis dga' chen de kho na: yang dag rdzogs pa'i rtog tshogs phra ba thim: yang dag sangs rgyas ye shes mtshon byed pa: lhan cig skyes 'chang snyigs ma dwangs mas phug: rags lus 'ja' tshon ltar snang 'byongs ba yis: yid kyi las dang thig le'i sgrib pa 'dag: bcu par skal mnyam phyag rgya'i rig 'dzin brnyes: phrin las dbang dang 'bras bu chos sku thob: sa ma ya: gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i lam bzang padma'i snying po'i rgyud las pho nya bde ba chen po'i chags lam gyi nyams len yang gsang gud du sbas pa'i le'u ste bcu drug pa'o: ྂ/: sems dpa' padma'i spyan gyis slar zhus pa: ka dag tshig dbang lam sbyong ji ltar 'dzin: zhes gsol ston pa 'od snang mtha' yas kyis: brjod med chos nyid rang sgras 'di skad gsungs: aḥ rtsol med rdzogs chen a ti yo ga ni: rtsa sdong yal ga lo 'dab rab rdzogs rtser: don dam snying po 'bras bu'i tshul du ston: ye thog dang po 'khor 'das mnyam brdal dus: kun tu bzang po ma bsgoms grol tshul dang : sems can las ma bsags par 'khrul ba'i tshul: rang gi ngo bo rig dang ma rig khyad: nyi ma'i 'od kyis shel 'od phyir gsal ltar: srog rlung gis bskyod rig pa'i ye shes nyid: gzhon nu bum sku'i sbubs nas rgya ral te: lhun grub 'od gsal sku dang ye shes rgyas: kun bzang rang snang mkhyen de skad cig de: phyi gsal ye shes nang thim gzhir sangs rgyas: sems can ngo ma shes par dran med 'thom: lhan skyes ma rig pa ni de dus byung : gzhi snang 'od gsal nyid la gnyis 'dzin gyi:

rtog pa skyes pas kun brtags ma rig byung : de gnyis 'gro kun 'khrul gzhi smag chen mthug: gnyis 'dzin sbug tshud bag chags rim gyis brtas: dug lnga dug gsum brgyad khri bzhi stong rgyas: rten 'brel bcu gnyis srid pa'i 'khor lo la: zon chu'i 'khyud mo bzhin du da bar 'khor: 'khrul ba'i rang mtshang mngon sum ma mthong na: 'khrul nas yun ring shin tu gom brtan 'thus: 'khrul snang rdzun phug phud par ga la 'gyur: mig ldir rkyen gyi nam mkhar sprin mthong dang : mkhris nad can gyis dung dkar ser snang bzhin: nam yang dri med rig pa'i zhal mi mjal: snang srid 'khor 'das chos rnams sems kyi klong : sems kyi rol rtsal phra rag tshogs drug yul: snang ba'i chos kun bden par ma grub pa: sgyu ma lta bu'i ngang tshul rtogs pa gnad: sa ma ya: gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i lam bzang padma'i snying po rgyud las: rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i khregs chod lta ba'i grol 'khrul gyi sa mtshams bstan pa'i le'u ste bcu bdun pa'o: ྂ/: sems dpa' padma'i snying pos slar zhus pa: khregs chod lta ba dngos gzhi gang ltar 'dzin: zhes gsol ston pa 'od snang mtha' yas kyis: brjod med chos nyid rang sgras 'di skad gsungs: aḥ da lta'i shes pa ma bcos sa le ba: wa le ye re smra bsam brjod yul bral: rgya mtsho'i klong nas nor bu rnyed pa bzhin: bsal stong dbyer med nam mkha' g.ya' dag ltar: gcer gyis bltas pas rig pa rjen par mthong : blta bya lta byed med pa lta ba'i gnad: gang yang mthong rgyu med pa mthong ba'i mchog: bu khyod ka dag rig pa mthong ba'o: rig pa nyag gcig dbyings su sku lnga dang : ye shes lnga dang rigs lnga lhun gyis grub: mchog gsum rtsa gsum sku gsum ye nas rdzogs: nyi gzhon 'od kyis khri mun bcom pa bzhin: rig stong ngang bskyang thog med bsags pa'i sdig: rang bzhin ma grub skad cig nyid la 'dag:

sdong po'i rtsar bcad lo 'dab mnyam skam bzhin: sems kyi rtsal chod nyon tshogs brgyad khri 'joms: gangs gnas gdong lngas sder chags zil gnon bzhin: mtha' yas phyi nang grub mtha' zil gyis gnon: rgya mtsho chen por chu klung kun 'dus bzhin: brgyad khri bzhi stong chos kun de nyid rtogs: nam mkha'i klong la mtha' dbus med pa bzhin: sems kyi 'od gsal 'khor 'das kun la brdal: shel gong 'od la phyi nang med pa bzhin: zang ma thal byung ka dag rig pa'i mdangs: lta bas thag bcad sgom pas nyams su blang : spyod pas 'phreng bsal 'bras bu mngon du bya: a ti'i mchog tu mi 'gyur bde chen nyid: ka dag dri med rig pa kun tu bzang : ngo bo ye nas spros pa kun dang bral: rang bzhin ma 'gag 'od gsal sa le ba: thugs rje'i kun khyab phyogs lhung ris su med: gsal stong zung 'jug rig stong rjen pa'i gshis: da lta'i tha mal shes pa blo bral 'di: sku gsum lhun grub dgongs pa mthar thug pa: don dam cha la bla ma yi dam dang : mkha' 'gro chos skyong ngo bo 'di kar gnas: rdzogs sangs rgyas tshe bzang du ma song ba: sems can 'khrul bas ngan du ma song ba: bzang ngan las 'das kun tu bzang po'i zhal: mngon sum mjal ba 'di las gzhan du med: sa ma ya: gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i lam bzang padma'i snying po'i rgyud las: rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i khregs chod rig pa gcer mthong gi lta ba ngo sprod bstan pa'i le'u ste bco brgyad pa'o: ྂ/: sems dpa' padma'i spyan gyis slar zhus pa: lam du long ba sgom tshul ji ltar 'dzin: zhes gsol ston pa 'od snang mtha' yas kyis: brjod med chos nyid rang sgras 'di skad gsungs: aḥ ye nas rang byung rang bab rang shar las: bcos ma'i sgom rtsol rdzogs chen sa la ring : ma bcos de gar lhod bzhag lta ba'i gnad: dus gsum rtog pas ma bslad sgom pa'i gnad: bzang ngan re dogs med pa spyod pas gnad:

gnad gsum gdeng ldan dri med rig pa'i zhal: thig le nyag gcig ngang rdzogs rdzogs chen zhes: don du rang bzhin tha mal shes pa 'di'i: ngo bo rang bab skyong ba kho nas chog: gnas tshe rang gnas 'gyu ba rig pa'i rtsal: gnyis ka rig pa'i ngang du tha mi dad: gnas pa chos sku 'gyu ba longs sku'i rtsal: rig pa sprul skur ye nas lhun gyis grub: dang po'i las can bying rgod rnam rtog 'phreng : bsal bzhag med pa sgrim lhod ran pas sel: nyon mongs rtog tshogs rags pa zhi ba'i tshe: zhi gnas mgo brtsam bde gsal mi rtogs pa: nyams la zhen med bzang ngan ro snyoms gces: phra ba zhi ba'i bar du nan gyis skyong : kun tu bzang po rang rig rjen pa'i zhal: ngo shes rtsal rdzogs bstan pa thob pa'i tshe: lhag par mthong rgyu med pa'i mthong ba mchog: rig stong rjen pa'i ngang tshul ma nyams na: grub mtha' mkhas pa'i paṇa ti brgyar bgros kyang : the tshom dri ma rdul tsam ga la 'gyur: sa ma ya: gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i lam bzang padma'i snying po'i rgyud las: rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i khregs chod sgom pa med par sgom tshul bstan pa'i le'u ste bcu dgu pa'o: ྂ/: sems dpa' padma'i snying pos slar zhus pa: 'chings grol med pa'i spyod pa ji ltar spyod: zhes gsol ston pa 'od snang mtha yas kyis: brjod med chos nyid rang sgras 'di skad gsungs: aḥ chos nyid brjod du med pa nam mkha'i klong : cog bzhag rnam bzhi'i gtan la yang dag 'beb: gang tshe de yi rtsal dang rol pa ni: tshogs drug snang ba sna tshogs gang shar ba: ji ltar nam mkha' yangs par bya rjes bzhin: chos sku'i ngang las g.yos pa rdul tsam med: bzhin dang me long tha mi dad pa bzhin: ro gcig rtogs tshe rnam dag chos kyi sku: thams cad chos nyid rgyan du shar ba'i tshe: kun bzang klong na bzang ngan ye nas med: ye sangs rgyas la yang sangs rgyas re dang : ye sangs rgyas zin 'khor bar lhung dog dang :

srid gsum dus gcig 'jigs kyang sngangs skrags sogs: kun bzang klong la 'gag grub ye nas med: de tshe gang shar ma bcos shugs 'byung cher: lam du long phyir sna tshogs ma nges par: brtul zhugs spyod pas lam gyi bog chen 'byaman: 'ching dang grol ba'i grub mtha' 'ang ye nas med: 'di rtogs a ti'i man ngag mthar thug la: grol dang ma grol gnyis med grol ba'i mchog: ye grol yin pa'i gang gis 'ching ba med: rang grol yin pas gnyen po gzhan na med: klong grol yin pa'i thams cad byang chub sems: mtha' grol yin pas rtag chad ye nas 'das: grol min mtshams zhes phra ba'i 'dzin rtog can: tshul de rdzogs pa chen po'i grol lugs min: klong du la bzla grol ba'i mchog tu bshad: phung po rags pa rdul phran dwangs pa sogs: khregs chod rtogs pas yon tan brjod las 'das: kun gzhi'i las dang shes bya'i sgrib pa 'dag: bcu gsum skal mnyam lhun grub rig 'dzin brnyes: phrin las sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam par sbyor: 'bras bu sku bzhi'i ngo bo nyid sku 'thob: sa ma ya: gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i lam bzang padma'i snying po rgyud las: rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i khregs chod spyod pa'i grod tshad bstan pa'i le'u ste nyi shu pa'o: ྃ/: sems dpa' padma'i spyan gyis slar zhus pa: shin tu spros med rig pa'i rtsal dbang gis: 'gag sdom lhun grub thod rgal ji ltar 'dzin: zhes gsol ston pa 'od snang mtha' yas kyis: brjod med chos nyid rang sgras 'di skad gsungs: aḥ a ti'i zab khyad gnad du dril ba'i bcud: sku dang ye shes 'du 'bral med par ston: shin tu gsang ba las kyang ches gsang ba: mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi snying khrag dwangs ma 'di: theg pa gzhan du zur tsam bstan pa med: tshe cig 'pho chen 'grub pa'i khyad chos 'dir: khregs chod las kyang zab pa'i gnad bdun dang : khyad par 'phags tshul bdun gyis yang dag bshad:

rig pa gcer mthong rno brtul med pas gnad: dbang pos bltar yod yid dpyod mi dgos gnad: rtsol sgrub med pas rgan gzhon med pa'i gnad: ye nas dri bral bzang ngan med pa'i gnad: 'od gsal mngon sum tha snyad mi ltos gnad: bsam brnyod yul 'das gzhi lam mi ltos gnad: sku gsum snang rdzogs phyir mi ldog pas gnad: de sogs khregs chod las ni gnad 'gag zab: nyams len bde zhing lus gnad rtsa yi khyad: snang byed sgo dang mthong byed dbang po'i sgor: mngon sum gzigs dang snang ba 'od kyi khyad: nyams snang gong 'phel khyad chos bdun gyis 'phags: de la sngon 'gro dngos gzhi gnyis kyis bstan: dang po sgo gsum bya ba dgu sprugs bstan: lus kyi tshe 'di'i dgra 'dul gnyen skyong phyi: dge sbyor nang dang lha sngags gsang ba ste: spangs pas dben par rang nyid gcig pur gnas: ngag gi 'brel med 'khrul tshig smra ba phyi: bzlas brjod nang dang rlung bzlas gsang ba ste: spangs nas cing mi smra ba rab tu gnas: sems kyis nyon mongs 'khrul rtog ma nges phyi: nges 'byung nang dang bskyed rdzogs gsang ba ste: spangs te mi rtogs pa ru rab tu gnas: sgo gsum bya ba btang bas so sor dal: rtsa rlung thig le dwangs ba'i rten 'brel des: nad zhi tshe ring ting 'dzin skye ba sla: sa ma ya: gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i lam bzang padma'i snying po'i rgyud las: 'od gsal thod rgal gyi sngon 'gro bstan pa'i le'u ste nyer gcig pa'o: ྂ/: sems dpa' padma'i spyan gyis slar zhus pas: 'od gsal 'char ba'i gnad 'gag ji ltar 'dzin: zhes gsol ston pa 'od snang mtha' yas kyis: brjod med chos nyid rang sgras 'di skad gsungs: aḥ 'od gsal nang gnas phyi la 'char sla'igand: sgo gsum gnad kyi gzer tshul man ngag ni: bzhugs stangs gsum dang gzigs stangs gsum gyis bstan: chos sku'i bzhugs stangs seṅge'i 'gying stabs kyis:

'byung ba cha snyoms rlung sems ye shes 'phel: las rlung ldog cing nyams snang myur du 'char: longs sku'i bzhugs stangs glang chen nyal stabs kyis: bde drod bskyed cing khams rnams rgyas pa dang : bying rgod cha snyoms dbyings rigs 'du 'bral med: sprul sku'i bzhugs stangs drang srong tsog bu yis: thabs shes dbyer med rlung sems gnon pa dang : 'byung ba snyoms shing rlung yang ngang gis dal: dbyings rig dbyer med nyid du 'dres par byed: tha mal spyod spangs bzhugs stangs rnam gsum dang : 'bral med pa ni bde gshegs sum stong dang : skal pa mnyam pa'i rtag tu bsten par bya: chos sku'i gzigs stangs gyen du bltas pa yis: ma dag las kyi bag chags thur la sel: longs sku'i gzigs stangs mnyam por zur bltas pas: 'khor 'das chos kun ro mnyam nyid du bsre: sprul sku'i gzigs stangs thur la phab pa yis: sku dang ye shes nyams snang dngos su 'phel: khyad par rlung dal la bslab 'phel cha bzang : gnad rnams ma 'bral 'od gsal myur du 'char: sa ma ya: gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i lam bzang padma'i snying po'i rgyud las: 'od gsal 'phel ba'i gnad 'gag bstan pa'i le'u ste nyer gnyis pa'o: ྂ/: sems dpa' padma'i spyan gyis slar zhus pa: dngos gzhi sgron ma rnam drug ji ltar 'dzin: zhes gsol ston pa 'od snang mtha' yas kyis: brjod med chos nyid rang sgras 'di skad gsungs: aḥ e ma a ti ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos: 'od gsal 'char gzhi sgron ma rnam drug ni: sems can kun gyi snying dbus 'bral med du: thog ma'i mgon po bum skur bzhugs pa nyid: til gyi mar dang sbrul gyi rkang pa bzhin: sgo yul rlung gi gnad kyis gcun pa'i tshe: dbang pos mngon sum mjal ba e ma rmad: tsitta sha sgron chos kyi pho brang sgo: dkar 'jam rtsa sgron ka ti shel sbug brgyud: rgyang zhags chu sgron dbang po zung gis sgor:

dbyings rig dbyer med smin mtshams mkha' la khrid: chos longs sprul gsum nyi zla mar me'i dben: 'og tu khru gang khrid de dal gyis gzer: rnam par dag pa dbyings kyi sgron ma ni: dwangs ba'i mkha' la 'ja' tshon lta bur 'char: de'i nang ko mong rdo bsgyur lta bu'am: rma bya'i mdongs 'dra thig le thig phran 'char: thig le stong sgron de yi dbyings dang ni: thig le'i nang du rta rnga mdud ldan nam: me tog chun po mu tig drwa ba nas: lcags thag 'dra ba kha dog sngo shas che: mig mang ris sogs sbrang char 'bab bzhin 'char: rig stong rdo rje lu gu rgyud ces bya: ma yengs rtse gcig bltas tshe rig pa nyid: ka dag lhun grub stong gsal mi rtog gnas: shes rab rang byung sgron ma zhes bya ba'o: sa ma ya: gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i lam bzang padma'i snying po'i rgyud las: 'od gsal sgron ma drug gi nyams len bstan pa'i le'u ste nyer gsum pa'o: ྂ/: sems dpa' padma'i spyan gyis slar zhus pa: 'od gsal snang bzhi'i gdeng tshad ji ltar 'dzin: zhes gsol ston pa 'od snang mtha' yas kyis: brjod med chos nyid rang sgras 'di skad gsungs: aḥ chos nyid mngon sum snang ba'i 'char tshul ni: 'od khyim nang du rig pa lug rgyud gsal: dbyings kyi rwa bar rig pa mi 'gyur tshud: dbyings rig gnyis su med par ar la gtad: thig le sum 'brel bar du snang ba'i tshe: chos nyid mngon sum snang ba'i rim pa rdzogs: de tshe yid dpyod 'dzin pa dang bral bas: ji ltar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'od kyi dal: mun pa'i yul phud 'khor bar mi ldog cing : de yi dus su tshe yi dus byas kyang : rang bzhin sprul sku'i zhing du dbugs 'byin 'gyur: sa ma ya: gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i lam bzang padma'i snying po'i rgyud las: chos nyid mngon sum gyi gdeng tshad bstan pa'i le'u ste nyer bzhi pa'o: ྂ/: sems dpa' padma'i spyan gyis slar zhus pa:

de bzhin nyams snang gong 'phel ji ltar 'dzin: zhes gsol ston pa 'od snang mtha' yas kyis: brjod med chos nyid rang sgras 'di skad gsungs: aḥ gong 'phel nyams ni snang shes gnyis su 'char: dang po bde gsal mi rtogs mtha' 'gyur nyams: srin bu me khyer sprin dang du ba dang : smig rgyu zla ba skar ma mar me sogs: sna tshogs ma nges 'char zhing nub par byed: gnyis pa dbyings rig smin mtshams nas bral tshe: skyes bu 'grum nad byang ltar 'khor ba med: 'od lnga g.yen sgreng rtsib shar zlum 'khrigs sogs: rnam pa ma nges je brtan je gsal 'phel: tho phyi gang ba nyin mtshan med par snang : 'char yun nges med 'og ma'i snang ba'ang 'char: thig le'i nang du sku phran sku phyed dang : rang rang rigs mthun lha yi sku rkyang 'char: de tshe nyams snang gong 'phel rim pa rdzogs: 'od gsal rtsal dang rig pa'i ting 'dzin 'phel: spyan dang mngon shes la sogs phyogs med 'char: sa ma ya: gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i lam bzang padma'i snying po'i rgyud las: 'od gsal nyams snang gong 'phel gyi rim pa bstan pa'i le'u ste nyer lnga pa'o: ྂ/: sems dpa' padma'i spyan gyis slar zhus pa: de bzhin tshad phebs snang ba ji ltar 'dzin: zhes gsol ston pa 'od snang mtha' yas kyis: brjod med chos nyid rang sgras 'di skad gsungs: aḥ rig pa tshad phebs dbyings snang rgyas thebs pas: 'byung lnga rang dag 'od snang mtha' dbus med: rigs lnga'i tshom bu ma 'dres dbyings gang 'char: 'od dang rang lus dbyer med 'brel bar snang : mi 'gyur bas na rtsol ba med par 'char: snang bar dbang thob 'byung bzhir thogs rdug med: rigs lnga'i sku dang zhing khams 'du 'bral med: 'od zer 'phrul bzhan dbang nod rang lus la: 'od lus snang zhing mdzod spur 'dom gang 'od: spyi gtsug ye shes rlung gis rab btegs pa'i: thig le mkhar gzhong tsam pa lnga'am dgu: brtsegs mar snang zhing ye shes rlung lnga ni:

lag sor tshud pas sor mor 'od lnga 'khrigs: 'od rtser ye shes rang mdangs lnga gsal bas: rang lus ba spu'i sgo sogs rdul phran gyi: khyon rer zhing khams sangs rgyas grangs tshad med: rigs drug yul snang sems can grangs tshad med: phyi nang zhi khro'i lha tshogs grangs tshad med: sprul pa'i 'gro 'dul phrin las grangs tshad med: lhun grub sgo brgyad snang ba rdzogs par 'char: kun rtog bag chags sgrib dag dri ma bral: mngon shes drug thob dag dang ma dag pa'i: zhing khams dpag med mthong zhing snang srid kun: dpe char shar bas chos rnams thogs med du: mkhyen pa'i shes rab klong nas rdol ba dang : ting 'dzin sgo me bye ba dpag med thob: rig pa tshad phebs tshe 'dir zhing khams rdzogs: longs spyod rdzogs pa'i zhing du nges par grol: sa ma ya: gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i lam bzang padma'i snying po'i rgyud las: rig pa tshad phebs kyi gdeng tshad bstan pa'i le'u ste nyer drug pa'o: ྂ/: sems dpa' padma'i spyan gyis slar zhus pa: de bzhin chos zad snang ba ji ltar 'dzin: zhes gsol ston pa 'od snang mtha' yas kyis: brjod med chos nyid rang sgras 'di skad gsungs: aḥ 'od gsal snang ba bzhi yi mthar thug pa: chos nyid zad tshe zla ba nya gang bzhin: gnam gang bar du rim 'grib lta bu ste: chos nyid don la 'phel 'grib mi mnga' yang : snang che'i rten 'brel bslu ba med pa'i phyir: rang gdangs ka dag dbyings thim sku yal nas: thig le nā da'i bar du dbyings su thim: chos nyid zad de gzhon nu bum sku brnyes: chos nyid 'phel 'grib bral ba'i ye shes ni: rang gdangs gzhir thim shel 'od nang nub ltar: brjod bya'i yul 'das kun bzang dgongs pa dngos: klong du gyur tshe zad pa'i tha snyad tsam: de tshe rgyun gyi ting 'dzin rtag par gnas: chos nyid ngang las mi 'da' spyan dang ni: mngon shes lnga sogs dbang 'byor kun gzhi las: shes sgrib phra mos sgrib pa'i lam dus der:

rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin mthus bsal nas: sgrib bral ka dag chos skur 'tshang rgya'o: skye 'jug dbang thob skad cig sangs rgyas kyang : 'gro don 'khor ba dong nas sprugs par byed: skye bar dbang thob ye shes sgyu ma che: 'pho chen skur bzhengs rdo rje lta bu'i skus: gang la gang 'dul sprul pas 'gro don mdzad: 'jug par dbang thob ka dag nang dbyings su: 'jug khar bcug pas sems can sum stong sogs: las la bzang ngan mi ltos dus gcig tu: 'od lus yal nas ka dag dbyings su gshegs: mi snang sku dang ye shes 'bral med bzhugs: skye 'jug grangs med 'jig rten grangs med khams: sems can grangs med 'gro don mdzad par 'gyur: sa ma ya: gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i lam bzang padma'i snying po'i rgyud las: chos nyid zad pa'i gdeng tshad bstan pa'i le'u ste nyer bdun pa'o: ྂ/: sems dpa' padma'i spyan gyis slar zhus pa: rnal 'byor lam gyi bogs 'don ji ltar 'dzin: zhes gsol ston pa 'od snang mtha' yas kyis: brjod med chos nyid rang sgras 'di skad gsungs: lam gyi bogs 'don brtul zhugs spyod pas 'don: dur khrod la sogs ya nga'i gnas nyid du: he ru ka ltar 'jigs med gdeng ldan pas: bdag 'dzin rtsa ba rbad kyis gcod pa'i phyir: thabs mchog pha dang shes rab ṭ yi sgra: gnyis med dbyings sbyor drag tu brjod pa yis: bzang ngan bar ma'i rtog tshogs dus gcig gcod: phaṭḥ de tshe rig pa rjen par bud pa'i tshe: bdag 'dzin rtsa ba skad cig der chod pa'i: shes rab pha rol phyin ma'i dgongs pa'i mthil: zhi byed gcod kyi gdams pa la brten nas: brtul zhugs spyod pa lam du long ba ni: ye thog 'khrul gzhi blangs nas da lta'i bar: 'khor bar yun ring 'khyams tshe phan tshun du: las snang 'brel ba'i pha ma sems can dang : khyad par lan chags sha 'khon bu lon rnams: gdams zab kyis bslang glo bur bar chad ldang :

de phyir nyin bzhin thun bzhir rang gi lus: gtan pa med pa'i mchod sbyin dam par 'byed: phaṭ kyis sgra yis rig pa nam mkhar bsre: skad cig ye shes ḍākki'i skur langs te: rang lus 'dod rgu nor bu'i gter chen spel: dus bzhir dkar dmar khra dang nag por 'gyed: tshogs chen gnyis rdzogs sgrib gnyis dri ma 'dag: bar chad bdud bzhi nang nas rnyed pa'i tshe: ri gnyen mtsho gling dur khrod la sogs par: mi 'jigs thog rdzis spyod pa sna tshogs pa: 'khor 'das ro mnyam blang dor med pa spyod: gang zhig bskyed rdzogs lam gyi rnal 'byor pa'i: bar chad kun sel lam gyi bogs 'don zab: sa ma ya: gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i lam bzang padma'i snying po'i rgyud las: bogs 'don gcod kyi gdams pa bstan pa'i le'u ste nyer brgyad pa'o: ྂ/: sems dpa' padma'i spyan gyis slar zhus pa: rgyud kyi mtha' brtan spyi chings ji ltar 'dzin: zhes gsol ston pa 'od snang mtha' yas kyis: brjod med chos nyid rang sgras 'di skad gsungs: mtha' brten spyi chings bar do drug gis bstan: rmi lam bar dor sprul bsgyur 'od gsal sbyang : gti mug ro nyal spangs la gdams ngag sgom: sa lam tshod 'dzin 'od gsal 'khor yug 'char: bsam gtan bar dor bskyed rdzogs gnad du bsnun: rnam g.yeng 'khrul pa spongs la gdams ngag sgom: bskyed rdzogs gdeng snyed bar do nyams 'og tshud: 'chi kha'i bar dor 'od gsal dbyings su 'pho: dbang rab bar med 'chi srid chos skur grol: gdeng ma thob tshe mi rtag rtsal sbyong sgom: zab lam 'pho ba'i rig sngags sgro rlabs kyis: mig 'phrul lta bur zhing bgrod sa lam gyi: lhag ma der 'byongs rim gyis byang chub thob: chos nyid bar dor sgra 'od zer gsum dang : sna tshogs ma nges zhi khro'i sna brnyan sogs: rang snang ngo shes ma spang bu 'jug gam: lan tshwa tshul thim 'od gsal ma bu 'dres: nges pa lnga ldan longs spyod rdzogs skur grol:

srid pa bar dor bla ma dkon mchog mthu: dad pa'i yul na rab snang mi bslu phyir: snying rus dag snang 'khor ba ru log sgom: rang bzhin sprul sku'i zhing du dbugs dbyung 'gyur: skye gnas bar dor phyi ma'i gzhan don phyir: las dbang mthu btsan rigs drug yul snang gi: bag chags skye ba'i ltas la mi zhen par: mtho ris mi lus rigs bzang chos ldan gyi: mngal sdoms nyon mongs chags sdang mig gzir spangs: bla ma yab yum 'du shes mngal bzung la: phyi ma'i srid de sngar sbyang 'phro sad de: rlabs chen don gnyis mtha' ru phyin par 'gyur: sa ma ya: gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i lam bzang padma'i snying po rgyud las: mtha' brten bar do drug gi rgyud kyi spyi chings te rdzogs par bstan pa'i le'u ste nyer dgu pa'o: sems dpa' phyag na padmos rdo rjes glus: padma bdag la thugs rje'i klong nas gdams: rje 'bangs grogs dang sangs rgyas ye shes la: byung dang 'byung gyur gdul byar sman pa'i phyir: smon lam bslu med dgongs pas gtad rgya bcas: yang gsang padma'i gnas kyi lte bar sbas: ma 'ongs cher snyigs mi thub lnga bdo'i dus: buddha dzñā na'i gter 'byin skye ba'i mtha': padma'i ming can sbas pa'i rnal 'byor pa: ma nges spyod pa can dang 'phrad par shog: bka' 'di gnyer gtad legs ldan tshogs kyi bdag: ma ning sde lnga dregs pa sde brgyad kyis: thub par srung shig badzra rakṣantu: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gu hye: brda thim: ྀatsha:

ces pa'ang kho bo 'gro 'dul pad rgyal gling pas gnas chen padma bkod kyi yang gsang dhe wa ko ḍi'i nye zhol 'brug la mar me kong 'bum zhes bya ba brag pha waṃ gur phub pa 'dra ba'i nub logs nas/ sa phag lo ston zla ra ba'i tshes bcu'i dus su dngos grub tu thob pas/ mi lo nyer bzhi'i bar gsang bar gnas pa nyid rtsa ba'i chos bdag puṇyai mtshan can gyis shes rab ral gri dang lha reg sogs maṇḍal 'phags lam grangs ldan gyi skyes dang bcas gsung gis nan bskul byung ba'i mtshams sbyar te/ dpal o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pa'i phrin las kyi gnas mchog mon kha ne ring seṅge rdzong zhes ri rtse gangs ri'i rwa bas yongs su bskor ba'i ljongs su phun sum tshogs pa'i nags tshal dang mtsho rdzing dang 'bab chu dang ne'u seng dang sman sna dang padma'i tshal kyis mdzes par brgyan pa'i sbas yul sa la spyod pa'i gnas kyi lho phyogs rin chen spungs pa'i ke'u tshang du thu mo zhes/ chu phag lo 'bras bu bcud du smin pa'i dus/ ston 'bring rags pa dbyug pa zla ba'i shes rab kyi char rgyal ba lha las bab pa'i dus bzang por grub par gtan la phab ste rtsa ba'i yi ge pa ni chos kyi bdag po nyid kyis bgyis pa 'gro kun kun bzang chos sku'i rgyal sa zin pa'i rgyu dang sa bon nyid du gyur cig /sarba dwa maṅga laṃ// // ༄༅/ /sku gsum dgongs 'dus las/ dbang bzhi ye shes char 'bebs khrigs su bsdebs pa skal ldan smin byed bzhugs so/ / byin rlabs rtsa ba bla ma thod phreng rtsal/ /dngos grub rtsa ba yi dam rta mchog dpal/ /phrin las rtsa ba ḍākki wā ra hi/ /dbyer med rigs 'dus khyab bdag bla mar 'dud/ /sku gsum dgongs 'dus chos sde chen po yi/ /smin byed dbang bzhi ye shes char 'bebs zhes/ /skal ldan smin byed rtsa dbang rjes gnang bcas/ /bklags chog spel la bka' gnang byin gyis rlobs/ / de yang sprul pa'i gter 'byin padma rgyal po gar dbang 'gro 'dul gling pa rtsal gyi zab gter/

sku gsum dgongs pa 'dus pa'i phrin las 'bring po dngos grub snying po dang 'brel ba'i don dbang spros pa 'bring pos dbang du byas te khol phyung du bkod pa la/ dang po ras bris sam ma 'byor na 'bru tshom dkyil 'khor dkod pa'i steng dbang bzhi brtsegs mar bshams/ mdun du sman gtor rakta/ mthar nyer spyod bskor bshams bya/ slob dpon gyi mdun rdor dril/ nas bzed/ thun snod/ bye yungs sogs nyer mkho'i rigs bsags la/ thog mar tshig bdun gsol 'debs nas brtsams phrin las snying po'i gzhung bsrang zhing bdag mdun dbyer med bskyed cing dzap khang dbye la bzlas par 'jug /de nas bum sgrub gzung thag blangs shing bum pa bskyed bzlas gzhung ltar bya/ /las bum rta mgrin bskyed bzlas mchod bstod 'od zhu grub nas/ rig me dor/ /slob ma 'jug pa'i gnang ba zhu/ dkyil 'khor yol bas bsgrib bo/ /bka' gter spyi dang khyad par rang lugs ma mgon bskang gsol sogs/ tshogs byin rlabs dngos grub snying po ltar bsgral bstab bar 'jug /de nas khrus dang bgegs bskrad mtshams gcod pa sogs spyi 'gros ltar byas nas lo rgyas mdor tsam brjod pa ni/ 'o na nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che ci nas kyang 'god par bya/ de'i ched du dbang bskur zab mo gsan nas don thugs nyams su bzhes te sems can thams cad bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas go 'phang la 'god par bya'o snyam du sems bskyed gsal btab ste gsan par zhu/ gang gsan par bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs ni/ 'dir rgyal ba thabs mkhas la thugs rje che bas rnam grangs bsam gyis mi khyab pas na/ gdul bya mtha' yas pas blo'i bye brag dang mthun par chos kyi sgo mo brgyad khri bzhi steng gsungs pa sogs mdor bsdu na/ theg pa rim pa dgu'am gnyis te mtshan nyid mdo yi theg pa dang*/

'bras bu rdo rje theg pa sngags kyi sgo gnyis su 'dus pa las/ da lam skabs su bab pa ni 'bras bu rdo rje theg pa yin/ de la yang gsar rnying gnyis las/ phyi ma snga 'gyur rdo rje theg pa'i khongs su gtogs la/ de la'ang bka' gter dag snang gi babs so chen po gsum du bzhugs pa las/ zab mo gter gyi phyogs su gtogs pa ma zad/ dus bab kyi zab chos su som nyi bral ba ste/ gter gzhung nas/ ma 'ongs gangs can thub bstan la: mtha' mis hab thob byed pa'i dus: dbus kyi gser mdangs g.ya' yis gos: sngan pos g.yogs kyang nogs por 'gyur: dam pa'i rten 'brel bdud kyis bsnog: ri snyil thang ral mtsho 'byung tshe: 'bri zla sgang gi thig le ru: gser ming yul du mchog gi rus: gnubs chen skyes mtha' gter la dbang : padma'i ming can 'gro ba'i dpal: spyod pa hur byung phyogs kun rgyu: ma nges spyod pa skyong ba dang : 'phrad nas rab 'bring tha ma yi: rten 'brel bzhin du 'gro don 'byung : rab kyis mtha' dmag dus khug gso: 'bring gis khol bu'i sa gnas skyob: tha mas rang skal gdul bya 'drong : khyad par sbas yul padma bkod: 'khor lo dang po'i bla gter 'di: zhal phyes tsam gyis snyigs dus kyi: rgud pa sel zhing gangs can nas: rgya mtsho'i bar gyi 'gro ba skyob: zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ gangs can phur thogs yongs kyi gtso bo gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes kyi rnam 'phrul sprul pa'i gter chen pad rgyal gling pas sa spyod don gyi 'og min sbas yul padma bkod 'khor lo lnga'i nang gses 'brug la mar me kong 'bum nas rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa phag lo ston zla ra ba'i tshes bcu yi dus su ngo mtshar ba'i cho 'phrul dang bcas gdan drangs pas zab chos sku gsum dgongs 'dus zhes nye brgyud byin rlabs kyi tshan kha che zhing*/ mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs ma yal ba'i zab gter 'di nyid kyi lo rgyus las/

nga nyid padma rgyal po ni: sku gsum rgyal ba ma lus pa'i: dgongs klong ye shes dbyings su 'dus: rtsa ba rdo rje gsum nyid las: mtha' yas phyag rgya'i sprin 'phro ba: dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i rnam par 'phrul: rang gi sgrub thabs rang gis byas: nga ni bde gshegs kun 'dus yin: nga sgrub sangs rgyas thams cad 'grub: nga mthong sangs rgyas thams cad mthong : nga ni rtsa gsum kun 'dus yin: sgrub thabs mang por 'jug mi dgos: 'on kyang dul bya tha dad ngor: sgrub thabs rgyas bsdus dpag med bstan: de dag kun gyi yang snying bcud: gsang ba kun gyi gnad dril ba: dus gsum rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha: ye shes gcig gi klong yangs su: sku gsum dgongs pa 'dus par sgrub: zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ dkyil 'khor kun bdag mtsho skyes rdo rje 'chang gi sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo la brten nas byin rlabs dngos grub phrin las kyi rtsa ba gsum dang*/ sgrub sde brgyad kyi bskyed rdzogs kyang zhar byung du tshang ba'i zab chos rmad du byung ba'i smin byed kyi dbang bskur ba la rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum las/ 'dir 'bring po dbang bzhi ye shes char 'bebs ltar bskur ba la/ sngon 'gro 'jug pa'i chos dang dngos gzhi dbang bskur gyi rim pa gnyis las/ slob dpon gyis bgyi bar 'os pa rnams gzhung bzhin legs par grub ste rdo rje slob ma khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa'i thog mar sngon 'gro 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i don du zhing khams 'bul/ zhes maṇḍal 'bul bcug / de nas bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo gnyis su med pa la dbang bskur stsal du gsol zhes gsol ba 'debs pa'i mos pa dang bcas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hoḥ ma lus rgyal kun ye shes sku gsung thugs: rdo rje'i slob dpon rdo rje thod phreng rtsal: sgyu 'phrul drwa ba mngon par rab rdzogs pa'i:

bla med byang chub chen po'i dkyil 'khor du: bdag nyid 'jug cing smin par mdzad du gsol: gsol ba lan gsum btab/ zhes gsol ba btab pas bka' yi gnang ba thob par mos mdzod/ da khyed rang rnams kyi rgyud snod rung du bya ba'i phyir/ bla ma he ru kaḥdakyil 'khor gyi gtso bo skyabs gnas rgya mtsho'i ngo bor bzhugs pa'i drung du: 'di nas byang chub snying po'i bar du mkha' khyab sems can gyi don du skyabs su 'gro bar bya snyam pa'i 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ na moḥ phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i skyabs yul ma lus pa: ye shes gcig gi dbyings su shar ba'i dpyid: padma 'byung gnas bde gshegs rtsa gsum lhar: byang chub snying po'i bar du skyabs su mchi: de nas sngon gyi bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyi 'gro ba'i don du smon 'jug gi byang chub thugs bskyed pa de bzhin du bdag gis kyang byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed par bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ hoḥ ji ltar sngon gyi bde gshegs sras bcas kyi: 'gro ba'i don du bla med thugs bskyed bzhin: bdag gis nyes spyod kun sdom dge chos bsdus: smon 'jug don dam byang sems rtag tu bskyed: de nas tshogs bsags phyir bsag sbyang yan lag brgyad pa'i skabs thob so so'i tshig don yid la bya bzhin 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hoḥ rang rig bla ma rtsa gsum lha tshogs la: gnyis su med par gar gyis phyag 'tshal lo: tshogs drug zhen pa bral ba'i mchod sprin 'bul: gzung 'dzin dri ma lta ba'i klong du bshags: bla med lta sgom spyod la rjes yi rang : brjod med don gyi chos 'khor bskor bar bskul: bde chen 'pho 'gyur bral bar rtag bzhugs gsol: 'khor gsum dmigs mtha' bral ba'i pha mthar bsngo: lhun grub gzhon nu bum skur byang chub shog: rgyud byangs/ de nas khyed rang rnams kyi rgyud sdom par bya ba'i slad du/

phyi nang gsang ba'i sdom pa dang dam tshig rnams tshul bzhin yongs su bzung bar bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ hoḥ rig 'dus rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor 'dir: so sor thar pa'i sdom pa dang : byang chub sems dpa'i bslab bya dang : rig 'dzin sngags kyi dam tshig rnams: deng nas bdag gis brtan por bzung : zhes sdom pa bzung*/ de nas dngos gzhi dbang gi gzhi brtan par bya ba'i slad du ye shes pa dbab pa yin pas/ khyed rang rnams lus gnad skyil krung drang por bsrang*/ ngag gnad rlung kha sbyor du 'ching*/ sems kyi gnad gzhan du ma yengs par dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzad 'tshal/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ khyad rang rnams kyi gdos bcas phung khams kyis mtshon pa'i ma dag pa'i snod bcud thams cad mi dmigs pa stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las snod bcud rnam dag padma drwa ba'i zhing khams mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa gsal ba'i dbus su/ khyed rang rnams gang du 'khod pa'i gdan pad nyi bdud bzhi'i gdan la rig pa rdo rje hrīḥdamar gyis mtshan par gyur/ de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid dbang chen rta mchog he ru kaḥsku mdog dmar gsal bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar zhing khro 'dzum gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum dang ldan zhing ral pa'i khrod du rta gdong ljang zhur nam mkhar gzigs shing rta skad drag tu 'tsher ba/ phyag g.yas gri gug nam mkhar phyar zhing*/ g.yon pas thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa/ sku la dur khrod kyi chos rnams rdzogs shing zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum gyis 'gying ba/ sbyor yum phag mo mthing nag gcer bu rus rgyan can nu ma dang bha ga rgyas pa/ sgeg bzhed khros ma'i nyams can phyag gnyis gri thod 'dzin pa'i yab dang sbyor ba/ ral pa kham nag thur du 'phyang bas dbus nas phag zhal nag po ngur sgra sgrogs pa/ bde ba chen po'i ye shes kyi me 'od rab tu 'khrigs pa'i klong na bzhugs pa/

yab kyi thugs dbus su g.yung drung dmar po g.yon du 'khor ba'i lte bar phag mo dmar po bde ba'i gar byed pa/ grwa bzhir ha ru ni sa'i mtshan pa la sems rtse gcig tu zungs shig /slob dpon rdo rje thod phreng rtsal dngos su mos pa'i gdung shugs bcas pas slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i 'od kyis phog pas/ lte ba'i phag mo bde ba'i gar drag tu 'khrab pas/ g.yung drung kyang shugs drag tu 'khor bas phag mo dang rigs bzhi'i mkha' 'gro'i sa bon las bde ba chen po'i 'od zer gyi snang ba zhing khams rab 'byams khyab par 'phros te sku gsum rgyal ba zhi khro rab 'byams dang*/ khyad par rnga yab gling du bzhugs pa'i gu ru rin po che la 'khor rtsa gsum dam can ḍākki dpa' bo rgya mtsho'i 'khor tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab par kha char bab pa bzhin dngos su byon nas/ slob ma khyed rang rnams kyi sgo gsum la sib sib thim pas bde ba'i ye shes btsan thabs su 'bar bar mos shig / spos rol ḍā dril dang bcas gdung shugs bskyed la las byang ltar/ hūm̐: sngon gyi skal pa'i dang po la: sogs nas dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma thod phreng rtsal badzra sa mā ya dzaḥsiddhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ dzñā na a be sha ya a a āḥ zhes dang*/ a ralli pheṃ pheṃ hriṃ hriṃ dza dzaḥ zhes btags ḍā dril drag tu 'khrol/ de ltar byin dbab pa'i ye shes kyi rgyun byang chub ma thob bar du 'phel 'grib med par brtan par byas par mos mdzod/ dzñā na tiṣṭha badzra sa spyi bor rdo rje bzhag la rgyas btab bo/ / de nas dbang bzhi dngos la/ thog mar bum pa 'di nyid gdos bcas tha mal ma yin par phyi bum pa'i rnam pa la/ nang rang bzhin chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang du bla ma sku gsum dgongs 'dus kyi lha tshogs yum dang bcas pa snyoms par zhugs pas dga' ba'i sgras de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs rnams spyan drangs/ rjes su chags pa'i byang chub kyi sems zhu ba'i bdud rtsi spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lor sib sib thim pas rgyal thabs spyi blugs su mngon par dbang bskur bar

mos la/ oṃ: ye shes sku mchog bum pa'i gzhal yas nas: ye shes lnga ldan bdud rtsi gtor blug dbang : skal ldan bu yi lus la bskur ba yis: lus snang gdos bcas lha skur smin par shog: rtsa sngags dang*/ badzra kā la sha kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: zhes bum chu myang*/ bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis lus kyi nang thams cad gang : bde ba chen po'i ye shes nyams su myong*/ chu'i lhag ma spyi bor 'khyil ba las rigs thams cad 'dus pa'i spyi gzugs rgyal ba kun tu bzang pos dbu brgyan/ spyan drangs pa'i dbang lha rnams kyang khyed rang rnams la dbyer med du thim par mos la/ oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swā hā/ zhes me tog 'thor/ de ltar na phyi kun rdzob mtshan ma rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor du bum pa'i dbang thob/ phung khams snod bcud tha mal du zhen pa'i rtog tshogs sbyangs te lus kyi sgrib pa dag /lam dus su bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa la dbang*/ snod bcud bla ma rtsa gsum lha'i dkyil 'khor gcig tu rdzogs nas/ 'bras bu sku rdo rje mchog gi sprul sku 'grub pa'i skal pa can du byas pa'o/ / zhes rtogs pa bskyed do/ /gnyis pa gsang dbang gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzad 'tshal/ slob dpon bla ma padma he ru ka'i rang 'od kyi yum mthing 'od 'bar ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i dga' ba'i sgra dang bde ba'i 'od zer gyis 'phro 'dus phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba thams cad spyan drangs pa yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar chags pa chen po'i mes bzhu ba sku'i dbyibs rgyud rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi padmar babs/ byang sems dkar dmar ro gcig tu 'dres pa'i rgyun mu tig gi mdangs can de nyid lce thog tu stsal bar

mos la/ aḥ bhandha bde ba chen po chos dbyings snod: ye shes rang bzhin bde chen bdud rtsis gtams: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la bskur ba yis: ngag rlung rdo rje dā la smin par shog: a ho badzra bho dhi tsitta ma hā su kha: zhes bdud rtsi myang*/ byang sems yi ge'i sprin a li ka li'i rnam par 'char bas rtsa gnas thams cad gang ste rtsa'i 'ching byed kyi mdud pa grol/ gzung 'dzin brgyad cu'i rtog pa 'gag /thig rlung sems gsum ye shes chen po'i ngo bor byin gyis brlabs nas bde ba'i ye shes khyad par can rgyud la skyes par gyur/ de ltar na kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du gsang ba'i dbang thob/ rlung tha mal du 'dzin pa'i bag chags sbyangs te ngag gi sgrib pa dag /lam dus su bdag byin rlabs rdzogs rim tsaṇḍa lī'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa la dbang*/ sgra skad dang rlung 'byin 'jug sngags su dag ste/ 'bras bu gsung rdo rje longs spyod rdzogs sku thob pa'i skal pa can du byas pa'o/ / zhes rtogs pa bskyed do/ / gsum pa sher dbang gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod cig /rang nyid bla ma padma he ru kaḥsnang stong sgyu ma lta bu'i skur gsal ba la/ slob dpon gyi yum mthing 'od 'bar ma las rigs mthun gyi shes rab ma gzugs dang lang tsho mtshan nyid phun sum tshogs pa zhig rnam par spros te thar pa bsten par bskul bar mos la/ hoḥ nga yi padma bde chen dgyes pa 'di: rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes bskyed pa'i gnas: skal ldan khyod kyis 'di zungs rtag tu mchod: 'di spangs pa la mchog gi dngos grub med: de phyir the tshom med pa'i brtul zhugs bskyed: yum gyi/ a nu rā ga ya hoḥ sa chags pa bskul/ yab gyi/ a nu rā ga ya mi: dgyes pa ster/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa nye bar bskul/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga na dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ/ gnyis med sbyor zhing bde ba'i ye shes bskyang :

hoḥ chos sku'i ye shes mngon sum lam longs phyir: gang zhig chags spangs lta bu'i khams gsum na: sdig gzhanamed pas khyod kyis nam du'ang : chags med chags bral chags pa'i mchod par brtson: zhes brtul zhugs bsgrag / de ltar na gsang ba chos thams cad 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ gzung 'dzin gnyis snang gi rtog tshogs sbyangs te yid kyi sgrib pa dag /lam dus su pho nya bde ba chen po rdo rje sems dpa'i gseng lam bsgom pa la dbang*/ bde sdug byung tshor thams cad lhan skyes ye shes su dag nas/ 'bras bu thugs rdo rje chos kyi sku thob pa'i skal pa can du byas so/ /bzhi pa tshig gi dbang bskur ba la/ khyed rang rnams phan tshun ma reg par rnam snang chos bdun drang por bsrangs nas lus sog phon gyi thag pa chad pa ltar shig ge /ngag pi wang gi rgyun thag chad pa ltar wang nge*/ sems nam mkha' rdul dang bral ba ltar sang nger zhog cig /cung zad mnyam par bzhag bcug /bla ma dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i zhal nas skye med rdo rje'i tshig gi rang byung don gyi dgongs pa ngo sprad de dbugs dbyung bar mos la/ aḥ mtshon byed dpe yi ye shes me long bzhin: mtshon bya don gyi ye shes dri ma med: rdo rje sems dpa' yang dag bde ba che: ka dag tshig dbang rin chen bla na med: oṃ badzra dharma dhā tu a ti hoḥ de ltar na don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du rig pa'i rtsal dbang thob/ sgo gsum tha dad du 'dzin pa'i shes bya'i sgrib pa ches phra ba sbyangs/ lam dus su ka dag lhun grub zung 'jug rdzogs rim mthar thug pa'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa la dbang*/ snang bzhi zad sar 'khyol te/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku kun bzang padma rgyal po'i go 'phang mngon du byed pa'i skal pa can du byas pa'o/ / zhes rtogs pa bskyed do/ / de nas mtha' rten byin rlabs gtor ma'i dbang bskur ba ni/

dbang gtor thogs la/ gtor snod gzhal yas khang du gtor ma dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rdzogs par gsal ba'i gnas gsum 'bru gsum gyi mtshan pa las/ 'od zer dang bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas slob ma'i tshangs bug nas rkang mthil yan chod ltem gyis gang ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi dngos grub ma lus pa thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: stong chen khyab brdal chos sku'i gtor gzhong du: snang cha ma 'gags gtor chen longs sku'i lha: rdo rje thod phreng sku gsum rtsa gsum gyi: dkyil 'khor rab 'byams lha tshogs dbyings nas bzhengs: 'gyur med sku yi dbang chen lus la bskur: nad gdon sdig sgrib rnam smin zhi ba dang : bum pa'i dbang thob sprul sku thob par shog: 'gag med gsung gi dbang chen ngag la bskur: nad gdon dig lkugs ngag sgrib zhi ba dang : gsang ba'i dbang thob longs sku thob par shog: 'khrul med thugs kyi dbang chen yid la bskur: nad gdon smyo 'bog yid sgrib zhi ba dang : sher ye'i dbang thob chos sku thob par shog: yon tan phrin las rdzogs pa'i dbang chen bskur: sgo gsum cha snyoms lhan skyes sgrib pa sbyong : tshig gi dbang thob sku bzhi mngon grub shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma thod phreng rtsal badzra sa mā ya dzaḥsiddhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ kā ya siddhi a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: wākka siddhi a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ tsitta siddhi a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ zhes gtor ma gnas bzhir bkod mthar / dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa gtor ma'i lha 'od du zhu nas slob mar gnyis su med par thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ rten snying dang su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swā hā: zhes me tog 'thor cing bkra shis brjod/ rjes kyi rim pa ni/ de ltar bla ma'i thugs sgrub sku gsum dgongs pa 'dus pa'i dbang bzhi zab mo rdzogs par thob pa'i sku drin gtang rag gi yon du maṇḍal zhig 'bul bar zhu/

sa gzhi spos sogs/ de ltar dbang bzhi mtha' rten dang bcas pa legs par grub pa'i de dag gi skabs su thob pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa rnams mi nyams par tshul bzhin srung snyam pa'i 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bo'i ji? de tsam du ma zad lus longs spyod dus gsum gyi dge tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyang yongs su 'bul na cha shas nas spyad du gsol snyam pa'i 'di yi rjes zlos mdzod/ deng nas brtsams te bdag? de ltar dbang bskur gsan pa las byung ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis mtshon/ dge tshogs ji snyed pa thams cad mkha' khyab sems can gyi don du bsngo ba dang*/ lam 'di nyid kyi sgo nas rang gzhan bstan 'gro'i don rgya chen po bsgrub par bya'o snyam pa'i bsngo ba dang*/ smon lam chabs cig tu mdzad pa zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis? sogs bsngo smon spyi ltar bya/ rjes su tshogs kyi 'khor lo la rol zhing dkyil 'khor rjes kyi cho ga gzhung ltar bya'o/ /skabs 'gar dbang bskur rgyas 'bring sogs long khom med skabs bsdus par 'dod na gtor dbang kho nas kyang rung bar gsungs te/ gzhung las/ dang po bskyed bzlas lha dang dbyer med sgrub: rang gi dbang blang slob ma'i bya ba yi: sbyor rjes gzhung bzhin dngos gzhi gtor dbang ni: zhes gsungs pa bzhin bdag bskyed phrin las 'bring po'am rgyun khyer ci rigs sngon du song nas/ dzap khang dbye la bdag mdun dbyer med du sgrub/ dbang bzhi'i dngos grub rang gzhung ltar blang ba'am rig pa'i me tog dor/ sbyor ba khrus nas dbyung ba dang*/ bgegs bskrad srung 'khor bsgom la/ lo rgyus kyi mtshams sbyor cung zad dang bcas/ da lam bla ma'i thugs sgrub sku gsum dgongs pa 'dus pa'i byin rlabs gtor ma'i dbang bskur sgrub pa la sogs maṇḍal mdor bsdus pa dang*/ de nas mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma sku gsum dgongs pa 'dus pa'i lha tshogs la phyogs bcu'i dus bzhi'i skyabs yul ma tshang ba med pas bskor ba mngon sum lta bur bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas bsags sbyang gi gnad 'dus 'di'i don la bsam zhing tshig gi rjes zlos mdzod/

rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal? sogs kyi rgyud sbyang*/ de nas gong gsal ltar gtor snod gzhal yas khang sogs nas/ mthar chags su bskur la/ de ltar byin rlabs gtor ma la brten nas dbang bzhi cig char du bskur ba'i phan yon yang*/ gter gzhung las/ dam rdzas gtor ma rin chen 'bar ba la: brten nas dbang bzhi cig char bskur ba'i thabs: dngos grub rgya mtsho nor bu'i lugs su bstan: gnas skyabs 'gal rkyen bar chad sel ba dang : mthar thug dngos grub thob pa'i sa bon te: thog mar chos sgo 'byed pa'i lde mig yin: tha ma dbang rnams rdzogs thob mtha' rten yin: zhes gsungs pa bzhin gtor dbang legs par thob pa'i gtang rag? sogs rjes kyi bya ba rnams spyi ltar byas pas chog go /zhes pa'ang bla ma'i thugs sgrub sku gsum dgongs 'dus kyi rtsa dbang chen mo khrigs sdeb dngos grub gsang rdzogs zhes bya ba rje gter chen bla ma'i chog khrigs rgyas pa las khol du phyung ba dbang bzhi ye shes char 'bebs khrigs bsdeb bya ba 'di'ang*/ mtshungs med sprul pa'i gter chen pad rgyal gling pa'i zhal snga nas/ ring lugs 'di nyid kyi dbang lung zab khrid yongs rdzogs legs par grub pa'i mtha' rten skabs lung zin chos bdag gu hyas mtshan can bya ba'i mtshan gyi cod pan dang*/ de bzhin rje rang nyid kyi dbang chas cha tshang*/ rigs lnga lha tsaka yongs rdzogs bcas gnang ste dam tshig bka' nan gyi tshul du/ ma 'ongs par gnam lcags kyi ring lugs zab gter gang du dar ba dang*/ de ga'i smin grol sgo 'byed pa'i skabs gter kha 'og ma sku gsum dgongs 'dus 'di nyid kyi smin grol kyang lhan du spel dgos pa dang*/ de bzhin sku gsum dgongs 'dus gang du dar bar gnam lcags smin grol kyang rgyun spel nas gong 'og 'brel mthud bya dgos pa ma zad/ khyad par du bod yul la spel ba'i byed por bka' lung yod pas spobs pa ma chung par gyis dang*/

da cha phran gnyis nyams chung yang slad bstan pa la phan thog yong nges yin/ ngas lung bstan 'di yin zhes ston rgyu med pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ rdo rje 'chang 'khyen brtse chos kyi blo gros kyi zab gter ci byung yal bar ma 'dor bar phab la dus min du gsang rgya ma shor bar gyis/ gter ston lung bstan gyis phung zhes bya ba yod pas lung bstan 'di rigs kyi mtho dman du mar phog thug gi rgyu ru 'gyur nyen che bas ma bris na legs zhes kha la tham ga ma brgyab tsam gnang song bas/ de don bzhin ma bris pa yin/ nged mi nyam chung song chos bdag chen po sogs phar la btsal na rgyu nor dang rgyab gnyer la re ba lta bu las mi snang bas/ khyod chos bdag yin zhes su'ang phar la btsal ma myong zhing*/ bstan 'gro la phan pa zhig yod na khyed rnams kyis rten 'brel phrin pa mdzod cig ces sngags kyi srung mar gnyer gtad byas nas bsdad pa yin/ des na khyed kyang tshur phebs pa de sngags kyis srung mas bskul ba yin 'ong bas/ da cha ngas kyang slob ma zer nas mnga' gsol/ chos bdag zer nas ming btag /bstan pa'i gnyer gtad zer na'ang 'dra/ 'byung 'gyur gyi re ba zer na'ang de tsam yin pas ma 'chug cig zhes tshogs yongs kyi dbugs su bka' phebs mdzad pa bzhin/ dam bca' bka' ldog gi nyes skyon mi 'byung ba'i slad da res gnam lcags kyi zab gter yongs rdzogs legs par grub pa'i mtha' rjes su/ gter kha 'og ma sku gsum dgongs 'dus kyi zab gter pod bzhi/ chos sde chen po rtsa ba sku gsum dang sgrub sde brgyad dang 'brel ba'i bla ma yi dam dbyer med ltar sgrub pa dang*/ yan lag sgos sgrub thod phreng sde lnga/ yum bka' mkha' 'gro dgongs 'dus/ gsang sgrub rdor sems padma gsang thig sogs re re la'ang cha lags dang bcas pa zab rgyas bzhugs pa las/ 'dir rtsa ba'i rgyud dang*/ smin byed 'bring po sgrub thabs cha shas tsam bsdu 'jog skabs/

smin dbang rgyas pa las khol du phyung nas smin grol rgyun spel slad/ nyer mkho'i ched chog khrigs su btab pas des kyang gter chen bla ma'i thugs kyi bzhed pa 'grub cing*/ zab chos 'di nyid mi nub phyogs dus gnas skabs kun tu dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas pa'i rgyur gyur cig /ces pa'ang ma hā gu ru padma sambha'i sgrub gnas bal yul yang le shod dang a su ra'i rdo rje'i ke'u tshang dang 'dab 'brel/ g.yu lo bkod rje btsun gling zhes gnas lcags bshad sgrub kyi bsti gnas ga la ba der/ dus khyad par can rab byung bcu bdun pa'i lcags mo yos kyi lo/ sa ga zla ba'i dmar phyogs mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus sgyu skar dbang po gro bzhin bu mo'i khyim du rtsen pa'i dus/ 'byung 'phrad sa chu 'grub sbyor bzang por gter slob tha shal ba sgo sprul gsang sngags bstan 'dzin gyis smras rim bzhin yi ge pa ni 'phel sprul gyis bgyis shing legs par grub pa'i skabs su sngags srung ma mo dgyes pa'i phyag mtshan g.yu spyang pho mo zung gi yang yang bskor ba byas shing*/ 'ja' tshon gyi gur phub pa dang sbrang char zim bur bab pa sogs zab chos byin rlabs kyi tshan kha ma nyams pa'i rtags mtshan min nam snyam ste spro dga' dang bcas grub par gyur to// // ༄༅/ / sku gsum dgongs 'dus las byang chub ba'i brgyud 'debs byin rlabs bcud 'dus ces bya ba// e ma hoḥ chos sku snang ba mtha'i thugs rje'i klong dkyil nas: longs sku thugs chen dbang chen hya ghṛ: rang byung sprul sku padma yab yum la: gsol ba 'debs so byin rlabs dngos grub stsol: dgongs pa'i gtan rgya thugs rje'i klong dkyil nas: buddha dzñā na rje 'bangs grogs bcas dang : gter ston sprul sku brgyud pa'i bla ma la: gsol ba 'debs so byin rlabs dngos grub stsol: 'phags yul dpal chen mchog grub rig 'dzin brgyad:

sgyu 'phrul drwa ba gu ru mtshan mchog brgyad: sgrub chen bka' brgyad dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: gsol ba 'debs so byin rlabs dngos grub stsol: bde stong ye shes bha ga'i klong dkyil nas: gsang ba ye shes badzra wā ra hī: mthing 'od 'bar ma gnas gsum ḍākki dmar: gsol ba 'debs so dga' bzhi'i ye shes spel: brgyud gsum bla mas gsang chen rgyud sde'i mdzod: dgongs pas gtad rgya sde gsum dregs pa'i sde: rdo rje'i chos skyong dam can rgya mtsho la: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol: 'khor bar nges 'byung so thar rgyud bsdams te: smon 'jug byang sems gzhan phan gter kha 'byed: rig 'dzin sngags kyi bskyed rdzogs mthar phyin nas: tshe gcig sangs rgyas 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: sku lnga lhun grub padma yab yum gyis: thugs bskyed smon lam nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam: mdzad pa phrin las sgyu 'phrul drwa ba che'i: rnam thar rgya mtsho bdag gis 'grub par shog: rang don chos sku'i ye shes mngon gyur te: gzhan don gzugs sku'i 'khor ba ma stong bar: sangs rgyas rnams kyi phrin las byed pa dang : sems can kun gyi gnyen du bdag 'gyur shog:
