ces pa'ang 'gro 'dul pad rgyas gling pas gter gzhung gi bcud bsdus te dpal gyi seṅge rdzong du sbyar ba siddhi rastu// bla ma'i thugs sgrub sku gsum dgongs 'dus las: yang gsang bla ma'i sgrub thabs phyag rgya gcig pa phrin las rdo rje snying po zhes bya ba bzhugs so: ྂ/: :༁/na/྅/ṭhāṭhā: bla med bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen po: dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag he ru kaḥ bdag gi sgrub thabs phyi nang gsang gsum las: 'di nyid yang gsang spros med nor bu'i lugs: gcig shes kun grol phyag rgya gcig sgrub 'di: nyams len snying po dril ba rtsa bar bzung : sa ma ya: nga yi sku gsung thugs kyi sgrub gnas sogs: dben gnas bzang por yar ngo'i tshes bcu sogs: dus sbyor dge bar 'dra 'bag tshad ldan sogs: gsang gsum rten bkram phyi nang mchod pas spras: spyi chings sbyor dngos rjes kyi rim par bstan: sbyor bar skyabs sems tshogs bsags bka' bsgo dang : mtshams gcod byin 'bebs mchod rdzas brlab pa'o: dang po skyabs 'gro ni: na moḥ phyogs bcu'i dus bzhi'i skyabs yum ma lus pa: ye shes gcig gi dbyings su 'dus pa'i dpyid: padma 'byung gnas bde gshegs rtsa gsum lhar: byang chub snying po'i bar du skyabs su mchi: gnyis pa sems bskyed ni: hoḥ ji ltar sngon gyi bde gshegs sras bcas kyis: 'gro ba'i don du bla med thugs bskyed bzhin: bdag gis nyes spyod kun sdom dge chos bsdus: smon 'jug don dam byang sems rtag tu bskyed: gsum pa tshogs bsags ni: hūm̐: rang rig bla ma rtsa gsum lha tshogs la: gnyis su med pa'i gar gyis phyag 'tshal lo: tshogs drug zhen pa bral ba'i mchod sprin 'bul: gzung 'dzin dri ma lta bas klong du bshags: bla med lta sgom spyod la rjes yi rang : brjod med don gyi chos 'khor bskor bar bskul: bde chen 'pho 'gyur bral bar rtag bzhugs gsol:

'khor gsum dmigs mtha' bral ba'i pha mthar bsngo: lhun grub gzhon nu bum skur byang chub shog: bzhi pa bka' bsgo ni: hūm̐: dbang chen rta mchog rgyal po'i bka' byung bas: bla med gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor 'dir: 'du ba'i lha ni ma gtogs glags lta'i bgegs: gtor ma 'di longs rang gnas bde bar dengs: dam las 'da' na tshig par gdon mi za: de bas da lta nyid du phyir dengs shig: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ lnga pa mtshams gcod ni: hūm̐: dbang drag 'bar ba'i gsang gsum ye shes mdangs: phyi snod gzhal yas nang bcud sems can lha: snang srid dag pa rab 'byams dkyil 'khor la: gnyis 'dzin bgegs kyi bar chad ga la srid: mtshams kyi dkyil 'khor rang bzhin lhun gyis grub: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra kro ta dzñā na rakṣa aḥ drug pa byin 'bebs ni: hūm̐: chos kyi sku la gshegs bzhugs mi mnga' yang : 'gro don lhun rdzogs gu ru rtsa gsum lha: sngon gyi thugs dam zhal bzhes rjes dgongs la: dbyings nas 'dir byon byin phob dbang bskur cig: gnas yul gzhal yas bkod pa nyams re dga': sgrub rdzas mchod sprin ye shes rol par gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru dhe wa ḍākki nī e hya hi dzñā na a be sha ya a aḥ bdun pa mchod rdzas byin rlabs ni: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: bdag gi thugs ka'i ye shes me rlung chus: snod bcud dngos 'dzin dri ma dbyings su sbyangs: gnas yul rnam dag padma drwa ba'i zhing : phyi nang mchod sprin ye shes rol par gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda āḥhūm̐ swā hā: oṃ ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta bha lingta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhāḥ oṃ bho dhi tsitta ma hā ta na ga na pū dza āḥhūm̐: sbyor ba'i las rim rdzogs nas gnyis pa ni: dngos gzhir lha bskyed spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol dang : phyag mchod bstod dang bzlas pa bya ba'o: dang po lha bskyed ni:

aḥ chos rnams smra bsam brjod med de bzhin nyid: rang gdangs ma 'gags stong nyid snying rje'i rtsal: skad cig mkha' la skar chen shar ba bzhin: rig pa rgyu yi yi ge hrīḥdamar po: 'od zer sna lnga 'byung ba'i yi ge 'phros: eḥyam̐ḥbam̐ḥram̐ḥlam̐ḥrnams rim bzhin zhu: nam mkha' rlung chu me sa'i dkyil 'khor lnga: bde chen 'gyur med yum lnga'i bha ga'i klong : bhrūm̐ las rang byung lhun 'grub gzhal yas khang : zhing khams sum brtsegs 'ja' tshon 'od phung 'bar: gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta bab gdugs tog dang : ri dwags pho mo'i chos nyan chos 'khor ldan: rab mdzes rin chen sna lngas brtsegs pa la: 'dod snam pha gu drwab shar bu dang : mda' yab la sogs tshad dang mtshan nyid rdzogs: phyi ltar rin chen sna lngas pho brang che: nang ltar dur khrod drag po'i bkod pa rdzogs: de dbus brag chen khri rkang pad nyi'i gdan: ru tra pho mo bsnol ba'i dbus nyid du: rig pa rgyu yi hrīḥnyid thol gyis bab: 'od zer yar mar 'phro 'du don gnyis byas: ma bcos rdzogs pa rang byung don gyi lha: 'khor 'das spyi dpal dbang chen hya ghṝ: dmar nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri thod 'dzin: spyi gtsug ral gseb rta mgo ljang zhur 'tsher: dpal dang dur khrod chas kyis brjid par brgyan: rigs bdag ye shes khyung chen me 'od 'bar: ye shes me phung rab 'bar klong du rol: hūm̐: dbang chen thugs dbus 'ja' 'od thig le'i klong : pad sdong thabs shes nyi zla 'od 'bar steng : sku gsum dgongs 'dus bla ma che ba'i mchog: snang srid zil gnon pad 'byung rgyal ba'i sku: bcu drug lo lon dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs: zhi ma khro nyams brtse bas rjes chags tshul: spyan zung lta stangs gdul bya'i 'gro la gzigs: gsang gos phod kha ber phyam chos gos dmar: phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga gdengs stabs phyar: g.yon pas bdud rtsi'i thod pa tshe bum mtshan: gru mo g.yon na kha ṭwāṃ rtse gsum pa:

bde stong zung 'jug yum gyi ngo bor rten: zhabs gnyis rdor skyil sku lus drang por bzhugs: bde gshegs rab 'byams bkod pa sku la rdzogs: dpral bar 'jam dpal mgrin par rta mchog dbang : thugs kar yang dag lte bar che mchog dpal: lte 'og mngon rdzogs gsang bar phur bu'i lha: bla g.yas drag 'dul bla g.yon drag sngags bdag: spyi gtsug rdo rje'i chos te bka' brgyad lha: ye shes klong dgu'i ngo bor lhun gyis grub: spyi dpal dbu steng mas rim tho brtsegs tshul: chos sku kun bzang longs sku rdo rje sems: sprul sku dga' rab rdo rje shrī seng sogs: brgyud gsum rig 'dzin bla ma'i sprin phung gtibs: gzhan yang nyi ma dang ni 'od zer bzhin: ye shes lnga rdzogs sku lnga thod phreng rtsal: tshogs brgyad rnam dag sgyu 'phrul mtshan mchog brgyad: gang 'dul rnam rol 'phrul mtshan bzhi bcu dang : rigs drug dbyings sgrol 'gro 'dul gu ru drug: tshad med sprin las ging chen yab yum brgyad: 'byung lnga rnam dag mkha' 'gro'i sprin phung 'khrigs: phrin las thog med sde brgyad pho nyar 'gyed: dpal chen grub pa'i mchog gi rig 'dzin brgyad: thugs sras grub brnyes rje 'bangs nyer lnga sogs: dkon mchog rtsa gsum rgya mtsho 'phro zhing 'du: zhing khams sum brtsegs steng khang chos sku dang : bar khang longs sku rigs kyi tshom bur gsal: du mar snang yang ngo bo ngang du gcig: rtsa gsum kun 'dus gu ru yid bzhin nor: dran pa tsam gyis srid zhi'i gdung ba sel: sgom pa tsam gyis mchog thun dngos grub thob: snang stong sgyu ma chu zla lta bur gsal: gdod nas dag pa ye shes lngar dbang rdzogs: rgyal kun rdo rje gsum gyi ngo bor dag: hrīḥhūm̐ trām̐ oṃ āḥ.a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ: oṃ āḥhūm̐: gnyis pa spyan 'dren ni: lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis bskul bas phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang slob mar bcas pa dgongs 'dus dkyil gsum gyi 'khor lo'i rnam par bzhengs:

khyad par du zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bo padma 'od kyi gzhal yas nas gu ru padma 'byung gnas la 'khor rtsa gsum zhi khro rab 'byams kyis bskor ba til gyi gong bu kha phye ba ltar lha tshogs dpag tu med pa mdun gyi nam mkhar badzra sa ma ya dzaḥ sa sad par bsam mo: hūm̐: sngon gyi bskal pa dang po la: o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams: dha na ko sha'i mtsho gling du: padma ge sar sdeng po la: ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes: padma 'byung gnas zhes su grags: 'khor du dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dang : rtsa gsum zhi khro tshogs kyis bskor: khyed kyi rjes su bdag sgrub kyi: byin gyis rlobs phyir gshegs su gsol: gnas mchog 'di ru byin phob la: sgrub mchog bdag la dbang bzhi bskur: bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma thod phreng rtsal badzra sa mā ya dzaḥsiddhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ badzra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ gsum pa bzhugs gsol ni: hūm̐: zhing khams sum brtsegs pho brang dam pa 'di: sku gsum lhun grub bzhugs gnas nyams re dga': gu ru rtsa ba gsum gyi lha tshogs rnams: mi g.yo dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs su gsol: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ badzra sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan: bzhi pa phyag 'tshal ba ni: na moḥ skye 'gag 'gyur med phrin las rab 'byams rdzogs: rang byung thugs rjes ma lus 'gro ba 'dul: gu ru rtsa ba gsum gyi lha tshogs la: gnyis med rtse gcig yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo: a ti pu hoḥ pra tītstsha hoḥ lnga pa mchod pa ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: dngos 'byor yid sprul 'phrul dga'i longs spyod bzhin: phyag rgya gar sogs phyi nang gsang ba yi: kun tu bzang po bla med mchod sprin gyis: dkyil 'khor rab 'byams ma lus mnyes gyur cig: oṃ badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda rū pa shabda gandhe rā sa sparshe dharma dhā tu sarba pū dza hoḥ

oṃ ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta ma hā rakta ma hā bha lingta kha kha khā hi: oṃ bho dhi tsitta ma hā ta ṇa ga na pū dza hoḥ drug pa bstod pa ni: hrīḥ ma bcos spros bral bla ma chos kyi sku: bde chen longs spyod bla ma chos kyi rje: pad sdong las 'khrungs bla ma sprul pa'i sku: sku gsum rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: sku ni mi 'gyur kun tu bzang po'i sku: gsung ni mi 'gag mnyam nyid rig pa'i gsung : thugs ni mi g.yo smra bsam brjod las 'das: sku gsung thugs ldan padma rgyal por bstod: hūm̐: 'gro ba'i don du rang byung 'od dpag med: bkra shis yon tan du mas brgyan pa'i sku: 'jig rten dbang phyug padma rgyal po'i sras: rdo rje thod phreng rtsal la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: sku mchog zil gnon 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed: gsung mchog 'gag med dbang chen hya ghṛ: thugs mchog 'gyur med yang dag he ru kaḥ gsang gsum dbyings su rdzogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: yon tan che mchog zhi khro rab 'byams rgyal: ma mo mkha' 'gro'i gtso bo mngon rdzogs rgyal: phrin las bdag nyid rdo rje phur pa'i lha: ye shes sku lnga rdzogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: rdo rje drag rtsal bla ma rig 'dzin rje: gsang bdag gos sngon mchod bstod dregs pa'i bdag: stobs ldan nag po dmod pa drag sngags gtso: bde gshegs 'dus pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: sku gsum sku lnga mtshan brgyad rig 'dzin brgyad: rje 'bangs nyer lnga yi dam bka' brgyad lha: bdun brgya nyer lnga mkha' 'gro dam can tshogs: ye shes gcig gi rol par phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: chos sku stong par mchod bstod mi dmigs kyang : gzugs sku lhun grub 'khor ba ma stong bar: thugs rje'i gang 'dul ye shes sgyu ma'i lhar: dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: bdun pa dzap dgongs ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: phyi snod 'jig rten ma bskyed gzhal yas khang :

nang bcud sems can yongs grub rtsa ba gsum: snang srid gzhir bzhengs rang byung don gyi lha: sku gsum dgongs pa yongs rdzogs 'dus pa yi: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dbyings nas skur bzhengs shig: rdo rje'i gdung 'tshob rnal 'byor sgrub mchog dang : rdo rje'i mched lcam rdo rje'i g.yar gam ni: srog gi phyir yang mi gtong sgrub lags na: thugs rje'i thugs dam ma g.yel nyer dgongs la: sku gsung thugs kyi dbyings su bdag sgrub shig: gdung bas dzap dbyangs spos rol gzi byin bskyed: hūm̐: gu ru'i thugs kar ye shes sems dpa'i tshul: yang dag thugs dbus ting 'dzin sems dpa' ni: zla steng rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐ dkar mthar: sngags 'khor 'od kyis zangs mdog dpal ri nas: o rgyan chen po'i thugs brgyud rab tu bskul: rab 'byams zhi khro gu ru rtsa gsum lha'i: phyag rgya sku dang yig 'bru phyag mtshan tshogs: nyi zer rdul dang kha char bu yug bzhin: rgyun mi chad par spyan drangs byin brlab gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma siddhi hūm̐: ma yengs rtse gcig chu bo'i rgyun bzhin du: kun 'dus nor bu'i lugs kyi rtsa sngags bzla: zhi khro bka' brgyad lha sngags dag dran bstan: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ni sku gsum zhi khro'i srog: gu hya dzñā na gsang ba ye shes dbyings: shī rang byung 'khor 'das spyi yi dpal: badzra kro ta rdo rje khro bo'i rgyal: ru lu gnas lugs chos dbyings skye ba med: ru lu snang lugs he ru ka yi dal: hūm̐ ni snang ba yab ste dpal chen dgu: bhyo ni stong pa yum ste dbyings phyug dgu: hūm̐ gis gnyis med chos skur la bzla zhing : phaṭḥkyis log rtog gnyis snang dbyings bsgral: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu hya dzñā na shrī badzra kro ta ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐ phaṭḥ yang dag dgongs pa'i gzer bcas bzlas par 'bad: mchog thun dngos grub myur thob sa ma ya:

gsum pa rjes kyi bya bar tshogs mchod ni: byin rlabs spyan 'dren mchod bshags bsgral bstab dang : lhag ma bskul dang chad brtan rta bro brdung : dngos grub len dang nongs bshags dkyil 'khor bsdu: bsngo smon bkra shis mtha' brgyan bya ba'o: dang po tshogs rdzas gtsang bsags byin rlabs ni: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: bdag gi thugs las 'byung ba'i yi ge 'phros: me rlung chu yis tshogs kyi dngos 'dzin sbyangs: slar yang oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis tshogs rdzas rnams: sbyangs rtogs spar bas ye shes 'khor lor gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ gnyis pa spyan 'dren ni: hūm̐: o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams: padma ge sar sdong po la: ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes: padma 'byung gnas zhes su grags: 'khor du dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dang : rtsa gsum zhi khro'i tshogs kyis bskor: khyed kyi rjes su bdag sgrub kyi: tshogs kyi 'du bar gshegs su gsol: gnas mchog 'di ru byin phob la: tshogs mchod ye shes bdud rtsir bsgyur: bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: badzra sa ma ya dzaḥ e ma hoḥ tshogs khang gsang chen rol pa nyams re dga': rab 'jigs dur khrod rol pa'i rgyan dang ldan: tshogs gzhong padma bhandha rgya re yangs: tshogs gtor ye shes bdud rtsi bcud re che: sha lnga bdud rtsi'i longs spyod dang re spro: tshogs rje bla ma yi dam byin re che: byin rlabs dngos sprin phung thibs se thib: tshogs mgron dpa' bo mkha' 'gro grangs re mang : dar dang ratna rus pa'i rgyan dang ldan: cang ti'u dang ni dril bu'i sgra dang bcas: rdo rje glu dang gar stabs shigs se shig: 'du tshogs rnal 'byor pho mo dam re gtsang : nyams dang rtogs pa'i ye shes sha ra ra: bla med gsang chen sngags kyi dam tshig rdzas: bde chen tshogs kyi 'khor lo e ma rmad: a la la ste thugs dam dbyings su skong : srid zhi mnyam nyid thig le chen po'i dbyings:

khams gsum 'khor ba'i sems can thams cad kyi: nyams chag rtog tshogs ma spang rang grol nas: rang rig dag pa sku gsum mngon gyur te: kun bzang gdod ma'i gzhi la sangs rgyas shog: oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐:

tshogs kyi rtogs pa bskyed cing nyams chag bskangs: gsum pa mchod pa ni: hūm̐: bla med tshogs kyi mchod pa dam pa 'di: dpag med 'dod yon lha mos gar bsgyur bcas: gu ru rtsa gsum dkyil lha la 'bul: bzhes nas dbang dang dngos grub bstsal du gsol: ma hā ga ṇa tsakra bha lingta pū dza khā hi: bzhi pa bshags pa ni: hoḥ ye thog 'khrul gzhi blang nas da lta'i bar: rig dang ma rig 'khrul pas las dbang gis: bcas dang rang bzhin nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs: 'dod yon tshogs kyi 'khor los bskang zhing bshags: badzra sa ma ya shuddhe aḥ lnga pa bsgral bstab ni: hūm̐: gzung 'dzin 'khrul pa'i rang gzugs dgra dang bgegs: stong nyid rnam thar e yi brub khung du: tshad med phyag rgya rnam bzhis dbyer med bstim: rnam shes dbyings sgrol gzugs phung zhal du bstab: a spha ra ṇa phaṭḥ dgra bgegs nṛ tri sarba shā truṃ mā ra ya phaṭḥ ma hā māṃ sa rakta kiṃ ni ri ti sarba ru tra pra wan tsakra pū dza kha kha khā hi: ha ha ha: hi hi hi: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: tshogs kyi nang mchod bsreg blug tshim par rol: drug pa lhag ma ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: hūm̐ bhyoḥ lhag la dbang ba'i dkyil 'khor mtha' skyong ba: dpal gyi 'khor tshogs badzra a rā li: ma tshogs dbang phyug ging lang 'bar ma'i tshogs: lhag gtor dgyes bzhes rnam bzhi'i phrin las sgrubs: utstshiṣṭa bha ling ta khā hi: bdun pa thugs dam bskul ba ni: hūm̐: phyogs bcu dag pa'i dkyil 'khor yangs pa nas: thugs rje dgongs shig bslu med dkon mchog gsum: dbyings nas bzhengs shig gu ru rtsa ba gsum: brgyud gsum dam can srung ma las la bzhengs: sna tshogs gang 'dul phrin las dus la bab: phyi yi dus 'khrug snod kyi rgud pa sol: nang gi 'byung 'khrugs nad mug mtshon bskal zlog: gsang ba sems 'khrul dug lnga'i rnam rtog gzhil: shin tu mi srid gdul dka' tshar gcod pa'i: phrin las myur du mdzod cig sa ma ya:

brgyad pa chad thod bsgrags pa ni: hūm̐ bhyoḥ dus gsum brgyud gsum rig 'dzin bla ma dang : he ru ka yi dam la rab gnas pa'i: bka' yi lha 'dre brgyud gsum dregs pa'i sde: chad tho'i gtor ma long la phrin las sgrubs: dgu pa brtan ma skyong ba ni: ma bhyoḥ khyad par slob dpon padma kā ra yis: bka' dang dam gnas bod khams skyong ba'i ma: dus sbyor bcu gnyis dag pa'i bstan skyong tshogs: bshal chu'i gtor ma dgyes bzhes phrin las mdzod: oṃ ma ma hrīṃ hrīṃ bā liṃ ta khā hi: bcu pa bro brdung bya ba ni: hūm̐: rnam thar gsum ldan e yi dbyings nyid du: gzung 'dzin mtshan mar lta ba'i dam sri brub: ye shes lnga yi glu blang bro brdung bas: 'od gsal stong nyid bde ba'i klong du sba: oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā: lam̐ḥya ma dam sri tri satwaṃ bha ya nan: bcu gcig pa dngos grub len pa ni: hoḥ gu ru rtsa gsum lha tshogs dgongs su gsol: sku gsung thugs kyi bha ga yangs pa nas: phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub dang : thun mong las bzhi grub brgyad 'dod rgu char: da lta nyid du bstsal zhing brtan par mdzod: rtsa sngags dang : kā ya wākka tsitta sarba siddhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ bcu gnyis pa nongs bshags ni: hoḥ gsang ba'i sgor zhugs rnal 'byor sgrub pa pos: bag med dbang gyur ting 'dzin ma gsal zhing : lha sngags ma dag cho gar lhag chad sogs: ye shes lha dang srung mar bzod par gsol: yig brgya bzla: bcu gsum pa dkyil 'khor bsdu rim ni: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: snang cha lha sngags 'khor lo dbyings su bsdu: mi gnas thugs kyi thig les rtag mtha' bral: a a āḥ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ stong nyid rang gdangs thugs rje'i ye shes rtsal: sku gsung thugs kyi 'khor los chad mtha' spangs: oṃ āḥhūm̐: badzra ma ma ka wa tsi rakṣa3 haṃ: bcu bzhi pa bsngo smon ni: hoḥ bdag gis dus gsum dge ba ci bsags mthus: nam mkha'i mthar thug gyur pa'i sems can kun:

bla med theg mchog sngags kyi snod gyur nas: padma rgyal po'i go 'phang myur thob shog: bco lnga pa bkra shis ni: hrīḥ rnga sgra'i rgyal po gzi brjid 'od dpag med: spyan ras gcig dbang dbang chen rta skad 'tsher: sgyu 'phrul drwa ba padma rgyal po che: sku gsum lhun grub rgyal ba'i bkra shis shog: gab sbas dkrugs med chu 'bab phrin las gzhung : dus gsum sgrib med padma nga nyid kyis: rang gi sgrub thabs rang gi byas nas su: ma 'ongs las can don du gtad rgyas btab: ma mo e ka tsa tis gnyer kha bsrungs: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gu hya: ྀatsha: ces pa'ang 'gro 'dul pad rgyal gling pas sbas yul padma bkod kyi 'brug la mar me kong 'bum zhes brag pha waṃ gur dbub pa 'dra ba'i nub logs nas dngos grub tu thob pa'i zab gter yang dag pa ste/ mi lo nyer bzhi'i bar gsang rgyar btab pa'i slar o rgyan chen po'i phrin las kyi gnas mchog mon kha ne rin seṅge rdzong ratna spungs pa'i ke'u tshang nas gtan la phab pa'o/ / sarba dā maṅga laṃ// ༄༅/ / sman mchod bsdus pa ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: chos sku snang mtha' thugs rje'i klong dkyil nas: longs sku thugs chen dbang chen hya ghṛ: rang byung sprul sku padma yab yum la: sman mchod 'bul lo dbang dang dngos grub stsol: sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi: dgongs pas gtad rgya thugs rje'i klong dkyil nas: buddha dzñā na rje 'bangs grogs bcas dang : gter ston sprul sku brgyud pa'i bla ma la: sman mchod 'bul lo dbang dang dngos grub stsol: sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi: 'phags yul dpal chen mchog grub rig 'dzin brgyad: sgyu 'phrul drwa ba gu ru mtshan mchog brgyad: grub chen bka' brgyad dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: sman mchod 'bul lo dbang dang dngos grub stsol: sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi: bde stong ye shes bha ga'i klong dkyil nas: gsang ba ye shes badzra wā rā hi:

mthong 'od 'bar ma gnas gsum ḍākki ma: sman mchod 'bul lo dga' bzhi ye shes spel: sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi: brgyud gsum bla ma gsang chen rgyud sde'i mdzod: dgongs pas gtad rgya sde gsum dregs pa'i sde: rdo rje'i chos skyong dam can rgya mtsho la: sman mchod 'bul lo phyi nang bar chad sol: sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi: bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug sgom pa'i klong dkyil nas: rdo rje'i phung khams gdan gsum lha yi mdangs: snang srid dag pa rab 'byams dkyil 'khor la: sman mchod 'bul lo sku gsum mngon gyur stsol: sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi: kā ya siddhi oṃ: wākka siddhi āḥ tsitta siddhi hūm̐: sarba siddhi hrīḥ dngos grub blang*/ ces pa'ang kā ma la rā dza dwī pas byin rlabs kyi bab che phyir gter gzhung gi dgongs bcud bsdus te sbyar bas yi ge pa ni dzñā nas zhus pa siddhi rastu// ༄༅/ / sku gsum dgongs 'dus cha lags tshogs glu dbyar rnga'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba// e ho ye/ sa gsum nam mkha' yangs pa'i lha lam gyi dbus na/ /'byung bzhir rang dbang thob pa g.yu 'brug gi gsung gdangs/ /lha dbang g.yul las rgyal ba'i rnga sgra las mtho ba/ /theg mchog rdzogs pa chen po'i seṅge yi sgra dbyangs/ /phyogs dus kun tu khyab pa'i rten 'brel la legs song*/ /ngo mtshar glu dbyangs len pa'i khyad chos zhig yod do/ /phun tshogs lo 'dab rgyas pa'i ljon shing gi steng na/ /tshangs dbyangs rang dbang thob pa'i khu dbyug gi gsung gdangs/ /'chi med lha yi bu mo'i gling bu las snyan pa/ /gsang chen rdo rje'i chos char 'dul zhing la sim nas/ /grub brnyes 'dod pa 'jo ba'i rten 'brel la legs song*/ /ngo mtshar glu dbyangs len pa'i khyad chos shig yod do/ /skal ldan las can pho mo'i tshogs khang gi dbus na/ /bskyed rdzogs rang dbang thob pa'i bla ma yi gsung gdangs/

/'jigs med gdong lnga'i rgyal po'i ngar skar las mtho ba/ /lta dman ri dwags tshogs kyi khengs pa kun bcom nas/ /theg gsum g.yu ral rgyas pa'i rten 'brel la legs song*/ /ngo mtshar glu dbyangs len pa'i khyad chos zhig yod do/ /gdan gsum lha yi dkyil 'khor rang lus kyi dbus na/ /rang rig rang dbang thob pa rang byung gi rgyal po/ /thugs rje'i mkha' la 'gro ba'i 'khor tshogs kyi bskor ba'i/ /kun bzang padma'i rang zhal ma bsgoms kyang mjal byung*/ /tshe gcig sangs rgyas 'grub pa'i rten 'brel la legs song*/ /ngo mtshar glu dbyangs len pa'i khyad chos shig yod do/ /sangs rgyas mi gzugs byon pa bla ma yi zhal las/ /gdams zab bdud rtsi'i bcud rol dga' ston gyi ngang nas/ /ma dang mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi snying khrag gi dwangs ma/ /rdzogs chen snang bzhi'i rtsal chen rang gshis su rdzogs te/ /theg dgu'i yang rtser son pa'i mthong chos kyi ya mtshan/ /'ja' lus chos sku 'grub pa'i dngos grub zhig zhu'o/ / ces pa'ang kā ma la rā dzas seng rdzong gu ru bzhugs khri nas dus mgron dbyar rnga'i skad gsar thos pa'i rkyen gyis thol byung shor song ngo*// ༄༅/ /sku gsum dgongs 'dus las/ rtsa sgrub bla ma'i las byang rgyun khyer dngos grub 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru bhye/ sku gsum dbyer med lha la rab tu 'dud/ /'di nyid dngos grub lam du byed pa'i thabs/ /man ngag gzhung las nyung ngur bsdud de bstan/ /spyi don gsum gyi dang po sbyor ba ni/ na moḥ ye nas chos kun sku gsum rang bzhin la: gnyis med rol pa chen por skyabs su mchi: 'gro kun gdod nas ye sangs rgyas pa'i don: yin par shes pa'i ngang nas sems bskyed do: lan gsum/ mchod rdzas rnams/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: snang srid rnam dag padma drwa ba'i klong : ye shes rang rtsal mchod pa'i phyag rgyar rdzogs: oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrī āḥ

badzra spha ra ṇa khaṃ: dngos gzhi ni/ aḥ chos rnams smra bsam brjod med de bzhin nyid: rang gdangs ma 'gags stong nyid snying rje'i rtsal: rig gdang rgyu yig hrīḥdamar 'phro 'du las: eḥyam̐ḥbam̐ḥram̐ḥlam̐ḥrnams rim bzhin zhu: nam mkha' rlung chu me sa'i dkyil 'khor lnga: bde chen 'gyur med yum lnga'i bha ga'i klong : bhrūm̐ las rang byung lhun grub gzhal yas khang : zhing khams sum brtsegs 'ja' tshon 'od phung 'bar: sgo gru rta babs mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs: phyi ltar rin chen sna lnga'i pho brang che: nang ltar dur khrod drag po'i bkod pa rdzogs: de dbus brag chen khri rkang pad nyi'i gdan: ru tra pho mo bsnol ba'i dbus nyid du: rig pa rgyu yi hrīḥnyid thol gyis bab: 'od zer yar mar 'phro 'du don gnyis byas: ma bcos rdzogs pa rang byung don gyi lha: 'khor 'das spyi dpal dbang chen hya ghṛ: dmar nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis gro thod 'dzin: spyi gtsug ral gseb rta mgo ljang zhur 'tsher: dpal dang dur khrod chas kyis brjid par brgyan: rigs bdag ye shes khyung chen me 'od 'bar: ye shes me dpung rab 'bar klong du rol: hūm̐: dbang chen thugs dbus 'ja' 'od thig le'i klong : pad sdong thabs shes nyi zla 'od 'bar steng : sku gsum dgongs 'dus bla ma che ba'i mchog: snang srid zil gnon pad 'byung rgyal ba'i sku: bcu drug lo lon dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs: zhi ma khro nyams brtse bas rjes chags tshul: spyan zung lta stangs gdul bya'i 'gro la gzigs: gsang gos phod kha ber phyam chos gos dmar: phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga gdengs stabs phyar: g.yon pas bdud rtsi'i thod pa tshe bum mtshan: gru mo g.yon na kha ṭwāṃ rtse gsum pa: bde stong zung 'jug yum gyi ngo bor brten: zhabs gnyis rdor skyil sku lus drang por bzhugs: bde gshegs rab 'byams bkod pa sku la rdzogs: dpral par 'jam dpal mgrin par rta mchog dbang :

thugs kar yang dag lte bar che mchog dpal: lte 'og mngon rdzogs gsang bar phur ba'i lha: brla g.yas dregs 'dul brla g.yon drag sngags dag: spyi gtsug rdo rje chos te bka' brgyad lha: ye shes klong dgu'i ngo bor lhun gyis grub: spyi dpal dbu steng mas rim mtho brtsegs tshul: chos sku kun bzang longs sku rdo rje sems: sprul sku dga' rab rdo rje shrī seng sogs: brgyud gsum rig 'dzin bla ma'i sprin phung gtib: gzhan yang nyi ma dam ni 'od zer bzhin: ye shes lnga rdzogs sku lnga thod phreng rtsal: tshogs brgyad rnam dag sgyu 'phrul mtshan mchog brgyad: gang 'dul rnam rol 'phrul mtshan bzhi bcu dang : rigs drug dbyings sgrol 'gro 'dul gu ru drug: tshad med phrin las ging chen yab yum brgyad: 'byung lnga rnam dag mkha' 'gro'i sprin phung 'khrigs: phrin las thogs med sde brgyad pho nyar 'gyed: dpal chen grub pa'i mchog rig 'dzin brgyad: thugs sras grub brnyes rje 'bangs nyer lnga sogs: dkon mchog rtsa gsum rgya mtsho 'phro zhing 'du: zhing khams gsum brtsegs steng khang chos sku dang : bar khang longs sku rigs kyi tshom bur gsal: du mar snang yang ngo bo ngang du gcig: rtsa gsum kun 'dus gu ru yid bzhin nor: dran pa tsam gyis srid zhi'i gdung ba sel: sgom pa tsam gyis mchog thun dngos grub thob: snang stong sgyu ma chu zla lta bur gsal: gdod nas dag pa ye shes lngar dbang rdzogs: rgyal kun rdo rje gsum gyi ngo bor dag: hrīḥhūm̐ trām̐ oṃ āḥ a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ: oṃ āḥhūm̐: ye shes pa 'gugs bstim ni/ hūm̐ dzaḥ rang snang rnam dag don gyi 'og min nas: rang rig byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor pa: gshegs dang bzhugs pa'i mtshan ma las 'das kyang : snang cha'i rten 'brel bslu med gdul bya'i ngor: rtsal dang rol pa zhi dang khro chags tshul: snang stong dbyer med chu zla'i zlos gar bzhin:

ye shes sgyu ma gzugs kyi skur bzhengs te: thugs rje'i dbang gis yang dag nye bar mdzod: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta e hya hi bha ga wan ma hā ka ru ṇi ka dṛ shya hoḥ zhes dang*/ rdo rje'i tshig bdun dang thod phreng rtsal gyi dzap dbyangs dang sbyar spos rtag spros thod rngas sgra bcas gdung ba'i shugs kyis ye shes pa spyan drangs te/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa gnyis su med par bstim/ badzra sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan gyis gdan 'bul/ a ti pu hoḥ pra tītstsha hoḥ sa phyag byas la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: dngos sbyor yid sprul 'phrul dga'i longs spyod bzhin: phyag rgya gar sogs phyi nang gsang ba yi: kun tu bzang po bla med mchod sprin gyis: rab 'byams dkyil 'khor ma lus mnyes gyur cig: oṃ badzra puṣpe sogs nas shabda 'i bar gyi phyis mchod dang : oṃ ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta bha lingta kha kha khā hiḥ sa nang mchod dang*/ ma hā ta na ga ṇa pū dza hoḥ sa gsang ba'i mchod pa/ ma hā dharma dhā tu aḥ de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa bcas kyis mchod la/ hūm̐: chos sku stong par mchod bstod mi dmigs kyang : gzugs sku lhun grub 'khor ba ma stong par: thugs rje'i gang 'dul ye shes sgyu ma'i lha: dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal bstod:

bsnyen dmigs ni/ hūm̐: gu ru'i thugs kar ye shes sems dpa'i tshul: yang dag thugs dbus ting 'dzin sems dpa' ni: zla steng rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐ dkar mthar: sngags 'khor 'od kyis zangs mdog dpal ri nas: o rgyan chen po'i thugs rgyud rab tu bskul: rab 'byams zhi khro gu ru rtsa gsum lha'i: phyag rgya sku dang yig 'bru phyag mtshan tshogs: nyi zer rdul dang kha char bu yug bzhin: rgyun mi chad par spyan drangs byin brlab gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma siddhi hūm̐: ma yengs rtse gcig chu bo'i rgyan bzhin du: kun 'dus nor bu'i lugs kyi rtsa sngags bzla: zhi khro bka' brgyad lha sngags dag dran bstan: oṃ āḥ.oṃ āḥhūm̐ ni sku gsum zhi khro'i srog: gu hya dzñā na gsang ba ye shes dbyings: shī rang byung 'khor 'das spyi yi dpal: badzra kro ta rdo rje khro bo'i rgyal: ru lu gnas lugs chos dbyings skye ba med: ru lu snang lugs he ru ka yi dal: hūm̐ ni snang ba yab ste dpal chen dgu: bhyo ni stong pa yum ste dbyings phyug dgu: hūm̐ gis gnyis med chos skur la bzla zhing : phaṭḥkyis log rtog gnyis snang dbyings bsgral: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu hya dzñā na shrī badzra kro ta ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐ phaṭḥ yang dag dgongs pa'i gzer bcas bzlas par 'bad: mchog thun dngos grub myur thob sa ma ya: gsum pa rjes kyi bya bar tshogs mchod ni: dang po tshogs rdzas gtsang bsags byin gyis rlabs: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gyis nyes skyon dri ma sbyang*/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis 'dod yon phung por brlab/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho/ dzaḥ tshogs mgron dkon mchog rtsa gsum rgyal mtsho'i tshogs/ /skad cig 'dir byon dgyes pa'i gdan la bzhugs/ /dngos su 'byor bshams dpag med 'dod yon tshogs/ /nam mkha' gang bar spros te dgyes pa bskong*/ /rig dang ma rig nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs/ /'dod yon tshogs kyi mchod pas bskang zhing bshags/

/bdag med mtshon chas bzung 'dzin dbyings bsgral ba'i/ /dam rdzas sha khrag rus pas thugs dam bskang*/ /dug gsum rnam dag sku gsung thugs kyi klong*/ /mchod bya mchod byed gnyis med bde ba ches/ /lhun grub rdzogs pa chen po'i klong du bskang*/ /sangs rgyas sems can gnyis su 'dzin pa'i blo/ /rnam par mi rtog bde chen ye shes che'i/ /sbyor ba med de khams gsum yongs kyi sbyor/ /sgrol ba med de khams gsum yongs kyi sgrol/ /zung 'jug bde ba chen po'i klong du bskang : srid zhi mnyam nyid 'od gsal byang chub sems/ /rig stong 'pho 'gyur bral ba'i klong du a/ / tshogs la rol zhing lhag ma byin gyis brlab/ hūm̐ bhyo/ lha mar dbang ba'i mgron kun gtor ma longs/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las rnam pa bzhi/ /g.yel med grogs mdzod gsang chen bstan pa srungs/ /lus dang grib bzhin 'bral med phrin las bsgrub/ /e a ra li bakṣa su bā liṃ ta khā hi: rjes chog yig brgya sngon du 'gro bas/ hūm̐/ ma dag lhag chad 'gal 'khrul ci mchis pa/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs spyan sngar mthong zhing bshags/ /hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ḥ gis lhar ldang*/ lha nyid rang la rang nyid lha'i 'khor lor/ /gnyis med bde ba chen po'i klong du muṃ/ /a a āḥ sa mnyam par bzhag /slar yang phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ kyis/ ye shes rang snang ma 'gags rol pa'i rtsal/ /snang grags rig gsum sku gsung thugs su sad/ /rgyun gyi 'gro ba 'dren pa'i spyod lam bya/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra kā wa tsi rakṣa maṃ/ ho/ bdag gis dus gsum dge rtsa byang chub rgyur/ /yongs bsngos padma rgyal po myur 'grub shog /hrīḥ rnga sgra'i rgyal po gzi brjid 'od dpag med/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang dbang chen rta skad 'tsher: sgyu 'phru drwa ba padma rgyal po che/ /sku gsum lhun grub rgyal ba'i bkra shis shog / zhes shis pa brjod/ ces pa'ang mdo sngags chos spyan rab tu yangs pa smyo shul mkhan rin po che 'jam dbyangs rdo rje mchog nas lha rdzas bcas gsung bskul bzhin pad rgyal gling pas gter gzhung gi dgongs bcud ma nor bar bsdus te sbyar ba siddhi rastu//

ྂ/: sku gsum dgongs 'dus las: tshe sgrub 'chi med srog ster zhes bya ba bzhugs so: ྂ/: :hyam̐//: 'chi med tshe yi lha la phyag 'tshal lo: rigs 'dus padma tshe dpag med mgon la: brten nas 'chi med srog ster zab lam bstan: bkra shis yang dben 'chi med sgrub gnas su: yar ngo'i gza' skar dus sbyor dge ba'i char: dal dbus sku gsung thugs kyi rten spyi dang : tshe bum bcud ldan bcud len tshe ril dang : tshe tshang mda' dar la sogs mchod pas spras: sbyor ba rtsa gsum las kyi gzhung bsrang la: dngos gzhir dmigs rim sgom bzlas bya bar bzhi: rdo rje dbye rgyas phaṭ dzaḥs sgra gdangs kyis: skad cig mig 'phrul lta bur dzap khang dbye: hrīḥ dam tshig sems dpa' sku gsum dgongs 'dus sku: phyag rgya snang srid zil gnon thugs ka ru: zla ba la gnas ye shes sems dpa' ni: padma tshe dpag med mgon sku mdog dmar: mnyam bzhag longs sku'i rgyan rdzogs tshe bum 'dzin: thugs kar nyi zla'i gwa'u kha sbyor dbus: ting 'dzin sems dpa' gser rdor rtse lnga'i lter: tshebasod ngo bo bhrūm̐ yig btso ma'i mdog: ha yi khog par tshe gzugs aḥyig dkar: dpung par srog gi dwangs ma nṛḥyig ljang : 'od lnga'i mdangs ldan thig le'i rnam par gsal: tha mar tshe yi rig pa g.yas 'khor las: dpag yas 'od zer lha mos mkhyogs ma'i tshogs: nyi rdul lta bus 'khor 'das zhing kun khyab: srid dang zhi ba'i khams kyi tshe yi bcud: sangs rgyas byang sems tshe lha drang srong tshogs: rigs sngags bden par grub pa'i byin rlabs dang : lha klu mi dbang 'gro ba'i bsod nams stobs: 'byung lnga'i bcud dang bsgrub bya'i bla tshe la: byad kyi bcing dang gdon gyi brkus pa sogs: yar dang 'thor dang bla tshe dbang nyams kun: rang dbang med par khab len lcags phye bzhin: skad cig 'bru gsum rnam par 'gug cing bstim: snum zad sdong rtsar mar khus gsos pa ltar:

bkrag mdangs gzi 'bar 'chi med srog 'grub gyur: oṃ gu ru ā yu siddhi hūm̐: oṃ a mā ra ṇi dzi wan te ye swā hā: oṃ a nri hūm̐ bhrūm̐ dzaḥ dmigs pa'i gzer bcas 'bru 'bum bzlas pa yis: 'chi med rig 'dzin 'grub par som nyi bral: sa ma ya: de nas las sbyor tshe 'gugs bskul ba ni: mda' dar g.yab cing spos gtul dbyang bcas bskul: hrīḥ spros bral bde chen dwangs ma tshe yi dal: lhun grub padma drwa ba'i zhing gi bdag: 'pho chen dwangs ma 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku: sku gsum dgongs 'dus bla ma che ba'i mchog: o rgyan padma rig 'dzin tshe dpag med: sor rtogs ye shes rang mdangs sku mdog dmar: sprul pa'i sku la mtshan dpe'i yon tan rdzogs: 'gyur med rdo rje thod pa tshe bum 'dzin: grub pa'i rgyal mo tshe yum mandha ra: gnyis med sbas tshul kha ṭwāṃ mchan g.yon brten: bde gshegs rab 'byams bkod pa sku la rdzogs: sku yi rang bzhin ma lus zhing kun khyab: mi shig rdo rje sku yi gsang ba nas: sgyu 'phrul tshe bdag gdan gsum zhi khro'i gar: bde gshegs yongs rdzogs sgrub sde brgyad kyi lhar: rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob rnal 'byor sgrub pa po'i: mda' dar g.yab cing gdung bas bskul lags na: bzhengs shig ma g.yel rgyal ba thugs dam can: bskul lo ye shes klong dgu'i dbyings nas bzhengs: thugs dam rgyud bskul sprul dang yang sprul tshogs: tshe 'gugs pho nya nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam: nyi rdul lta bus 'khor 'das srid zhi'i khams: dus gsum rgyal ba'i thugs rje byin rlabs dang : 'byung lnga'i dwangs bcud skye 'gro'i bsod nams stobs: rgyal po mi dbang lha klu drang srong sogs: nus stobs gzi brjid bden tshig grub pa'i tshe: khug cig drongs shig bkra shis tshe g.yang khug: khyad par bsgrub bya'i bla tshe srog dbugs khams: chad yar nyams rgud 'thor dang ral ba dang : grib kyis non dang byad kyis bcings pa dang :

gdon gyis brkus sogs dbang thang nyams pa kun: kham len rdo yis lcags phye blang ba bzhin: aḥnriḥhūm̐ bhrūm̐ 'od lnga'i rnam pa ru: mi shig tshe rten srog gi gwa'ur bskyil: sgrub mchog rnams la 'chi med tshe dbang bskur: ngo mtshar rtags dang mtshan ma myur du ston: srog rten mda' dar 'di la tshad cig ston: bcud len ril bu 'di la zhag cig bskyil: dza gad bdud rtsi 'di la bcud cig phob: rten 'brel bla rten 'di la bkrag cig ston: thugs rje'i rang bzhin tshe bdag rgyal ba yi: skyabs med 'gro ba'i tshe srog chu bur la: dus min 'chi ba'i nyes pa kun bzlog cing : 'chi bdag bdud 'acom tshe yi dpal stsol cig: ye nas skye 'chi mi mnga' rdo rje sku: gang gis gzhom gzhig med pa gzhon nus lus: bri gang 'pho 'gyur dang bral dwangs ma'i srog: 'chi med rtag pa dam pa'i mchog stsol cig: zhes bskul tshe gzungs brjod la yang yang bskyar: mi shig rdo rje tshe gta' sdoms pa ni: a: 'byung ba lnga yi khams nas tshe bcud kun: yum lnga'i mkha' la yongs grub rgyas gdab pas: rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis kyang mi gzigs: bar chad log par 'dren pas ga la srid: oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥdzñā na dharma rakṣa aḥ rten snying sngags brjod kra shis me tog 'thor: dus min 'chi bzlog tshe dpal ye shes 'phel: sdig sgrib kun byang bsod nams dpag med rgyas: zab lam snying bcud mnog pa'i gdams ngag 'di: dus mthar rkyen mang tshe thung long med skabs: chos mdzad skyes bu'i tshe phreng gso ba'i phyir: bdag 'dra padmas 'chi med srog ster 'dir: ma 'ongs las can don du bkod de sbas: skal ldan las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: ྀatsha: ces pa'ang 'gro 'dul pad rgyal gling pas sbas yul chen po padma bkod kyi byang gling dbang drag dga' tshal gyi nye zhol nas 'brug la mar me kong 'bum gyi gnas kyi lte ba brag pha wang mgur dbug pa 'dra ba'i nub logs nas dngos grub tu thob pa'i zab gter gyi gsang ba yang dag pa ste mi lo nyer bzhi'i bar du gsang ba'i dam tshig la gnas pa'i slar gu ru'i phrin las kyi dben gnas mon kha ne rin seṅge rdzong mi 'gyur rdo rje'i bzhugs khri'i ke'u tshang nas chu phag thun mo zhes pa'i sa ga zla ba'i yar tshes bdun rgyal phur me rlung 'grub sbyor bzang po'i char gtan la phab pa dge legs su gyur cig

/sarba dā maṅga laṃ// // ྃ/: sku gsum dgongs pa 'dus pa las: tshe sgrub 'chi med sreg ster gyi: tshe yi bskul byang rgyas par bstan: sa ma ya: rnal 'byor lha sngags dgongs pa'i gzer ldan pas: mda' dar g.yab cing gdung ba'i dbyangs kyis bskul: hūm̐: rang snang rnam dag sku gsum dgongs 'dus kyi: dkyil 'khor shar nas dngos grub bskul ba'i lha: byin gyis rlobs shig rig 'dzin hūm̐ chen kar: dngos grub stsol cig yang dag he ru kaḥ rigs bzhi'i sgyu 'phrul bkod pa'i dkyil 'khor lhar: rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob rnal 'byor sgrub pa po'i: mda' dar g.yab cing gdung bas bskul lags na: bzhengs shig ma g.yel rgyal ba thugs dam can: bskul lo me long ye shes dbyings nas bzhengs: thugs dam rgyud bskul sprul dang yang sprul tshogs: tshe 'gugs pho nya nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam: nyi rdul lta bus 'khor 'das srid zhi'i khams: dus gsum rgyal ba'i thugs rje byin rlabs dang : 'byung lnga'i dwangs bcud skye 'gro'i bsod nams stobs: rgyal po mi dbang lha klu drang srong sogs: nus stobs gzi brjid bden tshig grub pa'i tshe: khug cig drongs shig bkra shis tshe g.yang khug: khyad par bsgrub bya'i bla tshe srog dbugs khams: chad yar nyams rgud 'thor dang ral ba dang : grib kyis non dang byad kyis bcings pa dang : gdon gyi brkus sogs dbang thang nyams pa kun: khab len rdo yis lcags phye blang ba bzhin: aḥnriḥhūm̐ bhrūm̐ 'od lnga'i rnam pa ru: mi shig tshe rten srog gi gwa'ur bskyil: sgrub mchog rnams la 'chi med tshe dbang bskur: ngo mtshar rtags dang mtshan ma myur du ston: srog rten mda' dar 'di la tshad cig ston: bcud lan ril bu 'di la zhag cig bskyil: dza gad bdud rtsi 'di la bcud cig phob: rten 'brel bla rten 'di la bkrag cig ston: thugs rje'i rang bzhin tshe bdag rgyal ba yis: skyabs med 'gro ba'i tshe srog chu bur la:

dus min 'chi ba'i nyes pa kun bzlog cing : 'chi bdag bdud bcom tshe yi dpal stsol cig: ye nas skye 'chi mi mnga' rdo rje'i sku: gang gis gzhom gzhig med pa gzhon nu'i lus: bri gang 'pho 'gyur dang bral dwangs ma'i srog: 'chi med rtag pa dam pa'i mchog stsol cig: oṃ gu ru hūm̐ kā ra a yu siddhi hūm̐: oṃ aḥnriḥhūm̐ bhrūm̐ dzaḥ hūm̐: rang snang rnam dag sku gsum dgongs 'dus kyi: dkyil 'khor lho nas dngos grub bskul ba'i lha: byin gyis rlobs shig rig 'dzin mañdzu shrīḥ dngos grub stsol cig 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed: rigs bzhi'i sgyu 'phrul bkod pa'i dkyil 'khor lhar: rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob rnal 'byor sgrub pa po'i: mda' dar g.yab cing gdung bas bskul lags na: bzhengs shig ma g.yel rgyal ba thugs dam can: bskul lo mnyam nyid ye shes dbyings nas bzhengs: sogs nas mchog stsol cig: oṃ gu ru mañdzu shrī ā yu siddhi hūm̐: oṃ aḥnriḥhūm̐ bhrūm̐ dzaḥ hūm̐: rang snang rnam dag sku gsum dgongs 'dus kyi: dkyil 'khor nub nas dngos grub bskul ba'i lha: byin gyis rlobs shig rig 'dzin nā gardzu: dngos grub stsol cig dbang chen hya ghṛ: rigs bzhi'i sgyu 'phrul bkod pa'i dkyil 'khor lhar: rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob rnal 'byor sgrub pa po'i: mda' dar g.yab cing gdung bas bskul lags na: bzhengs shig ma g.yel rgyal ba thugs dam can: bskul lo sor rtogs ye shes dbyings nas bzhengs: sogs nas mchog stsol cig: oṃ gu ru nā gardzu na ā yu siddhi hūm̐: oṃ aḥnriḥhūm̐ bhrūm̐ dzaḥ hūm̐: rang snang rnam dag sku gsum dgongs 'dus kyi: dkyil 'khor byang nas dngos grub bskul ba'i lha: byin gyis rlobs shig rig 'dzin pra bha ha: dngos grub stsol cig dpal chen kī la ya: rigs bzhi'i sgyu 'phrul bkod pa'i dkyil 'khor lhar: rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob rnal 'byor sgrub pa po'i:

mda' dar g.yab cing gdung bas bskul lags na: bzhengs shig ma g.yel rgyal ba thugs dam can: bskul lo bya grub ye shes dbyings nas bzhengs: sogs nas mchog stsol cig: oṃ gu ru pra bha hastī ā yu siddhi hūm̐: oṃ aḥnriḥhūm̐ bhrūm̐ dzaḥ hūm̐: rang snang rnam dag sku gsum dgongs 'dus kyi: dkyil 'khor shar lhor dngos grub bskul ba'i lha: byin gyis rlobs shig rig 'dzin dha na saṃ: dngos grub stsol cig bla med he ru kaḥ rigs bzhi'i sgyu 'phrul bkod pa'i dkyil 'khor lhar: rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob rnal 'byor sgrub pa po'i: mda' dar g.yab cing gdung bas bskul lags na: bzhengs shig ma g.yel rgyal ba thugs dam can: bskul lo klong gyur ye shes dbyings nas bzhengs:

sogs nas mchog stsol cig: oṃ gu ru dha na saṃ kṛ ta ā yu siddhi hūm̐: oṃ aḥnriḥhūm̐ bhrūm̐ dzaḥ hūm̐: rang snang rnam dag sku gsum dgongs 'dus kyi: dkyil 'khor lho nub dngos grub bskul ba'i lha: byin gyis rlobs shig rig 'dzin bi mā la: dngos grub stsol cig yon tan bdud rtsi'i lha: rigs bzhi'i sgyu 'phrul bkod pa'i dkyil 'khor lhar: rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob rnal 'byor sgrub pa po'i: mda' dar g.yab cing gdung bas bskul lags na: bzhengs shig ma g.yel rgyal ba thugs dam can: bskul lo 'da' ka ye shes dbyings nas bzhengs: sogs nas mchog stsol cig: oṃ gu ru bi mā la mi trā ā yu siddhi hūm̐: oṃ aḥnriḥhūm̐ bhrūm̐ dzaḥ hūm̐: rang snang rnam dag sku gsum dgongs 'dus kyi: dkyil 'khor nub byang dngos grub bskul ba'i lha: byin gyis rlobs shig rig 'dzin rambu gu: dngos grub stsol cig mchod bstod dregs pa'i lha: rigs bzhi'i sgyu 'phrul bkod pa'i dkyil 'khor lhar: rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob rnal 'byor sgrub pa po'i: mda' dar g.yab cing gdung bas bskul lags na: bzhengs shig ma g.yel rgyal ba thugs dam can: bskul lo dbyings grol ye shes dbyings nas bzhengs: sogs nas mchog stsol cig: oṃ gu ru rambu gu hya ā yu siddhi hūm̐: oṃ aḥnriḥhūm̐ bhrūm̐ dzaḥ hūm̐: rang snang rnam dag sku gsum dgongs 'dus kyi: dkyil 'khor byang shar dngos grub bskul ba'i lha: byin gyis rlobs shig rig 'dzin shāntiṃ ghar: dngos grub stsol cig drag sngags dmod pa'i lha: rigs bzhi'i sgyu 'phrul bkod pa'i dkyil 'khor lhar: rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob rnal 'byor sgrub pa po'i: mda' dar g.yab cing gdung bas bskul lags na: bzhengs shig ma g.yel rgyal ba thugs dam can: bskul lo mtha' grol ye shes dbyings nas bzhengs: sogs nas mchog stsol cig: oṃ gu ru shāntiṃ garbha ā yu siddhi hūm̐:

oṃ aḥnriḥhūm̐ bhrūm̐ dzaḥ de ltar bskul bas rnal 'byor sgrub pa po'i: dus min 'chi zlog tshe dang ye shes rgyas: dngos grub kun thob tshe dang sgrub pa mnyam: nyams su longs shig skal ldan snying gi bu: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gu hya: brda thim: ྀatsha: ༈ sku gsum dgongs 'dus las/ rdo sems padma gsang thig gi don dbang bsdus pa bzhug so/ na mo gu ru badzra sa twā ye/ bla ma dpal ldan rdo rje sems/ sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i dkyil 'khor lha/ dbyer med 'khor lo'i mgon po la/ btud nas gsang thig don dbang spro/ de la rigs brgya rigs gcig du 'dus pa'i rigs 'dus rdo sems padma gsang thig gi dbang chen sogs mi lcog par skabs 'gar gter gzhung ltar don dbang mdor bsdus bya ba la gsum/ sbyor ba dkyil 'khor ram tshoms bu bkram pa'i steng dbus su bum pa*/ g.yas su sngags byang*/ g.yon du me long*/ mdun du sman gtor rakta bcas bsham/ mthar nyer spyod skor bshams bya/ dngos gzhi tshig bdun gsol 'debs nas brtsams nas las gzhung bsrang zhing bdag mdun dbyer med bskyed cing bzlas par 'jug /de nas bum pa gnyis bskyed bzlas mchod bstod 'od zhu grub nas rig me dor la slob ma 'jug pa'i gnang ba zhu/ bskang gsol nas tshogs drangs ba'i bar song la/ khrus dang bgeg bskrad mtshan gcod pa sogs spyi gros ltar byas nas lo rgyus mdor tsam brjod pa ni/ 'o na nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che ci nas kyang 'god par bya/ de'i ched du rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi rtsa ba mngon par dbang bskur zab mo gsan nas don thugs nyams su bzhes te sems can thams cad bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rigs kun khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa'i go 'phang la 'god par bya'o snyam du sems bskyed pa rgya chen po gsal btab ste gsan par zhu/

de la 'di ni gsang chen snga 'gyur rdo rje theg pa'i bka' bab kyi shing rta chen po mthu stobs nus pa'i mnga' bdag gangs can phur thogs yongs kyi gtso bo gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes kyi sgyu 'phrul sprul pa'i gter 'byin 'gro 'dul padma rgyal po gar dbang 'gro 'dul gling pa rtsal gyi gnas chen padma bkod kyi 'khor lo dang po'i bla gter du bzhes pa zab gsang bla ma thugs kyi sgrub pa sku gsum dgongs pa 'dus pa'i chos sde chen po'i cha lag gsang chen dkyil 'khor rab 'byams kyi sprul gzhi rigs bdag bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' padma gsang ba'i thig le'i dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba'i dbang bskur mdor bsdus tsam bya ba la/ bdag nyid kyi bgyi bar 'os pa rnams sngon du legs par grub te slob ma khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa'i thog mar dbang bskur zhu ba'i yon du zhing khams 'bul/ zhes maṇḍal phul bcug /bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo rdo rje sems dpa' tha mi dad par gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hoḥ rigs rnams kun bdag dpal ldan rdo rje sems: sgyu 'phrul gtso bo nyid dang dbyer med pa'i: bla ma rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol: rdo rje sku gsung thugs kyi dbang bskur stsol: gsol ba lan gsum btab/ de yang gter gzhung las/ sngon 'gros rgyud sbyang sdom gsum nod pa byas: slob ma lhar gsal ye shes spyan drangs bstim: zhes pas/ khyed rang rnams kyi rgyud snod rung du bya ba'i phyir bla ma dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo skyabs gnas rgya mtsho'i ngo bor bzhugs pa'i drung du byang chub snying po'i bar du mkha' khyab sems can gyi don du skyabs su 'gro ba 'di yi rjes zlos mdzod/ na moḥ phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i skyabs yul ma lus pa: ye shes gcig gi dbyings su shar ba'i dpyid: rdo rje sems dpa' sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i lhar:

byang chub snying po'i bar du skyabs su mchi: lan gsum/ de nas sngon gyi bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyi 'gro ba'i don du smon 'jug gi byang chub thugs bskyed pa de bzhin du bdag gis kyang byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed par bgyi'o snyam pas 'di yi rjes zlos mdzod/ hoḥ ji ltar sngon gyi bde gshegs sras bcas kyi: 'gro ba'i don du bla med thugs bskyed bzhin: bdag gis nyes spyod kun sdom dge chos bsdus: smon 'jug don dam byang sems rtag tu bskyed: lan gsum gyis byang chub sems bskyed/ de nas tshogs bsags phyir bsags sbyang yan lag brgyad pa'i skabs thob so so'i tshig don yid la bya bzhin 'di yi rjes zlos mdzod: hoḥ rang rig bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' la: gnyis su med par gar gyis phyag 'tshal lo: tshogs drug zhen pa bral ba'i mchod sprin 'bul: gzung 'dzin dri ma lta ba'i klong du bshags: bla med lta sgom spyod la rjes yi rang : brjod med don gyi chos 'khor bskor bar bskul: bde chen 'pho 'gyur bral bar rtag bzhugs gsol: 'khor gsum dmigs mtha' bral ba'i pha mthar bsngo: lhun grub gzhon nu bum skur byang chub shog: rgyud sbyangs/ dngos gzhir ye shes dbab pa ni: skad cig gis khyed rang bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum gyi skur gsal ba'i thugs ka'i sa bon mar me ltar 'bar zhing gsal ba'i 'od kyis bskul bas/ bla ma dkyil 'khor pa'i lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs ka nas sku dang yig 'bru phyag mtshan gyi rnam pa grangs med pa 'od zer gyi phung por 'bar zhing 'phro ba kha char dang bu yug 'tshubs pa bzhin du byung ba ba spu'i khung bu nas zhugs lus kyi nang kun dang khyad par snying ga'i ting 'dzin sems dpa' la sib sib thim pas bde ba'i ye shes bzod med du 'bar bar bsam zhing*/ spos rol bcas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru badzra sa twa dhe wa ḍākki nī dzñā na a be sha ya a āḥ

pra be sha ya: pra be sha ya: sa ma ya phaiṃ phaiṃ: sa ma ya: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes ye shes pa dbab la/ tiṣṭha badzras brtan par bya/ de nas thog mar bum pa mngon par dga' ba'i zhing khams bcud rnams bla ma bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa' sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i bdag nyid rjes chags su zhu ba'i bdud rtsi ye shes lnga yi rang bzhin can gyi rgyal thab spyi blugs mngon par dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ /rnam rgyal bum pa spyi bor bzung bya la: oṃ āḥhūm̐: phyi ltar bum pa rin chen gzhal yas khang : nang ltar ye shes lnga ldan bcud kyis gtams: gsang ba rdor sems sgyu 'phrul lha tshogs bzhugs: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: rdo rje sku gsung thugs su smin par shog: yig brgya dang : badzra ka la sha kā ya wākka tsitta sarba siddhi a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā: bum pa gnas gsum du bzhag la bum chu blud/ de ltar dbang bskur ba'i rdo rje'i slob ma rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum cha snyam dang bcas pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs sgo gsum sku gsung thugs rdo rje gsum du smin zhing 'bras bu sku bzhi thob pa'i mos pa mdzod cig /zhes me tog 'thor/ gnyis pa gsung bzlas pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod cig /dpon slob gnyis ka lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i sa bon las sngags phreng mar me gcig las gnyis mched bzhin thon/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas zhugs/ slob ma'i mgrin pa'i lam brgyud nas snying kha'i sa bon la thim par mos la sngags 'di'i rjes zlos kyang mdzod cig /yig brgya lan gsum rjes zlos byar gzhug /mthar brtan par bya ba'i slad du sngags byang mgrin par bzhag la/ āḥ dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' che: sgyu 'phrul drwa ba dam pa rigs brgya yi: ngo bo gsang sngags yi ge 'bru brgya'i dbang : skal ldan bu yi ngag la bskur ba yis: rgyal kun gsung gi rdo rje 'grub par shog:

yig brgya'i sham bur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta wākka a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ de ltar gsung gis dbang bskur bas ngag gi nad gdon sdig sgrib sbyangs/ gsung mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i dbang dang dngos grub ma lus pa thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ gsum pa thugs kyi nus pa 'jug pa'i slad du 'od gsal de kho na nyid kyi rjes su gnang ba la lha sngags kyi mtshon pa'i snang cha thams cad rig stong 'dzin med khyab brdal gyi dbyings su cung zad mnyam par 'jog mdzod/ brtan par bya ba'i phyir me long snying khar bzhag cing hūm̐: 'khor 'das chos rnams 'od gsal stong pa nyid: gsal stong sgrib g.yogs bral ba'i a dharsha: dbyer med bde ba ched po rdo rje sems/ brjod med don gyi tshig dbang tob par shog: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ de ltar thugs kyi dbang bskur bas yid kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib dag /thugs mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i dbang dang dngos grub ma lus pa thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ mtha' rten byin rlabs gtor ma'i dbang bskur ba ni/ gtor snod gzhal yas khang dang gtor ma dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i lha tshogs rdzogs par gsal ba'i gnas gsum 'bru gsum gyis mtshan pa las 'od zer dang bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pa'i slob ma'i tshangs bug nas rkang mthil yan chad ltems kyis gang bas dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi dngos grub ma lus thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: stong gsal skye med dbyings kyi gtor gzhong du: snang stong 'gags med stong gsal lha yi sku: rdo rje sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs bzhugs: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las lnga'i: dbang dang dngos grub ma lus thob par shog: kā ya wākka tsitta sarba a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: gtor ma gnas bzhir bkod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gtor ma'i lha 'od du zhu ba slob ma dang gnyis su med par thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/

rten snying dang*/ su pra tiṣṭha badzras brtan par bya'o/ de dag gi byin rlabs dbang bskur gyi rim pa mdor bsdus grub pa'i sku drin gtang rag yon du maṇḍal zhig 'bul bar zhu/ sa gzhi spos sogs/ slar yang de dag gi skabs su thob pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa rnams mi nyams par tshul bzhin srung snyams pa'i 'di yi rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bo'i ji? de ltar dbang bskur gsan pa las byung ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis mtshon/ dge tshogs ji snyed pa thams cad mkha' khyab sems can gyi don du bsngo ba dang*/ lam 'di nyid kyi sgo nas rang gzhan bstan 'gro'i don rgya chen po bsgrub par bya'o snyam pa'i bsngo ba dang*/ smon lam chabs cig tu mdzad par zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis?sogs/ bsngo smon sogs spyi mtshungs ltar bya'o/ rjes su tshogs kyi 'khor lo la rol zhing dkyil 'khor rjes kyi cho ga gzhung ltar bya'o/ zhes pa'ang dbang khrigs ye shes thig le gsal ba'i sgron me las rgyun mkho 'di tsam gal che bar mthong nas gter slob gu hya'i ming gi rab byung 17 shing mo bya yi lo dbyug zla'i nag phyogs rgyal ba gsum par nub phyogs e wam̐ sti gnas su bgyis pa'i rang gzhan dam tshig nyam pa sos zhing rdo rje'i gseng lam nas gdod ma'i rgyal sar dbugs dbyung ba'i rgyur gyur cig/ ༄༅/ /sku gsum dgongs 'dus las/ nang sgrub rdor sems padma gsang ba'i thig le'i bdag 'jug gi cho ga dngos grub 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru badzra satwa ye/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ de yang rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor zab mo nyams su len pa'i cha rkyen lam dus kyi dam tshig gso zhing ye shes spel ba la med du mi rung ba lhag pa'i lha'i dkyil 'khor du bdag 'jug mdor bsdus te blang ba'i tshul ni/ sbyor ba mtshan ma'i dkyil 'khor bzhengs te bdag mdun bum gsum tha mi dad kyi tshul du las gzhung gi khrigs ltar sgrub cing*/

tshogs gtor rnams kyang ji ltar rigs pa bshams la/ dngos gzhi bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa dbang len pa'i yul dang*/ dbang gi bya ba rnams gtso bo las phye ba'i las kyi he ru kas mdzad cing*/ bdag nyid rnam 'gyur glo bur ba'i rang bzhin dbang zhu ba por byas nas 'jug ste/ de la gnyis/ dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa dang*/ zhugs nas dbang blang ba'o/ /snga ma la gnyis so/ /dang po phyi 'jug ni/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs kyis las bum gyi chus khrus bya/ sumbha ni 'i sngags kyis bgegs bskrad/ sa gzhi spos chus sogs kyis maṇḍal phul la/ oṃ tsakṣu bhandha wā ra ma ṇa ye swā hā sa mig dar 'ching*/ āḥkhaṃ wī ra hūm̐ gis me tog bzung nas/ thal mo sbyar ba btud de/ bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /slob dpon la ni skyabs su mchi/ /bla ma dpal ldan rdo rje sems/ /sgyu 'phrul rnam par rol pa yi/ /lha rnams la yang phyag 'tshal lo/ /mi gnas bde chen grong mchog tu/ /slob dpon khyod kyis bdag 'jug gsol/ / zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal/ / sogs rgyun bshags yan lag brgyad pas tshogs bsags shing rgyud sbyang*/ sgyu 'phrul rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir: so sor thar pa'i sdom pa dang : byang chub sems dpa'i bslab bya dang : rig 'dzin sngags kyi dam tshig rnams: deng nas bdag gis brtan por bzung :

zhes sdom pa bzung*/ snying gar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du don dam byang chub sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje ser po rtse lnga pa'i gzugs su gnas par bsam zhing*/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsitta utpa da ya mi: lan gsum/ snying gar rdo rje reg la/ bho dhi tsitta sa ma ya satwaṃḥ zhes gsang sngags nang gi sems bskyed/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ bhrūm̐ pra be sha ya phaṭḥ ces dkyil 'khor gyi sgo phyes pa'i nang du bzhugs par mos pas/ oṃ na ma ste hūm̐: oṃ na ma mī hūm̐: oṃ na mo na ma hūm̐: zhes phyag bya/ gnyis pa nang 'jug la/ sbyor ba dam la bzhag pa ni/ rdo rje mgor bzhag ste/ hoḥ rab tu bskal pa bzang po'i bu khyod kyi: gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor dam pa 'dir zhugs na: dngos grub nye bar thob pa'i skal ldan kyang : snod med gzhan du smras na de ltar min: badzra gu hya sa ma ya hoḥ rdo rje spyi bor bzhag ste dam tshig bsgrags: hoḥ sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes rdo rje sems: 'di ni khyod kyi snying dbus yang dag zhugs: rlung phyogs tsam gyi gsang bsgrags nyams par 'gyur: de bas shin tu gsang chen thub par gyis: badzra sa twa dzñā na sa ma ya hūm̐: rdo rje snying khar bzhag la dam tshig bsgrags: badzra a mṛ ta u da ka sa ma ya hoḥ zhes mna' chu sbyin la: badzra sa ma ya rakṣantu: rdo rje spyi bor bzhag la nan gyis bsgrags: dngos gzhir ye shes dbab pa ni: skad cig gis khyed rang bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum gyi skur gsal ba'i thugs ka'i sa bon mar me ltar 'bar zhing gsal ba'i 'od kyis bskul bas/ bla ma dkyil 'khor pa'i lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs ka nas sku dang yig 'bru phyag mtshan gyi rnam pa grangs med pa 'od zer gyi phung por 'bar zhing 'phro ba kha char dang bu yug 'tshubs pa bzhin du byung ba ba spu'i khung bu nas zhugs lus kyi nang kun dang khyad par snying ga'i ting 'dzin sems dpa' la sib sib thim pas bde ba'i ye shes bzod med du 'bar bar

bsam zhing*/ spos rol bcas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru badzra sa twa dhe wa ḍākki nī dzñā na a be sha ya a āḥ pra be sha ya: pra be sha ya: sa ma ya phaiṃ phaiṃ: sa mā ya dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes ye shes pa dbab la/ tiṣṭha badzra sa brtan par bya/ oṃ puṣpe ghṛhna hoḥ sa me tog dkyil 'khor du 'dor/ slar me tog spyi bor bkod la/ pra ti ghṛhna siddhi hūm̐: zhes lha de spyi bor stim/ badzra dzñā na tsakṣu pra be sha ya phaṭḥ ces gdong g.yog bsal la/ rang rig bla ma rdo rje sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rten dang brten par bcas pa mngon sum du mthong bar mos mdzod/ gnyis pa dbang blang ba dngos la thun mong dang*/ khyad par gnyis kyi dang po ni/ maṇḍal phul la/ bde gshegs sku lnga'i bdag nyid bla ma dgongs: ma dag nyon mongs lnga dang phung po lnga: rnam dag ye shes lnga dang sku lnga ru: bdag rgyud dbang lngas smin par mdzad du gsol: zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ rang nyid dkyil 'khor chen po'i shar sgo'i khyams la glang po ches gtegs pa'i rin po che'i khri pad zla'i gdan la gtso bo'i gzugs kyi rnam pas 'khod par gyur: slob dpon bla ma he ru ka'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ 'og min gyi zhing nas dbang lha de bzhin gshegs pa rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad gdan gsum tshang ba'i dbang gi lha tshogs kyi rnam par badzra sa mā dzaḥ sa spyan drangs la/ oṃ badzra puṣpe sogs nas/ shabda 'i bar gyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas gdan gsum tshang ba'i dbang lha rdo rje rgyal po de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ sems dpa' sems ma rnams kyis me tog 'thor zhing shis pa brjod/ kiṅka ra rnams kyi bgegs bskrad/ bum 'dzin rig pa'i lha mo rnams kyis rdo rje mi bskyod pa'i ngo bor gyur pa'i rin po che'i bum pa zag med ye shes kyi bdud rtsis bkang bas spyi bo nas mngon par dbang bskur bar

mos la/ hūm̐: nyon mongs zhe sdang rnam dag rdo rje'i rigs: mi bskyod ngo bo chu yi dbang bskur bas: rnam shes phung po ma spang rang grol nas: rang gnas me long ye shes mngon gyur shog: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ hūm̐: bum pa spyi bor bzhag cing bum chu blud/ des rdo rje mi bskyod pa'i sgo nas bum pa'i dbang thob/ zhe sdang gi dri ma sbyangs/ rnam shes kyi phung po gnas gyur me long lta bu ye shes mngon du byas/ rdo rje mi bskyod pa'i go 'phang nus pa rgyud la bzhag /rdo rje'i rigs kyi dngos grub thob pa'i skal pa can du byas so/ /rin chen 'byung gnas kyi ngo bor gyur pa'i rin po che'i dbu rgyan dar dpyangs dang ldan pas mngon par dbang bskur zhing spyi bor bcings par bsam la/ trām̐: nyon mongs nga rgyal rnam dag rin chen rigs: rin 'byung ngo bo dbu rgyan dbang bskur bas: tshor ba'i phung po ma spang rang grol nas: rang gnas mnyam nyid ye shes mngon gyur shog: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ratna a bhi ṣiñtsa trām̐ trām̐: zhes dbu rgyan mgo bor bcing*/ des rin chen 'byung gnas kyi sgo nas cod pan gyi dbang thob/ nga rgyal gyi dri ma sbyangs/ tshor ba'i phung po gnas gyur/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ rin chen 'byung gnas kyi go 'phang nus pa rgyud la bzhag /rin chen rigs kyi dngos grub thob pa'i skal pa can du byas so/ /snang ba mtha' yas kyi ngo bor gyur pa'i rdo rje rtse lnga pas mngon par dbang bskur zhing lag g.yas su gtad par mos la/ hrīḥ nyon mongs 'dod chags rnam dag padma'i rigs: snang mtha'i ngo bo rdo rje'i dbang bskur bas: 'du shes phung po ma spangs rang grol nas: rang gnas sor rtogs ye shes mngon gyur shog: oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā padma a bhi ṣiñtsa hrī hrīḥ zhes rdo rje gsor zhing snying gar bzung*/ des snang ba mtha' yas kyi sgo nas rdo rje'i dbang thob/

'dod chags kyi dri ma sbyangs/ 'du shes kyi phung po gnas gyur/ so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ snang ba mtha' yas kyi go 'phang gi nus pa rgyud la bzhag /padma rigs kyi dngos grub thob pa'i skal pa can du byas so/ /don yod grub pa'i ngo bo gyur pa'i dril bu'i mngon par dbang bskur zhing lag g.yon du gtad par mos la/ āḥ nyon mongs phrag dog rnam dag las kyi rigs: don grub ngo bo dril bu'i dbang bskur bas: 'du byed phung po ma spangs rang grol nas: rang gnas bya grub ye shes mngon gyur shog: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta karma a bhi ṣiñtsa a āḥ zhes dril bu bsil zhing skur brten/ des don yod grub pa'i sgo nas dril bu'i dbang thob/ phrag dog gi dri ma sbyangs/ 'du byed kyi phung po gnas gyur/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ don yod grub pa'i go 'phang nus pa rgyud la bzhag /las kyi rigs kyi dngos grub thob pa'i skal pa can du byas so/ /dbang lha de bzhin gshegs pa rigs kyi yum dang bcas pa thams cad kyis mgrin gcig dbyangs gcig tu rnam par snang mdzad gyi ngo bor gyur pa'i rdo rje'i ming gis mngon par dbang bskur bas mos la/ oṃ: nyon mongs gti mug rnam dag sangs rgyas rigs: rnam snang ngo bo ming gi dbang bskur bas: gzugs kyi phung po ma spang rang grol nas: rang gnas chos dbyings ye shes mngon gyur shog: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta buddha a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ oṃ: de'i rnam par snang mdzad kyi sgo nas ming gi dbang thob/ gti mug gi sgrib pa sbyang*/ gzugs kyi phung po gnas gyur/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi go 'phang nus pa rgyud la bzhag /sangs rgyas rigs kyi dngos grub thob pa'i skal pa can du byas so/ /slar yang rnam rgyal bum pa'i bdud rtsis rgyal thabs spyi blugs su mngon par dbang bskur bar

mos la/ oṃ: ye shes sku mchog bum pa'i gzhal yas nas: ye shes lnga ldan bdud rtsi gtor blug dbang : skal ldan bu yi lus la bskur ba yis: lus snang gdos bcas lha skur smin par shog: rtsa sngags dang*/ badzra kā la sha kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: zhes bum chu myang*/ bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ bde ba chen po'i ye shes nyams su myong*/ chu'i lhag ma spyi bor 'khyil ba las rigs thams cad 'dus pa'i spyi gzugs rgyal ba kun tu bzang pos dbu rgyan/ spyan drangs pa'i dbang lha rnams kyang rang la dbyer med du thim par mos la/ oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swā hā/ zhes me tog 'thor/ de ltar na phyi kun rdzob mtshan ma rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor du bum pa'i dbang thob/ phung khams snod bcud tha mal du zhen pa'i rtog tshogs sbyangs te lus kyi sgrib pa dag /lam dus su bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang*/ snod bcud thams cad bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' zhi khro sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i dkyil 'khor gcig tu rdzogs nas/ 'bras bu sku rdo rje mchog gi sprul sku 'grub pa'i skal pa can du byas pa'o/ / zhes rtogs pa bskyed do/ /maṇḍal phul la/ kyaiḥ rdo rje slob dpon rang bzhin longs spyod rdzogs: bdag rgyud bum pa'i dbang gis smin zin te: bde chen gsang ba bhandha'i dkyil 'khor du: de ring nyid nas 'jug cing smin par mdzod: zhes gsol ba btab/ slob dpon bla ma rdo rje he ru ka'i rang 'od kyi yum rdo rje snyems ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i dga' ba'i sgra dang bde ba'i 'od zer gyis 'phro 'dus phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba thams cad spyan drangs pa yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar chags pa chen po'i mes zhu ba sku'i dbyibs brgyud rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi padmar babs/ byang sems dkar dmar ro gcig tu 'dres pa'i rgyun mu tig gi mdangs can de nyid lce thog tu stsal bar

mos la/ āḥ bhandha bde ba chen po chos dbyings snod: ye shes rang bzhin bde chen bdud rtsis gtams: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la bskur ba yis: ngag rlung rdo rje na dār smin par shog: a ho badzra bho dhi tsitta ma hā su kha: zhes bdud rtsi myang*/ byang sems yi ge'i sprin a li ka li'i rnam par 'char bas rtsa gnas thams cad gang ste rtsa'i 'ching byed kyi mdud pa grol/ gzung 'dzin brgyad cu'i rtog pa 'gags: thig rlung sems gsum ye shes chen po'i ngo bor byin gyis brlabs nas bde ba'i ye shes khyad par can rgyud la skye bar gyur: slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo sprul pa'i sku shākya seṅge'i rnam par bzhengs nas byang chub mchog tu lung bstan par mos la/ 'dir ni khyod la ngas lung bstan/ sangs rgyas rdo rje dbyings zhes pa'i: srid pa kun las rnam grol ba: de bzhin gshegs pa nyid yin no: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta bhurbhu ba swa: zhes lung bstan/ de ltar na kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du gsang ba'i dbang thob/ rlung tha mal du 'dzin pa'i bag chags sbyangs te ngag gi sgrib pa dag /lam dus su bdag byin rlabs rdzogs rim tsaṇḍa lī'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa la dbang*/ sgra skad dang rlung 'byin 'jug gsang sngags su dag ste/ 'bras bu gsung rdo rje longs spyod rdzogs sku thob pa'i skal ba can du byas pa'o/ / gnyis pa sher dbang ni/ maṇḍal phul la/ kyaiḥ rdo rje slob dpon ngo bo chos kyi sku: bdag ni gsang ba'i dbang gis smin zin te: mchog gi gsang ba bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du: de ring nyid nas 'jug cing smin par mdzod: zhes gsol ba btab/ rang nyid bla ma rdo rje he ru kaḥsnang stong sgyu ma lta bu'i skur gsal ba la/ slob dpon gyi yum rdo rje snyems ma las rigs mthun gyi shes rab ma gzugs dang lang tsho mtshan nyid phun sum tshogs pa zhig rnam par spros te thar pa brten par bskul bar

mos la/ hoḥ nga yi padma bde chen dgyes pa 'di: rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes bskyed pa'i gnas: 'di spong pa la mchog gi ye shes med: skal ldan khyod kyi 'di bzung rtag tu mchod: a nu rā ga ya mi: a nu rā ga ya hoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga na dzñā na swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ: zhes 'khyud rgya bya/ 'dod chags bral ba lta ba'i sdig: khams gsum gnas na sdig med de: de bas 'dod la chags bral ba: khyod kyi nam yang ma byed cig: ces brtul zhugs bsgrag /de ltar na gsang ba chos thams cad 'byung ba'i dkyil du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ gzung 'dzin gnyis snang gi rtog tshogs sbyangs te yid kyi sgrib pa dag /lam dus su pho nya bde ba chen po rdo rje sems dpa'i gsang lam bsgom pa la dbang*/ bde sdug byung tshor thams cad lhan skyes ye shes su dag nas/ 'bras bu thugs rdo rje chos kyi sku thob pa'i skal pa can du byas so/ / gsum pa tshigs dbang ni/ maṇḍal phul la/ kyai: rdo rje slob dpon bde chen rdo rje'i sku: bdag ni sher ye'i dbang gis smin zin te: mchog gsang brjod med don gyi dkyil 'khor du: de ring nyid nas 'jug cing smin par mdzod: zhes gsol ba btab: bla ma dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i zhal nas skye med rdo rje'i tshig gi rang byung don gyi dgongs pa ngo sprad de dbugs dbyung bar mos la/ āḥ mtshon bya dpe yi ye shes me long bzhin: mtshon byed don gyi ye shes dri ma med: rdo rje sems dpa' yang dag bde ba che: ka dag tshig dbang rin chen bla na med: oṃ badzra dharma dhā tu a ti hoḥ zhes rang byung gi ye shes de kho na nyid kyi ngang la mnyam par bzhag /de ltar na don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du rig pa'i rtsal dbang thob/ sgo gsum tha dad 'dzin pa'i shes bya'i sgrib pa ches phra ba sbyangs/ lam dus su ka dag lhun grub zung 'jug rdzogs rim mthar thug pa'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa la dbang*/

snang bzhi zad sar 'khyol te/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku kun bzang rdo rje sems dpa'i go 'phang mngon du byed pa'i skal pa can du byas pa'o/ / zhes rtogs pa bskyed do/ /rjes ni/ gtso bo ji ltar sogs dang*/ deng nas btsams te sogs kyis dam tshig khas blangs te lus longs spyod dbul zhing gtang rag gi maṇḍal sngar ltar phul/ cho ga'i rjes kyi bya ba rnams las byang bzhin mthar dbyung bar bya'o/ /ces pa'ang gter gzhung rtsa ba'i dbang gi gzhung las 'jug pa bde ba'i ngag 'don khol du phyung ste lho ljongs gnas chen spa gro stag tshang gi nye zhol dgon pa bkra shis chos gling nas rab byung bcu drug pa'i zla 8tshes 25la dus mtha'i gter ming 'dzin pa 'gro 'dul pad rgyal gling pas sbyar ba dza yantu// // ྂ/: sku gsum dgongs 'dus las: nang sgrub rdo rje sems dpa' padma gsang ba'i thig le zhes bya ba bzhugs so: bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo: ma lus rigs rnams kun gyi bdag po che: rdo rje sems dpa' padma gsang thig gi: lam gyi rim pa nyams su len 'dod pas: nyams grib la sogs ma gos dben gnas su: rdor sems bris 'bur sku gsung thugs rten bkram: rin chen maṇḍal tshom bu gcig pa'i dbus: so lnga'i bcud ldan bum pa sngags phreng dang : dri med me long phyi nang mchod pas bskor: sbyor ba'i chos rnams gzhung bzhin sngon song bas: dngos gzhi dam tshig 'khor lo bskyed pa ni:

oṃ ma hā shu n+ya ta dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ: chos rnams smra bsam brjod med rdo rje sems: stong nyid snying rje'i rang rtsal kun tu snang : rig pa mi 'gyur rgyu yi yi ge hūm̐: mkha' las skar chen shar bzhin 'od rab gsal: spha ra ṇa phaṭḥ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐: 'od zer 'phro 'du snang srid rnam par dag: rdo rje sems dpa'i zhing khams mngon par dgar: kun nas bkod legs rmad byung mchod sprin gtib: bhrūm̐ las rang byung lhun grub gzhal med dbus: glang chen khri rkang padma nyi zla'i steng : hūm̐ las bla ma dpal ldan rdo rje sems: padma gsang ba'i thig le sku mdog dmar: longs spyod rdzogs sku dar dang rin chen brgyan: rang 'od snye ma padma'i gri thod dmar: gnyis med 'khril sbyor rdo rje skyil krung bzhugs: phyag g.yas rdo rje thugs kar gtod de 'dzin: g.yon pas dril bu yum gyi sku la 'khyud: thugs kar gzhi yi kun bzang yab yum la: phung lnga rnam dag rgyal ba rigs lnga dang : 'byung lnga rnam dag dbyings kyi yum chen lnga: dbang yul rnam dag sems dpa' sems ma dang : nyon drug dag pa'i sprul sku thub pa drug: mu bzhi gnas dag thar byed yab yum brgyad: ma bskyed yongs grub gdan gsum zhi ba'i mdangs: spyi bor dung gang rab 'bar me dpung klong : kun tu bzang po che mchog he ru kaḥ khrag 'thung rgyud sde'i spyi dpal chen po la: dug lnga gnas 'gyur tshar gcod khro bo'i lha: lnga bcu rtsa brgyad 'bar ba'i tshogs kyis bskor: gdod nas yongs grub sgyu 'phrul drwa bar rdzogs: dbang lha mkha' dbyings gang ba'i tshogs rnams kyis: rdo rje'i glu dang me tog char 'bebs shing : ngo mtshar rmad byung bkra shis rnam rol bcas: ye shes lnga yi ngo bor dbang bskur zhing : snang mtha' gtsor gyur rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan rdzogs: gnas gsum gsang ba'i yi ge dkar dmar mthing : phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi:

rdo rje gsum gyi ngo bor ye nas rdzogs: hrīḥhūm̐ trām̐ oṃ āḥ a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ: oṃ āḥhūm̐: ye shes 'gugs gzhugs dbyer med bstim par bya: dzaḥ chos nyid don la gshegs bzhugs mi mnga' yang : thugs rje 'gags pa med pa'i rgyal ba rnams: dad dang dam tshig dbang gis spyan 'dren na: thugs rje'i dbang gis yang dag nye bar mdzod: hūm̐: 'og min mngon par dga' ba'i zhing khams nas: longs sku'i ston pa bcom ldan rdo rje sems: 'gags med thugs rje sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i lha: 'gro kun don phyir dad pas spyan 'dren na: chos sku 'od gsal dbyings las ma g.yos bzhin: phyag rgya so so'i gzugs kyi skur bzhengs la: ye shes sgyu mar rol bzhin gshegs su gsol: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta bha ga wan e hya hi: ma hā kā ru ṇi ka dri shya hoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gsum pa brda yi phyag 'tshal ni: hoḥ ji ltar chu nyid la ni chu thim bzhin: dbyer med lha la lha thim ngo mtshar che: gdod nas du ma ro gcig dkyil 'khor la: gnyis med chu zla'i gar gyis phyag 'tshal lo: na mo na ma hoḥ phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pas dgyes pa bskyed: khyad par rdo rje glu yi bstod pa ni: hūm̐: gdod nas yongs grub gdan gsum dkyil 'khor gtso: rigs rnams kun bdag gsang chen ston pa'i rgyal: rdo rje sems dpa' yang dag gsang ba che: dkyil 'khor kun gyi byed por phyag 'tshal bstod: gang gi sku dang gsang sngags yi ge brgya: dran pa'i mod la mtshams med lnga bsags pa'i: las ngan rgyun gcod na raka dongs nas sprugs: sbyong ba'i rgyal po che la phyag 'tshal bstod: dang po'i sangs rgyas rang byung kun tu bzang : rdo rje sems dpa' rdo rje de bzhin gshegs: snang stong sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i skur ston pa: dam pa rigs brgya'i 'khor lor phyag 'tshal bstod: bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor bsnyen grub las gsum las: dang por gsal brtan bdag dran tshad long tshe:

thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i: rdo rje'i lte bar pad dmar 'dab drug dbus: hūm̐ dmar mtha' bskor gsang sngags 'bru drug gsal: 'od zer 'phro 'du snod bcud snang srid kun: rdo rje sems dpa'i zhing khams chen por blta: oṃ badzra sa twa aṃ: sgrub pa ni: yab kyi thugs dbus hūm̐ yig dmar po las: rigs brgya'i rang bzhin yi ge brgya pa'i sprin: zhal nas byung ste yum gyi zhal tu zhugs: mkha' gsang padmo rdo rje'i khong gseng nas: brgyud de rang sgra 'od zer dpag med bcas: rgyun mi chad par 'khor bas yab yum zung : mi bzod bde ba'i sgra dang 'od zer gyis: gdan gsum zhi khro dam pa rigs brgya bskul: rang rang phyag rgyar sbyor ba'i bde chen 'bar: phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas rnams kun: rdo rje sems dpa' sgyu 'phrul drwa ba yi: gsang gsum 'khor lo'i rnam par spyan drangs bstim: mchog thun dngos grub ma lus thob par bsam: oṃ padma sa twa sa ma ya: ma nu pā la ya: padma sa twa twe no pa: tiṣṭha dṛ ḍho me bha wa: su toṣyo me bha wa: su po ṣyo me bha wa: a nu rakto me bha wa: sarba siddhi mme pra yatstsha: sarba karma su tsa me: tsittaṃ shrī ya: ku ru hūm̐: ha ha ha ha ho: bha ga wān: sarba ta thā ga ta: padma mā me muñtsa: padma bha wa: ma hā sa ma ya sa twa āḥhūm̐ phaṭ: las sbyor ni/ bcom ldan rdo rje sems dpa'i gnas drug nas: rdor sems rigs drug thub drug sku dpag med: ma dag rigs drug gnas rnams gang bar 'phros: yig brgya'i sngags sgra thugs rje'i 'od zer gyis: rigs drug so so'i 'khor ba dong nas sprugs: ma lus sangs rgyas sa la bsgral bar bsam: yig brgya'i sham du/ 'aḥ.aḥshaḥsaḥmaḥhaḥ ma ma ko ling sa mānta: aḥtriḥṇiḥsuḥpreḥduḥsarba duḥkha shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: bsnyen pa bye ba sgrub pa 'bum drug dang : las sbyor khri yis mchog thun dngos grub thob:

lus nas rnag khrag srog chags 'byin pa dang : khrus dang mtsho bgrod mkhar 'phur rmi lam rtags: nyams rtogs 'phel dang zhal mjal la sogs 'byung : bdag mdun dbyer med sgrub pa'i thun mtshams su: thal mo sbyar te 'dod don gsol ba btab: hoḥ bla ma dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa' kye: 'jigs rung srid mtshor bying ba'i mtha' med 'gror: sangs rgyas phrin las mdzad pa rmad byung bas: myur du dbugs chen dbyung bar mdzad du gsol: yang dag ye shes snang ba chen po yis: 'gro drug ma rig smag thug rab bcom ste: bla med byang chub lam la 'god mdzad pa'i: nus mthu gang lags mgon pos bdag la stsol: lan gsum: zhes gsol rdor sems zhal nas rigs kyi bu'i: sdig sgrib dag go zhes pa'i dbugs dbyung bsam: bdag dbang blang la gzhan la yang dag byin: lam 'dir ma lus gsang ba spyir 'jug pa'i: lam gteg lta bur med pa'i thabs bral bas: rnam pa kun tu rnal 'byor mchog tu bzung : sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gu hya: brda thim: ྀatsha: ༄༅/ khyab bdag dang po'i ston pa kun tu bzang*/ /gzhi snang lhun grub rdor sems rigs lnga'i sprin/ khyab brdal dgongs pa klong yangs brgyud pa la/ /gsol ba 'debs so dgongs pa'i dbang chen stsol/ /bde chen rdo rje gar mkhan dga' rab rje/ /mañdzu shrī shrī singha sogs/ /rig pa rtsal gyi brda chos brgyud pa la/ /gsol ba 'debs so thogs med rig rtsal stsol/ /mtsho skyes rdo rje sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i bdag /buddha dzñā na gter 'byin rig pa 'dzin/ /gang zag mchog gyur snyan khungs brgyud pa la/ /gsol ba 'debs so yang dag smin grol stsol/ /brgyud gsum bla ma yi dam zhi khro'i gar/ /mkha' 'gro dam can rtsa gsum lha yi lha/ /snang srid dag pa rab 'byams dkyil 'khor la/ /gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ /tshad med rnam bzhi dag pas rgyud 'byongs shing*/ /dbang gi chu bo bzhis smin lam mthar son/

/tshe 'dir sku bzhi'i 'bras bu mngon gyur te/ /gzhan don 'khor ba dong sprugs dpal thob shog / ces pa'ang 'gro 'dul pad rgyal gling pa bde chen rdo rje rtsal gyis gnas chen seṅge rdzong du sbyar ba'o// ༄༅/ /sku gsung dgongs 'dus las/ nang sgrub rdor sems padma gsang ba'i thig le'i phrin las 'og min gsang lam zhes bya ba bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti siddhi/ thig le nyag gcig kun bzang chos sku'i klongam̐*/ /klongam̐ las ma g.yos longs sku rigs lnga'i sprin/ /sprin chen rol mo sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i gtso/ /bde chen rdo rje sems la gnyis med 'dud/ /gang gi sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i yang zhun phulam̐/ /phulam̐ byung padma'i man ngag ches gsam̐ng ba/ /gsam̐ng ba'i thig le'i lam bzang 'di ko rmadam̐/ /rmadam̐ byung bsdus gsol phrin las snying po'i bcud/ /ma nor lam bzang 'og min gsang lam la/ /brten nas skal bzang rdo rje'i rigs can rnams/ /rang snang don gyi 'og min mngon par dgar/ /tshegs med bgrod pa gsang ba'i lam bzang bstan/ / de la 'dir gsung rigs rdor sems phyag rgya gcig sgrub padma gsang ba'i thig le'i phrin las dkyus gcig tu sdebs te nyams su len par 'dod pas/ nyams grib la sogs ma gos dben gnas su: rdor sems bris 'bur sku gsung thugs rten bkram/ rin chen maṇḍal tshom bu gcig pa'i dbus/ so lnga'i bcud ldan bum pa sngags phreng dang*/ dri med me long phyi nang mchod pas bskor/ zhes pas/ sbyor ba bsham 'god ni/ dben zhing gtsang ma'i gnas su mthong rgyun ltar stegs bu kheb ldan gyi dbus su mngon rtogs dang mthun pa'i sku rten bris 'bur gang rung rab gnas can dang*/ gsung rten glegs bam/ thugs rten rdor dril sogs kyi spyan sngar gtor zlum rgyan spros can/ dam can spyi gtor/ sngags srung ma'i 'bul gtor/ chad brtan sman raka bcas bkod pa'i mdun dbus su 'dzoms na ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor bkram/

ma 'dzoms na dngul sogs kyi maṇḍal la dri bzang gi khu bas sbag pa'i 'bru dkar gyi tshom bu gcig bkod pa'i khar mañdzis bstegs pa'i rnam bum so lnga'i bcud ldan kha rgyan mgul chings dmar po gzungs thag rdo rje bcas pa'i g.yas su me long*/ g.yon du sngags byang*/ mdun du dung chu/ rgyab tu sku tsaka bcas bkod/ bdag 'jug rgyas pa dang dbang sgrub skabs su mchog dbang gong ma gsum gyi rdzas gsum po rnam bum khar brtsegs mar bkod/ dkyus mar mi dgos/ mthar nyer spyod phreng tshar dang tshogs gtor/ sngon gtor bcas bshams/ rang gi mdun du nang mchod/ rdor dril thod rnga me tog gi snod/ las phur/ las bum sogs mkho ba'i yo byad rnams tshogs par byas la/ gter gzhung las/ sbyor rjes bya ba gsang ba'i gzhung ltar la/ dngos gzhi dam tshig 'khor lo sgom pa ni/ zhes pas/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po la bdun/ sa bslang skyabs sems tshogs bsags bka' bsgo dang*/ mtshams gcod byin 'bebs mchod rdzas rlabs pa'o/ /zhes dang po sa slong ba ni/ sgrub gnas rnying par mi dgos shing sa gzhi ma btul ba lta bu yin na sngon gtor dkar dmar gnyis rang rgyun du bgegs gtor bcas bshams pa bran la/ oṃ badzra sa twa aṃ: rang nyid rdo rje sems dpa'i nga rgyal dang ldan pa'i/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: bhrūm̐ las gtor zhong ratna'i gzhal yas su: oṃ las gtor ma 'dod yon phung por gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ bhū mi pa ti badzra sa mā ya dzaḥ sa mgron bsdus la/ oṃ sarba bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra na ma sarba ta thā ga ta bhyo sogs nas ba liṃ ta ye swā hā: lan gsum gyis gtor ma bsngos la/ hūm̐: sngon tshe ston pas bdud bcom bden pa'i dpang : lha mo bstan ma la sogs sa bdag sde: gzhan yang lha klu sde brgyad gang dag la: gtor ma 'bul bzhes sa 'di bdag la stsol: zhes gtor ma gshegs/ sarba lo ka gatstshaḥ

sa rang gnas su gshegs par bsam mo/ /gnyis pa skyabs sems ni/ rang gi snying kha'i 'od kyi mdun gyi nam mkhar rigs 'dus bla ma rdo rjes sems dpa' dkon mchog rtsa gsum rgya mtsho'i sprin phung 'phro ba badzra sa mā ya dzaḥ sa sad par mos la/ na moḥ phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i skyabs yul ma lus pa: ye shes gcig gi dbyings su 'dus pa'i dpyid: rdo rje sems dpa' sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i lhar: byang chub snying po'i bar du skyabs su mchi: lan gsum/ hoḥ ji ltar sngon gyi bde gshegs sras bcas kyi: 'gro ba'i don du bla med thugs bskyed bzhin: bdag gis nyes spyod kun sdom dge chos bsdud: smon 'jug don dam byang sems rtag tu bskyed/ lan gsum/ gsum pa tshogs bsags ni/ hūm̐: rang rig bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' la: gnyis su med pa'i gar gyis phyag 'tshal lo: tshogs drug zhen pa bral ba'i mchod sprin 'bul: gzung 'dzin dri ma lta ba'i klong du bshags: bla med lta sgom spyod la rjes yi rang : brjod med don gyi chos 'khor bskor bar bskul: bde chen 'pho 'gyur bral bar rtag bzhugs gsol: 'khor gsum dmigs mtha' bral ba'i pha mthar bsngo: lhun 'grub gzhon nu bum skur byang chub shog: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim pas rgyud byin gyis rlabs par gyur bar bsam/ bzhi pa bka' bsgo ba ni/ oṃ badzra kro ta shrī he ru ka rang nyid skad cig gis gnyug ma'i lha rdo rje he ru ka'i skur gyur/ gtor ma byin rlabs gong du ma byas na gong bzhin bya/ sarba bhu ta a karṣa ya dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa mgron bkugs la/ oṃ sarba bighnān na ma sarba ta thā ga ta bhyo sogs nas ba liṃ ta ye swā hā: lan gsum gyi gtor ma bsngos la/ hūm̐: rdo rje khro bo'i rgyal po'i bka' byung bas/ bla med gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor 'dir: 'du ba'i lha ni ma gtogs glags lta'i bgegs:

gtor ma 'di longs rang gnas bde bar dengs: dam las 'da' na tshig par gdon mi za: de bas da lta nyid du phyir dengs shig: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ gul yungs bdug brab kyis rdzas bcas bskrad/ lnga pa mtshams gcod ni/ hūm̐: he ru ka yi gsang gsum ye shes mdangs: phyi snod gzhal yas nang bcud sems can lha: snang srid dag pa rab 'byams dkyil 'khor la: gnyis 'dzin bgegs kyi bar chad ga la srid: mtshams kyi dkyil 'khor rang bzhin lhun gyis grub: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra kro ta dzñā na rakṣa āḥ drug pa byin 'bebs ni/ hūm̐: chos kyi sku la gshegs bzhugs mi mnga' yang : gzugs sku sgyu 'phrul rdo rje sems dpa'i lha: sngon gyi thugs dam zhal bzhes rjes dgongs la: dbyings nas 'dir byon byin phob dbang bskur cig: gnas yul gzhal yas bkod pa nyams re dga': sgrub rdzas mchod sprin ye shes rol bar gyur: oṃ e hya hi dzñā na a be sha ya a ā: bdun pa mchod rdzas byin rlabs ni: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: bdag gi thugs ka'i ye shes me rlung chus: snod bcud dngos 'dzin dri ma dbyings su sbyang : gnas yul rnam dag 'og min mngon dga'i zhing : phyi nang mchod sprin ye shes rol bar gyur: oṃ āḥbadzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐ swā hā:
