de bzhin du/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke gandhe/ nai wi dye/ shabda āḥhūm̐ swā hā: oṃ ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta bha liṃ ta hūm̐ hrī ṭhāḥ oṃ bho dhi tsitta ma hā ta na ga na pū dza āḥhūm̐: zhes byin rlabs/ gnyis pa dngos gzhir/ bskyed bstims phyag mchod bstod bzlas dang drug las/ dang po dam tshig gi 'khor lo bskyed pa ni/ oṃ ma hā shu n+ya ta dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ: chos rnams smra bsam brjod med rdo rje sems: stong nyid snying rje'i rang rtsal kun tu snang : rig pa mi 'gyur rgyu yi yi ge hūm̐: mkha' las skar chen shar bzhin 'od rab gsal: spha ra ṇa phaṭḥ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐: 'od zer 'phro 'du snang srid rnam par dag: rdo rje sems dpa'i zhing khams mngon par dga': kun nas bkod legs rmad byung mchod sprin gtib: bhrūm̐ las rang byung lhun grub gzhal med dbus: glang chen khri rkang padma nyi zla'i steng : hūm̐ las bla ma dpal ldan rdo rje sems: padma gsang ba'i thig le sku mdog dmar: longs spyod rdzogs sku dar dang rin chen brgyan: rang 'od snye ma padma'i gri thod dmar: gnyis med 'khril sbyor rdo rje skyil krung bzhugs: phyag g.yas rdo rje thugs kar gtod de 'dzin: g.yon pas dril bu yum gyi sku la 'khyud: thugs kar gzhi yi kun bzang yab yum la: phung lnga rnam dag rgyal ba rigs lnga dang : 'byung lnga rnam dag dbyings kyi yum chen lnga: dbang yul rnam dag sems dpa' sems ma dang : nyon drug dag pa'i sprul sku thub pa drug: mu bzhi gnas dag thar byed yab yum brgyad: ma bskyed yongs grub gdan gsum zhi ba'i mdangs: spyi bor dung khang rab 'bar me dpung klong : kun tu bzang po che mchog he ru kaḥ khrag 'thung rgyud sde'i spyi dpal chen po la: dug lnga gnas 'gyur tshar gcod khro bo'i lha: lnga bcu rtsa brgyad 'bar ba'i tshogs kyis bskor: gdod nas yongs grub sgyu 'phrul drwa bar rdzogs:

dbang lha mkha' dbyings gang ba'i tshogs rnams kyis: rdo rje'i glu dang me tog char 'bebs shing : ngo mtshar rmad byung bkra shis rnam rol bcas: ye shes lnga yi ngo bor dbang bskur zhing : snang mtha' gtsor gyur rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan rdzogs: gnas gsum gsang ba'i yi ge dkar dmar mthing : phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi: rdo rje gsum gyi ngo bor ye nas rdzogs: hrīḥhūm̐ trām̐ oṃ āḥ a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ: oṃ āḥhūm̐: gnyis pa ye shes kyi 'khor lo spyan 'dren bstim pa ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis 'og min gyi dbyings nas bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' zhi khro sgyu 'phrul rnam par rol pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mdun gyi nam mkhar badzra sa mā dzaḥ sa sad par bsam/ dzaḥ chos nyid don la gshegs bzhugs mi mnga' yang : thugs rje 'gags pa med pa'i rgyal ba rnams: dad dang dam tshig dbang gis spyan 'dren na/ thugs rje'i dbang gis yang dag nye bar mdzod: hūm̐: 'og min mngon par dga' ba'i zhing khams nas: longs sku'i ston pa bcom ldan rdo rje sems: 'gags med thugs rje sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i lha: 'gro kun don phyir dad pas spyan 'dren na: chos sku 'od gsal dbyings las ma g.yos bzhin: phyag rgya so so'i gzugs kyi skur bzhengs la: ye shes sgyu mar rol bzhin gshegs su gsol: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta bha ga wan e hya he: ma hā ka ru ṇi ka dri shya hoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gsum pa brda yi phyag 'tshal ba ni: hoḥ ji ltar chu nyid la ni chu thim bzhin: dbyer med lha la lha thim ngo mtshar che: gdod nas du ma ro gcig dkyil 'khor la: gnyis med chu zla'i gar gyis phyag 'tshal lo: na mo na ma hoḥ bzhi pa mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ zhar la maṇḍal 'bul bar spro na/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: rin chen maṇḍal yid 'ong mchod pa'i sprin: 'dod rgu'i 'byor tshogs dpag med dang ldan pa: dpag yas nam mkha'i rgyan gyur 'di phul bas:

rang bzhin sprul sku'i zhing la spyod par shog: 'og min bde chen rin chen gzhal yas khang : sna tshogs mchod pa'i sprin gyi bla bre can: nam mkha' gang bar dmigs te phul ba yis: lhun grub longs sku'i zhing la spyod par shog: 'od gsal lhun grub ye shes rigs lnga'i zhing : sku dang thig le ye nas brgyan pa 'di: rang snang dag pas legs par phul ba yis: kun bzang chos sku'i zhing la spyod par shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐: dngos 'byor yid sprul 'phrul dga'i longs spyod bzhin: phyag rgya gar sogs phyi nang gsang ba yi: kun tu bzang po bla med mchod sprin gyis: rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor ma lus mnyes gyur cig: oṃ gu ru badzra sa twa sa pa ri wā ra bhyaḥ arghaṃ pra tītstsha ye swā hā: de bzhin/ pā dyaṃ? puṣpe? dhū pe? ā lo ke? gandhe? nai wi dye? shabda 'i bar sbyar te phyi mchod dang : hoḥ ye shes lnga sbyor dug lnga sel ba'i sman: khams gsum yongs sgrol 'khor ba stong pa'i khrag: 'dod yon lngas brgyan dam rdzas gtor chen po: thugs dam gnyan po bskang ba'i don phyir 'bul: ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta bha lingta kha kha khā hi: zhes nang mchod dang*/ āḥ gzhi dbyings stong chen e yi padmo ru: gzhi snang ma 'gags thabs mchog rdo rjes sbyor: zung 'jug bde chen gsang ba'i mchod pa che: gnyis med don rtogs bde ba'i klong du 'bul: oṃ ma hā a nu rā ga na su kha dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko ྅haṃ: zhes sbyor mchod dang*/ āḥ 'khor 'das gnyis kyis bsdus pa'i chos so cog: 'od gsal stong nyid lta ba'i klong du bsgral: gnyis snang bdag 'dzin 'khrul rtog ru tra kun: gnyis med he ru ka yi zhal du bstab: ma hā ru tra pra wan tsakra sarba pūtstsha hoḥ zhes bsgral mchod dang*/ āḥ mchod bya mchod byed mchod yul gdod nas dag: mchog tu mi 'gyur rig stong byang chub sems: blo 'das ka dag gnyug ma rdo rje'i srog:

'gyur med mchog gi mchod pa bla na med: oṃ badzra dharma dhā tu a: zhes de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa'o/ /lnga pa bstod pa ni/ hūm̐: gdod nas yongs grub gdan gsum dkyil 'khor gtso: rigs rnams kun bdag gsang chen ston pa'i rgyal: rdo rje sems dpa' yang dag gsang ba che: dkyil 'khor kun gyi byed por phyag 'tshal bstod: gang gi sku dang gsang sngags yi ge brgya: dran pa'i mod la mtshams med lnga bsags pa'i: las ngan rgyun gcod na raka dong nas sprugs: sbyong ba'i rgyal po che la phyag 'tshal bstod: dang po sangs rgyas rang byung kun tu bzang : rdo rje sems dpa' rdo rje de bzhin gshegs: snang stong sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i skur ston pa: dam pa rigs brgya'i 'khor lor phyag 'tshal bstod: drug pa dzab bzla ba la bsnyen sgrub las gsum la dang po bsnyen pa ni/ bhrūm̐ bi shwa bi shuddhe phaṭ dzaḥ sa rten dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā phaṭ dzaḥ sa brten pa'i lha/ bdag nyid rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor las: ye shes dkyil 'khor logs su phyes: mdun gyi nam mkhar mngon sum du: ma 'dres yongs rdzogs lam gyi gsal/ zhes gsal btab la: oṃ āḥhūm̐: phyi snod 'jig rten ma bskyed gzhal yas khang : nang bcud sems can yongs grub lha yi dal: snang srid gzhir bzhengs rang byung don gyi lha: rdo rje sems dpa' sgyu 'phrul drwa ba che'i: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dbyings nas skur bzhengs shig: rdo rje'i gdung 'tshob rnal 'byor sgrub mchog dang : rdo rje mched lcam rdo rje'i g.yar dam ni: srog gi phyir yang mi gtong sgrub lags na: thugs rje'i thugs dam ma g.yel nyer dgongs la: sku gsung thugs kyi dbyings su bdag sgrubs shigaḥ zhes gdung ba'i dbyangs dang spos rol bcas gzi brjid bskyed/ thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i: rdo rje'i lte bar pad dmar 'dab drug dbus: hūm̐ dmar mtha' bskor gsang sngags 'bru drug gsal:

'od zer 'phro 'du snod bcud snang srid kun: rdo rje sems dpa'i zhing khams chen por blta: oṃ badzra sa twa āḥ sgrub pa ni/ yab kyi thugs dbus hūm̐ yig dmar po las: rigs brgya'i rang bzhin yi ge brgya pa'i sprin: zhal nas byung ste yum gyi zhal tu zhugs: mkha' gsang padmo rdo rje'i khong gseng nas: brgyud de rang sgra 'od zer dpag med bcas: rgyun mi chad par 'khor bas yab yum zung : mi bzod bde ba'i sgra dang 'od zer gyis: gdan gsum zhi khro dam pa rigs brgya bskul: rang rang phyag rgyar sbyor ba'i bde chen 'bar: phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas rnams kun: rdo rje sems dpa' sgyu 'phrul drwa ba yi: gsang gsum 'khor lo'i rnam par spyan drangs bstim: mchog thun dngos grub ma lus thob par bsam: oṃ padma sa twa sa ma ya: ma nu pā la ya/ padma sa twa twe no pa/ tiṣṭha dṛ ḍho me bha wa/ su toṣyo me bha wa/ su po ṣyo me bha wa/ a nu rakto me bha wa/ sarba siddhi mme pra yatstsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsittaṃ shrī ya/ ku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥbha ga wān/ sarba ta thā ga ta/ padma mā me muñtsa/ padma bha wa/ ma hā sa ma ya sa twa āḥhūm̐ phaṭ/ las sbyor ni/ bcom ldan rdo rje sems dpa'i gnas drug nas: rdor sems rigs drug thub drug sku dpag med: ma dag rigs drug gnas rnams gang bar 'phros: yig brgya'i sngags sgra thugs rje'i 'od zer gyis: rigs drug so so'i 'khor ba dong nas sprugs: ma lus sangs rgyas sa la bsgral bar bsam: yig brgya'i sham du/ 'aḥ.aḥshaḥsaḥmaḥhaḥ ma ma ko ling sa mānta: aḥtriḥṇiḥsuḥpreḥduḥsarba duḥkha shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: zhes grangs tshad/ gter gzhung las/ bsnyen pa bye ba sgrub pa 'bum drug dang : las sbyor khri yis mchog thun dngos grub thob: lus nas rnag khrag srog chags 'byin pa dang : khrus dang mtsho bgrod mkhar 'phur rmi lam rtags: nyams rtogs 'phel dang zhal mjal la sogs 'gyur:

zhes pa ltar bzla zhing dbang sgrub sogs kyi skabs su rnam bum ched du sgrub tshe/ gzungs thag 'jus te/ phaṭ dzaḥ sa phyes la/ bum pa rang byung gzhal med khang chen por/ skad cig mkha' la gza' skar shar ba bzhin/ dkyil 'khor rtsa ba'i lha nyid bkra lam me/ gsal ba'i thugs srog sngags phreng spro bsdu yis/ byang sems bdud rtsis bum pa gang bar bsam/ zhes gsal brtan gi ngang nas yig brgya ci rigs bzla zhing las bum la dmigs te/ gzungs thag spos la/ mtshan ldan las bum bdud rtsi dbus nyid du/ zla gdan la gnas hūm̐ la yig brgyas bskor/ 'od zer 'phro 'dus ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ byung bas bum pa ltem gyi gang bar mos/ zhes bsam zhing yig brgya dang*/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐: oṃ e yam̐ bam̐ lam̐ ram̐ a hoḥ shuddhe shuddha bi shuddhe sarba pā paṃ shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ zhes nyer gcig sogs bzla'o/ /thun mtshams su dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying bcas kyis kha skong zhing brtan par byas la/ oṃ/ ye shes lha tshogs spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'bul: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las tshogs la bstod: nyams chags kun bshags mchog thun dngos grub stsol: zhes stong tshig gi mchod bstod bya/ dung chu'i mchod yon oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes phul/ bum lha bde stong gi ngo bor zhu bas dam ye gnyis su med pa'i byang sems bdud rtsi'i bum pa gang bar bsam mo/ /bdag 'jug bsdus pa'i dgongs pa ni/ āḥ rdzogs chen spros pa bral ba'i rnal 'byor che'i: 'khor 'das chos sku rang rig byang chub sems: sems kyi rang bzhin chos dbyings nam mkha' che: chos kyi dbyings su nyams pas gos ma myong : nyams srid sgro skur 'debs pa'i gnod pa gang : 'khor 'das mnyam nyid thig le chen por bshags: lta ba'i klong bshags rgyud kyi rgyal po 'di:

gsang chen 'od gsal rdo rje theg pa'i srog: de ltar rtogs na bskang bshags mchog tu 'gyur: a la la hoḥ sa bzlas pa'i nyes byas bshags/ gsol ba 'debs pa ni thal mo sbyar la/ hoḥ bla ma dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa' kyaiḥ 'jigs rung srid mtshor bying ba'i mtha' med 'gror: sangs rgyas phrin las mdzad pa rmad byung bas: myur du dbugs chen dbyung bar mdzad du gsol: yang dag ye shes snang ba chen po yis: 'gro drug ma rig smag 'thug rab bcom ste: bla med byang chub lam la 'god mdzad pa'i: nus mthu gang lags mgon pos bdag la stsol: lan gsum/ zhes gsol rdor sems zhal nas rigs kyi bu'i: sdig sgrib dag go zhes pa'i dbugs dbyung bsam: dzpa khang bsdu ba ni/ dam ye dbyer med rtogs pa'i phyir/ oṃ badzra sa ma ya oṃ: ā badzra sa ma ya ā/ hūm̐ badzra sa ma ya hūm̐/ swā badzra sa ma ya swā/ hā badzra sa ma ya hā/ zhes rig pa'i me tog dor bas/ dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa gnyis kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las rnams gnyis su med par rigs ste/ oṃ/ ye shes rgyal po sku gsung thugs/ /yon tan phrin las rmad po che/ /de nyid du ni mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /phyag rgya chen por bdag sbyor cig /oṃ badzra sa ma ya hūm̐/ oṃ badzra sa ma ya satwaṃ/ oṃ badzra sa ma ya hoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa dzpa khang bsdus la/ dbyer med sgyu ma chu zla 'ja' tshon bzhin: rang dang snang ba'i cha dang rnam pa kun: rdo rje sems dpa'i sku gsung thugs rdo rje: dbyer med bde ba chen por 'byams klas gyur/ zhes gsal brtan gyi dbang du/ yi ge brgya pa brjod/ bdag 'jug rgyas pa ma grub kyang chad skyon mi 'gyur ba tsam ste 'dir gzhan rjes su 'dzin pa dang 'brel tshe dkyil 'khor lha la thal mo sbyar btud de/ oṃ/ rdo rje'i ye shes thob bya'i phyir/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /snying po'i dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir/ /bdag gi slob ma 'jug par 'tshal/

/ zhes gsol bas gnang ba byin par mos so/ /rtsa ba'i gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa tshogs mchod 'bul ba ni/ gter gzhung las/ tshogs kyi mchod pa gsang ba'i gzhung ltar bya: zhes gsungs pas: byin rlabs spyan 'dren mchod bshags bsgral stabs dang : lhag ma bskul dang chad brtan rta bro brdung : dngos grub len dang nongs bshags dkyil 'khor bsdu: bsngo smon bkra shis mtha' brgyan bya ba'o: dang po tshogs rdzas gtsang bsags byin rlabs ni: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: bdag gi thugs las 'byung ba'i yi ge 'phros: me rlung chu yis tshogs kyi dngos 'dzin sbyangs: slar yang oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis tshogs rdzas rnams: sbyang rtogs spar bas ye shes 'khor lor gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ gnyis pa spyan 'dren ni: dzaḥ 'og min mngon par dga' ba'i zhing khams nas: longs sku'i ston pa bcom ldan rdo rje sems: 'gags med thugs rje sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i lha: 'gro kun don phyir dad pas spyan 'dren na: chos sku 'od gsal dbyings las ma g.yos bzhin: phyag rgya so so'i gzugs kyi skur bzhengs la: 'dod yon tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: e hya he:

sa mkha' khyab kyi 'khor lor sad pa la rang gi thugs ka nas sprul pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod par bsam la/ oṃ badzra rū pa āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin spel ba'i/ shabda gandhe rā sa sparshe āḥhūm̐: zhes spyir mchod/ bla med gsang chen sngags kyi dam tshig rdzas: bde chen tshogs kyi 'khor lo e ma rmad: a la la ste thugs dam dbyings su skong : srid zhi mnyam nyid thig le chen po'i dbyings: khams gsum 'khor ba'i sems can thams cad kyi: nyams chags rtog tshogs ma spang rang grol nas: rang rig dag pa sku gsum mngon gyur te: kun bzang gdod ma'i gzhi la sangs rgyas shog: oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐: tshogs kyis rtogs pa bskyed cing nyams chags bskang : gsum pa mchod pa ni: hūm̐: bla med tshogs kyi mchod pa dam pa 'di: dpag med 'dod yon lha mos gar bsgyur bcas: rdor sems sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i lha la 'bul: bzhes nas dbang dang dngos grub stsal du gsol: ma hā ga ṇa tsakra bha liṃ ta pū dzaḥkhā hi: bzhi pa bshags pa ni: hoḥ ye thog 'khrul gzhi blangs nas da lta'i bar: rig dang ma rig 'khrul pa'i las dbang gis: bcas dang rang bzhin nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs: 'dod yon tshogs kyi 'khor los bskang zhing bshags: badzra sa ma ya shuddhe a: lnga pa bsgral bstab ni: oṃ badzra ma hā shrī he ru ka rang nyid rdo rje he ru ka'i skur gyur/ spro na bden brdar sngon du 'gro ba'i/ nṛ tri sarba sha truṃ a karṣa ya dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa 'gugs la/ hūm̐: gzung 'dzin 'khrul ba'i rang gzugs dgra dang bgegs: stong nyid rnam thar e yi brub khung du: tshad med phyag rgya rnam bzhis dbyer med bstim: rnam shes dbyings bsgral gzugs phung zhal du stob: a spha ra ṇa phaṭḥ kyis spar/ dgra bgegs nṛ tri sarba sha truṃ mā ra ya phaṭḥ kyis bsgral/ ma hā māṃ sa rakta kiṃ ni ri ti sarba ru tra pra wan tsakra pū dzaḥkha kha khā hi: ha ha ha:

hi hi hi: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: gis stabs/ oṃ badzra sa twa oṃ: zhes rang nyid rdo rje sems dpa'i skur nga rgyal 'phos la/ tshogs kyi longs spyod nang mchod bsreg blug gis tshim par rol: drug pa lhag ma ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: hūm̐ bhyoḥ lhag la dbang ba'i dkyil 'khor mtha' skyong ba: dpal gyi 'khor tshogs badzra a ra li: ma tshogs dbang phyug ging lang 'bar ma'i tshogs: lhag gtor dgyes bzhes rnam bzhi'i phrin las sgrubs: utstshiṣṭa bā liṃ ta khā hi: bdun pa thugs dam bskul ba ni: hūm̐: phyogs bcu dag pa'i dkyil 'khor yangs pa nas: thugs rjes dgongs shig bslu med dkon mchog gsum: dbyings nas bzhengs shig sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i lha: gdan gsum dkyil 'khor khrag 'thung rgyud sde'i tshogs: brgyud gsum dam can srung ma las la bzhengs: sna tshogs gang 'dul phrin las dus la bab: phyi yi dus 'khrugs snod kyi rgud pa sol: nang gi 'byung 'khrugs nad mug mtshon gsum bzlog: gsang ba sems 'khrul dug lnga'i rnam rtog gzhil: shin tu mi bsrun gdul dka' tshar gcod pa'i: phrin las myur du mdzod cig sa ma ya: brgyad pa chad tho bsgrags pa ni: hūm̐ bhyoḥ dus gsum brgyud gsum rig 'dzin bla ma dang : he ru ka yi dam la rab gnas pa'i: bka' yi lha 'dre brgyud gsum dregs pa'i sde: chad tho gtor ma longs la phrin las sgrubs: dgu pa brtan ma skyong ba ni: ma bhyoḥ khyad par slob dpon padma kā ra yis: bka' dang dam gnas bod khams skyong ba'i ma: dus sbyor bcu gnyis dag pa'i brtan skyong tshogs: bshal chu'i gtor ma dgyes bzhes phrin las mdzod: oṃ ma ma hriṃ hriṃ ba liṃ ta khā hi: bcu pa bro brdung bya ba ni: hūm̐: rnam thar gsum ldan e yi dbyings nyid du: gzung 'dzin mtshan mar lta ba'i dam sri thub: ye shes lnga yis glu blangs bro brdung bas: 'od gsal stong nyid bde ba'i klong du sba: oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā:

laṃ ya ma dam sri tri satwaṃ bha ya nan: bcu gcig pa dngos grub len pa ni: hoḥ sgyu 'phrul rdor sems lha tshogs dgongs su gsol: sku gsung thugs kyi bha ga yangs pa nas: phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub dang : thun mong las bzhi grub brgyad 'dod rgu'i char: da lta nyid du bstsal zhing brtan par mdzod: rtsa sngags dang : kā ya wākka tsitta sarba siddhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ bcu gnyis pa nongs bshags ni: hoḥ gsang ba'i sgor zhugs rnal 'byor sgrub pa po'i: bag med dbang gyur ting 'dzin ma gsal zhing : lha sngags ma dag cho gar lhag chad sogs: ye shes lha dang srung mar bzod par gsol: yig brgya bzla: bcu gsum pa dkyil 'khor bsdu rim ni: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: snang cha lha sngags 'khor lo dbyings su bsdu: mi gnas thugs kyi thig les rtag mtha' bral: ā ā āḥ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ stong nyid rang gdangs thugs rje'i ye shes rtsal: sku gsung thugs kyi 'khor los chad mtha' spangs: oṃ āḥhūm̐: badzra ma ma ka wā tsi rakṣa haṃ: bcu bzhi bsngo smon ni: hoḥ bdag gis dus gsum dge ba ci bsags mthus: nam mkha'i mthar thug gyur pa'i sems can kun: bla med theg mchog sngags kyi snod gyur nas: rdo rje sems dpa'i go 'phang myur thob shog: bco lnga pa bkra shis ni: hūm̐: bcom ldan rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs bskyed dang : mdzad pa smon lam mkhyen brtse nus pa'i stobs: bla med ye shes sgyu 'phrul mkha' dang mnyam: dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog: snang zhen lha skur rdzogs pa'i bkra shis shog: sgra grags sngags su dag pa'i bkra shis shog: dran rtogs chos skur smin pa'i bkra shis shog: 'ja' lus zang thal chen po'i bkra shis shog: ces me tog gi char phab pas dge legs su bya'o/ /slar smas pa/ gang gi mtshan tsam 'dzin pas kyang*/ /sems can na raka dong sprugs pa'i/ /sbyong rgyud rgya mtsho'i yang zhun mchog /lha mchog rdo rje sems dpa' rmad/

/padma gdams bcud ches gsang ba'i/ /thig les phrin las 'di bskrun dges/ /mkha' khyab yid can ma lus pa/ /mngon par dga' bar byang chub shog /ces bla ma'i thugs sgrub sku gsum dgongs pa 'dus pa'i nang sgrub rdo rje sems dpa' padma gsang ba'i thig le'i phris las 'og min gsang lam 'di'ang rang slob chos kyi bdag po rnal 'byor pa bsod nams 'brug stobs kyis zab chos yongs rdzogs gtan 'bebs kyi nan bskul yid la sim/ nye char mchog sprul o rgyan kun dga' dang 'jam dbyangs rig grol zung gis bskul ngor ne ren seṅge rdzong nas bklags chog tu sdebs pa siddhi rastu/ yi ge pa'ang karma ye shes mthar phyin gyi zhus pa dge legs su gyur cig/ // ྂ/: sku gsum dgongs 'dus las: bskang bshags rdo rje sems dpa'i dgongs rgyan ces bya ba bzhugs so: ྂ/: tta/tsa//rga/: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo: gang zhig rgyud gzhi gso zhing sbyong ba'i phyir: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod bsham byin gyis brlabs: oṃ āḥhūm̐: stong gsum rab 'byams nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa: phyi nang gsang ba'i bkod pa bla na med: dngos su bshams dang yid kyis rnam par 'phrul: kun bzang mchod pa'i phyag rgya chen por shar: na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhyoḥ sogs nas swā hā: nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags dang phyag rgyas brlabs: tshogs zhing bsgrub pa ni: e ma hoḥ snang srid rnam dag 'og min mngon dga'i zhing : rmad byung bla med kun bzang mchod sprin dbus: rigs rnams kun 'dus bla ma rdo rje sems: ma lus skyabs gnas rgya mtsho'i ngo bor bzhugs: hūm̐: rab 'byams rgyal kun ye shes klong chen gcig: de sras phyogs bcu'i dus bzhir bzhugs pa yi: dgra bcom byang sems yi dam ḍākki'i sprin: ma lus zhing gi rdul snyed gshegs su gsol: badzra sa mā ya dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ phyag 'tshal ba ni: na moḥ bde gshegs snying po'i ngang bzhugs gzhi'i sangs rgyas:

ye grol kun bzang klong du dbyer med kyang : glo bur 'khrul ngor sna tshogs thabs mkhas kyi: theg pa rim dgur shar la phyag 'tshal lo: bde gshegs sku lnga'i bdag nyid rdzogs sangs rgyas: de yi zhal gsung theg dgu dam pa'i chos: sa dang lam gnas 'phags tshogs dge 'dun sde: bla med dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo: byin rlabs sprin phung brgyud gsum bla ma dang : dngos grub char 'bebs yi dam zhi khro'i lha: phrin las myur 'grub mkha' 'gro chos skyong sogs: bde gshegs rtsa ba gsum la phyag 'tshal lo: ngo ba ka dag stong chen chos kyi sku: rang bzhin 'od gsal thugs rje'i kun la brdal: rdul gcig steng na rdul snyed bzhugs pa yi: sku dang ye shes tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo: skye med chos kyi sku la phyag 'tshal lo: longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: cir yang sprul pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: mngon par byang chub sku la phyag 'tshal lo: mi 'gyur rdo rje'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: rgyud sde bzhi yi lha la phyag 'tshal lo: bde gshegs zhi ba'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo: khrag 'thung khro bo'i tshogs l kun bzang chos kyi sku l bde chen yum gyi mkha' l yab yum gnyis su med l gnyis med cho 'phrul (sho lo ka 'di rang nyid kyis mchan/) ston l thabs kyi 'gro ba sgrol l longs sku rigs lnga'i sku l byang sems lcam dral tshogs l sprul sku thub chen drug l sgo ba yab yum brgyad l dpal chen he ru ka l kro ti shwa ri yum l khrag 'thung rigs lnga'i sku l kro ti shwa ri lnga l gnas kyi ma mo brgyad l yul bdag phra men brgyad l spor byed chen mo brgyad l rnal 'byor dbang mo'i tshogs l ye shes sgo ma bzhi l dam pa'i rigs brgya'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo: rnal 'byor chen po bla na med pa yi: ye shes lha tshogs kun la phyag 'tshal lo: 'dus pa mdo yi lha l sgyu 'phrul rgyan gyi lha l

a ti sems kyi lha l 'chi med tshe yi lha l 'jam dpal sku yi lha l padma gsung gi lha l yang dag thugs kyi lha l yon tan bdud rtsi'i lha l phrin las phur pa'i lha l rbod gtong ma mo'i tshogs l bla ma rig 'dzin tshogs l 'jig rten mchod bstod tshogs l dmon pa drag sngags tshogs l dam can srung mar bcas l bdag sogs mkha' mnyam sems can kun gyi lus: zhing rdul grangs snyed sprul ste phyag 'chal lo: na mo pū ru sha ya hoḥ thun mong phyi yi mchod pa ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: stong gsum 'di'am stong gsum gzhan dag na: lha rdzas me tog bdun spos mar me dri: zhal zas rol mo'i bye brag ma lus pa: thugs dam gnyan po skong ba'i don phyir 'bul: badzra puṣpe sogs shabda pra tītstsha ye swā hā: thun mong nang gi mchod pa ni: ye shes lnga rdzogs dug lnga sel ba'i sman: khams gsum yongs sgrol 'khor ba stong ba'i khrag: 'dod yon lngas brgyan dam rdzas gtor chen po: thugs dam gnyen po bskang ba'i don phyir 'bul: ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta bha lingta kha kha khā hi: khyad par sgron me'i mchod pa ni: nyi zla gza' skar phyi yi sgron me bkra: rtsa rlung thig le nang gi sgron me gsal: 'byung ba'i zhun mar rdzas kyi sgron me spar: ye shes snang ba chen po'i mchod pa 'bul: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra ā lo ke pra tītstsha swā hā: dngos gzhi rim dgu so sor bskang bshags ni: hoḥ so thar 'dul ba bden bzhi'i dkyil 'khor nas: nyan thos tshom bu lnga yi thugs dam bskang : bcas dang rang bzhin 'gal ba'i nongs pa bshags: 'phags pa dgra bcom go 'phang thob byin brlob: oṃ badzra sa twa sa ma ya: sogs nas sa twa āḥhūm̐ phaṭḥ zhes yig brgya so sor brjod: hoḥ rten 'brel bcu gnyis lugs ldog dkyil 'khor nas: rang rgyal dkyil 'khor rnam bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : bslab pa mdo sde'i srung mtshams las 'gal bshags:

tshogs dang bse ru'i rang rgyal dngos grub stsol: yig brgya brjod: hoḥ bden gnyis lam du khyer ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: mngon pa'i dkyil 'khor bcu yi thugs dam bskang : mu bzhi lam du gol ba'i nong pa bshags: dag gzhan kun nas 'od kyi sa la skyol: yig brgya brjod: hoḥ dag pa rnam pa gsum gyi dkyil 'khor nas: bya rgyud dkyil 'khor drug gi thugs dam bskang : gtsang sbra chung sogs phra rag nyam chag bshags: thabs mchog bde chen rdo rje'i dngos grub stsol: yig brgya brjod: hoḥ thabs dang shes rab gnyis med dkyil 'khor nas: spyod rgyud dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang : lha sngags ting 'dzin ma dag nyams chag bshags: grub chen brgyud sogs mchog thun dngos grub stsol: yig brgya brjod: hoḥ lha sngags phyag rgya dbyer med dkyil 'khor nas: yo ga ling tshe dgu yi thugs dam bskang : bzang ngan blta sogs nongs par gyur kun bshags: mi 'gyur bde chen mchog gi dngos grub stsol: yig brgya brjod: hoḥ snang srid dag pa rab 'byams dkyil 'khor nas: sgyu 'phrul tshom bu bcu gnyis thugs dam bskang : nyer lnga gsang bcu la sogs dam nyams bshags: tshe 'dir rig 'dzin rnam bzhi'i sa la skyol: yig brgya brjod: hoḥ rdo rje'i phung po lus kyi dkyil 'khor nas: mnyam sbyor a nu'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : nye nyon sems byung lnga bcu'i rtogs tshogs bshags: lhan skyes bde ba chen po'i sa la skyol: yig brgya brjod: hoḥ rig stong 'pho 'gyur med pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: a ti don gyi lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : klong du ma gyur rtsal shugs chung ba bshags: lhun 'grub rdzogs pa chen po'i sa la skyol: yig brgya brjod: bshags tshan rnam bzhi'i nang gsal sdom gsum bshags pa ni: hoḥ sgo gsum mi dge bcu dang mtshams med lnga : de dang nye ba lnga sogs mi dge'i las: bcas dang kha na ma tho sdig pa'i tshogs:

rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs la bzod par gsol: so thar 'dul ba mdo yi dge slong la: nyams pa skyon gyi dri ma ma mchis te: nyis brgya lnga bcu'i khrims las 'gal ba sogs: dgra bcom 'phags pa'i tshogs la bzod par gsol: theg chen byang chub sems dpa'i dge slong la: nyams pa skyon gyi dri ma ma mchis te: nag po'i chos bzhi la sogs ltung ba'i tshogs: byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs la bzod par gsol: gsang ba rig 'dzin sngags kyi rnal 'byor la: nyams pa skyon gyi dri ma ma mchis te: rtsa ltung bcu bzhi la sogs dam nyams pa: rdo rje 'dzin pa'i tshogs la bzod par gsol: yig brgya brjod: rtsa gsum spyi bshags ni: hoḥ gang zhig dngos grub slob dpon rjes 'brang phyir: slob dpon drug dang dbang bzhi'i bla ma la: ma gus pa dang 'byor tshogs chung ba sogs: rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs la bzod par gsol: dang po me tog phog pa'i yi dam lhar: bsnyen sgrub rnam bzhi'i dus tshig g.yel ba dang : re dogs dbang gis spang len bgyis pa sogs: yi dam lha tshogs rnam la bzod par gsol: bka' bzhin bsgrub pa'i rnal 'byor pho mo la: lus dang grib ltar 'grogs pa'i bya ra bar: khas blang nyams dang tshogs gtor chung ba sogs: mkha' 'gro chos skyong tshogs la bzod par gsol: ston pa gcig gi chos sgor zhugs so cog: thams cad mched grogs yin par ma shes nas: chags sdang phyogs ris brtse gdung chung ba sogs: byang sems lcam dral tshogs la bzod par gsol: nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can rnams: dus gsum pha mar gyur pa ma shes nas: dgra gnyen dbang gis phan sems chung ba sogs: drin chen pha ma'i tshogs la bzod par gsol: kun gzhi bde gshegs snying po'i rang bzhin las: 'khor ba logs su med par ma shes nas: sangs rgyas sems can bzang ngan blta ba'i gnong : byang chub skyon bral klong du mthol lo bshags:

yig brgya brjod: lta bsgom bshags pa ni: āḥ lta ba ka dag klong chen rab 'byams la: nyams pa skyon gyis dri ma ma mchis te: rtag chad mu bzhir gol bas nongs pa gang : mtha' dbus gnyis med thig le chen por bshags: sgom pa 'od gsal 'khor yug brdal ba la: nyams pa skyon gyi dri ma ma mchis te: bying rgod rmugs par 'thib pa'i nongs pa gang : gnyug ma 'od gsal 'phel 'grib med par bshags: spyod pa re dogs bral ba'i rnal 'byor la: nyams pa skyon gyi dri ma ma mchis te: sgyu 'bras khyad bsad tha mal shor ba'i gnong : spang blang mtshan ma bral ba'i ngang du bshags: ye nas yin pa med pa'i lta ba rtogs: gnas skabs min pa med pa'i sgo nyams len: yin min bzang ngan med pa'i spyod pa skyong : 'bras bu re dogs med pa'i byang chub sems: bshags bya bshags byed gnyis med chos skur grol: yig brgya brjod: gzhi lam bshags pa ni: hoḥ bed gshegs snying po bzhi yi bzhugs tshul la: nyams pa skyon gyi dri ma ma mchis ti: bzang ngan gnyis su lta ba'i nongs pa gang : kun byed rgyal po'i dbyings su bshags par bgyi: 'od gsal snying po lam gyi bgrod tshul la: nyams pa skyon gyi dri ma ma mchis te: sgom pa yun thung chos nyid don ma rtog: rig stong gnyug ma'i dbyings su bshags par bgyi: 'bras bu'i rgyal po sku bzhi'i dbang phyug la: nyams pa skyon gyi dri ma ma mchis te: thob bya'i zhe 'dod blo yi dri ma gang : ye grol kun bzang klong du bshags par bgyi: e ma: ye gsang thabs kyis chod pa'i theg mchog lam: dbang rab las 'phro ldan pa'i gsang ba'i gnas: gting dpag dka' bas lta sgom gnad ma rtogs: dam tshig sa ya 'bum sde la sogs pa: rnam grangs mang bas srung byar ngo ma thog: sngags gsum phyag rgya bzhi dang slob dpon drug: sku gsung thugs dang yan lag nyer lnga sogs: nongs par gyur kun rang gnong bzod par gsol:

don gyi mthar thug gnad kun sdom pa'i gsang : bzhi cha sum bral skad cig sa le ba: rang rig skye med kun tu bzang po la: thob bya'i dbang dang srung bya'i dam tshig sogs: rgyu dang 'bras bu'i chos las ye nas 'das: ye srung mtshan ma bral ba'i rdzogs pa cher: dam tshig nyams par 'gyur ba ga la srid: nyams par 'gyur zhes sgro bskur 'debs pa'i gnong : ye grol kun bzang klong du bshags par bgyi: kun bzang chos sku'i dgongs spyod de 'dra yang : de ltar bdag gis ma rig ma rtogs te: glo bur 'khrul dbang drag pos 'khor bar 'khyams: yod med gnyis kar 'dzin pa yong re gol: 'bad dang rtsol bas bsgrubs pa thang re chad: gnas lugs rang ngo ma shes snying re rje: sdug bsngal rgya mtshor g.yeng ba nyon re mongs: deng nas rdo rje rgyal po'i bka' drin gyis: thabs mchog bla med cho gas nyer zin te: skad cig rdzogs sangs rgyas pa'i ngo mtshar rmad: nyams chag rtog tshogs ma spangs rang grol nas: 'ja' lus zang thal chen po chos kyi sku: 'bras bu rgyal po'i btsan sa bla na med: kun bzang chos sku'i rgyal srid a la la: de ltar rtogs na bskang bshags mchog tu 'gyur: yig brgya brjod: de ltar bshags bgyis nyams chag sor chud nas: slad nas dam bca' mchog tu bzung ba ni: hoḥ mgon po thugs rje chen po'i rang bzhin dgongs: thog ma tha ma med nas da lta'i bar: sems can lags pa'i 'khrul pa'i rang bzhin te: ma rig dbang gis nongs par mchis srid kyang : sgyu ma lags pa'i gnyen po stobs bzhi yis: bshags par bgyid zin mngon du 'gyur lags kyi: mi gsang mi sbed slad 'chad yang dag sdom: mgon po kun gyi spyan sngar bdag 'bul gyis: brtse ba chen po'i rjes su bzung du gsol: sngon gyi sras bcas rgyal kun gshegs pa'i lam: rmad byung byang chub spyod pa bdag gis spyad: gdul dka' snyigs ma'i 'gro ba thabs kyis 'dul:

'gro khams ma stong bar du bdag gcig pur: mya ngan 'das la spro ba cang ma mchis: 'gro ba drug po gnas par de srid du: bdag nas bdag gis ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral: ma bsgrol bsgrol dang mya ngan 'das la 'god: mdor na 'gro ba'i don du bdag gi lus: dum bu stong du gtub kyang mi 'da' bar: 'gro kun byang chub snying po mchis bar du: dkon mchog gsum 'dzin dam tshig sngags la brtson: sku gsung thugs dang rigs lnga srog tu 'dzin: yan lag rnams kyang de bzhin yang dag bzung : sngon gyi bde gshegs sras bcas mdzad pa dang : rlabs chen spyod pa rgya mtsho ci 'dra ba: de 'dra kho nar bdag spyad bdag 'gyur bar: dam pa rnams kyis nus mthu bstsal du gsol: tsitta badzra sa ma ya hoḥ badzra sa ma ya satwaṃ: rjes 'brel cho gar yi rang ba ni: hoḥ mgon po sras bcas mdzad pa rgya mtsho dang : so 'phags rnam dkar dge ba'i bsod nams la: phrag dog mi dge'i kun slong rab spangs nas: tshad med dga' bas rjes su yi rang ngo : bskul ba ni: hoḥ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas rnams dgongs: mtha' yas 'gro ba kun la sman bslad du: gdul bya'i khams dbang mthun par theg dgu yi: chos kyi 'khor lo rab 'byams bskor bar bskul: gsol 'debs ni: hoḥ ma dag zhing gi 'gro ba gnas kyi bar: phyogs rnams kun bzhugs bstan pa'i sgron me rnams: mya ngan 'da' bzhed ston pa gang su dag: bskal pa bye ba bsam yas bzhugs gsol 'debs: bsngo ba ni: hoḥ dge tshogs gang 'dis ston pa sangs rgyas kyi: bstan pa'i lam bzang theg pa rim pa dgu'i: sa bcu lam lnga'i bgrod pa mthar phyin nas: don gnyis lhun 'grub bkra shis dpal 'bar shog: de ltar yan lag brgyad kyi rgyud sbyong zhing : dbang bzhi'i ye shes yang dag gso bar byed: oṃ badzra sa ma ya oṃ: āḥbadzra sa ma ya āḥ hūm̐ badzra sa ma ya hūm̐: swā badzra sa ma ya swā: hā badzra sa ma ya hā: rdo rje'i me tog gnas lngar dor byas la:

e ma: rang gnas ye shes ye nas dag pa la: glo bur rnam rtog sprin bsgribs ma rig 'gror: nam mkha'i rdo rje'i dbang bskur rmad po che: rgyal thabs spyi blug chen por yang dag stsol: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wākka tsitta sarba badzra sa ma ya hūm̐: sa ma ya satwaṃ: sa ma ya hoḥ yang dag bskul zhing yang dag 'jug par 'tshal: hūm̐: rigs 'dus rdo rje sems dpa'i gnas bzhi nas: dbang zhi'i ye shes yi ge sprin du blang : las nyon bag chags shes bya'i sprin bral nas: lam bzhi'i snod gyur sku bzhi'i sa bon bzhag: gu ru badzra sa twa kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃḥ wākka a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: sarba a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ dbang bzhi rim dang gcig 'char blangs ba'i mthar: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dbyer med sgyu ma chu zla 'ja' tshon bzhin: rang dang snang ba'i cha dang rnam pa kun: rdo rje sems dpa'i sku gsung thugs rdo rje: dbyer med bde ba chen por 'byams klas gyur: oṃ badzra sa twa āḥ rigs 'dus yang snying mchog 'di yang dag bzla: rdo rje'i 'dul bar rdo rje gso sbyong 'di: tshig nyung don 'dus gsang ba spyi dang mthun: yar mar dus dang rgyun du 'bad gyur na: nyams pa skyon gyi dri ma kun dag nas: tshe 'dir mchog thun dngos grub dka' ba med: tshe gcig sgrub la 'bad kyang 'di med na: lam mgron rkang pa chag bzhin shin tu rmongs: dngos grub chu rgyun 'gog pa'i nyams chag sdig: bshags pa'i taṇṭa kun gyi dgongs bcud bsdus: bdag 'dra padmas ma 'ongs don du bkod: skal ldan las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gu hya: brda thim: ྀatsha: ces pa'ang 'gro 'dul pad rgyal gling pas sbas yul padma bkod kyi byang gling dbang drag dga' tshal gyi nye zhol 'brug la mar me kong 'bum nas spyan drangs pa'i zab gter yang dag pa'o/ /sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༄༅/ / bskang bshags nyer bsdus ni/ ye shes kyi 'khor lo mkha' khyab tu sad par gyur:

zhes skyabs yul gsal la: oṃ: gzhi thog dang po'i sangs rgyas kun tu bzang : rdo rje sems dpa' rdo rje de bzhin gshegs: dpa' bo chen po 'gro ba skyob pa'i mgon: bdag la brtser dgongs ye shes spyan gyis gzigs: ā: gdod nas ma skyes ye nas rnam dag kyang : 'khrul ngor glo bur shar ba'i kun rtog las: ma rig gzung 'dzin rkyen snang nyams chag kun: dag chen chos dbyings yum gyi klong du bshags: badzra: gsang ba'i bdag po rdo rje'i dam bsgrags pa: sku gsung thugs gsang sa ma ya 'bum gyi: dam las nyams shing tshig las 'gal ba gang : rab tu gnong shing 'gyod pas mthol lo bshags: sa twa: nyams pa skyon du gyur pa'i dus 'das nas: las kyi gnyer 'dzin rdo rje mkha' 'gro yi: bka' yi chad pa drag po'i rgyur gyur pa'i: 'di phyi'i sgrib gyur dmyal chen rgyu bsags bshags: hūm̐: 'dod pa'i rgyal po ye nas rdo rje che: dmigs su med cing nyams dang bshags pa bral: kun tu bzang po ye rdzogs rig pa'i klong : 'du 'bral med pa chos dbyings klong du ā: aḥ rdzogs chen spros pa bral ba'i rnal 'byor che'i: 'khor 'das chos kun rang rig byang chub sems: sems kyi rang bzhin chos dbyings nam mkha' che: chos kyi dbyings su nyams pa'i gos ma myong : nyams srid sgro bskur 'debs pa'i nongs pa gang : 'khor 'das nyams nyid thig le chen por bshags: lta ba'i klong bshags rgyud kyi rgyal po 'di: gsang chen 'od gsal rdo rje theg pa'i srog: de ltar rtogs na bskang bshags mchog tu gyur: a la la hoḥ rje btsun bla ma rnams kyi spyan lam du/ /yo byad 'byor tshogs chung ba mthol lo bshags/ /yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi spyan lam du/ /mngon rtogs spong len bgyis pa mthol lo bshags/ /mkha' 'gro sde bzhi rnams kyi spyan lam du/ khas blangs dam bca' nyams pa mthol lo bshags/ /chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi spyan lam du/

/gtor ma lo zlar 'gyangs ba mthol lo bshags/ /dus gsum pha ma rnams kyi spyan lam du/ /drin lan lan gyis ma 'jal mthol lo bshags/ /mched dang lcam dral rnams kyi spyan lam du/ /dam tshig brtse gdung chung ba mthol lo bshags/ /'gro drug sems can rnams kyi spyan lam du/ /snying rje phan sems chung ba mthol lo bshags/ /so sor thar pa rnams kyi sdom pa dang*/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bslab pa dang*/ /rig 'dzin sngags kyi dam tshig la sogs pa/ /'gal zhing nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags/ /mi 'chab mi sbed slan chad sdom par bgyi/ /dus gsum bsags pa'i sdig sgrib mthol bshags na/ /tshangs par mdzad nas sku gsung thugs la sogs/ /mchog dang mthun mong dngos grub bstsal du gsol/ /oṃ/ ye shes lha la rnam rtog mi mnga' yang*/ /de 'khor bka' yi srung ma dam tshig can/ /thugs dang 'gal bar gyur kun bzod par gsol/ /yun gyi sgrib pa mchis na sgrib pa sbyong*/ /'phral gyi rkyen gegs mchis na rkyen gegs zlog /tshangs pa mchog gi dngos grub bstsal du gsol/ / yig brgya brjod/ hūm̐: bka' gsang rmad du byung ba'i dkyil 'khor du: bla ma yid dam lha tshogs yongs rdzogs la: rang byung chos kyi dbyings kyi kong bu ru: rig pa'i ye shes mar me gtams te 'bul: rtsa brgyad yan lag stong sbyar a mṛ ta: sku lnga ye shes yongs rdzogs mchod pa 'bul: gtor gzhong rnam dag dpal gyi gtor mas gtams: 'dod yon yongs su rdzogs pa'i mchod pa 'bul: khams gsum 'khor ba yongs sgrol mkha' dbyings su: chags med rakta dmar gyi mnyes mchod 'bul: 'bru bcud stong la sbyar ba'i dpa' bo'i rdzas: gzi byin bskyed phyir dza gad mchod pa 'bul: a la la te dgyes par bzhes su gsol: gzhan yang tshe 'das sbyin bdag sogs kha bsgyur te/ pha mas thog drangs 'gro kun gyi/ /nyams chags thams cad bskang gyur cig /rtog sgrib thams cad byang gyur cig

/las ngan sdig sgrib dag gyur cig khams gsum 'khor ba stong gyur cig /'bras bu sku gsum thob gyur cig /bskang gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: nam mkha'i mthar thug sogs smon lam btab bo/ /ces pa'ang rgyun khyer gyi dbang du byas te pad rgyal pas so// ༄༅/ / rdor sems padma gsang thig gi dgos bskang ni/ bskang rdzas nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas brlab la/ hūm̐/ gzhi thog dang po'i mgon po kun tu bzang*/ /gzhi snang ma 'gag rol pa rdo rje sems/ /rgyal ba dgongs pa'i brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams/ /brdal khyab yangs pa lta bas thugs dam bskang*/ /dga' rab rdo rje bde chen rdo rje'i gar/ /shrī singha a ti chos kyi mdzod/ /mañdzu shrī brda brgyud bla ma rnams/ /gsal stong 'od gsal bsgom pas thugs dam bskang*/ /mtsho skyes yab yum gsang chen sngags kyi mdzod/ /gdams pa'i bka' bab sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ /dus gsum rig 'dzin snyan brgyud bla ma rnams/ /rang byung shugs 'byung spyod pas thugs dam bskang*/ /gter 'byin rig 'dzin bka' bab chos kyi bdag /rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam ḍākki dang*/ /rdo rje'i chos srung gter bdag dam can bcas/ /kun bzang rnam 'phrul rgya mtshos thugs dam bskang*/ /chos rnams ma lus gdod nas rnam dag pa'i/ /chos kun ngo bo bde chen rdo rje sems/ /ye rdzogs sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i dkyil 'khor pa/ /snang srid gzhir bzhengs mchod pas thugs dam bskang*/ /chos nyid mngon sum 'ja' zer thig le'i klong*/ /nyams snang gong 'phel mchod pa'i phyag rgya ches/ /rig pa tshad phebs don dam a ti'i lha/ /blo 'das chos zad klong du thugs dam bskang*/ /ma dag khams gsum 'khor ba'i sems can gyi/ /gnyis snang 'khrul rtog dbyings su bsgral ba yi/ /gnyis med don gyi rdo rje sems dpa' che/ /phyi nang gsang ba dbyer med rtogs pas bskang*/ /nyams chags rtog tshogs ma spangs rang grol nas/

/bzang ngan gnyis med kun tu bzang po'i klong*/ /sku gsum dgongs pa'i ye shes mngon gyur te/ /phyam gcig gdod ma'i gzhi la sangs rgyas shog / ces pa'ang chos sde 'di'i rnal 'byor g.yar dam du 'chang ba karma ye shes mthar phyin gyis ngor 'gro 'dul pad rgyal gling pa bde chen rdo rje rtsal gyis shar mar sbyar ba siddhi rastu// // ༄༅/ / rdor sems tshogs bsdus ni/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: bla med tshogs kyi mchod pa dam pa 'di: dpag med 'dod yon lha mo'i gar bsgyur bcas: rdo rje sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs kun bskang zhing bshags: dgra bgegs dbyings sgrol gzugs phung zhal du bstab: lhag gtor dgyes bzhes rnam bzhi'i phrin las sgrubs: ma hā ga ṇa tsakra bā liṃ ta pū dza khā hi: utstshiṣṭa bā liṃ ta khā hi: ces pa'ang pad rgyal pas nyer mkho'i dbang gis gter gzhung gi bcud bsdus te sbyar ba dge/ ༈ tshogs 'bum skabs su sngags bsngos tsam gyi grangs bsags dgos tshe lha gang yin gyi rtsa sngags mthar 'bul sngags kho na'o/ /de'i tshul/ oṃ badzra sa twa āḥ sa pa ri wā ra bhyaḥ ma hā ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi: zhes brgya re'i mtshams tshogs bsdus tshar re sbyar ro/ /zhes so sor gzhan la'ang bsgyur ro/ /zhes rā dzas so// //

ྂ/: sku gsum dgongs 'dus las: snang gsal sgron me'i bskang bshags bzhugs: ྂ/: shasd+ya/༁/: rang rig sku gsum dag pa'i 'dud: bzhi ba'i lam gyi ye shes las byed phyir: shin tu dag gtsang snang gsal brgya rtsa sogs: lhag bsam dag pa gang 'byor legs par bshags: rna dag ting 'dzin dag pa'i byin gyis brlab: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: ye shes rang rtsal dag pa'i me rlung chus: rnam rtog mtshan ma'i dri ma dbyings su sbyang : chos dbyings 'od gsal stong pa ngang nyid las: bhrūm̐ las kong bu stong gsum yangs pa ru: hūm̐ las sdong bu dri med ri rab tsam: bam̐ las mar khu mtha' yas mtsho ltar 'khyil: ram̐ las me 'od srid rtse mnar med par: rang bzhin 'od gsal snang ba lam me ba: ngo mtshar rmad byung dag dang ma dag pa'i: zhing khams kun khyab ye shes snang ba ches: khams gsum 'khor ba'i rmongs khams rab bsal te: rang gsal ye shes lnga yi don rtogs gyur: oṃ ma hā badzra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐ swā hā: lan gsum dang : oṃ badzra spha ra ṇa khaṃ: sngags rgyas mkha' khyab dag pa'i 'khor lor spel: snang gsal sgrol me'i bskang bshags dngos gzhi ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: snang srid dag pa rab 'byams don gyi dal: bka' gsang rmad du byung ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir: dngos 'byor gtsang sbyar rdzas kyi sgron me'i mtshon: yid sprul sgron me'i srid zhi'i zhing kun khyab: don dam sgron me'i byang chub sems kyi mdangs: snang gsal sgron me 'bar ba'i dam tshig 'dis: bskang ngo bskal ba'i thugs dam gnyan po bskang : phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i mchog gsum rtsa gsum lha: mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho la sogs pa'i: ji snyed mchod 'os rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang : bskang gyur dbang dang dngos grub ma lus stsol: bshags so rang bzhin sdig ltung ma lus bshags: khyad par theg gsum sgor zhugs bcas pa'i khrims: theg pa rim dgu'i dam tshig nyams chag bshags: rmi lam glog sprin sgyu ma chu zla'i gar:

'gro drug las snang ma rig mun khams sangs: phyi nang gsang gsum dbyer med a ti'i klong : 'khor 'das mnyam nyid rang rig byang chub sems: kun tu bzang po'i klong du mnyam brdal pas: khams gsum 'khor ba dong nas sprugs pa dang : ye shes lnga yi rang rtsal rab rdzogs nas: sku lnga lhun 'grub 'bras bu myur thob shog: 'aḥ.aḥshaḥsaḥmaḥhaḥm ma ko liṃ sa mānta: ma hā su khā siddhi pha la a la la hoḥ a a āḥ 'od gsal dag mnyam chen po'i dgongs nyams bskyang : de yis nyams chag rtog sgrib dbyings su dag: mchog gsang a ti'i gnad gsang snang ba bzhi'i: nyam len drod tshad ma lus mthar phyin nas: nang dbyings gzhon nu bum skur byang chub thob: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gu hya: brda thim: ྂ/: sku gsum dgongs 'dus las: snang gsal smon lam ye shes gsang rdzogs zhes bya ba: ྂ/: gagmā/: e ma hoḥ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas rnams dang : dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kyi spyan lam du: rgyu rkyen rnam dag mchod pa'i phyag rgya che: snang gsal mar me 'di phul bsod nams kyis: 'dir tshogs mched lcam pha mas gtsor byas pa'i: khams gsum rigs drug sems can ma lus pa: ma rig mun pa'i smag 'thug drung 'byin te: rang rig dag pa ye shes 'od lnga'i klong : sa bcu lam lnga mig 'phrul ltar bgrod nas: rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa la rab tu gnas: sangs rgyas mdzad pa'i sprin chen rol mo yis: khams gsum 'khor ba dong nas sprugs gyur cig: de ma gyur gyi tshe rabs thams cad du: dal 'byor rten thob gsang sngags chos dang 'phrad: phyi nang bskyed rdzogs dam tshig rnam par dag: sa dang lam gyi yon tan rab rdzogs nas: kun tu bzang po'i go 'phang myur thob shog: dam gtsang mched lcam rdo rje lu gu brgyud: snang gsal thogs te dkyil 'khor dal la bskor: mi g.yo rig pa'i rtsal gyis rgyas gdab na: sa lam yon tan mig 'phrul ltar bgrod nas:

tshe gcig sangs rgyas sa la the tshom med: tshig chung don che khyad par 'phags pas zab: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gu hya: ྀatsha: ces pa'ang 'gro 'dul pad rgyal gling pa'i sbas yul padma bkod kyi chos sde yang dag pa'o/ /sarba dā maṅga laṃ// // ྂ/: sku gsum dgongs 'dus las: rdo rje sems dpa'i tshe sgrub ye shes bcud len bzhugs so: ྂ/: ༁ཾṭsa/rya/: rdo rje tshe dpag med la dbyer med 'dud: rdo rje tshe yi las la sbyar 'dod na: bcud ldan tshe bum dza gad bcud len rdzas: tshe mda' la sogs rten bcas rtse gcig tu: ting 'dzin ldan pa'i tshe yi rig sngags bzla: gsang ba'i gzhung bsrang dngos gzhi bskyed bzlas ni: rdor sems thugs kar nyi zla'i gwa'u'i dbus: padma tshe dpag med mgon sku mdog dmar: dmar gsal mnyam bzhag tshe bum longs spyod rdzogs: rang 'od yum sbyor thugs kar zla dkyil steng : hrīḥmathar tshe yi rig pa g.yas 'khor las: 'od zer spro bsdus 'khor 'das tshe bcud kun: thugs ka'i hrīḥl 'dus pa'i rdo rje yi: srog mchog dam pa mngon du gyur bar bsam: oṃ badzra sa twa āḥ hrīḥbadzra ā yu ṣe hūm̐ bhrūm̐ nṛ dzaḥswā hā: 'bru 'bum bzlas pas rdo rje srog thob gyur: sa ma ya: skabs su rdo rje'i tshe mchog bskul ba ni: hrīḥ tshe dang ye shes dpag med bcom ldan 'das: rang byung rdo rje sems dpa' tshe dpag med: gdan gsum zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor dbyings nas bzhengs: tshe yi pho nya lha mo mgyogs ma'i tshogs: nyi rdul lta bur dpag med rab 'phros pas: snang srid 'khor 'das kun gyi tshe dang bcud: rang bzhin dbyings nas phyag rgya 'od zer dang : yig 'bru phyag mtshan bdud rtsi'i rnam pa ru: khug cig drongs shig ye shes tshe bcud khug: gzhom zhig dang bral 'chi med rdo rje'i sku: 'gags med gsung dang rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs: mngon gyur rtag pa dam pa'i mchog stsol cig: oṃ badzra sa twa āḥ

oṃ tshe bhrūm̐ g.yu bhrūm̐ g.yu tshe bhrūm̐ ā yurdzñā na g.yu tshe bhrūm̐: yang yang bskul zhing dbyings su sba bar bya: hoḥ ma lus 'khor 'das kun gyi tshe dang bcud: 'byung lnga rnam dag yum chen lnga yi mkha': rnam kun mchog ldan dbyings su rgyas gdab pas: mtshan med don gyi rdo rje sems dpar mjal: dharma dhā tu āḥ de ltar bskyed bzlas nus pa lam longs phyir: rdo rje tshe yi dbang mchog bskur 'dod na: slob ma khrus la bgegs phral dbugs dbyung ste: dbang bskur dgongs pa khrol zhing lo rgyus bshad: maṇḍal 'bul zhing gsol ba 'debs pa ni: hoḥ rang byung rdo rje sems dpa' tshe dpag med: dbyer med rdo rje slob dpon brtse bar dgongs: dus min 'chi ba'i 'jigs tshogs kun skyob cing : rdo rje tshe yi dbang mchog dam pa stsol: rgyud sbyang sdom sbyin snod dang ldan par byas: slob ma ltar gsal dbyings nas ye shes bkugs: dbyer med rgyas gdab rdo rje'i tshe 'gugs bskul: tshe bum bdud rtsi gang ba spyi bor bzung : oṃ: 'chi med rdo rje rang bzhin bum pa na: rang byung rdo rje tshe yi lha tshogs bzhugs: skal ldan bu yi lus la dbang bskur bas: mi shigs rdo rje sems dpa'i sku thob shog: rtsa sngags dang : badzra kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: tshe bcud bdud rtsi'i bhandha mgrin par bzhag: āḥ rang bzhin rnam dag dbyings kyi bhandha ru: 'chi med byang sems dza gad bcud kyi gtams: skal ldan slob ma'i mgrin par bskur ba yi: 'gags med rdo rje sems dpa'i gsung thob shog: badzra wākka a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ tshe ril snying khar bzhag cing jur mid chug: hūm̐: snod bcud rnam dag 'khor 'das kun gyi bcud: ye shes snying po srog tu dril ba'i dbang : skal ldan slob ma'i sems la bskur ba yi: rang byung rdo rje sems dpa'i srog thob shog: badzra tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: dbyings su rgyas gdab shis pa rgya cher spel:

dam tshig khas blangs gtang rag maṇḍal 'bul: rjes kyi rim pa sgrub thabs gzhung ltar bya: de yis gnas skabs tshe yi bgegs sel cing : mthar thus 'chi med gnyug ma'i srog grub bo: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gu hya: ྀatsha: ༄༅/ /sku dgongs rdor sems padma gsang thig gi tshe dbang zur rgyan rdo rje'i phreng mdzes zhes bya ba bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti/ sku dgongs rdor sems padma gsang thig gi tshe sgrub ye shes bcud len dang 'brel ba'i tshe dbang ji ltar bskur ba'i tshul ni/ gter gzhung las/ bcud ldan bum pa dza gad bcud len rdzas: tshe mda' la sogs rten bcas rtse gcig tu: ting 'dzin ldan pa'i tshe yi rigs sngags bzla: zhes rdor sems dkyil 'khor gzhung bzhin zhal phyes pas mdun ngos sogs gang bder maṇḍal tshom bu gcig pa'i khar dbus su tshe bum bcud ldan gyi g.yas g.yon du tshe chang dang tshe ril tshe rdzas phab gta' can dang*/ rgyab sogs gang bder mda' dar sogs bkod la/ gzhung gi bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi bzlas pa sgrub mtshams gzungs thag bsdu la/ phaṭ dzaḥ sa ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor logs su phyes te tshe yi dkyil 'khor du 'jug par bsam la/ rdor sems thugs kar sogs nas 'gyur bar bsam/ 'bru drug tshe sham can bzla la mda' dar bcas tshe 'gugs ni/ hrīḥ tshe dang ye shes sogs nas g.yu tshe bhrūm̐: bar lan gsum bskul/ tshe rgyas gdab pa ni/ hoḥ ma lus sogs nas dhā tu āḥ zhes dang thun mtshams mchod bstod nas bdag 'jug bsdus pa yongs rdzogs las byang ltar btang*/ srung ma'i gtor bsngos dang*/ bskang bshags rgyas bsdus gang grub kyi tshogs mchod byin brlabs nas tshogs tha ma'i bar btang*/ bdag 'jug rgyas pa ma grub na bsdus pa gong du song ba'i mthus/ dbang dngos la gter gzhung las/ slob ma khrus la bgegs phral dbugs dbyung ste: dbang bskur dgongs pa khrol zhing lo rgyus bshad: maṇḍal 'bul zhing gsol ba 'debs pa ni/

zhes slob ma bos la sgo drung nas khrus dang nang du 'khod par me tog bkyes la bgegs gtor/ rang nyid skad cig gis rdo rje he ru ka'i skur gsal/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis bsang sbyangs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ sa byin brlab/ sarba bhū ta a karṣa ya dzaḥ sa mgron bkug /sarba bhighnān ba liṃ ta khā hi/ lan gsum gyi gtor ma bsngos/ las byang ltar bka' bsgo dang srung 'khor gyi tshig brjod la dmigs pa gsal gdab/ mtshams sbyor gyi khyad par/ de la 'dir zab gsang bla ma thugs kyi sgrub pa sku gsum dgongs pa 'dus pa'i chos sde chen po'i cha lag gsang chen dkyil 'khor rab 'byams kyi sprul gzhi rigs bdag bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' padma gsang ba'i thig le'i dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba'i 'chi med tshe yi dbang bskur ba yin te/ gter gzhung las/ de yis gnas skabs tshe yi bgegs sel cing : mthar thug 'chi med gnyug ma'i srog grub bo: ces dpal gyi gur nas bsngags pa don dang ldan zhing zab pa'i mthar thug de'i dbang bskur ba la dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i dbang bskur ba gnyis las/ dang po bdag nyid kyi bgyi bar 'os pa rnams sngon du legs par grub te slob ma khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du zhing khams dbul/ zhes maṇḍal phul bcug /bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo rdo rje sems dpa' tshe dpag med tha mi dad par gsol ba btab pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ hoḥ rang byung rdo rje sogs nas dam pa stsol: lan gsum dang*/ gter gzhung las/ rgyud sbyang sdom sbyin snod dang ldan par byas: slob ma lhar gsal dbyings nas ye shes bkug: dbyer med rgyas gdab rdo rje'i tshe 'gugs bskul: zhes bla ma dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo skyabs gnas rgya mtsho'i ngo bo bzhugs pa'i drung du thal sbyar snyim pa me tog gis brgyan te byang chub snying po'i bar du mkha' khyab sems can gyi don du skyabs su 'gro zhing sems bskyed pa

'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ na moḥ phyogs bcu'i sogs nas skyabs su mchi: lan gsum dang*/ hoḥ ji ltar sogs nas rtag tu bskyed: lan gsum phyag 'tshal ba sogs tshogs bsags yan lag brgyad kyi tshig don gsal thob la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hoḥ rang rig sogs nas byang chub shog: zhes dang*/ khyed rang rnams kyi rgyud sdom ldan du bya ba'i slad du 'di'i rjes zlos gsum mdzod/ sgyu 'phrul rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di: so sor thar pa'i sdom pa dang : byang chub sems dpa'i bslab bya dang : rig 'dzin sngags kyi dam tshig rnams: deng nas bdag gis brtan por bzung : zhes dang*/ dbang gi gzhi 'god pa ye shes pa dbab pa'i don du khyed rnams kyi sgo gsum gyi gnad drag tu gcun la dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ da slob ma khyed rang rnams skad cig gis bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum gyi skur gsal ba'i thugs kar nyi zla'i gwa'u kha sbyor gyi dbus su ye shes sems dpa' padma tshe dpag med sku mdog dmar po phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag gi steng na 'chi med tshe yi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa 'dzin cing rang 'od kyi yum dang sbyor ba/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i chas kyi rgyan par gsal ba'i thugs ka'i sa bon mar me ltar 'bar zhing gsal ba'i 'od kyis bskul ba'i/ bla ma dkyil 'khor ba'i lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs ka nas sku dang yig 'bru phyag mtshan gyi rnam pa grangs med pa 'od zer gyi phung por 'bar zhing 'phro ba kha char dang bu yug 'tshubs pa bzhin du byung ba khyed rang rnams kyi ba spu'i khung bu nas zhugs lus kyi nang kun dang khyad par snying ga'i ting 'dzin sems dpa' la sib sib thim pas bde ba'i ye shes bzod med du 'bar bar sgoms shig / spos rol bcas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru badzra sa twa a yu ṣe dhe wa ḍākki nī dzñā na a be sha ya a āḥ pra be sha ya pra be sha ya: sa ma ya phaiṃ phaiṃ:

sa ma ya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes ye shes pa khyed rang rnams kyi rgyud la byang chub ma thob kyi bar du rab tu brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ tiṣṭha badzra me tog dor/ gnyis pa tshe dbang dngos gzhi'i don du maṇḍal phul/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hoḥ skye rga na 'chi sgyu ma'i grong khyer nas: srog gi chu bur 'jigs pa skyabs kyi mchog: bcom ldan rdo rje sems dpa' tshe dpag med: bdag la 'chi med tshe yi dbang bskur stsol: lan gsum/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis bskul bas dbang lha gdan gsum tshang ba'i dkyil 'khor nam mkha' gang ba'i lha tshogs sprul pa'i lha mo mgyogs ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi rdo rje tshe 'gugs pa'i phrin las mdzad par mos la/ hrīḥ tshe dang ye shes sogs nas g.yu tshe bhrūm̐: lan gsum dang*/ tshe bum thogs la/ oṃ: 'chi med rdo rje sogs nas a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: bum pa spyi bor bzhag cing bum chu myang*/ tshe chang thogs la/ āḥ rang bzhin rnam dag sogs nas a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ tshe thod mgrin par bzhag cing bdud rtsi myang*/ tshe ril thogs la/ hūm̐: snod bcud rnam dag

sogs nas a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: tshe ril snying khar bzhag cing za bcug /gzhung las/ dbyings su rgyas gdab shis pa rgya cher spel: zhes tshe mda' spyi bor rgya gram gyi tshul du bkod la/ hoḥ ma lus 'khor 'das sogs nas dharma dhā tu āḥ rnyed dka'i snying po dal 'byor thob dus 'dir/ /bsam pa'i don la bar chad mi 'byung zhing*/ /gnas skabs kun tu phan bde rgyas rgyur cing*/ /tshe dang chos sbyor rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog / me tog 'thor/ de ltar tshe dbang zab mo legs par thob pa'i bka' drin gtang rag tu zhing khams 'bul/ spyi dang bye brag gi bsdus pa'i dam tshig gi rim pa khas len pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bo'i ji ltar sogs/ longs spyod dbul ba 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ deng nas brtsams ste sogs/ de ltar gsan pa las byung ba'i dge tshogs byang chub yongs bsngos kyi rgyas 'debs lhan cig tu gnang bar zhu/ bsod nams 'di'i sogs/ slob ma rnams dkyes/ slob dpon gyi tshogs la rol zhing phrin las dkyus bzhin mthar dbyung bas grub bo/ /ces pa'ang skal ldan chos 'di'i bdag po bla ma rnal 'byor pa dang zhal slob karma ye shes rnam pa gnyis kyi thugs dam nyams bzhes 'jug pa bde ba'i dbang du byas te 'gro 'dul pad rgyas gling pas rang gnas 'brug bkra shis sgang 'jam mkhar mchod rten dgon par rab byung bcu bdun pa me yos zla tshes la sbyar bas rtsa ba'i yi ge pā ni karma dzñā nas zhus pa a yu ṣe siddhi rastu// // /: sku gsung dgongs 'dus las: gsang sgrub rdo rje sems dpa'i sgo nas gnas 'dren lcags kyu rnon po zhes bya ba bzhugs so: ྂ/: sa/ga/rṭhā/྅/hya//: rigs 'dus rdo rje sems la phyag 'tshal lo: skyabs bral mgon med pha rol song ba yi: bar do'i 'gro ba rjes su 'dzin pa'i thabs: thugs rje'i lcags kyu rnon po gsal bar ston: sa ma ya: sbyor ba dngos dang rjes kyi rim par bstan:

dang por dal bsham rten bskyed rnam shes dgug: gshed dang kha phral khrus phyag dug sbyong ngo : dang po dal bshom rigs drug sa bon bkod: zhal zas mar me chang bu drug phrag re: ming byang gzugs brnyan snying khar nṛḥyig mtshan: so'am rus bu yang na gson dus kyi: rgyan gos rnying pa dri ldan bag chags rten: dar gyi gdugs dang phye mar zas sna'i rigs: gtsang mar bsags pa dkyil 'khor lho sgor bkod: gnyis pa dmigs rten ming byang sbyang byas la: hūm̐: ming byang mi dmigs stong pa'i ngang nyid las: nṛḥlas dmigs yul gson po'i gnas skabs ltar: khams dang skye mched rdzogs shing thal mo sbyar: dad cing gus pas bla ma dkon mchog la: mchod rdzas me tog pad dkar 'dzin par bskyed: gsum pa bden stobs rnam shes bkug pa ni: kye maḥ ma yengs nyon cig tshe 'das rigs kyi bu: 'khor 'das chos rnams ma lus rkyen yin te: so so'i 'dun pa'i rtse la rab tu gnas: de phyir 'dun pa bsgyur ba rab tu gces: dkyil 'khor 'di ni 'og min zhing khams dngos: gnas pa'i dal 'di rigs drug gnas ris dngos: nga ni dus gsum sangs rgyas pho nya yin: 'dren pa thub chen drug po dngos su bzhugs: dar sna'i 'phan chung 'di ni lus kyi rten: ming bris byang bu 'di ni ngag gi rten: snang gsal sgron me 'di ni yid kyi rten: rus bu dri ma 'di ni bag chags rten: kha zas bzang rgu 'di rnams gnyen gyi zas: brtse gdung byams pas 'bod pa'i gnas 'di ru: bsam pa tsam gyis stong gsum 'khor nus pa'i: lus med stong gzugs bar do'i rnam shes khyod: las kyi dbang gis rigs drug gar 'khyams kyang : mchog gsum bden pas skad cig 'dir shog la: ma yengs rtse gcig yid kyis gnas par gyis: thabs mkhas thugs rje'i cho ga mdzad pa 'di: rgyal ba'i phrin las yin pa'i dga' chen sgom: nṛ a karṣa ya dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ bden stobs brdar zhing yang yang 'gug cing bstim:

bzhi pa gshed phral lan chags bsngo ba ni: hūm̐: lan chags gtor ma 'dod yon rgya mtsho 'di: gnyis 'dzin 'khor ba'i rtsa ba ngar 'dzin bdud: skye nas shi ba'i bar du mnyam par 'ong : gson du srog bcad gshin dus bla yid la: bdag tu bzung nas thar lam bgegs byed dang : gzhan yang thog med dus nas 'brel ba yi: lan chags mgron rigs ma lus tshims par bsngo: rigs drug 'khor ba'i lan chags kun byang nas: thar pa'i lam la bar du ma gcod par: so so rang rang gnas su bde bar 'dengs : gal te bka' la ma nyan bgegs byed tshe: rdo rje khro rgyal khros pa'i ting 'dzin gyis: lus sems skad cig gzhom par gdon mi za: drag sngags thun brab mi phyed srung 'khor sgoms: oṃ badzra rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐: dzwa la raṃ raṃ: dharma rakṣa dzñā na āḥ lnga pa gzungs bum chu yis dag par 'khru: hūm̐: bcom ldan rigs 'dus rdo rje sems dpa' dang : rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i byin rlabs chus: dmigs yul thog drangs sems can thams cad kyi: sgrib pa rnam bzhi byang zhing dag gyur cig: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐: oṃ badzra sa twa sa ma ya: sogs nas sa twa āḥhūm̐ phaṭḥ 'aḥ.aḥshaḥsaḥmaḥhaḥ aḥtriḥnṛḥsuḥpreḥdu: sarba pā paṃ dha ha na shuddhe shuddhe bhi shuddhe shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: lan grangs brgya dang rtsa brgyad bzlas byas nas: mtshams med lnga byang rigs drug 'khor ba stong : drug pa rma bya'i mdongs gyi byab pa ni: hūm̐: 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug nga rgyal dang : phrag dog the tshom rnam drug 'jig rten dug: dkon mchog gsum la ye nas dug mi mnga': mchog gsum bden pas gtan nas dag gyur cig: rten la byab cing khrus sngags gang mang bzla: hūm̐: sa chu me rlung nam mkha' 'byung ba lnga: 'jig rten dug gi pha dang ma yin te: yum lnga'i mkha' la ye nas dug mi mnga': rang bzhin med pa'i dbyings su dag gyur cig:

khrus sngags sham du 'byung lnga'i sbyong sngags ni: oṃ laṃ ho shuddhe shuddhe swā hā: baṃ ho shuddhe? raṃ ho shuddhe? yaṃ ho shuddhe? e ho shuddhe shuddhe swā hā: a a swā hā: rdzas rnams dor la dmigs med ngang du bzhag: rang dang gzhan gyi kun rdzob bden pa'i dug: don dam mnyam bzhag skad cig cha la 'dag: sa ma ya: de nas dngos gzhi rigs drug gnas 'dren la: tshogs bsags gnas spar dbang gis rjes su 'dzin: dang po tshogs bsags zhal zas byin gyis brlabs: oṃ āḥhūm̐: ji ltar sems can 'khrul snang tha dad par: sangs rgyas rnams kyi gang la gang 'dul ba'i: sprul sku thub drug rgyal ba sras bcas la: dmigs yul thog drangs mkha' mnyam sems can rnams: gus pas phyag 'tshal snying nas skyabs su mchi: zhal zas ro brgya'i dpal 'dzin la sogs pa'i: dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod: tadya thā: oṃ mu ne mu ne ma hā mu ne dreṃ truṃ druṃ breṃ sruṃ ye swā hā: badzra nai wī dye āḥhūm̐: rgyud drug 'khor ba'i bag chags las nyon sdig: ma lus snying nas 'gyod bshags sdom par bgyi: bsod nams dge tshogs kun la rjes yi rang : ji snyed phyogs bcu'i skyabs yul ma lus la: bskul zhing gsol 'debs dge ba byang chub bsngo: hoḥ 'jigs rung bar do'i 'phrang dang ya nga'i gnas: 'jigs sngangs tsha grang bkres skom blun rmongs dang : skye rga na 'chi 'thab rtsod 'pho ltung sogs: rigs drug so so'i sdug bsngal las sgrol te: bde chen thar pa'i lam la drongs du gsol: gnyis pa rigs drug gnas nas spar ba ni: ming byang dmyal ba'i dal nas yas rim spar: dmigs yul lus kyi gnas drug spyi bor dang : mgrin pa snying kha lte ba gsang ba'i gnas: rkang mthil drug tu rigs drug sa bon drug: aḥtriḥnṛḥsuḥpreḥduḥso so'i steng : sbyong byed yi ge 'bru gsum 'od 'bar sgoms: dang po dmyal ba'i gnas nas drangs pa ni:

kye maḥ ma yengs nyon cig dmigs yul rigs kyi bu: sa 'di bcad pa man chad dmyal ba'i gnas: tsha grang btso bsreg sdug bsngal brjod las 'das: skye ba'i rgyu ni nyon mongs zhe sdang ste: gnong ngo 'gyod do gnas ngan de spongs la: sa 'di bcad pa yan chad dag pa'i zhing : mngon dga'i zhing du 'dong phyir yar gshegs la: chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la skyabs su mchi: dmyal khams gnas nas myur du drongs du gsol: me chu'i rdzas kyi phan dbang bskur bar bya: hūm̐: nyon mongs zhe sdang sdug bsngal las sgrol phyir: bsil drod gang 'dod ye shes me chu'i dbang : dmigs yul rigs kyi bu la bskur ba yis: gnas der phyir mi ldog pa'i sa thob shog: nirmā kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: phyag mtshan rkang mthil bzhag la sa bon sbyang : hūm̐: bdag nyid rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs ka nas: hūm̐ las 'od 'phros 'byung ba'i yi ge bskul: me rlung chu yis rkang mthil duḥnag sbyang : zhe sdang dmyal ba'i skye sgo chod par shog: ram̐ spha ra ṇa phaṭḥ yam̐ spha ra ṇa phaṭḥ kham̐ spha ra ṇa phaṭḥ duḥd ha da ha sarba na raka ka ga te he tun hūm̐ phaṭḥ zhe sdang gi las dang tsha grang gi sdug bsngal thams cad pra be sha ya phaṭḥ byang sems chu yis bag chags lhag med sbyang : oṃ: bkra shis dri med bum pa bzang po nas: me long ye shes chu yis legs khrus pa'i: dmigs yul thog drangs sems can thams cad kyi: nyon mongs zhe sdang dri ma dag gyur cig: yig brgya khrus bdun sngags kyis yang dag bkru: zhe sdang gi las dang tsha grang gi sdug bsngal thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: gnyis pa yi dwags gnas nas drangs pa ni: kye maḥ ma yengs nyon cig dmigs yul rigs kyi bu: sa 'di bcad pa man chad yi dwags gnas: shin tu bkres skom sdug bsngal brjod las 'das: skye ba'i rgyu ni nyon mongs ser sna ste: gnong ngau 'gyod do gnas ngan de spongs la: sa 'di bcad pa yan chad dag pa'i zhing :

bde chen zhing du 'dong phyir yar gshegs la: bcom ldan kha 'bar zhabs la skyabs su mchi: yi dwags gnas nas myur du drongs du gsol: rin chen sgrom bu'i phan dbang bskur bar bya: hūm̐: nyon mongs ser sna'i sdug bsngal las sgrol phyir: dgos 'dod kun 'byung rin chen sgrom bu'i dbang : dmigs yul rigs kyi bu la bskur ba yis: gnas der phyir mi ldog pa'i sa thob shog: nirmā kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: phyag mtshan gsang bar bzhag la sa bon sbyang : hūm̐: bdag nyid rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs ka nas: hūm̐ las 'od 'phros 'byung ba'i yi ge bskul: me rlung chu yis gsang gnas preḥdamar sbyangs: pre ta ka yi skye sgo chod par shog: ram̐ spha ra ṇa phaṭḥ yam̐ spha ra ṇa phaṭḥ kham̐ spha ra ṇa phaṭḥ preḥpa tsa pa tsa sarba pre ta ka ga te he tun hūm̐ phaṭḥ ser sna'i las dang bkres skom gyi sdug bsngal thams cad sarba pra be sha ya phaṭḥ byang sems chu yis bag chags lhag med sbyang : oṃ: bkra shis dri med bum pa bzang po nas: sor rtogs ye shes chu yis legs khrus pa'i: dmigs yul thog drangs sems can thams cad kyi: nyon mongs ser sna'i dri ma dag gyur cig: yig brgya khrus bdun sngags bcas yang dag bkru: ser sna'i las dang bkres skom gi sdug bsngal thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: gsum pa dud 'gro'i gnas nas drangs pa ni: kye maḥ ma yengs nyon cig dmigs yul rigs kyi bu: sa 'di bcad pa man chad dud 'gro'i gnas: blun rmongs bskol spyod sdug bsngal brjod las 'das: skye ba'i rgyu ni nyon mongs gti mug ste: gnong ngau 'gyod do gnas ngan de spongs la: sa 'di bcad pa yan chad dag pa'i zhing : stug po bkod du 'dong phyir yar gshegs la: bcom ldan seṅge'i zhabs la skyabs su mchi: dud 'gro'i gnas nas myur du drongs du gsol: dam chos po ti'i phan dbang bskur bar bya: hūm̐: nyon mongs gti mug sdug bsngal las sgrol phyir:

chos nyid rnam dag dam chos po ti'i dbang : dmigs yul rigs kyi bu la bskur ba yis: gnas der phyir mi ldog pa'i sa thob shog: nirmā kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: phyag mtshan lte bar bzhag la sa bon sbyang : hūm̐: bdag nyid rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs ka nas: hūm̐ las 'od 'phros 'byung ba'i yi ge bskul: me rlung chu yis lte ba'i suḥljang sbyangs: tirya ka yi skye sgo chod par shog: ram̐ spha ra ṇa phaṭḥ yam̐ spha ra ṇa phaṭḥ kham̐ spha ra ṇa phaṭḥ suḥm tha ma tha sarba tirya ka ga te he tun hūm̐ phaṭḥ gti mug gi las dang bskol spyod kyi sdug bsngal thams cad sarba pra be sha ya phaṭḥ byang sems chu yis bag chags lhag med sbyangs: hūm̐: bkra shis dri med bum pa bzang po nas: chos dbyings ye shes chu yis legs khrus pa'i: dmigs yul thog drangs sems can thams cad kyi: nyon mongs gti mug dri ma dag gyur cig: yig brgya khrus bdun sngags bcas yang dag bkru: gti mug gi las dang bskol spyod kyi sdug bsngal thams cad sarba shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: bzhi pa mi yi gnas nas drangs pa ni: kye maḥ ma yengs nyon cig dmigs yul rigs kyi bu: sa 'di bcad pa man chad mi yi gnas: skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal brjod las 'das: skye ba'i rgyu ni nyon mongs 'dod chags te: gnong ngo 'gyod do gnas ngan de spongs la: sa 'di bcad pa yan chad dag pa'i zhing : bde chen zhing du 'dong phyir yar gshegs la: bcom ldan thub dbang zhabs la skyabs su mchi: mi yi gnas nas myur du drongs du gsol: lhung bzed bzang po'i phan dbang bskur bar bya: hūm̐: nyon mongs 'dod chags sdug bsngal las sgrol phyir: drang srong skrogs shing 'dod 'byung spar bu'i dbang : dmigs yul rigs kyi bu la bskur ba yis: gnas der phyir mi ldog pa'i sa thob shog: nirmā kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: phyag mtshan snying khar bzhag la sa bon sbyang : hūm̐:

bdag nyid rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs ka nas: hūm̐ las 'od 'phros 'byung ba'i yi ge bskul: me rlung chu yis snying kha'i nṛḥsngon sbyangs: gling bzhi mi yi skye sgo chod parashog: ram̐ spha ra ṇa phaṭḥ yam̐ spha ra ṇa phaṭḥ kham̐ spha ra ṇa phaṭḥ nṛḥtshindha tshindha sarba a wā ra na nṛ hūm̐ phaṭḥ dug lnga'i las dang skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal thams cad sarba pra be sha ya phaṭḥ byang sems chu yis bag chags lhag med sbyangs: hūm̐: bkra shis dri med bum pa bzang po nas: ye shes lnga ldan chu yi legs khrus pas: dmigs yul thog drangs sems can thams cad kyi: nyon mongs dug lnga'i dri ma dag gyur cig: yig brgya khrus bdun sngags kyis yang dag bkru: dug lnga'i las dang skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal thams cad sarba shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: lnga pa lha min gnas nas drangs pa ni: kye maḥ ma yengs nyon cig dmigs yul rigs kyi bu: sa 'di bcad pa man chad lha min gnas: phan tshun 'thab rtsod sdug bsngal brjod las 'das: skye ba'i rgyu ni nyon mongs phrag dog ste: gnong ngau 'gyod do gnas ris de spongs la: sa 'di bcad pa yan chad dag pa'i zhing : las rab bkod par 'dong phyir yar gshegs la: bcom ldan thag bzang ris la skyabs su mchi: lha min gnas nas myur du drongs du gsol:

sgo mtshon bzang po'i phan dbang bskur bar bya: hūm̐: nyon mongs phrag dog sdug bsngal las sgrol phyir: phyogs las rnam rgyal sgo mtshon bzang po'i dbang : dmigs yul rigs kyi bu la bskur ba yis: gnas der phyir mi ldog pa'i sa thob shog: nirmā kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: phyag mtshan mgrin par bzhag la sa bon sbyangs : hūm̐: bdag nyid rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs ka nas: hūm̐ las 'od 'phros 'byung ba'i yi ge bskul: me rlung chu yis lkog ma'i triḥser sbyangs: phrag dog lha min skye sgo chod par shog: ram̐ spha ra ṇa phaṭḥ yam̐ spha ra ṇa phaṭḥ kham̐ spha ra ṇa phaṭḥ triḥsarba du la sarba karma pra be sha ya phaṭ phaṭḥ phrag dog gi las dang 'thab rtsod kyi sdug bsngal thams cad sarba pra be sha ya phaṭḥ byang sems chu yis bag chags lhag med sbyangs: hūm̐: bkra shis dri med bum pa bzang po nas: bya grub ye shes chu yis legs khrus pa'i: dmigs yul thog drangs sems can thams cad kyi: nyon mongs phrag dog dri ma dag gyur cig: yig brgya khrus bdun sngags bcas yang dag bkru: phrag dog gi las dang 'thab rtsod kyi sdug bsngal thams cad sarba shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: drug pa lha yi gnas nas drangs pa ni: kye maḥ ma yengs nyon cig dmigs yul rigs kyi bu: sa 'di bcad pa man chad lha yi gnas: 'phen byed dge 'bras rdzogs nas ngan song du: 'chi 'pho ltung ba'i sdug bsngal brjod las 'das: skye ba'i rgyu ni nyon mongs nga rgyal te: gnong ngo 'gyod do 'khor ba'i gnas ris spongs: sa 'di bcad pa yan chad dag pa'i zhing : dpal ldan zhing du 'dong phyir yar gshegs la: lha dbang brgya byin zhabs la skyabs su mchi: lha yi gnas nas myur du drongs du gsol: pi waṃ bzang po'i phan dbang bskur bar bya: hūm̐: nyon mongs nga rgyal rnam smin las sgrol phyir: 'pho ltung dgra bcom pi waṃ snyan pa'i dbang : dmigs yul rigs kyi bu la bskur ba yis:

gnas der phyir mi ldog pa'i sa thob shog: nirmā kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: phyag mtshan spyi bor bzhag la sa bon sbyangs : hūm̐: bdag nyid rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs ka nas: hūm̐ las 'od 'phros 'byung ba'i yi ge bskul: me rlung chu yis dpral ba'i aḥdakar sbyangs: 'pho ltung lha yi skye sgo chod par shog: ram̐ spha ra ṇa phaṭḥ yam̐ spha ra ṇa phaṭḥ kham̐ spha ra ṇa phaṭḥ aḥsarba ta thā ga ta buddha ṣiñtsa tshindha tshindha hūm̐ phaṭḥ nga rgyal gyi las dang 'pho ltung gi sdug bsngal thams cad sarba pra be sha ya phaṭḥ byang sems chu yis bag chags lhag med sbyangs: hūm̐: bkra shis dri med bum pa bzang po nas: mnyam nyid ye shes chu yis legs khrus pas: dmigs yul thog drangs sems can thams cad kyi: nyon mongs nga rgyal dri ma dag gyur cig: yig brgya khrus bdun sngags bcas yang dag bkru: nga rgyal gyi las dang 'pho ltung gi sdug bsngal thams cad sarba shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: rigs drug dal bsdu 'khor ba'i bag chags sangs: zhen pa'i 'phrang chod bar do rang ngo 'phrod: sa ma ya: gsum pa dbang gi rjes su 'dzin pa ni: thun mong snod la bum pa'i dbang bskur dang : thun min snod ldan dbang bzhi rdzogs par bskur: gsang sngags dbang la rag las gnad du gces: dbang ma thob la dngos grub skal ba med: rjes kyi rim par ngo sprod 'dod yon bsngo: lam bstan gnas spar ming byang sbyang ba'o: dang por bar do ngo sprod gdams pa ni: kye maḥ mi rtag sgyu ma lus kyi grong khyer nas: las dbang rdzogs te pha rol song ba yi: lus med stong gzugs bar do'i rnam shes khyod: 'khor 'das snang min mtshams nas tshur gson cig: nga ni bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' ste: khyod kyi bsu ma lam ston mkhan po yin: yang dag nges pa'i lung 'di legs par nyon: chos nyid bden pa'i tshig mchog bla na med: 'od gsal rdzogs chen lam zhugs skyes bu la: bde gshegs snying pos khyab pa'i sems can dang :

'bras bu mngon du gyur pa'i sangs rgyas gnyis: ye nas gnyis med bzang ngan rdul tsam med: chos nyid don la skye 'chi mi mnga' yang : kun rdzob sgyu ma'i g.yar khang rgya ral ba: tha snyad ming tsam shi ba tsam du zad: 'on kyang dge sdig rgyu 'bras mi bslu bas: gdul bya thun mong pa yi snang ngo ru: dag pa lha sngags chos nyid rang sgra sogs: rang las byung te mngon sum snang ba dang : ma dag gshin rje'i pho nya sha tshugs can: 'jigs rung 'phrang dang ya nga'i gnas la sogs: dge sdig gzugs brnyan ji ltar shar na yang : rmi lam sad rmis rang snang 'khrul pa las: gzhan du bden grub med par ngo shes tshe: de yi ngang bzhag skad cig rdzogs sangs rgyas: ji ltar chu bor bying ba'i ko ba bzhin: rkyen gyis bsgyur sla yang dag 'dun pa bsgyur: thogs med rdzu 'phrul yid kyi mngon shes ldan: grogs la nges med shi gson ci yang 'grogs: gnas la nges med bsam pas stong gsum 'khor: nyi zla'i snang ba rkang rjes grib ma med: ltog 'khyag skom pa'i snang ba 'ba' zhig 'char: tshe tshad nges med rigs mthun bar do'i 'gror: zas ni bsngos thob me gsur dri yis tshim: rang nyid shi'am ma shi the tshom za: shi bar thag chod thabs bral snang ba skyo: las rlung mthu btsan bya sgro rlung khyer 'dra: ma yengs rtse gcig gsol ba 'debs pa gnad: bslu med bla ma dkon mchog gsum gyi mthu: rnam gsum dad pa'i yul na rab tu snang : dbang thob bla ma yi dam lha sngags dang : dag pa'i zhing khams yid la 'bral med kyis: khyod kyi pha ma nye du nga yin zhes: smre sngags lhang lhang 'bod pa'i sgra la sogs: byang chub lam la bar du gcod byed pa'i: ma dag rigs drug 'khor ba'i chos rnams la: snying po khab kyi rtse tsam ma mchis pa'i: ma chags ma zhen ha la'i dug ltar spongs: dbang bskur mchog thob lha dang bskal pa mnyam: brtse gdung byams pa'i pha ma nye 'brel gyis: bza' btung sna tshogs 'dod yon tshogs su bsham:

bden pa'i tshig gis yang dag dkrol te bsngo: zas gtad 'di ni shin tu dga' ba'i longs: gnyis pa bza' btung 'dod yon bsngo ba ni: hūm̐: yid mthun rin chen sna tshogs snod yangs par: zag med 'dod yon nam mkha' gang ba 'di: bla ma rdor sems zhi khro rab 'byams lha: phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i skyabs yul rgya mtsho la: phul bas skyabs bral bar do'i 'gro ba rnams: 'byor ldan ting 'dzin zas kyis 'tsho bar shog: oṃ gu ru badzra sa twa sarba ta thā ga ta bhyaḥ badzra ma hā sarba pū dzaḥme gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐: phud kyis dkon mchog mchod cing de'i lhag ma: srid pa bar ma do yi mgron la bsngo: oṃ: ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgya rnam dag mthus: gtan pa med pa'i gzugs mchog rgya mtsho'i sprin: rdo rje sems dpa'i gnas thob khyod la 'bul: gzugs phung gti mug ma spangs rang grol nas: chos dbyings ye shes mchog la mnga' brnyes shog: oṃ badzra rū pa āḥhūm̐: trām̐ḥ ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgya rnam dag mthus: gtan pa med pa'i sgra mchog rgya mtsho'i sprin: rdo rje sems dpa'i gnas thob khyod la 'bul: tshor phung nga rgyal ma spangs rang grol nas: mnyam nyid ye shes mchog la mnga' brnyes shog: oṃ badzra shabda āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgya rnam dag mthus: gtan pa med pa'i dri mchog rgya mtsho'i sprin: rdo rje sems dpa'i gnas thob khyod la 'bul: rnam shes zhe sdang ma spangs rang grol nas: me long ye shes mchog la mnga' brnyes shog: oṃ badzra gandhe āḥhūm̐: hrīḥ ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgya rnam dag mthus: gtan pa med pa'i ro mchog rgya mtsho'i sprin: rdo rje sems dpa'i gnas thob khyod la 'bul: 'du shes 'dod chags ma spangs rang grol nas: sor rtogs ye shes mchog la mnga' brnyes shog: oṃ badzra rā sa āḥhūm̐: hā: ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgya rnam dag mthus: gtan pa med pa'i reg mchog rgya mtsho'i sprin:

rdo rje sems dpa'i gnas thob khyod la 'bul: 'du byed phrag dog ma spangs rang grol nas: bya grub ye shes mchog la mnga' brnyes shog: oṃ badzra sparshe āḥhūm̐: gsum pa lam ston sgron me'i 'od bstan la: bhrūm̐: kong bu rnam dag chos dbyings gzhal yas su: snang gsal rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs ka nas: ye shes 'od lngas dug lnga'i sgrib pa bsal: sa bcu lam lnga bgrod bya'i yon tan kun: skad cig mig 'phrul lta bur rdzogs gyur cig: yig brgya bzla zhing ma nor lam mchog ston: kye ma: legs par nyon cig dmigs yul rigs kyi bu: yang dag nges pa'i lam mchog nga yis ston: 'khor ba gang du skyes kyang bde ba med: sdug bsngal rgya mtsho shin tu gting zab la: zhen pa'i 'brel thag chod cig rigs kyi bu: ma yengs ltos shig yang dag don la ltos: nam mkha' lta bur sems nyid mtha' dbus bral: gang yang mthong med smra bsam brjod bral che: mthong ba'i mchog gyur rdo rje sems dpa'i zhal: ma bcos dri med rig stong sa le ba: kun bzang rdo rje sems dpa' 'di ka'o: ma 'gags rtsal dang rang gdangs ye shes lnga: zhi ba longs spyod rdzogs sku'i rang bzhin no: rtsal las ma 'gags rol pa khro bo'i sprin: bar do longs spyod rdzogs sku'i chos nyid do: de tshe ngo shes rtsal rdzogs dus mnyam kyang : gom stobs chung dang las ngan shugs che bas: rang snang dgrar bzung 'khor bar 'khyam srid tshe: dpag med thabs mkhas rgyal ba sras bcas kyis: thugs rje'i gang 'dul sprul pa bsam mi khyab: rigs drug dong sprugs thub pa rigs drug sogs: 'dren pa'i bla ma thugs rje can rnams la: gsol btab dran pas skye ba sprul pa'i skur: byang chub rim thob ma brjed dran pas zungs: hūm̐: 'di nas shar phyogs rnam par dag pa yi: zhing mchog mngon par dga' ba zhes bya ba: ngo mtshar bkod pa bsam mi khyab pa na: ston pa rdo rje sems dpa' zhes bya bas:

rigs kyi 'khor tshogs grangs las 'das pa la: rtag pa rgyun gyi 'khor lor chos ston to: bu khyod sangs rgyas de yi mtshan zungs la: thogs med rig pa rtsal gyis 'gro bar gyis: 'di nas shar gyi phyogs kyi nam mkha' la: ltos shig seṅge'i 'gying stabs gyis la ltos: mchongs shig stag mo'i mchongs stabs gyis la mchongs: song zhig rtsal chen mda' 'phang bzhin du song : rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs kyi klong du gshegs: rnam shes hūm̐ dkar po rnam par spyi bor nas: rgyang gyis thon te mngon dgar gshegs par bsam: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ a a a: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: rgyal ba'i sras gyur 'gro khams ma stong par: sprul pa'i 'gro don rgyun chad med pa yis: ngan song gsum sogs sdug bsngal gyis mnar ba'i: ma gyur 'gro ba yongs kyi dpal du shog: bzhi pa rnam shes gshegs pa'i ming byang nyid: sgrib pa lhag med sbyong phyir me yis sbyangs: hūm̐: bcom ldan rdo rje sems dpa'i ye shes mes: dmigs yul phung khams sgrib bzhi bud shing la: khams gsum 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal rgya mtsho'i gting : ye shes snang ba chen pos skem gyur cig: oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrī āḥ oṃ badzra sa twa āḥ 'aḥ.aḥshaḥsaḥmaḥhaḥ ma ma ko liṃ sa mānta: a a a: yig brgya bzla zhing 'khor gsum dag par sbyangs: byang thal sātstsha gdab pas chos sku las: gzugs sku'i rten 'brel bsgrigs shing dge ba bsngo: sems can shi gson khyad med skra sen dang : rwa dang rus pa gang la'ang brten byas te: na raka dong sprugs rdo rje sems dpa' che'i: lha sngags phyag rgya'i las la sus sbyor ba: mtshams med las bsags sems can sdig chen yang : na raka dong nas sprugs par the tshom med: de phyir skal ldan rnams kyis nyams su longs: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gu hya: brda thim: ྀatsha: ces pa'ang sbas yul padma bkod kyi gter byon rtsa ba'i chos kyi bdag po bsod nams 'brug stobs mtshan can gyi chos sde yongs rdzogs gtan 'bebs nan bskul ngor 'gro 'dul pad rgyal gling pas mon kha seng rdzong gnas mchog tu gtan la phab pa'o/

/dge legs 'phel// // ༄༅/ /sku dgongs nang sgrub rdor sems padma gsang thig gi gnas 'dren zur 'debs mthong ba don gsal bzhugs so// bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ / srid pa bar do'i 'gro ba rjes su 'dzin pa'i cho ga gnas 'dren gter gzhung la cung zad zhal skong gi rim par thog mar ming byang ni dug med kyi rgya shog sogs la pho mo rgan gzhon gang yin gyi gzugs thal sbyar pus btsug me tog 'dzin pa'i snying khar nṛḥdang rgyab tu/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma mchog gsum rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams dang bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /'jig rten 'di nas tshe pha rol tu song ba cha3lt;!TCC Tibetan character 3,148 undefined in unicode!>ཻ mo'i thog med kyi sdig pa sbyang du gsol/ dbang bskur du gsol/ lam bstan du gsol/ myur du bla na med pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che thob par mdzad du gsol/ zhes bris pa skyes pa mda' dang bud med 'phang la brgyan te bag chags kyi rten rus bu'am rgyan gos rnying pa bcas pas steng du gdugs/ zur g.yas g.yon du phan chung re/ 'og tu gdan/ mdun du mar me dang me long*/ g.yas su bza' ba'i rigs/ g.yon du btung ba'i rigs bcas bsham/ gnas 'dren gyi gzhi'i dbyibs nar mo kheb ldan gyi rgyab sogs nas thub drug tsakli bsgreng bar gral stabs su bsham/ de'i mdun du rigs drug sa bon gan rkyal du bsham/ de yang aḥtriḥnṛḥ gsum po mgo gyen bstan/ saḥ 'phred bstan/ preḥduḥ thur bstan ste gral stabs su bsham/ de'i mdun du zhal zas drug de'i mdun du chang bu drug rnams kyang bkod/ 'og tu mkho ba'i zhi sbyong la padma gsum dang mtheb kyu gsum drag por mar me drug bcas snod gcig tu bsham/ 'byung bzhi'i rdzas kyang snod gcig tu bsham/

khrus bum/ gul yungs/ khrus dar dang me long*/ thub drug gi phyag mtshan tsakli/ sātstsha'i brkos phor bcas gang bder bsags/ thog mar thos grol nas byung ba'i ra mda' bran pa'i smon lam mam ltung bshags gang rung sngon du 'gro ba'i/ rten bskyed ni/ ming byang mi dmigs sogs nas 'dzin par bskyed/ / bden brdar ni/ na mo/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos nyid gdod nas stongs kyang chos can rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bden pa dang*/ ngan 'gro thams cad yongs su sbyong ba dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i mthus/ 'jig rten 'di nas tshe pha rol tu song ba cha3lt;!TCC Tibetan character 3,148 undefined in unicode!>ཻ mo'i rnam par shes pa khams gsum rig drug lam rgyud lnga/ skye gnas rnam pa bzhis bsdus pa'i sa gnas skad cig yud tsam la dmigs pa'i rten 'dir mchis par gyur cig /nṛ yam̐ dzaḥ nṛ badzra a karṣa ya dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho
