sa rnam shes a dkar po'i rnam par rten dang gnyis su med par gyur/ sarba pā paṃ a pa na ya hūm̐: gis sdig sgrib bkug /kyai maḥ ma g.yeng nyin cig sogs nas baṃ ho/ sbyang gtor rnams las chus bran la/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis bsang sbyang*/ bhrūm̐ las gtor gzhong ratna'i gzhal yas su: oṃ las gtor ma 'dod yon phung por gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho sa byin gyis brlabs/ sarba bhū ta a karṣa ya dzaḥ lan gsum gyi gshin lcags kyi bgegs bkug la/ rten la padma dang mtheb kyu drug po re re bzhin g.yas su bskor la rigs drug gi lan chags sbyang ba ni/ sarba bhighnān na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhyoḥ sogs nas ba liṃ ta ye swā hā: lan drug gi bsngos/ pad mtheb rnams re re bzhin snod dang por bsnan/ hūm̐: lan chags gtor ma sogs nas bde bar dengs: oṃ sumbha ni sngags kyis chang bu drug po gong bzhin bsngos la/ gong bzhin bden brdar sngon du 'gro ba'i/ na mo/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos nyid gdod nas stongs kyang chos can rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bden pa dang*/ ngan 'gro thams cad yongs su sbyong ba dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i mthus/ 'jig rten 'di nas tshe pha rol tu song ba cha3lt;!TCC Tibetan character 3,148 undefined in unicode!>ཻ mo gson gyi dus su tshe srog la bar du gcod cing gshin gyi dus su sdig pa sbyong ba la bar du gcod pa'i gshed ma bgegs kyi rigs gang dag ji snyed yod pa de dag thams cad gtor ma 'dis tshim par gyis la dpag tshad dang rgyang grags su mi gnas pa gzhan du songs shig / sngar bzhin/ hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags brjod cing lan gsum mthar/ gal te bka' la mi nyan sogs nas gdon mi za: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: bi shwa kro ta dzwa la maṇḍa la phaṭ phaṭḥ ha la ha la hūm̐ phaṭḥ

ces drag tu brjod cing gdug brab kyi rdzas bcas bskrad do/ /oṃ badzra rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐: rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi rgya bcas/ steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad rdo rje khro bo'i tshogs kyi gtam par bsam/ dzwa la ram̐ ram̐ zhes rdo rje me'i rgya bcas/ steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad bskal pa'i me dpung chen pos bcings pas gshed mas nam yang mi mthong bar bsam/ dharma rakṣa rakṣa dzñā na āḥ rdo rje chos kyi rgya bcas mtshan ma med pa'i dbyings su rgyas gdab bo/ /khrus ni/ rdor sems sngags kyi sgrub pa'i gzungs chu'i 'khru ba yin pas lha khrus mi dgos shing*/ dmigs rten ming byang me long la gzugs brnyan 'char bar bkru ba ni/ bsdu na gter gzhung gi tshig kho nas 'thus shing cung zad spro na/ phar phyin drug dang sbyar te/ hūm̐/ 'di ni sbyin pa'i rang bzhin chu/ /ser sna'i dri ma sbyong ba'i phyir/ /sbyin pa chu yis legs khrus pa'i/ /ser sna'i dri ma dag gyur cig / khrus sngags brjod/ de bzhin 'og ma rnams la 'gres sbyar te/ hūm̐/ 'di ni tshul khrims rang bzhin chu/ /'chal ba'i dri ma sbyong ba'i phyir/ /tshul khrims chu yi legs khrus pa'i/ khrims 'chal dri ma dag gyur cig / khrus sngags/ 'di ni bzod pa'i rang bzhin chu/ khong khro'i dri ma sbyong ba'i phyir/ /bzod pa chu yi legs khrus pa'i/ khong khro'i dri ma dag gyur cig khrus sngags/ 'di ni brtson 'grus rang bzhin chu/ /le lo'i dri ma sbyong ba'i phyir/ /brtson 'grus chu yi legs khrus pa'i/ /le lo'i dri ma dag gyur cig / khrus sngags/ 'di ni bsam gtan rang bzhin chu/ /rnam g.yeng dri ma sbyong ba'i phyir/ /bsam gtan chu yis legs bkrus pas/ /rnam g.yeng dri ma dag gyur cig / khrus sngags/ 'di ni shes rab rang bzhin chu/ /shes 'chal dri ma sbyong ba'i phyir/ /shes rab chu yi legs bkrus pa'i/ /shes 'chal dri ma dag gyur cig

/ so sor khrus sngags bcas dang*/ hūm̐: bcom ldan rigs 'dus sogs nas swā hā: lan grangs gsum nas bdun sogs gang mang bcas bkru/ rten la byab pa ni/ rma bya'i mdongs bcas/ hūm̐: 'dod chags zhe sdang sogs nas yang yang bzla/ dug dbyung ni/ hūm̐: sa 'di 'jig rten dug gi pha yin te: sa 'di 'jig rten dug gi ma yang yin: spyan ma'i mkha' la ye nas dug mi mnga': rang bzhin med pa'i dbyings su dag gyur cig: khrus sngags dang : oṃ lam̐ ho shuddhe shuddhe ye swā hā: hūm̐: chu 'di 'jig rten dug gi pha yin te: chu 'di 'jig rten dug gi ma yang yin: mā ki'i mkha' la ye nas dug mi mnga': rang bzhin med pa'i dbyings su dag gyur cig: khrus sngags dang*/ oṃ bam̐ ho shuddhe shuddhe ye swā hā: hūm̐: me 'di 'jig rten dug gi pha yin te: me 'di 'jig rten dug gi ma yang yin: gos dkar mkha' la ye nas dug mi mnga': rang bzhin med pa'i dbyings su dag gyur cig: khrus sngags dang*/ oṃ ram̐ ho shuddhe shuddhe ye swā hā: hūm̐: rlung 'di 'jig rten dug gi pha yin te: rlung 'di 'jig rten dug gi ma yang yin: sgrol ma'i mkha' la ye nas dug mi mnga': rang bzhin med pa'i dbyings su dag gyur cig oṃ yam̐ ho shuddhe shuddhe ye swā hā: hūm̐: nam mkha' 'jig rten dug gi pha yin te: nam mkha' 'jig rten dug gi ma yang yin: dbyings phyug mkha' la ye nas dug mi mnga': rang bzhin med pa'i dbyings su dag gyur cig: oṃ e ho shuddhe shuddhe a a swā hā: 'byung ba dang 'byung ba las byung ba'i dug thams cad rang bzhin gyi rnam par dag pa yum chen lnga'i mkha' dbyings su dag par gyur cig: thub drug gi zhal zas 'bru gsum byin rlabs sngon du 'gro ba'i/ hūm̐: ji ltar sems can sogs nas rgya mtshos mchod: tadya thāḥ oṃ mu ni sogs nas āḥhūm̐: sngags lan drug gis mchod la/ zhal zas rnams yar gzhi khar phul/

rgyud drug 'khor ba'i sogs nas drongs du gsol: zhes mjug gi tshig rkang lnga po lan gsum brjod la phyag 'tshal/ 'og gi rigs drug so so'i gnas 'dren gyi khrus bum skabs su/ byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin dag byed ye shes kyi chus gang ba'i bum pa bzang po'i khrus byed pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces pa tsam gyi mtshams sbyar la gter gzhung ltar gnas 'dren gyi rim pa grub nas dbang gi rjes su 'dzin pa ni/ rgyas pa ni bdag 'jug ltar dbang lnga dang dbang bzhi rdzogs par bskur/ bsdu na/ sa gzhi spos chu'i sogs maṇḍal 'bul/ oṃ tsakṣu bhandha wa ra ma ṇa ye swā hā: mig dar 'ching*/ ā khaṃ wī ra hūm̐ gis me tog bzung nas/ thal mo sbyar nas btud de/ bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /slob dpon la ni skyabs su mchi/ /bla ma dpal ldan rdo rje sems/ /sgyu 'phrul rnam par rol pa ni/ /lha rnams la yang phyag 'tshal lo/ /mi gnas bde chen grong mchog tu/ /slob dpon khyed kyis bdag gzhugs gsol/ / ces lan gsum gyi gsol ba gdab/ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal/ sogs rgyun bshags yan lag brgyad pas tshogs bsags zhing rgyud sbyang*/ sgyu 'phrul rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir: so sor thar pa'i sdom pa dang : byang chub sems dpa'i bslab bya dang : rig 'dzin sngags kyi dam tshig rnams: deng nas bdag gis brtan por bzung : zhes sdom pa bzung*/ snying gar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du don dam byang chub sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje ser po rtse lnga pa'i gzugs su gnas par bsam zhing*/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsitta utpā da ya mi: lan gsum/ snying gar rdo rje reg la/ bho dhi tsitta sa ma ya satwaṃ: zhes gsang sngags nang gi sems bskyed/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ bhrūm̐ pra be sha ya phaṭḥ ces dkyil 'khor gyi sgo phyes pa'i nang du zhugs par mos pas/ oṃ na ma ste hūm̐:

oṃ na ma mi hūm̐: oṃ na mo na ma hūm̐: zhes phyag bya/ gnyis pa nang 'jug la/ sbyor ba dam la bzhag pa ni/ rdo rje mgor bzhag ste/ hoḥ rab tu bskal pa bzang po'i bu khyed kyi: gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor dam pa 'dir zhugs na: dngos grub nye bar thob pa'i skal ldan kyang : snod med gzhan du smras na de ltar min/ badzra gu hya sa ma ya hoḥ rdo rje spyi bor bzhag te dam tshig bsgrags: hoḥ sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes rdo rje sems: 'di ni khyed kyi snying dbus yang dag zhugs: rlung phyogs tsam gyi gsang bsgrags nyams par gyur: de bas shin tu gsang chen thub par gyis: badzra sa twa dzñā na sa ma ya hūm̐: rdo rje snying khar bzhag la dam tshig bsgrags: badzra a mṛ ta u da ka sa ma ya hoḥ zhes mna' chu sbyin la/ badzra sa ma ya rakṣantu: rdo rje spyi bor bzhag la nan gyis bsgrags: dngos gzhir ye shes dbab pa ni/ skad cig gis khyed rang bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum gyi skur gsal ba'i thugs ka'i sa bon mar me ltar 'bar zhing gsal ba'i 'od kyis bskul bas/ bla ma dkyil 'khor ba'i lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs ka nas sku dang yig 'bru phyag mtshan gyi rnam pa grangs med pa 'od zer gyi phung po 'bar zhing 'phros pa kha char bu yug 'tshubs pa bzhin du byung ba ba spu'i khung bu nas zhugs lus kyi nang kun dang khyad par snying ga'i ting 'dzin sems dpa' la sib sib pas bde ba'i ye shes bzod med du 'bar bar bsam zhing*/ spos rol bcas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru badzra sa twa dhe wa ḍākki nī dzñā na a be sha ya āḥ pra be sha ya: pra be sha ya: sa ma ya phaiṃ phaiṃ: sa ma ya: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes ye shes pa dbab la/ tiṣṭha badzra sa brtan par bya/ oṃ puṣpe ghṛ ha na hoḥ sa me tog dkyil 'khor du dor/ pra ti ghṛ ha na siddhi hūm̐: zhes lha de spyi bor stim/ badzra dzñā na tsakṣu pra be sha ya phaṭḥ zhes gdong g.yog bsal la/

rang rig bla ma rdo rje sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rten dang brten par bcas pa mngon sum du mthong ba'i mos pa mdzod/ maṇḍal phul la bum dbang dngos ni/ dmigs yul dkyil 'khor chen po'i shar sgo'i khyams la glang po che'i khri pad zla'i gdan la gtso bo'i gzugs kyi rnam pas 'khod par gyur/ slob dpon bla ma rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ 'og min gyi zhing nas dbang lha de bzhin gshegs pa rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad gdan gsum tshang ba'i dbang gi lha tshogs kyi rnam par badzra sa mā dzaḥ sa spyan drangs la/ oṃ badzra puṣpe sogs nas shabda'i bar gyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas gdan gsum tshang ba'i dbang lha rdo rje rgyal po de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ sems dpa' sems ma rnams kyis me tog 'thor zhing shis pa brjod/ kiṅka ra rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ bum 'dzin rig pa'i lha mo rnams kyis rnam rgyal bum pa'i bdud rtsis rgyal thabs spyi blugs su mngon par dbang bskur bar mos la/ oṃ: ye shes sku mchog bum pa'i gzhal yas nas: ye shes lnga ldan bdud rtsi gtor blug dbang : skal ldan bu yi lus la bskur ba yi: lus snang gdos bcas lha skur smin par shog: rtsa sngags dang*/ badzra kā la sha kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: zhes bum chu dmigs yul gyis btung ba'i snod du gtig /bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis lus kyi nad thams cad gang*/ bde ba chen po'i ye shes nyams su myong*/ chu'i lhag ma spyi bor 'khyil ba las rigs thams cad 'dus pa'i spyi gzugs rgyal ba kun tu bzang pos dbu rgyan/ spyan drangs pa'i dbang lha rnams kyang khyed rang la dbyer med du thim par mos la/ oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swā hā/ zhes me tog 'thor/ de ltar na phyi kun rdzob mtshan ma rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor du bum pa'i dbang thob/

phung khams snod bcud tha mal du zhen pa'i rtog tshogs sbyangs te lus kyi sgrib pa dag /lam dus su bskyed pa'i rim pa sgom pa la dbang*/ snod bcud bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' zhi khro sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i dkyil 'khor gcig tu rdzogs nas/ 'bras bu sku rdo rje mchog gi sprul sku 'grub pa'i skal pa can du gyur pa la 'dod yon lnga yi mchod par mos/ zhes za btung gi tshogs la bran te/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis bsang sbyang*/ rnam pa 'dod yon gyi longs spyod la ngo bo ye shes kyi bdud rtsi zad mi shes pa nam mkha' mdzod kyi sprin chen por gyur bar bsams la/ kye maḥ mi rtags sgyu ma sogs nas dga' ba'i longs: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho sa lan gsum dang*/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas byin rlabs/ hūm̐: yid mthun rin chen sna tshogs sogs nas sa ma ye aḥhūm̐: bla ma dang dkyil 'khor pa'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnam la 'dod yon gyi phud phul ba la brten nas dmigs yul sogs sems can thams cad kyi tshogs gnyis rdzogs/ sgrib gnyis sbyang*/ myur du sangs rgyas kyis go 'phang rin po che thob par mdzad du gsol/ zhes lhag ma bar de'i mgron la bsngo ba ni 'dod yon lnga'i tshogs 'khor me hom du bsreg la/ oṃ: ting 'dzin sngags dang sogs nas pra she āḥhūm̐: smon lam ni/ 'di ni sbyin pa'i rang bzhin zas/ /ser sna'i dri ma rnam par dag /zas mchog 'di la longs spyod nas/ /sbyin pa'i zas kyis 'tsho bar shog /'di ni tshul khrims rang bzhin zas/ khrims 'chal dri ma rnam par dag /zas mchog 'di la longs spyod nas/ /tshul khrims zas kyis 'tsho bar shog /'di ni bzod pa'i rang bzhin zas/ khong khro'i dri ma rnam par dag /zas mchog 'di la longs spyod nas/ /bzod pa'i zas kyis 'tsho bar shog /'di ni brtson 'grus rang bzhin zas/ /le lo'i dri ma rnam par dag /zas mchog 'di la longs spyod nas/ /brtson 'grus zas kyi 'tsho bar shog

/'di ni bsam gtan rang bzhin zas/ /rnam g.yeng dri ma rnam par dag /zas mchog 'di la longs spyod nas/ /bsam gtan zas kyi 'tsho bar shog /'di ni shes rab rang bzhin zas/ /shes 'chal dri ma rnam par dag /zas mchog 'di la longs spyod nas/ /shes rab zas kyi 'tsho bar shog / zhes dang*/ sbyin pa rnam par dag pa/ tshul khrims rnam par dag pa/ bzod pa rnam par dag pa/ brtson 'grus rnam par dag pa/ bsam gtan rnam par dag pa/ shes rab rnam par dag pa ste pha rol tu phyin pa drug rnam par dag pa'i sgo nas bsngos pas 'dod yon gyi rnam pa mig gi yul du gzugs/ rna ba'i yul du sgra/ sna yi yul du dri/ lce'i yul du ro/ lus kyi yul du reg bya/ yid kyi yul du chos/ gzhan yang*/ za ba ri rab/ btung ba rgya mtsho/ na bza' lho sprin tsam la ma chags ma zhen pa'i sgo nas longs spyod kyi skal ba dang ldan pa'i 'dod yon bzang po 'di khyer la bde chen dag pa gtan gyi pho brang du songs shig / zhes dang*/ kaṃ ka ni sngags brjod/ lam bstan sgron mer chab bran la/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las kong bu bhrūm̐ las gzhal yas khang du sdong bu hūm̐ las rdo rje sems dpa' zhi khro sgyu 'phrul drwa bas spyi gzugs chen por gsal ba'i 'od kyis dmigs yul gyi sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa sangs sangs dag ste bgrod bya sa lam gyi yon tan ma lus pa skad cig mig 'khrul ltar stan thog cig tu bgrod par

bsam la/ yig brgya bdun nam nyer gcig brjod la/ bhrūm̐: kong bu rnam dag chos dbyings sogs nas mtha' dbyung bas grub bo/ /zhar la skabs 'gar rus chog mdor bsdus bya bar 'dod na mi dang dud 'gro'i rigs gang yin shi ba'i rus bu dang*/ gson po'i so dang skra sen bsreg pa'i thal ba la'ang rung ste/ dar ras dkar po dri med kyi khug mar blugs pa ko ṭo ra'i snod du mañdzis btegs la rdor sems kyis bsgrubs pa'i gzungs chus rgyun ma chad par khrus la/ dmigs rten gyi nam mkha' zla ba la gnas pa'i hūm̐ yig dkar po'i mthar bzlas bya'i gzungs sngags rang sgra dang bcas te g.yas su 'khor ba las 'od zer dang ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun dpag tu med pa byung bas dmigs yul de nyid gtso bor byas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib thams cad ba mo nyi mas bcom pa ltar sangs kyi dag ste byang chub mchog gi go 'phang la bkod par bsam la/ yig brgya'i sham du/ dmigs yul gyi sdig sgrib thams cad sarba shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ brgya rtsa nas 'bum gyi bar bzlas te thun nam zhag grangs rdzogs nas/ zla gdan la sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa 'od du zhu nas gnyis su med par bsam/ de ltar khrus pa'i khu ba chu bor sbyang*/ slar yang rus bu zhib par 'thag ste sa byin dang bsres te yig brgya dang rten snying bzla bzhin par gzungs chus bkrus te sātstsha gcig gsum lnga gang rung btab te na bza' sku dkar gsol te rab gnas byas nas dben pa'i gnas su bskyal lo/ /rus chog dang tsha chog yang rgyas par spro na zur du shes/ zhes pa'ang rtsa ba'i chos bdag puṇyai'i mtshan can gyi bzhed skong du dmigs te ka ma la rā dza dī pas 'brug shar phyogs gnas chen dgon skor gyi gtsug lag khang du sbyar ba siddhi rastu// // ༄༅/ /sku gsum dgongs 'dus las/ nang sgrub rdor sems gnas 'dren bsdus pa thar lam myur 'byin zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

rab 'byams zhi khro'i sprul gzhi mchog /sgyu 'phrul gtso bo bcom ldan 'das/ /bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' la/ /sgo gsum gus pas rab tu 'dud/ /skyabs bral bar do'i 'gro ba rnams/ /myur du rjes su 'dzin pa'i thabs/ /rigs drug gnas nas thar lam mchog /myur du 'byin pa'i cho ga bstan/ / de la 'dir sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po sbyor ba mtshan byang dang bca' bshom rnams gter gzhung dang gnas zur du bshad pa ltar las/ dngos gzhi rten bskyed pa/ rnam shes 'gugs pa/ gshed dang phral ba/ sdig sgrib sbyong ba/ tshogs bsags pa/ gsol ba 'debs pa/ rigs drug gi gnas nas 'dren pa/ dbang bskur ba/ 'dod yon bsngo ba dang dgu las/ dang po rten bskyed ni/ hūm̐: ming byang mi dmigs stong pa'i ngang nyid las: nṛḥlas dmigs yul gson po'i gnas skabs ltar: khams dang skye mched rdzogs shing thal mo sbyar: dad cing gus pas bla ma dkon mchog la: mchod rdzas me tog pad dkar 'dzin par bskyed: gnyis pa rnam shes 'gugs pa ni/ na mo/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos nyid gdod nas stongs kyang chos can rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bden pa dang*/ ngan 'gro thams cad yongs su sbyong ba dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i mthus/ 'jig rten 'di nas tshe pha rol tu song ba cha3lt;!TCC Tibetan character 3,148 undefined in unicode!>ཻ mo'i rnam par shes pa khams gsum rigs drug lam rgyud lnga/ skye gnas rnam pa bzhis bsdus pa'i sa gnas skad cig yud tsam la dmigs pa'i rten 'dir mchis par gyur cig /nṛḥyam̐ dzaḥ nṛḥbadzra a karṣa ya dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho sa rnam shes a dkar po'i rnam par rten dang gnyis su med par gyur/ sarba pā paṃ a pa ṇa ya hūm̐: gis sdig sgrib bkug /kye maḥ ma yengs nyon cig tshe 'das rigs kyi bu:

lus med stong gzugs bar do'i rnam shes khyod: las kyi dbang gis rigs drug gar 'khyams kyang : mchog gsum bden pas skad cig 'dir shog la: ma yengs rtse gcig yid kyi gnas par gyis: gsum pa gshed dang phral ba ni/ sbyong gtor rnams chus bran la/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis bsang sbyang*/ bhrūm̐ las gtor gzhong ratna'i gzhal yas su: oṃ las gtor ma 'dod yon phung por gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ sa byin gyis brlabs/ sarba bhu ta a karṣa ya dzaḥ lan gsum gyi gshin lcags kyi bgegs bgug la/ rten la padma dang mtheb kyu drug po re re bzhin g.yas su bskor la rigs drug gi lan chags sbyang ba ni/ sarba bhighnān na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhyoḥ sogs nas ba liṃ ta ye swā hā: lan drug gi bsngos/ pad mtheb rnams re re bzhin snod dang por bsnan/ hūm̐: lan chags gtor ma 'dod yon rgya mtsho 'dis: rigs drug 'khor ba'i lan chags kun byang nas: thar pa'i lam la bar du ma gcod par: so so rang rang gnas su bde bar dengs: oṃ sumbha ni sngags kyis changs bu drug po gong bzhin bsngos la/ gong bzhin bden brdar sngon du 'gro ba'i/ 'jig rten 'di nas tshe pha rol tu song ba cha3lt;!TCC Tibetan character 3,148 undefined in unicode!>ཻ mo gson gyi dus su tshe srog la bar du gcod cing gshin gyi dus su sdig pa sbyong ba la bar du gcod pa'i gshed ma bgegs kyi rigs gang dag ji snyed yod pa de dag thams cad gtor ma 'dis tshim par bgyis la dpag tshad dang rgyang grags su mi gnas par gzhan du songs shig / sngar bzhin hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags brjod cing lan gsum mthar/ gal te bka' la mi nyan gegs byed tshe: rdo rje khro rgyal khros pa'i ting 'dzin gyis: lus sems skad cig gzhom par gdon mi za: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: bi shwa kro ta dzwa la maṇḍal phaṭ phaṭ ha la ha la: zhes drag tu brjod cing gdug brab kyi rdzas bcas bskrad do/

/oṃ badzra rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐: dzwa la ram̐ ram̐: dharma rakṣa dzñā na āḥ zhes khro bo'i sprin dang me dpung 'bar bas bcings te gshed ma'i nam yang mi mthong bar bsam/ bzhi pa sdig sgrib sbyong ba ni/ khrus bum thogs la/ hūm̐: bcom ldan rigs 'dus rdo rje sems dpa' dang : rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i byin rlabs chus: dmigs yul thog drangs sems can thams cad kyi: sgrib pa rnam bzhi byang zhing dag gyur cig: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐: oṃ badzra sa twa sa ma ya: sogs nas sa twa a hūm̐ phaṭḥ 'aḥ.aḥshaḥsaḥmaḥhaḥ aḥtriḥnṛḥsuḥpreḥduḥsarba pā paṃ dha ha na shuddhe shuddhe shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: dmigs yul gtsor byas pa'i sems can thams cad rigs drug gi las sgrib bag chags thams cad sarba shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: zhes lan gsum sogs bskyal te bkru/ rma bya'i mdong thogs la/ hūm̐: 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug nga rgyal dang : phrag dog the tshom rnam drug 'jig rten dug: dkon mchog gsum la ye nas dug mi mnga': mchog gsum bden pas gtan nas dag gyur cig: rten la byab shing khrus sngags gong bzhin bzla/ 'byung bzhi'i rdzas thogs la/ hūm̐: sa chu me rlung nam mkha' 'byung ba lnga: 'jig rten drug gi pha dang ma yin te: yum lnga'i mkha' la ye nas dug mi mnga' : rang bzhin med pa'i dbyings su dag gyur cig: khrus sngags sham du 'byung lnga'i sbyong sngags ni: oṃ lam̐ ho shuddhe shuddhe swā hā: bam̐ ho shuddhe shuddhe? ram̐ ho shuddhe shuddhe? yam̐ ho shuddhe shuddhe? e ho shuddhe shuddhe swā hā: a a swā hā: 'byung ba dang 'byung ba las byung ba'i dug thams cad rang bzhin gyi rnam par dag pa yum chen lnga'i mkha' dbyings su dag par gyur cig / lnga pa tshogs bsags pa ni/ zhal zas drug / oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs la/ hūm̐: sprul sku thub drug rgyal ba sras bcas la:

gus pas phyag 'tshal snying nas skyabs su mchi: zhal zas ro brgya'i dpal 'dzin la sogs pa'i: dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod: tadya thāḥ oṃ mu ne mu ne ma hā mu ne dreṃ truṃ druṃ breṃ sruṃ ye swā hā: badzra nai wi dye āḥhūm̐: lan drug gis mchod la/ zhal zas rnams yar gzhi khar phul/ drug pa gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ las rdor gyi ming byang thogs te phyag bya la/ hoḥ 'jigs sngangs tsha grang bkres skom blun rmongs dang : skye rga na 'chi 'thab rtsod 'pho ltung sogs: rigs drug so so'i sdug bsngal las sgrol te: bde chen thar pa'i lam la drangs du gsol: lan gsum/ bdun pa rigs drug gi gnas nas 'dren pa la gnyis las/ dang po dmigs pa'i gzhi 'god pa ni/ dmigs yul lus kyi gnas drug spyi bor dang : mgrin pa snying kha lte ba gsang ba'i gnas: rkang mthil drug tu rigs drug sa bon drug: aḥtriḥnṛḥsuḥpreḥduḥso so'i steng : sbyong byed yi ge 'bru gsum 'od 'bar sgom: gnyis pa rigs drug so so'i gnas nas spar ba la bzhi las/ dang po dmyal ba'i gnas spar dngos ni/ zhe sdang dbang gis dmyal bar skyes srid pa'i: gnong ngo 'gyod do gnas can de spongs la: mngon dga'i zhing du 'dong phyir yar gshegs la: chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la skyabs su mchi: tshig rkang rjes ma lan gsum brjod/ ming byang yang rim gyi yar spar/ gnyis pa dbang bskur ba ni/ me chu thogs la/ nyon mongs zhe sdang sdug bsngal las sgrol phyir: bsil drod gang 'dod ye shes me chu'i dbang : dmigs yul rigs kyi bu la bskur ba yis: gnas der phyir mi ldog pa'i sa thob shog: nirmā kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes phyag mtshan rkang mthil bzhag /gsum pa sa bon sbyong ba ni/ rig grol bye ma thogs la/ hūm̐: bdag nyid rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs ka nas: hūm̐ las 'od 'phros 'byung ba'i yi ge bskul:

me rlung chu yis rkang mthil duḥnag sbyang : zhe sdang dmyal ba'i skye sgo chod par shog: ram̐ spha ra ṇa phaṭḥ yam̐ spha ra ṇa phaṭḥ kham̐ spha ra ṇa phaṭḥ duḥd ha da ha sarba na ra ka ga te he tun hūm̐ phaṭḥ zhe sdang gi las dang tsha grang gi sdug bsngal thams cad pra be sha ya phaṭḥ bzhi pa khrus sbyong ni/ khrus bum thogs la/ hūm̐: bkra shis dri med bum pa bzang po nas: me long ye shes chu yis legs khrus pa'i: dmigs yul thog drangs sems can thams cad kyi: nyon mongs zhe sdang dri ma dag gyur cig: yig brgya khrus bdun sngags bcas bkru/ zhe sdang gi las dang tsha grang gi sdug bsngal thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: gnyis pa yi dwags gnas nas drangs pa ni: ser sna'i dbang gis pre tar skye srid pa'i: gnong ngo 'gyod do gnas ngan de spongs la: bde chen zhing du 'dong phyir yar gshegs la: bcom ldan kha 'bar zhabs la skyabs su mchi: gnyis pa dbang bskur ba ni/ sgrom bu thogs la/ hūm̐: nyon mongs ser sna'i sdug bsngal las sgrol phyir: dgos 'dod kun 'byung rin chen sgrom bu'i dbang : dmigs yul rigs kyi bu la bskur ba yis: gnas der phyir mi ldog pa'i sa thob shog: nirmā kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: phyag mtshan gsang bar bzhag /gsum pa sa bon sbyang ba ni/ reg grol bye ma thogs la/ hūm̐: bdag nyid rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs ka nas: hūm̐ las 'od 'phros 'byung ba'i yi ge bskul: me rlung chu yis gsang gnas preḥdamar sbyangs: pre ta ka yi skye sgo chod par shog: ram̐ spha ra ṇa phaṭḥ yam̐ spha ra ṇa phaṭḥ kham̐ spha ra ṇa phaṭḥ pre pa tsa pa tsa sarba pre ta ka ga te he tun hūm̐ phaṭḥ ser sna'i las dang bkres skom gyi sdug bsngal thams cad sarba pra be sha ya phaṭḥ yig brgya khrus bdun sngags bcas bkru/ bzhi pa khrus sbyong ni/ khrus bum thogs la/ hūm̐: bkra shis dri med bum pa bzang po nas: sor rtogs ye shes chu yis legs bkrus pa'i:

dmigs yul thog drangs sems can thams cad kyi: nyon mongs ser sna'i dri ma dag gyur cig: yig brgya khrus bdun sngags bcas bkru/ ser sna'i las dang bkres skom gi sdug bsngal thams cad sarba shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: gsum pa dud 'gro'i gnas spar ni: gti mug dbang gis dud 'gror skyes srid pa'i: gnong ngo 'gyod do gnas ngan de spongs la: stug po bkod du 'dong phyir yar gshegs la: bcom ldan seṅge'i zhabs la skyabs su mchi: gnyis pa dbang bskur ba ni/ po ti'i thogs la/ hūm̐: nyon mongs gti mug sdug bsngal las sgrol phyir: chos nyid rnam dag dam chos po ti'i dbang : dmigs yul rigs kyi bu la bskur ba yis: gnas der phyir mi ldog pa'i sa thob shog: nirmā kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: phyag mtshan lte bar bzhag /gsum pa sa bon sbyong ba ni/ reg grol bye ma thogs la/ hūm̐: bdag nyid rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs ka nas: hūm̐ las 'od 'phros 'byung ba'i yi ge bskul: me rlung chu yis lte ba'i suḥljang sbyangs: tirya ka yi skye sgo chod par shog: ram̐ spha ra ṇa phaṭḥ yam̐ spha ra ṇa phaṭḥ kham̐ spha ra ṇa phaṭḥ suḥm tha ma tha sarba tirya ka ga te he tun hūm̐ phaṭḥ gti mug gi las dang bskol spyod kyi sdug bsngal thams cad sarba pra be sha ya phaṭḥ bzhi pa khrus sbyong ni/ khrus bum thogs la/ hūm̐: bkra shis dri med bum pa bzang po nas: chos dbyings ye shes chu yis legs khrus pa'i: dmigs yul thog drangs sems can thams cad kyi: nyon mongs gti mug dri ma dag gyur cig: yig brgya khrus bdun sngags bcas bkru/ gti mug gi las dang bskol spyod kyi sdug bsngal thams cad sarba shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: gzhi pa mi yi gnas nas spar ba ni: 'dod chags dbang gis mi ru skyes srid pa'i: gnong ngau 'gyod do gnas ngan de spongs la: bde chen zhing du 'dong phyir yar gshegs la: bcom ldan thub dbang zhabs la skyabs su mchi:

gnyis pa dbang bskur ba ni/ lhung bzed thogs la: hūm̐: nyon mongs 'dod chags sdug bsngal las sgrol phyir: drang srong skrogs shing 'dod 'byung spar bu'i dbang : dmigs yul rigs kyi bu la bskur ba yis: gnas der phyir mi ldog pa'i sa thob shog: nirmā kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: phyag mtshan snying kharabazhag /gsum pa sa bon sbyong ba ni/ reg grol bye ma thogs la/ hūm̐: bdag nyid rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs ka nas: hūm̐ las 'od 'phros 'byung ba'i yi ge bskul: me rlung chu yis snying kha'i nṛḥsngon sbyangs: gling bzhi mi yi skye sgo chod parashog: ram̐ spha ra ṇa phaṭḥ yam̐ spha ra ṇa phaṭḥ kham̐ spha ra ṇa phaṭḥ nṛḥtshindha tshindha sarba a wa ra na nṛ hūm̐ phaṭḥ dug lnga'i las dang skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal thams cad sarba pra be sha ya phaṭḥ bzhi pa khrus sbyong ni/ khrus bum thogs la/ hūm̐: bkra shis dri med bum pa bzang po nas: ye shes lnga ldan chu yis legs khrus pa'i: dmigs yul thog drangs sems can thams cad kyi: nyon mongs dug lnga'i dri ma dag gyur cig: yig brgya khrus bdun sngags bcas bkru/ dug lnga'i las dang skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal thams cad sarba shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā:

lnga pa lha min gyi gnas nas spar ba ni/ phrag dog dbang gi lha min skyes srid pa'i: gnong ngau 'gyod do gnas ris de spongs la: las rab bkod par 'dong phyir yar gshegs la: bcom ldan thag bzang ris la skyabs su mchi: gnyis pa dbang bskur ba ni/ sgo mtshon thogs la/ hūm̐: nyon mongs 'dod chags sdug bsngal las sgrol phyir: phyogs las rnam rgyal sgo mtshon bzang po'i dbang : dmigs yul rigs kyi bu la bskur ba yis: gnas der phyir mi ldog pa'i sa thob shog: nirmā kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: phyag mtshan mgrin par bzhag /gsum pa sa bon sbyong ba ni/ reg grol bye ma thogs la/ hūm̐: bdag nyid rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs ka nas: hūm̐ las 'od 'phros 'byung ba'i yi ge bskul: me rlung chu yis lkog ma'i triḥser sbyangs: phrag dog lha min skye sgo chod par shog: ram̐ spha ra ṇa phaṭḥ yam̐ spha ra ṇa phaṭḥ kham̐ spha ra ṇa phaṭḥ triḥsarba du la sarba karma pra be sha ya phaṭḥ phrag dog gi las dang 'thab rtsod kyi sdug bsngal thams cad sarba pra be sha ya phaṭḥ bzhi pa khrus sbyong ni/ khrus bum thogs la/ hūm̐: bkra shis dri med bum pa bzang po nas: bya grub ye shes chu yis legs bkrus pa'i: dmigs yul thog drangs sems can thams cad kyi: nyon mongs phrag dog dri ma dag gyur cig: yig brgya khrus bdun sngags bcas bkru: phrag dog gi las dang 'thab rtsod kyi sdug bsngal thams cad sarba shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: drug pa lha yi gnas nas spar ba ni: nga rgyal dbang gis lha ru skyes srid pa'i: gnong ngo 'gyod do 'khor ba'i gnas ris spongs: dpal ldan zhing du 'dong phyir yar gshegs la: lha dbang brgya byin zhabs la skyabs su mchi: gnyis pa dbang bskur ba ni/ pi waṃ thogs la/ hūm̐: nyon mongs nga rgyal rnam smin las sgrol phyir: 'pho ltung dgra bcom pi waṃ snyan pa'i dbang : dmigs yul rigs kyi bu la bskur ba yis:

gnas der phyir mi ldog pa'i sa thob shog: nirmā kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: phyag mtshan dpral bar bzhag /gsum pa sa bon sbyong ba ni/ reg grol bye ma thogs la/ hūm̐: bdag nyid rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs ka nas: hūm̐ las 'od 'phros 'byung ba'i yi ge bskul: me rlung chu yis dpral ba'i aḥdakar sbyangs: 'pho ltung lha yi skye sgo chod par shog: ram̐ spha ra ṇa phaṭḥ yam̐ spha ra ṇa phaṭḥ kham̐ spha ra ṇa phaṭḥ aḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhuddha ṣiñtsa tshindha tshindha hūm̐ phaṭḥ nga rgyal gyi las dang 'pho ltung gi sdug bsngal thams cad sarba pra be sha ya phaṭḥ bzhi pa khrus sbyong ni/ khrus bum thogs la/ hūm̐: bkra shis dri med bum pa bzang po nas: mnyam nyid ye shes chu yis legs khrus pas: dmigs yul thog drangs sems can thams cad kyi: nyon mongs nga rgyal dri ma dag gyur cig: yig brgya khrus bdun sngags bcas bkru: nga rgyal gyi las dang 'pho ltung gi sdug bsngal thams cad sarba shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: rdzogs pa'i byang chub sgrub pa la/ /phyi dang nang gi 'tshe ba yi/ /bar du gcod pa thams cad kun/ /nye bar zhi ba'i bkra shis shog / brgyad pa bum dbang gi rjes su 'dzin pa ni/ sa bzhi spos chus sogs/ oṃ tsakṣu bhandha wa ra ma ṇa ye swā hā sa mig dar 'ching*/ a kham̐ wī ra hūm̐ gis me tog bzung nas/ thal mo sbyar nas btud de/ bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /slob dpon la ni skyabs su mchi/ /bla ma dpal ldan rdo rje sems/ /sgyu 'phrul rnam par rol pa yi/ /lha rnams la yang phyag 'tshal lo/ /mi gnas bde chen grong mchog tu/ /slob dpon khyed kyis bdag gzhug gsol/ / ces lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal/ / zhes sogs rgyun bshags yan lag brgyad pas tshogs bsags shing rgyud sbyang*/ sgyu 'phrul rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir: so sor thar pa'i sdom pa dang : byang chub sems dpa'i bslab bya dang :

rig 'dzin sngags kyi dam tshig rnams: deng nas bdag gis brtan por bzung : zhes sdom pa bzung*/ sarba yo ga tsitta utpa dā ya mī: lan gsum gyi kun rdzob byang sems dang*/ rdo rje snying gar reg la/ bo dhi tsitta sa ma ya satwaṃ: don dam byang sems bzung*/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ bhrūm̐ pra be sha ya phaṭḥ kyis dkyil 'khor du zhugs/ oṃ na ma ste hūm̐: oṃ na mo mī hūm̐: oṃ na mo na ma hūm̐: zhes phyag bya/ dzra gu hya sa ma ya hoḥ rda ོ rje spyi bor bzhag / badzra sa twa dzñā na sa ma ya hūm̐: rdo rje snying khar bzhag / badzra a mṛ ta u da ka sa ma ya hoḥ mna' chu sbyin la/ badzra sa ma ya rakṣantu: slar rdo rje spyi bor bzhag la dam tshig bsgrags/ migs yul skad cig gis rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum gyi skur gsal ba'i thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa bla ma rdo rje sems dpa'i gsang gsum 'khor lo'i rnam par byon te sib sib thim par bsam/ spos rol bcas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru badzra sa twa dhe wa ḍākki nī dzñā na a be sha ya a āḥ pra be sha yaḥ pra be sha yaḥ sa ma ya phaiṃ phaiṃ: sa ma ya: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes ye shes pa dbab la/ tiṣṭha badzra sa brtan par bya/ oṃ puṣpe ghri ha na hoḥ sa me tog spyi bor bkod/ dkyil 'khor du dor/ pra ti ghṛ ha na siddhi hūm̐: zhes lha de spyi bor bstim/ badzra dzñā na tsakṣu pra be sha ya phaṭḥ zhes gdong g.yog bsal la dkyil 'khor bstan/ maṇḍal phul la bum dbang dngos ni/ rang gi snying kha'i 'od kyis 'og min gyi zhing nas dbang lha de bzhin gshegs pa rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad gdan gsum tshang ba'i dbang gi lha tshogs rnams kyis mngon par bum pa'i dbang bskur bas mos pa mdzod/ oṃ: ye shes sku mchog bum pa'i gzhal yas nas: ye shes lnga ldan bdud rtsi'i gtor blug dbang : skal ldan bu yi lus la bskur ba yis: lus snang gdos bcas lha skur smin par shog:

rtsa sngags dang*/ badzra kā la sha kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: zhes bum chu dmigs yul gyis btung ba'i snod du gtig /bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ bde ba chen po'i ye shes nyams su myong*/ chu'i lhag ma spyi bor 'khyil ba las rigs thams cad 'dus pa'i spyi gzugs rgyal ba kun tu bzang pos dbu rgyan/ spyan drangs pa'i dbang lha rnams kyang khyed rang la dbyer med du thim par mos la/ oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swā hā: zhes me tog 'thor/ dgu pa 'dod yon bsngo ba ni/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis bsangs sbyang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum gyis byin rlabs/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhyoḥbhi shwa sogs nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas spel la/ ho/ zhal zas ro brgya 'dod lnga'i sprin chen 'di/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma zhi khro rab 'byams sogs/ /skyabs gnas rgya mtsho'i tshogs la legs 'bul na/ /bzhes shig bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ mang du bzla/ ho/ thams cad nam mkha' yangs pa'i mdzod bzhin du/ /ji srid bar du 'dzad pa med pa'i gter/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yi longs spyod 'di/ /dmigs yul thog drangs srid pa bar ma dor/ /yid lus skyabs bral 'gro ba yongs la bsngo/ /gnas grogs longs spyod phun sum tshogs thob nas/ /'khrul snang 'jigs skrag sdug bsngal kun zhi zhing*/ /'khrul ba rang snang yin par ngo shes te/ /rang rig rtsal rdzogs nges pa lnga ldan gyi/ /longs spyod rdzogs sku'i zhing du grol bar shog / 'bru gsum gang mang dang*/ kaṃ ka ni 'i gzungs brjod/ gsum pa rjes kyi bya bar 'khor bar ma chags par gdams shing rnam shes spar ba/ ming byang sbyang ba dang gnyis kyi dang po ni/ ho/ ma yengs ma 'khrul nyon cig rigs kyi bu/ /'khor ba'i chos la snying po rdul tsam med/ /don dam snying po rang rig dri med nyid/ /a dkar rnam par chos kyi dbyings su gshegs/

/a phaṭḥ ces mi dmigs pa'i dbyings su mnyam par bzhag la rgyas gdab la/ rgyal ba'i sras gyur 'gro khams ma stongs par: sprul pa'i 'gro don rgyun chad med pa yis: ngan song gsum sogs sdug bsngal gyis mnar ba'i: ma gyur 'gro ba yongs kyi dpal du shog: zhes smon lam gdab/ gnyis pa ming byang sbyong ba ni/ hūm̐: bcom ldan rdo rje sems dpa'i ye shes mes: dmigs yul phung khams sgrib bzhi'i 'bud shing la: khams gsum 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal rgya mtsho'i gting : ye shes snang ba chen pos skem gyur cig: oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrī āḥ oṃ badzra sa twa āḥ 'aḥ.aḥshaḥsaḥmaḥhaḥ ma ma ko liṃ sa manta: a a āḥ zhes mtshan ma med pa'i dbyings su rgyas gdab pas chos sku dang*/ byang thal la sātstsha btab pas gzugs sku'i rten 'brel bsgrig go /'di dang dus gsum dge kun gcig tu mthus/ /skyabs med bar do'i 'gro ba gtsor gyur pa'i/ /mkha' khyab yid can 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /kun bzang rdo rje sems dpa' mchog 'grub shog / ces pa'ang kho bo pad rgyal gling pas gter gzhung gi bcud bsdus te sbyar ba siddhi rastu// // ༄༅/ /rgyas par 'dod yon lnga so sor bsngo bar 'dod na/ me long thogs la/ gzugs mdzes longs spyod 'di ltar dpag med kyang : dngos su 'byor bshams yid sprul gzugs mdzes tshogs: ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlabs te: tshe 'das rigs kyi bu la bsngos pa yis: gzugs mdzes longs spyod dpal du spyod par shog: oṃ badzra rū pa āḥhūm̐: ting shag brdung la/ sgra snyan longs spyod 'di ltar dpag med kyang : dngos su 'byor bshams yid sprul sgra snyan tshogs: ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlabs te: tshe 'das rigs kyi bu la bsngos pa yis: sgra snyan longs spyod dpal du spyod par shog: oṃ badzra shabda āḥhūm̐: spos dang dri chab sogs thogs la/ dri zhim longs spyod 'di ltar dpag med kyang :

dngos su 'byor bshams yid sprul dri zhim tshogs: ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlabs te: tshe 'das rigs kyi bu la bsngos pa yis: dri zhim longs spyod dpal du spyod par shog: oṃ badzra gandhe āḥhūm̐: zas bsngo'i phud thogs la/ ro mchog longs spyod 'di ltar dpag med kyang : dngos su 'byor bshams yid sprul ro mchog tshogs: ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlabs te: tshe 'das rigs kyi bu la bsngos pa yis: ro mchog longs spyod dpal du spyod par shog: oṃ badzra rā sa āḥhūm̐: gos zung thogs la/ reg bya longs spyod 'di ltar dpag med kyang : dngos su 'byor bshams yid sprul reg bya'i tshogs/ ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlabs te: tshe 'das rigs kyi bu la bsngos pa yis: reg bya'i longs spyod dpal du spyod par shog: oṃ badzra sparshe āḥhūm̐: gter gzhung rtsa tshig ni/ 'dod yon longs spyod 'di ltar dpag med kyang : gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya la sogs rdzas: dngos su 'byor bshams yid sprul 'dod yon tshogs: ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlabs te: tshe 'das rigs kyi bu la bsngos pa yis: 'dod yon longs spyod dpal du spyod par shog: oṃ badzra rū pa shabda gandhe rā sa sparshe āḥhūm̐: zhes bsngos pas bdag gir bzung nas dkyil 'khor mchod par bsams la/ dus gsum sangs rgyas sku gsung thugs/ /de bzhin gshegs pas dkyil 'khor du/ /tshe 'das sgo gsum mchod par 'bul/ /tshogs gnyis zung 'jug phrin las kyis/ /bar dor 'khyams pa'i sems can kun/ /thugs rjes lcags kyu'i bzung du gsol/ / zhes sogs brjod de rdzas lhag rnams ngan slong dang bya khyi sogs la ster ram phyogs mtshams su gtor ro/ /bsngo tshig 'di rnams gter gzhung rdo rje'i tshig rkang rnams su khrol med kyang las dang po par 'jug bde ba dang dmigs pa gsal bde ba'i ched du so sor kha khrol rgyud zhal 'phang mchis bzhin lam 'dir g.yar dam du 'cha' ba'i rnal 'byor par grags pa puṇyai ming gi zur byang du bkod pas 'brel thog thar pa'i lam bzang la nye bar dkri ba'i rgyur gyur cig

/sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༄༅/ / gshin po'i me gsur shin tu bsdus pa ni/ rang nyid lha'i rnal 'byor la gnas pa'i/ hūm̐/ bdag nyid yi dam lha gsal thugs ka nas: hūm̐ las 'od 'phros tshe 'das rnam shes de: rigs drug gang na gnas pa'i sa phyogs nas: bdag gi 'od kyis rigs ma thag tu ni: rnam shes nṛ de aḥdakar zhig tu gyur: mdun du bkug nas mtshan byang rten la bstim: nṛ yaṃ dzaḥ nṛ badzra aṅku sha ya dzaḥ lan gsum gyis bkug /dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa rten la bstim/ bza' btung gi tshogs la chab byan la/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis ma dag dri ma sbyang*/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ dang ha ho hrīḥrnams kyis/ /ngo bo ye shes bdud rtsi'i sprin phung la/ /rnam pa bza' btung sna tshogs 'dod rgu'i gter/ /'dzad med nam mkha' mdzod kyi 'khor lor gyur/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhyo bi shwa sogs nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas spel/ ho/ zhal zas ro brgya 'dod lnga'i sprin chen 'di/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma zhi khro rab 'byams sogs/ /skyabs gnas rgya mtsho'i tshogs la legs 'bul na/ /bzhes shing bla med grub mchog bstsal du gsol/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mang du bzla/ ho/ thams cad nam mkha' yangs pa'i mdzod bzhin du/ /ji srid bar du 'dzad pa med pa'i gter/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yi longs spyod 'di/ /dmigs yul thogs drangs srid pa bar ma dor/ /yid lus skyabs bral 'gro ba yongs la bsngo/ /gnas grogs longs spyod phun sum tshogs thob nas/ /'khrul snang 'jigs skrag sdug bsngal kun zhi zhing*/ /'khrul ba rang snang yin par ngo shes te/ /rang rig rtsal rdzogs nges pa lnga ldan gyi/ /longs spyod rdzogs sku'i zhing du grol bar shog / 'bru gsum gang mang dang kaṃ ka ni 'i gzungs brjod/ lam bstan ni/ ho/ ma yengs ma 'khrul nyon cig rigs kyi bu/ /'khor ba'i chos la snying po rdul tsam med/ /don dam snying po rang rig dri med nyid/ /aḥdakar rnam pa chos kyi dbyings su gshegs/

/a phaṭḥ ces mi dmigs pa'i dbyings su mnyam par bzhag la rgyas gdab bo/ /bsngo smon ni/ hūm̐/ rgyal ba'i sras gyur 'gro khams ma stong bar/ /sprul pa'i 'gro don rgyun chad med pa yis/ /ngan song gsum sogs sdug bsngal gyis mnar ba'i/ /ma gyur 'gro ba yongs kyi dpal du shog: gzhan yang theg chen smon lam rgyas bsdus skabs thob gang rigs kyi mtha' brgyan no/ /ces pa'ang kā ma la rā dza dwī pas shar mar sbyar ba don dang ldan par gyur cig/ // ༄༅/ /rdor sems sogs sbyong byed kyi lha gang la'ang sbyar chog pa'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga zla ba'i 'od zer zhes bya ba bzhugs so// bla ma lha dang dbyer med pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor lha la phyag 'tshal zhing*/ /ngan song rgyud na gnas pa yi/ /'gro phan sgrib sbyong snying por 'chad/ / gang du bya ba'i gnas der gzhi bdag la gtor ma byin nas bka' bsgos/ rdo rje dang bcas pa'i lag g.yas pa sa la bzhag ste lha gang yin gyi rtsa sngags brgya rtsa bzlas pas byin gyis brlabs nas stong nyid du rgyas btab/ thab stegs gru bzhi pa ba byung gis byugs pa'i khar/ bri thab la tshangs zur gyi thig btab/ rgyar khru gang*/ mchu dang kha khyer la sor bzhi re/ nang du cha phran gcig pa la rdo rje'i phreng bas bskor ba'i padma 'dab brgyad lte bar rdo rjes mtshan pa/ phyi'i gru bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes spras pa/ kha dog thams cad kun nas dkar por byas pa'i phyir ba byung bdud rtsi lnga dri bzang dang bcas pas byugs/ me tog dkar po bcal du bkram/ tsher ma dang srog chags med pa'i shing dri zhim pa ji ltar rigs pa zlum por brtsig /slob dpon gyi g.yon phyogs thab dang nye bar mchod rdzas dang*/ g.yas su bsreg rdzas rnams mi ring bar nyis rim/ mdun du bsangs chu rdor dril dkar blugs nang mchod rnams bsham/ slob dpon chas gos dkar po dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan/

'jam pa'i stan la kha shar du phyogs pas 'khod de/ cho ga dngos la/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa'i bar sngar bzhin byas nas lha'i nga rgyal la gnas pas rdo rje thabs kyi rang bzhin dang*/ dril bu shes rab kyi rang bzhin/ gnyis ka'ang don dam pa'i byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin du mos la/

oṃ ma hā badzra hūm̐/ zhes lag g.yas kyis rdo rje thugs kar gsor/ oṃ badzra gandhe āḥ zhes lag g.yon gyis dril bu dkrol zhing dkur rten/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā a nu rā ga ṇa badzra swa bhā wa atma ko ྅haṃ/ thugs kar 'khyud rgya bya zhing*/ rdo rje thugs kyi dam tshig /dril bu gsung gi dam tshig /phyag rgya sku'i dam tshig ste/ gong gi rdor dril kha sbyor bas byung ba'i bde ba chen po'i bdag nyid nga'o snyam pas dam tshig gsum dran par byas/ mchod rdzas rnams ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis sbyangs/ bdag gi thugs ka'i ye shes me rlung chus: snod bcud dngos 'dzin dri ma dbyings su sbyangs: gnas yul rnam dag padma drwa ba'i zhing : phyi nang mchod sprin ye shes rol par gyur: oṃ badzra arghaṃ āḥhūm̐: de bzhin du/ pā dyaṃ/ puṣpe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke /gandhe/ nai wi dye/ shabda āḥhūm̐/ sogs kyis byin gyis brlab/ bsreg rdzas rnams bdud rtsis bran la/ rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i phyag rgyas reg la/ oṃ swā hāḥ sa rdzas rnams dkru/ yam shing la/ oṃ āḥswā hā/ zhun mar la oṃ shrī swā hā/ 'bru rnams la/ oṃ dzriṃ swā hā/ rdzas rnams la/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ stong pa'i ngang las rdzas rnams rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa las byung ba'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin sreg rdzas so so'i rnam par gsal bar gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gcig la/ oṃ bo dhi bṛkṣā ya swā hā/ lan gsum btags pa brjod/ de bzhin du/ oṃ agne ye swā hā/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badzra ye swā hā/ oṃ sarba samba de swā hā/ oṃ badzra puṣṭā ya swā hā/ oṃ badzra bī dzā ye swā hā/ oṃ ma hā be gā ya swā hā/ oṃ ma hā ba la ya swā hā/ oṃ badzra ghasma ryai swā hā/ oṃ badzra a yu ṣe swā hā/ oṃ a pra ti ha na badzra ya swā hā/ 'bru gsum dang rdzas sngags gsum gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlabs/

oṃ agna ye dzwa la raṃ/ zhes pas dud ba med par 'bar ba'i me g.yas su bskor nas thab tu bcug hūm̐ brjod cing rlung g.yab kyis me spar/ oṃ agne swā hā/ zhes blugs gzar phyis mar khu'i thigs pas gso/ oṃ badzra sa twa āḥ zhes brjod pa'i ku sha/ oṃ/ ku sha 'di ni gtsang zhing dge /tshangs pa lha rnams dag byed yin/ /dkon mchog gsum po mnyes byed pa/ /sa las skyes pa 'dab ma'i snying*/ /bdag gi bgegs rnams thams cad ni/ /zhi dang bkra shis mdzad du gsol/ /swā hā/ zhes pas thab kyi khar g.yon nas brtsams te g.yas bskor du dgram/ thab/ oṃ padma ma hā kro dhi shwa ri sarba drwa byaṃ sho dha ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ kyis bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las zhi ba'i thab khung zlum zhing dkar ba mtshan nyid thams cad tshang ba'i dbus su pad zla la gnas pa'i ram̐ las zhi ba'i me lha dkar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas gnyis dbyug pa dang bgrang phreng*/ g.yon gnyis ril ba dang skyabs sbyin mdzad pa/ drang srong gi cha byad can 'khor tshogs du mas bskor ba'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying gar hūm̐ sngon po rnams kyis mtshan par gyur/ snying ga'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis ye shes pa spyan drangs par mos la/ oṃ/ tshur gshegs tshur gshegs 'byung po che/ /me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /bsreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du/ /'bar ba'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ agne ye ā karṣa ya dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ las sngags/ oṃ padma ta kri ta badzra kro ta hya ghṛ wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭḥ sogs kyis phyi 'brang gi bgegs bskrad/ oṃ agne dhe wa sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā sa mchod yon dang*/ oṃ agne dhe wa sa pa ri wā ra pā dyaṃ? pra tītstsha swā hāḥ sa zhabs bsil phul/ oṃ agne ye sa ma ya satwaṃ/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho/ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ de nas me lha cung zad 'dzum pa'i ljags dang gzar bu gnyis kyi kha la ram̐ yig gis mtshan par bsam la/

oṃ agne ye swā hā/ zhes dang*/ mar khu blugs gzar bdun gyis bkang ba'i dgang gzar gyi zags chu las babs pa'i mar khu bdud rtsi'i dwang mar drangs te gsol bas dgyes shing tshim par bsam la gzar bu kha sbyar te/ oṃ agne ye dī bya bi shuddhe ma hā shrī ha bya ka bya ba ha na ya hūm̐ phaṭḥswā hā/ zhes pas g.yas su bskor zhing lan gsum du dbul/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa'i sdig sgrib bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi ba'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ zhes spel tshig dang bcas lan gsum gyis gsol zhing me pra brtag /oṃ agne ye sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ nas shabda 'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ/ gzi brjid chen po me yi lha/ /'dod pa thams cad gsal mdzad pa/ /bdag gzhan don sgrub pa la bzhugs/ /'dzin byed me lha nyid la bstod/ / de nas rdzas rnams rim bzhin 'bul ba las/ yam shing*/ oṃ bo dhi bṛkṣā ya swā hā/ gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ mar khu/ oṃ agne ye swā hā/ 'byor pa phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ til/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badzra ye swā hā/ sdig pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zho zan/ oṃ sarba samba de swā hā/ bde ba phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ 'bras/ oṃ badzra puṣṭā ya swā hā/ bsod nams phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ so ba/ oṃ badzra bī dzā ye swā hā/ nor dang 'bru phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ nas/ oṃ ma hā be gā ye swā hā/ shugs phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ sran ma/ oṃ ma hā ba la ya swā hā/ stobs phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ gro/ oṃ badzra ghasma ryai swā hā/

nad med phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ durba/ oṃ badzra ā yu ṣe swā hā/ tshe ring ba phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ ku sha/ oṃ a pra ti ha ta badzra ye swā hā/ srung ba phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes rdzas rnams so sor nyer gcig re sogs 'bul/ gzhan yang bsreg rdzas ci 'byor pa/ agne ye dī bya bi shuddhe ma hā shrī ha bya ka bya bahna ya hūm̐ phaṭḥswā hā/ zhes dbul/ de nas yungs dkar thab tu gtor te/ drang srong chen po 'khor dang bcas pas bsreg rdzas lha'i zhal du stob pa dang*/ me nyid ye shes kyi mer byin gyis brlabs te/ bdag gi sdig sgrib thams cad zhi ba'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol la/ oṃ badzra dzwa la ram̐ gyis me lha 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur par bsam mo/ /mnyam pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ me/ oṃ padma ta kri ta sogs kyis bsang*/ oṃ ma hā shū n+ya ta sogs brjod pas stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las thab kyi dbus su e las nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor chos kyi 'byung gnas 'byams klas pa'i dbyings su/ yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor ljang gu rgya gram/ ram̐ las me yi dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum/ bam̐ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po/ lam̐ las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi pa rnams brtsegs mar gnas pa'i dbus su/ sum̐ las rin po che sna bzhi las grub pa'i ri rab kyi rtser padma dang sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la gnas pa'i bhrūm̐ yig yongs su gyur pa las thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ nang nas rim pa bzhin dkar mthing ser dmar ljang ba'i rtsigs pa la rim pa lngas bskor ba'i steng du pha gu dang drwa ba drwa phyed shar bu mda' yab dang bcas pa/ rtsig pa'i rtsa bar 'dod yon gyi snam bu la gzungs ma rnams 'khod pas mchod pa'i sprin spro ba/

nang ka ba brgyad kyis btegs shing rdo rje'i gdung gis phub pa'i ya phub phyur ba'i rtser rdo rje'i tog gis spras pa/ sgo bzhir ka ba bzhi bzhis btegs pa'i rta babs snam bu brgyad pa chos 'khor ri dwags gdugs dang bcas pa tshad dang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs shing rgyan thams cad kyis rnam par brgyan pa/ phyogs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i kha dog can dwangs shing sgrib pa med pa'i 'od zer kun tu 'phro ba/ phyi rol nas padma'i phreng ba dang rdo rje'i rwa ba me dpung 'bar ba'i 'khor yug gis bskor ba/ de'i nang du sna tshogs padma 'dab ma brgyad pa ze'u 'bru phreng bas bskor ba'i lte ba dang bcas pa'i dbus su/ 'di nas gzhung gang yin gyi lha bskyed rdzogs par btang la/ gnyis pa ye shes kyi 'khor lo spyan drangs sogs ni/ snying ga'i sa bon las byung ba'i 'od zer gyis ye shes kyi 'khor lo mdun gyi nam mkhar badzra sa mā dzaḥ sa spyan drangs par bsam la/ gzhung gang yin gyi spyan 'dren sngags bcas mthar/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa dgug gzhug bcing pa dang dgyes pa bskyed nas dam tshig gi 'khor lo dang gnyis su med par gyur/ sgrub mchod dang 'brel ba la ni/ mngon rtogs kyi/ rin po che'i khri bkod pa phul du byung ba'i steng du padma dang zla ba'i gdan la bkra lam gyis gsal bar gyur/ gzhung gang yin spyan 'dren sngags bcas brjod/ sgrub dkyil las me tog gis mtshon par spos dang rol mo bcas spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho/ rtsa sngags brjod la gzhung gang yin gyi lha bskyed rdzogs pa'i mthar/ thab tu bzhugs su gsol zhing*/ gsal gdab pa tsam khyad par ro/ /gang ltar yang*/ dang po phyag 'tshal ba ni/ tshogs rten gyi thugs ka nas rang nyid logs su phye bas phyag 'tshal sogs las rim la 'jug par gyur/ gzhung so so'i bzhugs gsol dang phyag 'tshal bcas sbyar/ gnyis pa mchod pa la/ phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid dang bzhi las/

dang po phyi mchod kyi thog mar mchod sprin spyir spro ba ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: dngos 'byor yid sprul 'phrul dga'i longs spyod bzhin: phyag rgya gar sogs phyi nang gsang ba yi: kun tu bzang po bla med mchod sprin gyis: rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor ma lus mnyes gyur cig: lha gang yin gyi mtshan sngags mthar/ sa pa ri wā ra bhyaḥ arghaṃ pra tītstsha ye swā hā: de bzhin/ pā dyaṃ/ puṣpe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke gandhe/ nai wi dye/ shabda 'i bar sbyar te phyi mchod dang*/ de nas rin chen bdun ni/ mi dbang rin chen sna bdun 'di dag ni/ /sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa ma lus la/ /bshams shing yid kyis sprul te phul ba yis/ /'gro ba mi zad gter la spyod par shog /oṃ sabta ma hā ratna badzra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ 'dod yon lnga ni/ phyogs dus kun na gzugs sgra dri dang ro/ /reg bya'i khyad par phun sum tshogs pa rnams/ /mos blos bla ma sras bcas la 'bul na/ /bzhes shig bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol/ /oṃ pañtsa kā ma gu ṇa badzra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ bkra shis rdzas brgyad 'bul ba ni/ lha yi dbang po lha min g.yul rgyal nas/ /bkra shis lha mo brgyad kyis mchod pa ltar/ /deng 'dir lhag pa'i lha yi dkyil 'khor la/ /bkra shis rdzas brgyad dag gis mchod par bgyi/ /oṃ aṣṭa maṅga la badzra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ na bza' 'bul ba/ sna tshogs dbang po'i gzhu ltar rab bkra zhing*/ /gang la reg na bde ba'i rgyu gyur ba'i/ /gos bzang rin chen bdag blo sbyong phyir 'bul/ /bzod pa dam pa'i gos kyis brgyan par shog /oṃ badzra wasatra pra tītstsha swā hā/ rgyan 'bul ba/ rgyal ba mtshan dpe'i rang bzhin rgyan ldan phyir/ /rgyan gzhan dag gis brgyan par mi 'tshal kyang*/ /rin chen rgyan mchog phul bas 'gro kun gyi/ /mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i sku mchog thob par shog /oṃ ratna a laṅka ra pra tītstsha swā hā/ yid byung gi mchod pa 'bul ba/

oṃ/ mchod pa'i phyag rgya chen po ni/ /sems kyi yid bzhin sprin tshogs kyis/ /phyogs bcu thams cad sangs rgyas zhing*/ /mnyen 'jam reg na bde ba dang*/ /sna tshogs rin po che yi gzhi/ /mdzes par bres shing spras pa dang*/ /kun 'byung rin chen phung por 'bar/ /dbyibs legs rdzing bu bro mchog bsil/ /rin chen khang pa sna tshogs dang*/ /rgyan dang dpag bsam ljon pa'i tshal/ /glu dbyangs tshig su bcad pa'i sgra/ /bla bre rgyal mtshan na bza' gdugs/ /do shal dpung rgyan se mo do/ /bza' dang btung ba'i mchog rnams dang*/ /rang la mdzes par rgyan pa yi/ /lha dang lha mo rdul rnyed kyi/ /bro gar la sogs bsam yas kyis/ /phyogs bcu nam mkha'i khams bkang nas/ /dkyil 'khor kun la rgyas par 'bul/ /thugs rjes brtser dgongs bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ sarba pū dza ho/ zhes 'bul/ hoḥ ye shes lnga sbyor dug lnga sel ba'i sman: khams gsum yongs sgrol 'khor ba stongs pa'i khrag: 'dod yon lngas brgyan dam rdzas gtor chen po: thugs dam gnyan po skong ba'i don phyir 'bul: ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi: zhes nang mchod dang : ā: gzhi dbyings stong chen e ye padmo ru: gzhi snang ma 'gags thabs mchog rdo rje sbyor: zung 'jug bde chen gsang ba'i mchod pa che: gnyis med don rtogs bde ba'i klong du 'bul: oṃ ma hā a nu ra ga na su ṣa dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa atma ko3 haṃ: zhes sbyor mchod dang*/ āḥ 'khor 'das gnyis kyis bsdus pa'i chos so cog: 'od gsal stong nyid lta ba'i klong du bsgral: gnyis snang bdag 'dzin 'khrul rtog ru tra kun: gnyis med he ru ka yi zhal du bstab: ma hā ru tra pra wan tsakra sarba pū dza ho/ zhes sgrol mchod dang*/ āḥ mchod bya mchod byed mchod yul gdod nas dag: mchog tu mi 'gyur rig stong byang chub sems: blo 'das ka dag gnyug ma rdo rje'i srog: 'gyur med mchog gi mchod pa bla na med:

oṃ badzra dharma dhā tu āḥ zhes de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa'o/ /gzhung gang yin gyi bstod pa byas nas/ dgang blugs 'bul ba ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha cung zad 'dzum pa'i sngags dang gzar bu gnyis kyi kha la ram̐ yig gis mtshan par bsam la/ lha gang yin gyi rtsa sngags lan bdun gyis mar khu blugs gzar gyis bkang ba'i dgang blugs kha sbyar te lha gang yin gyi gzungs ring lta bas g.yas su bskor nas/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa'i sdig sgrib bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi ba'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ zhes dang gter gzhung*/ ram̐: ye shes klong yangs 'khyil ba'i hoṃ khang du: dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'bar ba'i bsreg rdzas 'bul: dam tshig bzhin las ci bder bzhes nas kyang : thog med las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod: hoḥ thog med bsags pa'i sdig ltung nyams chags dang : sngon las 'phral rkyen byad phur rbod gtong sogs: mi mthun dgra gdon rkyen ngan bar chad kun: ma bcos rig pa'i ngang du zhi gyur cig: oṃ sarba shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā:

de nas rdzas rnams rim pa bzhin lha so so'i rtsa sngags gsham gong bzhin brgya rtsa sogs 'bul/ bsreg rdzas gzhan yod na yang phul ba'i mthar/ yungs dkar la rtsa sngags sam gzungs ring gi rigs bzlas pas thab tu gtor la/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa'i sdig sgrib bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi ba'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ dgang blugs 'bul skabs bzhin/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha cung zad 'dzum pa'i ljags dang gzar bu gnyis kyi kha la ram̐ yig gis mtshan par bsams la/ lha gang yin gyi rtsa sngags lan bdun gyis mar khu blugs gzar gyis bkang ba'i dgang blugs kha sbyar te lha gang yin gyi gzungs ring bzla bas g.yas su bskor nas/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa'i sdig sgrib bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi ba'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ tshar gsum gyis dgang blugs phul/ gtang rag gi mchod bstod ni/ lha gang yin gyi mtshan sngags mthar sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ nas shabda pra tītstsha swā hā/ zhes mchod cing rigs mthun gyi shāo lo kas bstod/ hoḥ chos nyid don la nor 'khrul mi dmigs kyang : lta dman rig pa'i 'ub tu ma chub pa'i: lha sngags ting 'dzin cho ga yo byad rdzas: lhag chad 'gal 'khrul rang gnong bzod par gsol: yi ge brgya pas nongs pa bzod par gsol/ oṃ/ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ / sogs kyi ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang gi lte ba'i a thung la bsdu/ sgrub mchod skabs/ bzod gsol rjes/ badzra muḥ thab kyi lha tshogs rnams dkyil 'khor pa'i thugs kar gshegs par gyur/ ces ye shes pa dkyil 'khor du gshegs shing tshom bu slar spyan drangs/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu/ gnyis ka'i mthar/ blugs gzar gyis mar khu dang*/ oṃ agne ye dzwa la dzwa la hūm̐/ zhes brjod pas me gso zhing*/ slar yang me lha cha byad yongs su rdzogs pa skad cig gis gsal bar gyur/ me lha cung zad 'dzum pa'i ljags dang gzar bu gnyis kyi kha la ram̐ yig gis mtshan par

bsam la/ oṃ agne ye swā hā/ zhes dang mar khu blugs gzar bdun gyis bkang ba'i dgang gzar gyi zag mchu las bab pa'i mar khu bdud rtsi'i dwangs mar drangs te gsol bas dgyes shing tshim par bsams la/ oṃ agne ye dī bya dī bya bi shuddhe ma hā shrī ha bya ka bya ba ha na ya hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lan gsum du dbul/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa'i sdig sgrib bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi ba'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ de nas rdzas rnams rim bzhin gong ltar lan bdun sogs kyis 'bul/ gtor ma/ oṃ agne ye dhe wa sa pa ri wā ra oṃ a kā sogs kyis lan gsum phul la/ me ste bsreg bya za ba'i lha/ /drang srong rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /shar lho me lha'i tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ / zhes bstod cing*/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ / sogs kyis phrin las bcol/ yig brgya bzla zhing nongs pa bshags/ bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don/ /byin za khyod kyis bsgrubs kyi gshegs/ /ji bzhin dus su slar byon la/ /bdag gi 'dod pa thams cad sgrubs/ /oṃ agne ye gatstsha zhes rang gnas su gshegs su gsol/ oṃ a kā ro brjod 'o ma dang dri bzang gi chus me btul/ las rjes mi mngon par byas la/ dge ba 'di yis skye bo kun/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs shing*/ /bsod nams ye shes las byung ba/ /dam pa sku gnyis thob par shog / gzhan yang theg chen smon lam gang rig sbyar ro/ /rten 'brel snying po bzlas pa'i me tog 'thor bzhin pas/ oṃ/ byin rlabs mchog stsol rigs brgya'i bdag /bla ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog /dngos grub char 'bebs zhi dang khro/ /yi dam lha tshogs bkra shis shog /thogs med phrin las sgrub mdzad pa'i/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i bkra shis shog /gang la bsam pa'i don kun grub/ /dge legs mchog gi bkra shis shog / sogs bkra shis brjod par bya'o/

/de las ro bsreg gi cho ga'i khyad par ni/ sngar bshad pa'i bris thab kyi khar pha khu sogs kyi ro khang phyi brtsig pa'i rgyar khru gang dang nang*/ che chung phung po dang tshod ran pa dpangs su ji ltar rigs pa brtsig /spar byed kyi me tshang mchod sreg gi rdzas rnams tshogs par 'du byas la/ gnas lung dngos gzhi'i lam sbyong bstan yan chad song ba na ro khang rnying pa las phud du phyung te/ sngar bzhin bgegs la gtor ma btab nas drag sngags bzla zhing rol mo dang bcas pas phung po yungs thun gyis brab/ gu gul gyis bdug pa sogs byas la bgegs bskrad/ sgrib sbyong gi sngags bzlas pa'i bye yungs kyis brab cing bum chus bkru/ dri bzang gis byugs/ stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs dkri/ gnas gsum sogs su btags grol dang gdags yi ge rim pa ci 'byor btags/ skad cig gis lha gang yin gyi gtso bo'i rnam par gsal/ cung zad mchod cing bstod nas/ ras sogs stan srab mo'i khyogs la btegs nas/ rol mo dang bcas pas thab kyi nang du cung zad 'gu bar bzhag pa'i mdun dngos shing phra ba dang rgyab rnams cung zad sbom pas gang bde ba'i phyi'i mdun gyi rtsa bar spar khung*/ rked par rdzas khung*/ steng du dud khung rnams ma gtogs gzhan thams cad mdzes shing brtan par brtsig /dkar rtsi byugs shing gdugs dbub pa sogs bya/ bdag bskyed sogs sngar bzhin las/ me spar ba ni/ don dam ye shes lnga rdzogs spar ba'i mes: dmigs yul phung khams sgrib bzhi'i bud shing la: khams gsum 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal rgya mtsho'i gting : ye shes snang ba chen pos skem gyur cig: oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrī āḥ rtsa sngags dang*/ 'aḥ.aḥshaḥsaḥmaḥhaḥ ma ma ko liṃ sa mānta: a a āḥ yig brgya bzla zhing 'khor gsum dag par sbyangs/ gzhan yang kaṃ ka ni sogs ngan song sbyong ba'i sngags gang rigs brjod/ gang zag mchog yin na rten dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dang dbyer med du bya zhing*/

dman pa la sha khrag bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin gyi mchod rdzas su dmigs pa yin la/ spel tshig kyang des rigs 'gre ste sbyar tshul ni/ gang zag mchog la/ zhi bar gshegs pa'i sa lam gyi bar chad 'brel thog sems can gyi sdig sgrib thams cad zhi ba'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ ram̐: ye shes klong yangs 'khyil ba'i hoṃ khang du: dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'bar ba'i bsreg rdzas 'bul: dam tshig bzhin las ci bder bzhes nas kyang : thog med las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod: hoḥ thog med bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyams chags dang : sngon las 'phral rkyen za 'dre shi gshed sogs: thar lam byang chub sgrub pa'i bar chad kun: ma bcos rig pa'i ngang du zhi gyur cig: lhag lha gang la bsten pa'i rtsa sngags sham: tshe las 'das pa cha3lt;!TCC Tibetan character 3,148 undefined in unicode!>ཻ mo'i sdig sgrib thams cad sarba shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: zhes pas grangs ldan phul ba'i sa lam gyi: bar chad zhi nas bde 'gro'i rten bzang sogs: yon tan kun ldan sangs rgyas thob pa'o: de bzhin gang zag dman pa la/ tshe las 'das pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad zhi ba'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ ram̐: ye shes klong yangs 'khyil ba'i sogs gong bzhin sbyar ro/ /cho ga gzhan ni sngar gyi dkyus bzhin rdzas rnams 'bul ba na/ dmigs yul rjes su dran pas de la phan pa'i bsam pas sngags bzlas shing sbyin bsreg byas pas bdag dang lha dang mchod rdzas dang me las ye shes kyi 'od zer dkar po 'phros dmigs yul la thim pas de'i sdig sgrib kyi nyes pa thams cad sel bar bsam pa yin te/ ngan song rgyud na gnas pa yi/ /sems can rjes su dran byed cing*/ / zhes dang*/ bzlas dang sbyin sreg nyid byed cing*/ /'od zer sprin gyis de lus la/ /'phro bar gyur pa rnams sgom ste/ /rtag tu gar bltas 'od zer gyis/ /nyes pa thams cad sel byed pa/ / zhes sogs cho ga 'di nyid ston pas rgyud las gsungs pa'o/

/gsum pa sātstsha gdab pa'i cho ga ni/ de ltar ro bsregs tshar ba'i rjes su rdo rje sems dpa'i nga rgyal gyis/ badzra saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ zhes rus bu rnams bsdus la rin po che sogs kyi snod du bzhag /de'i steng du mañdza'i khar rin po che'i bum pa sman dang dri bzang gi chus gang ba'am/ nye logs su ba byung lnga'i snod dang ga bur gur gum sogs dri bzang gi chu'i snod kyang so sor bshams/ rus bu'i steng du zla ba la gnas pa'i āḥdakar po 'od zer 'phro ba de las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi babs pas tshe 'das kyi sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs par bsam la/ lha gang yin gyi gzungs sngags dang ngan song sbyong ba'i sngags mang du bzlas nas bum chu la sogs pa'i rdzas thams cad la gdab cing rus bu rnams dag par bkru/ de nyid zhi bar sbyangs nas sngar gyi bum chu dang ba byung lnga rnams lhan cig tu sbyar ba slar yang dri bzang dang sa bzang por 'jim pa rnams bsres pas snying po bzla bzhin pas brdzis la/ 'jim pa rin po che'i phung por bsam te rang gi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis 'og min du rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer byung bas sems can thams cad kyi rgyud sbyangs 'jim pa la thim pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad ye shes kyi rang bzhin du gyur par bsam la/ lag g.yon pa'i mthe'u chung mthe bos mnan pa gyen bstan dang*/ g.yas pa'ang de bzhin du kha sbub pa'i bar du 'jim pa bzhag la rnam snang gi gzungs ring sngags/ yang na/ oṃ dzi na dzi ka swā hā/ zhes pa nyer gcig dang yig brgyas byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ badzra ā yu ṣe swā hā/ rdo rje'i srog thob par bsam la 'jim pa bcad/ oṃ badzrod bha wā ya swā hā/ ye shes rdo rje 'byung ba bsam la 'bi 'bi bya/ oṃ a ra dze bi ra dze swā hā/ ye shes rdul bral du bsam la snum byug /oṃ dharma dhā tu garbha swā hā/

chos kyi dbyings kyi snying po rnyed par bsam zhing brkos phor du bcug /oṃ badzra muṅga ra a ko ṭa ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi phyag rgyas btab par bsam la gdab/ oṃ sarba bidyā swā hā/ ye shes kyi snying po khong du chud par bsam la / gur gum gyis bris pa'i yig brgya dang rten snying gzungs su gzhug /oṃ dharma ra ti swā hā/ chos sku las gzugs skur grub par bsam zhing phyir 'don/ oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzra swā hā/ sangs rgyas thams cad de la brtan par bzhugs par bsam la me tog 'thor zhing rab tu gnas par bya'o/ /cung zad rgyas par spro na bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas rten gyi bgegs sbyong ba dang*/ khrus gsol nas rnam snang dam tshig par bskyed/ ye shes pa spyan drangs la bstim dbang bskur/ mchod pa bstod pa byas nas rang gzugs su bsgyur nas rten bzhugs dang shis brjod bya'o/ /cho ga de lta bu'i sgo nas mchod rten gcig btab pas bye ba snyed btab par 'gyur zhing thams cad du skye ba dran par 'gyur ro/ /yang mchod rten gdab pa de dang 'brel bar sems can la phan gdags par spro na/ mchod rten gyi bya ba rdzogs pa'i 'og tu bdag nyid lhag pa'i lha'i ting nge 'dzin las snying ga'i sngags kyi 'od zer gyis dmigs yul gyi sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs par bsam la lha gang yin gyi gzungs ring gsham dmigs yul gyi ming nas smros pa'i sgrib sbyong gi spel tshig can 'bum phrag gcig bzla zhing dkon mchog la mchod pa dang*/ 'gro la sbyin gtong gi dpung bskyed pa rnams byas na dmigs yul der ngan song gi sdug bsngal las thar ba'i phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab par gsungs shing*/ de'i thabs ni gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /'di dang dus gsum 'brel ba yi/ /rnam dkar dge tshogs gcig bsdoms nas/ /ngan song gsum sogs 'gro ba rnams/ /yang dag las la 'god par shog /bstan pa rgya mtsho'i snying po bcud/

/rmad byung rdo rje theg mchog gi /bstan dang bstan 'dzin sde dang bcas/ /dar zhing rgyas la yun gnas shog / ces pa 'di'ang rang slob karma dzñā nas don gnyer chen pos nan bskul ngor kā ma la rā dza dī pas rang gter sku gsum dgongs 'dus kyi cha lag tu rgya 'brug gi mtshams dge legs phug nas rab lo me yos dge ba'i char sngon gyi rdo rje 'dzin pa rnams kyis ji ltar dkrol ba'i rjes su 'brangs te dag par sbyar ba siddhi rastu/ yi ge pā ni rang slob padma ma tis zhus pa dge legs 'phel// // ྂ/: bla ma sku gsum dgongs 'dus las: rab gnas ye shes rab 'bar bzhugs: ྂ/: ma 'ongs lnga brgya tha ma la: rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs rten la: brten nas rten 'brel 'grigs pa na: dus kyi rgud pa rab sel nas: phyi nang 'byung ba cha snyoms te: 'jig rten bde skyid nges par 'byung : de phyir 'di nyid gtso bor bstan: sa ma ya: rigs lnga'i dam rdzas so sor ma 'dres par: gnas bya'i rten rnams dal dbus mchod pas spras: bgegs bskrad khrus byas dam tshig sgom par bya: oṃ ma hā shu n+ya ta'i sngags kyis sbyang : āḥ snang srid rnam dag bde chen rigs lnga'i zhing : ma bskyed yongs grub bkod rdzogs gzhal med khang : kun bzang rnam rol mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i dbus: rigs lnga'i dam tshig rten rdzas yo byad rnams: seṅge glang chen rta mchog rma bya shang : rin chen khri steng padma zla gdan dbus: so so'i sa bon phyag mtshan rnam par gyur: dbus kyi seng khrir 'khor lo oṃ dkar mtshan: 'phro 'du yongs gyur rnam snang yab yum gsal: shar du rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gi mtshan: 'phro 'du yongs gyur mi bskyod yab yum gsal: lho ru rin chen ser po trām̐ gyi mtshan: 'phro 'du yongs gyur rin 'byung yab yum gsal: nub tu padma dmar po hrīḥyi mtshan: 'phro 'du yongs gyur snang mtha' yab yum gsal: byang du rgya gram ljang khu a yi mtshan:

'phro 'du yongs gyur don grub yab yum gsal: kun gyi gnas gsum 'bru gsum mtshan pa las: ye shes 'khor lo spyan drangs gnyis med gyur: rigs lnga'i dbang bskur rigs bdag dbu rgyan bsam/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrī āḥ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐: ma lus rgyal kun ye shes klong gcig las: chu zla'i gar bzhin sna tshogs gdul bya'i ngor: gang la gang 'dul de la der ston pa'i: rgyal ba 'khor bcas ma lus sa mā dzaḥ e hya hi: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam ye dbyer med gyur bar spyan dbye ni: hoḥ ye shes thur mas mdun gyi rten gyi spyan: deng 'dir 'gro ba'i don phyir rab dbye na: sems can thams cad 'khor ba las sgrol ba'i: ye shes gzigs spyan phun sum tshogs par gyur: sa ma ya dzñā na tsakṣu pra be sha ya phaṭḥ yan lag bdun gyis tshogs bsags bsgyur bar bya: oṃ āḥhūm̐: sa ma ya hoḥ sa ma ya satwaṃ: rten rnams so so'i gzugs kyi rnam par blta: sngags kyi mnga' dbul rten snying ji 'grub bzla: me tog 'bru rnams yig 'bru'i rnam pa la: rang sgra sgrogs shing 'od zer rab 'phros pas: phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas ma lus la: mnyes par mchod cing thugs dam rgyud bskul te: bzlas bya'i gzungs sngags yig 'bru rnam pa ru: char ltar byon nas rten sgrub rdzas la thim: ye shes 'od zer mchog tu 'bar bar 'gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā: oṃ ye dharma

a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐: ma lus rgyal kun sogs gong ltar 'gres sbyar ro/ /gzhi pa yon tan gyi rten gyi rigs ni/ āḥ snang srid rnam dag bde chen rgyal ba'i zhing : ma bskyed yongs grub bkod rdzogs gzhal med khang : kun bzang rnam rol mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i dbus: rta mchog khri steng padma zla gdan dbus: rin chen gser po 'od 'bar trām̐ gyis mtshan: 'phro 'du yongs gyur rin 'byung yab yum gsal: de yi gnas gsum 'bru gsum mtshan pa las: ye shes 'khor lo spyan drangs gnyis med gyur: rigs lnga'i dbang bskur rigs bdag dbu rgyan bsam/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrī āḥ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐: ma lus rgyal kun sogs gong ltar 'gres sbyar ro/ /lnga pa phrin las kyi rten ni/ āḥ snang srid rnam dag bde chen rgyal ba'i zhing : ma bskyed yongs grub bkod rdzogs gzhal med khang : kun bzang rnam rol mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i dbus: shang shang khri steng padma zla gdan dbus: rgya gram ljang khu 'od 'bar a yi mtshan: 'phro 'du yongs gyur don grub yab yum gsal: de yi gnas gsum 'bru gsum mtshan pa las: ye shes 'khor lo spyan drangs gnyis med gyur: rigs lnga'i dbang bskur rigs bdag dbu rgyan bsam/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrī āḥ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐: ma lus rgyal kun sogs gong ltar 'gres sbyar ro/ /drug pa gnod sbyin 'khor lo ni/ āḥ snang srid rnam dag bde chen rgyal ba'i zhing : ma bskyed yongs grub bkod rdzogs gzhal med khang : kun bzang rnam rol mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i dbus: 'khor lo mi dmigs stong pa'i ngang nyid las: srung 'khor dbus su sna tshogs pad 'dab brgyad: lte ba rnams su bam̐ dang dzam̐ gyi mtshan: 'phro 'du yongs gyur gnod sbyin nor lha'i gtso: nor rgyun ma dang arya dzambha la: gtso 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa sku mdog ser: zhal gcig phyag gnyis kun gyi phyag g.yas pas:

bi dza pū ra ka 'dzin yum rnams kyis: g.yon pas rin chen 'bras kyi snye ma dang*/ /yab rnams g.yon pas gter gyi ne'u le 'dzin/ /dar dang rin chen rgyan rdzogs phyed skyil bzhugs/ /zhabs 'og padma'i gdong gi gter bdag mnan/ /lha mo rnams kyang mdzes sdug 'gying bag ldan/ /thams cad gnas gsum rdo rje'i 'bru gsum mtshan/ /thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer lcags kyu'i dbyibs/ /'phros pas ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs bstim/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par gyur/ /slar yang thugs ka'i 'od kyis dbang gi lha/ /rigs lnga 'khor bcas badzra sa mā dzaḥ pañtsa ku la sa pā ri wā ra arghaṃ nas shabda pra tītstsha swā hā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ ji ltar bltam pa nas shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag /chu'i lhag yar lud rin 'byung dbu rgyan gyur/ mchod pa ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis bsangs sbyangs/ snang ba thams cad ye shes rol pa'i rgyan: mchod pa'i sprin gyis mkha' dbyings gang bar gyur/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin shabda 'i bar gyi brlabs/ oṃ ba su dha ri sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha ye swā hā/ de bzhin shabda 'i bar gyi mchod/ 'gro kun dbul phongs sdug bsngal mun pa'i smag /thugs rje nyi ma'i 'od kyis sel mdzad pa/ /nor rgyun lha mo arya dzambha la/ /'khor dang bcas la gus pas phyag 'tshal bstod/ / zhes bstod/ yum rnams thugs khar zla gdan bam̐/ /yab rnams thugs kar zla gdan dzam̐/ /srog yig sngags phreng bskor bas 'od zer 'phros/ /srid zhi'i dpal 'byor kun 'dus sbyin bdag dang*/ /sems can kun gyi dbul phongs sdug bsngal bsal/ /bde 'byor longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa gyur/ oṃ ba su dha ri ni swā hā/ oṃ tsand+ra kā ṇyai swā hā/ oṃ dārta ye swā hā/ oṃ dātta ye swā hā/ oṃ ārya ye swā hā/ oṃ su bha dra ye swā hā/ oṃ gupta ye swā hā/

oṃ de bye ye swā hā/ oṃ swā ra swā dyai swā hā/ oṃ dzambha la dza land+ra ye swā hā/ oṃ ma ṇi bha dra ya swā hā/ oṃ pūrna bha dra ya swā hā/ oṃ dha na rā ya swā hā/ oṃ bai shā ma ṇa ya swā hā/ oṃ ki li ma li ni swā hā/ oṃ tsi pi kuṇḍa li ni swā hā/ oṃ mu khend+ra ya swā hā/ oṃ tsa rend+ra ya swā hā/ zhes pa rnams ci 'grub bzla/ yig brgya brjod/ gnod sbyin gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ bhrūm̐ las gtor zhong ratna'i gzhal yas su: oṃ las gtor ma 'dod yon phung por gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ lan gsum gyis byin brlab/ gnod sbyin yab yum rnams kyi ye shes ljags/ /'od kyi sbu gus drangs te gsol bar gyur/ oṃ ba su dha ri sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ bha lingta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum gyis phul/ gang ltar mchod cing bstod/ nor rgyun lha mo yab yum gtso 'khor rnams/ /sgrub gzhi 'di la brtan par bzhugs nas kyang*/ /sbyin bdag la sogs sems can thams cad la/ /dpal 'byor rgyun mi chad par 'byung bar mdzod/ / zhes 'dod don gsol/ nor rgyun ma yab yum gtso 'khor rnams 'od du zhu nas 'khor lo'i rnam par gyur/ zhar la tshogs bdag 'khor lo 'byor tshe sgrub pa ni/ bsangs sbyangs/ snang srid rnam dag gzhal med khang chen por/ /srung 'khor dang ni mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i dbus/ /bai ḍūrya'i brag ri brtsegs pa'i steng*/ /sna tshogs pad nyi zla gdan la gnas pa'i/ /byi ba sngon po mgo bo g.yas bstan steng*/ /gaḥyig yongs gyur lha chen tshogs bdag dmar/ /glang po'i gdong can ral pa'i thor cog la/ /rin po che dang rab mdzes me tog brgyan/ /bcu gnyis phyag ldan g.yas drug rim pa bzhin/ /dgra satwa mda' chen lcags kyu rdo rje dang*/ /ral gri 'phang mdung dang ni g.yon drug na/ /gtun shing gzhu dang kha ṭwāṃ thod khrag dang*/ /sha chen thod pa la phub ba dan 'dzin/ /dar gyi sham thabs rin chen phreng bas brgyan/

/g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs/ /gnas gsum 'bru gsum thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig las/ /'od zer gyis bskul rang bzhin gnas mchog nas/ /thugs rje chen po tshogs kyi bdag po ni/ /'khor dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzaḥ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas thugs rje chen po tshogs kyi bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ hūm̐/ rang bzhin dag pa byang shar mtshams shed nas/ /thugs rje chen po tshogs bdag skur sprul pa/ /mchod cing sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir spyan 'dren na/ /thog pa med par myur du gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ badzra sa mā ya dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par gyur/ /slar yang thugs ka'i 'od kyis dbang gi lha/ /rigs lnga 'khor bcas badzra sa mā dzaḥ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ nas shabda pra tītstsha swā hā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ ji ltar bltam pa nas shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag /chu'i lhag yar lud snang mtha' dbu rgyan gyur/ mchod pa ram̐ yam̐ kham̐

gis bsangs sbyangs/ snang ba thams cad ye shes rol pa'i rgyan: mchod pa'i sprin gyis mkha' dbyings gang bar gyur/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin shabda 'i bar gyi brlabs/ oṃ ga ṇa pa ti sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha ye swā hā/ de bzhin shabda 'i bar gyi mchod/ thugs rje'i gter chen mgon po spyan ras gzigs/ /'gro ba'i don du lha yi nor lhar sprul/ /pad rag mdog ldan rin chen gser khrir bzhugs/ /dngos grub mchog stsol khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces bstod/ thugs kar nyi ma'i gdan la gaḥyig mthar/ /sngags skor 'od kyis 'jig rten khams kun gyi/ /dpal 'byor bkrag mdangs gzi brjid thams cad bsdus/ /bdag sogs sems can kun gyi dpal 'byor bkrag /gzi brjid phun tshogs longs spyod rgyas par gyur/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ gaḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes dang*/ oṃ gu ga ṇa pa ta ye dā na pa ti sa pa ri wā ra puṣṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ oṃ badzra a du sha ma dza ta ga ta se ta a karṣa ye dā na ba su āḥyu puṇyai puṣṭiṃ ku ru swā hā/ ga ga ga ga ga / ces ci 'grub bzla/ yig brgya rten snying brjod/ tshogs gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ bhrūm̐ las gtor zhong ratna'i gzhal yas su: oṃ las gtor ma 'dod yon phung por gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ lan gsum gyis byin brlab/ lha chen tshogs kyi bdag po'i ye shes ljags/ /'od kyi sbu gus drangs te gsol bar gyur/ oṃ ga ṇa pa ti i daṃ bha lingta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum gyis phul/ gang ltar mchod cing bstod/ thugs rje chen po tshogs bdag 'khor bcas rnams/ /sgrub gzhi 'di la brtan par bzhugs nas kyang*/ /sbyin bdag la sogs sems can thams cad la/ /dpal 'byor rgyun mi chad par 'byung bar mdzod/ / zhes 'dod don gsol/ nor rgyun ma yab yum gtso 'khor rnams 'od du zhu nas 'khor lo'i rnam par gyur/ bum rdzas nyer lnga byin gyis brlab pa'i sngags las sman lngar/

oṃ pañtsa bhe ṣa dzyai āḥhūm̐: rin chen lngar/ oṃ pañtsa ratna āḥhūm̐: dri lngar/ oṃ pañtsa gandhe āḥhūm̐: 'bru lngar/ oṃ pañtsa be ga āḥhūm̐/ snying po lngar/ oṃ pañtsa garbha āḥhūm̐/ zhes pa rnams ci rigs bzla/ bang mdzod kyi rdzas rnams rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya phun sum tshogs pa rten la mchod pa dang*/ sbyin pa'i bdag po dang bdag sogs sems can thams cad la 'dod rgu'i yo byad thams cad zad mi shes pa rgyun mi chad du 'byung ba'i gter chen por gyur/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgyas/ oṃ sarba bī pū ra sogs dang*/ sngags drug phyag rgya drug gis byin gyis brlab/ na mo/ bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs sogs dang rten snying bzlas la phun sum tshogs pa'i shis pa rgya cher brjod do/ /gzugs sku rnams sgrub ma thag rab gnas ma byas na bgegs 'jug gi skyon yod pas khrir bkod nas mchod pa bcas ji ltar bltams pa sogs nas shrī ye āḥhūm̐/ tsam gyi khrus dang gul yungs rdzas bcas sumbha ni 'i sngags kyi bgegs bskrad de ma lus sems can kun gyi sogs nas gshegs su gsol/ badzra sa mā ya dzaḥ sa nam mkhar rgyal ba sras bcas spyan drangs la ji snyed su dag sogs nas phyir bsngo'o/ bar gyi tshogs bsags la 'dir ni gzugs dang lhan cig tu sogs nas badzra ye swā hā/ me tog 'thor la rten snying brjod cing*/ tshogs zhing rgyal ba sras dang bcas/ /'od phung 'bar ba'i rnam pa ru/ /gyur te rten dang dbyer med par/ /rab tu brtan cing gnas par mdzod/ /mi 'gyur lhun po sogs kyi shis pa brjod/ de ni mdo lugs kyi rab gnas shin tu bsdus pa tsam yin te rjes su sngags lugs kyi rab gnas gong du bshad ma thag ltar nan tan dgos gal che ba bcas le lo dang phyi bshol gyis dbang du ma song ba gces so/ /'di brtsam pa las dge ba gang*/

/mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i rgyud la bsngo/ /gnas skabs 'jig rten dge mtshan rgyas/ /mthar thug rnam mkhyen 'bras thob shog / ces pa'ang kho bo 'gro 'dul pad rgyal gling pa rtsal gyis kha skong zur 'debs kyi tshul du shar mar sbyar ba'i rtsa ba'i yi ge pa ni karma dzñā nas zhus pa 'gro kun sku bzhi'i rgyal sar dbugs dbyung ba'i rgyur gyur cig /sarba dā maṅga laṃ// // ྂ/: sku gsum dgongs 'dus las: gu ru ratna thod phreng rtsal gyi sgos dbang bzhugs so: ྂ/: ratna thod phreng rtsal la phyag 'tshal lo: rgyas mdzad bla ma bskyed bzlas nyams len gyi: snod du rung phyir dbang bskur rim pa bstan: sa ma ya: dben pa'i gnas su tshul bzhin 'du bgyis pa'i: maṇḍal dbang rdzas phyi nang mchod pa bkram: bdag mdun dbyer med bskyed bzlas bdag dbang blang : tshogs kyi mchod pas nyams chags bshags bgyid nas: snod ldan slob ma bos la khrus kyis dbyung : mi dbang bgegs bskrad srung ba'i 'khor lor bcings: chos bshad maṇḍal 'bul zhing gsol ba gdab: hoḥ dkyil 'khor gtso bo ratna thod phreng dang : dbyer med rdo rje slob dpon brtse bas dgongs: mchog gi bla ma ratna thod phreng gi: smin byed dbang gi bka' drin bdag la stsol: lan gsum: skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshogs bsags sdom pa bzung : slob ma'i rgyud sbyang lhar bskyed ye shes dbab: de nas rnam rgyal bum pa spyi bor bzhag: hūm̐: rin chen bum pa bzang po gzhal yas khang : dkyil 'khor lha tshogs bdud rtsi'i rnam par gtam: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: ratna thod phreng sku yi dbang thob shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru ratna thod phreng rtsal kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: sngags byang mgrin par bzhag la: āḥ ji snyed sgra yi snying po bde chen sngags: bsnyen sgrub phrin las snying po yi ge'i gzugs: chos kyi ring bsrel ye shes sngags kyi dbang : ratna thod phreng gsung gi dbang thob shog:

gong ltar sngags sham: wākka a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ me long dwangs gsal bstan la ngo sprod gdab: hūm̐: rang rig mtha' dbus gnyis med zang thal le: 'dus ma byas pa mtshon byed tsam gyi brdar: dwangs gsal me long dri med dbang bskur bas: ratna thod phreng thugs kyi dbang thob shog: sngags sham: tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: sgrub pa'i gtor sdong gnas bzhir bzhag la myang : oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ gtor gzhong rang byung dbyings kyi gzhal med khang : gtor ma'i ngo bo rig pa'i ye shes bcud: lha dang dbyer med gtor ma'i dbang bskur bas: ratna thod phreng dbang bzhi rdzogs thob shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥbadzra gu ru ratna thod phreng rtsal kā ya wākka tsitta sarba a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ de dag mtha' ru bkra shis g.yang gtad dbang : yongs rdzogs grub pa'i mtha' brten mnga' gsol bya: bkra shis dge legs yun du gnas par gyur: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: zab rgya: gtad rgya: sbas rgya: gsang rgya: gu hya: ྀatsha: ces pa'ang 'gro 'dul pad rgyal gling pa'i sbas yul padma bkod kyi chos sde yang dag pa'o// // sku gsum dgongs 'dus las/ sgos sgrub thod phreng sde lnga'i spyi chings sngon rjes mtshams sbyar bzhugs so/ dug lnga gnas dag ye shes lnga yi dngos/ phrin las lnga rdzogs rigs lnga thod phreng rtsal/ dbyer med sku lnga rigs 'dus bla ma la/ btud nas dgos sgrub spyi ching khol phyung bya*/ de la sku gsum dgongs pa 'dus pa'i chos sde chen po'i yan lag thod phreng sde lnga'i gter gzhung las/ sbyoraba'i chos rnams gsang ba'i gzhung bzhin bya: zhes 'byung ba bzhin zur 'don zhus par/ thog mar tshig bdun gsol 'debs nas brtsams phrin las snying po'i gsol 'debs sngon gtor dkar dmar song nas skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ dang po skyabs sems ni/ rang gi snying kha'i 'od kyis mdun gyi nam mkhar rigs 'dus bla ma thod phreng rtsal dkon mchog rtsa gsum rgya mtsho'i sprin phung 'phro ba badzra sa mā ya dzaḥ
