sa sad par mos la/ na moḥ phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i skyabs yul ma lus pa: ye shes gcig gi dbyings su 'dus pa'i dpyid: padma 'byung gnas sgyu 'phrul rtsa ba'i lhar: byang chub snying po'i bar du skyabs su mchi: lan gsum/ hoḥ ji ltar sngon gyi bde gshegs sras bcas kyi: 'gro ba'i don du bla med thugs bskyed bzhin: bdag gis nyes spyod kun sdom dge chos sdud: smon 'jug don dam byang sems rtag tu bskyed/ lan gsum/ gnyis pa tshogs bsags ni/ hūm̐ rang rig bla ma thod phreng dkyil 'khor lhar: gnyis su med pa'i gar gyis phyag 'tshal lo: tshogs drug zhen pa bral ba'i mchod sprin 'bul: gzung 'dzin dri ma lta ba'i klong du bshags: bla med lta sgom spyod la rjes yi rang : brjod med don gyi chos 'khor bskor bar bskul: bde chen 'pho 'gyur bral bar rtag bzhugs gsol: 'khor gsum dmigs mtha' bral ba'i pha mthar bsngo: lhun grub gzhon nu bum skur byang chub shog: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim pas rgyud byin gyis rlabs par gyur bar bsam/ gsum pa bka' bsgo ba ni/ oṃ badzra kro ta shrī he ru ka rang nyid skad cig gis gnyug ma'i lha rdo rje he ru ka'i skur gyur/ gtor ma byin rlabs gong du ma byas na gong bzhin bya/ sarba bhu ta a karṣa ya dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa mgron bkugs la/ oṃ sarba bighnān na ma sarba ta thā ga ta bhyoḥsogs nas ba liṃ ta ye swā hā: lan gsum gyi gtor ma bsngos la/ hūm̐: rdo rje khro bo'i rgyal po'i bka' byung bas/ bla med gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor 'dir: 'du ba'i lha ni ma gtog glags lta'i bgegs: gtor ma 'di long rang gnas bde bar dengs: dam las 'da' na tshig par gdon mi za: de bas da lta nyid du phyir dengs shig: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ gul yungs bdug brab kyis rdzas bcas bskrad/ bzhi pa mtshams gcod ni/ hūm̐:

he ru ka yi gsang gsum ye shes mdangs: phyi snod gzhal yas nang bcud sems can lha: snang srid dag pa rab 'byams dkyil 'khor la/ gnyis 'dzin bgegs kyi bar chad ga la srid/ mtshams kyi dkyil 'khor rang bzhin lhun gyis grub: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra kro ta dzñā na rakṣa āḥ lnga pa mchod rdzas byin rlabs ni: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: bdag gi thugs ka'i ye shes me rlung chus: snod bcud dngos 'dzin dri ma dbyings su sbyang : gnas yul rnam dag 'og min mngon dga'i zhing : phyi nang mchod sprin ye shes rol bar gyur: oṃ āḥbadzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐ swā hā: de bzhin du/ dhū pe/ a lo ke /gandhe/ nai wi dye/ shabda āḥhūm̐ swā hā: oṃ ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta bha liṃ ta hūm̐ hrī ṭhaḥ oṃ bho dhi tsitta ma hā ta na ga na pū dza āḥhūm̐: zhes byin rlabs/ gnyis pa dngos gzhir rang gzhung bzhin bskyed bzlas mchod bstod bar so so'i gzhung ltar bya'o/ thod phreng sde lnga'i spyi ching las stod las zur 'debs gzhung las zur du phyung ba'o// dbang chog spyi ching zur du gsal lo/ thod phreng sde lnga'i spyi ching las rjes gyi bya ba smad las zur 'debs ni/ rjes kyi las rim phrin las gzhung ltar ro: zhes gsungs pas/ tshogs mchod bya ba la/ dang po tshogs rdzas gtsang bsags byin rlabs ni: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: bdag gi thugs las 'byung ba'i yi ge 'phros: me rlung chu yis tshogs kyi dngos 'dzin sbyangs: slar yang oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis tshogs rdzas rnams: sbyang rtogs sbar bas ye shes 'khor lor gyur: oṃ āḥbhrūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ gnyis pa spyan 'dren ni: hūm̐: o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams: padma ge sar sdong po la: ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes: padma 'byung gnas zhes su grags: 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor: khyed kyi rjes su bdag bsgrub kyi: tshogs kyi 'du bar gshegs su gsol: gnas mchog 'di ru byin phob la:

tshogs mchod ye shes bdud rtsi bsgyur: sgrub mchog bdag la dbang bzhi bskur: bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: badzra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ bla med gsang chen sngags kyi dam tshig rdzas: bde chen tshogs kyi 'khor lo e ma rmad: a la la ste thugs dam dbyings su skong : srid zhi mnyam nyid thig le chen po'i dbyings: khams gsum 'khor ba'i sems can thams cad kyi: nyams chags rtog tshogs ma spang rang grol nas: rang rig dag pa sku gsum mngon gyur te: kun bzang gdod ma'i gzhi la sangs rgyas shog: oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyoḥhūm̐: tshogs kyi rtogs pa bskyed cing nyams chags bskang : gsum pa mchod pa ni: hūm̐: bla med tshogs kyi mchod pa dam pa 'di: dpag med 'dod yon lha mos gar bsgyur bcas: gu ru rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: bzhes nas dbang dang dngos grub bstsal du gsol: ma hā ga ṇa tsakra bha lingta pū dzaḥkhā hi: bzhi pa bshags pa ni: hoḥ ye thog 'khrul gzhi blang nas da lta'i bar: rig dang ma rig 'khrul pa'i las dbang gis: bcas dang rang bzhin nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs: 'dod yon tshogs kyi 'khor los bskang zhing bshags: badzra sa ma ya shuddhe a: lnga pa bsgral bstab ni: nṛ tri sarba sha truṃ a karṣa ya dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa 'gugs la/ hūm̐: gzung 'dzin 'khrul ba'i rang gzugs dgra dang bgegs: stong nyid rnam thar e yi brub khung du: tshad med phyag rgya rnam bzhis dbyer med bstim: rnam shes dbyings sgrol gzugs phung zhal du stob: a spha ra ṇa phaṭḥkyis spar/ dgra bgegs nṛ tri sarba sha truṃ mā ra ya phaṭḥkyis bsgral/ ma hā māṃ sa rakta kiṃ ni ri ti sarba ru tra pra wan tsakra pū dzaḥkha kha khā hi: ha ha ha: hi hi hi: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐:gis stabs/ drug pa lhag ma ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: hūm̐ bhyoḥ lhag la dbang ba'i dkyil 'khor mtha' skyong ba: dpal gyi 'khor tshogs badzra a ra li:

ma tshogs dbang phyug ging lang 'bar ma'i tshogs: lhag gtor dgyes bzhes rnam bzhi'i phrin las sgrub: utstshi ṭa ba liṃ ta khā hi: bdun pa thugs dam bskul ba ni: hūm̐: phyogs bcu dag pa'i dkyil 'khor yangs pa nas: thugs rjes dgongs shig bslu med dkon mchog gsum: dbyings nas bzhengs shig gu ru rtsa gsum lha: gdan gsum dkyil 'khor khrag 'thung rgyud sde'i tshogs: brgyud gsum dam can srung ma las la bzhengs: sna tshogs gang 'dul phrin las dus la bab: phyi yi dus 'khrugs snod kyi rgud pa sol: nang gi 'byung 'khrugs nad mug mtshon gsum bzlog: gsang ba sems 'khrul dug lnga'i rnam rtog gzhil: shin tu mi bsrun gdul dka' tshar gcod pa'i: phrin las myur du mdzod cig sa ma ya: brgyad pa chad tho bsgrags pa ni: hūm̐ bhyoḥ dus gsum brgyud gsum rig 'dzin bla ma dang : he ru ka yi dam la rab gnas pa'i: bka' yi lha 'dre rgyud gsum dregs pa'i sde: chad tho gtor ma longs la phrin las sgrubs: dgu pa brtan ma skyong ba ni: ma bhyoḥ khyad par slob dpon padma kā ra yis: bka' dang dam gnas bod khams skyong ba'i ma: dus sbyor bcu gnyis dag pa'i brtan skyong tshogs: bshal chu'i gtor ma dgyes bzhes phrin las mdzod: oṃ ma ma hriṃ hriṃ ba liṃ ta khā hi: bcu pa bro brdung bya ba ni: hūm̐: rnam thar gsum ldan e yi dbyings nyid du: gzung 'dzin mtshan mar lta ba'i dam sri thub: ye shes lnga yis glu blangs bro brdung bas: 'od gsal stong nyid bde ba'i klong du sba: oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā: laṃ ya ma dam sri tri satwaṃ bha ya nan: bcu gcig pa dngos grub len pa ni: hoḥ rigs 'dus thod phreng lha tshogs dgongs su gsol: sku gsung thugs kyi bha ga yangs pa nas: phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub dang : thun mong las bzhi grub brgyad 'dod rgu'i char: da lta nyid du bstsal zhing brtan par mdzod: rtsa sngags dang :

kā ya wākka tsitta sarba siddhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ bcu gnyis pa nongs bshags ni: hoḥ gsang ba'i sgor zhugs rnal 'byor sgrub pa po'i: bag med dbang gyur ting 'dzin ma gsal zhing : lha sngags ma dag cho gar lhag chad sogs: ye shes lha dang srung mar bzod par gsol: yig brgya bzla: bcu gsum pa dkyil 'khor bsdu rim ni: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: snang cha lha sngags 'khor lo dbyings su bsdu: mi gnas thugs kyi thig les rtag mtha' bral: ā ā āḥ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ stong nyid rang gdangs thugs rje'i ye shes rtsal: sku gsung thugs kyi 'khor los chad mtha' spangs: oṃ āḥhūm̐: badzra ma ma ka wā tsi rakṣa haṃ: bcu bzhi bsngo smon ni: hoḥ bdag gis dus gsum dge ba ci bsags mthus: nam mkha'i mthar thug gyur pa'i sems can kun: bla med theg mchog sngags kyi snod gyur nas: padma rgyal po'i go 'phang myur thob shog: bco lnga pa bkra shis ni: hrīḥ rnga sgra'i rgyal po gzi brjid 'od dpag med: spyan ras gzigs dbang dbang chen rta skad 'tsher: sgyu 'phrul drwa ba padma rgyal po che: sku gsum lhun grub rgyal ba'i bkra shis shog: ces me tog gi char phab pas dge legs su bya'o// /ces bla ma'i thugs sgrub sku gsum dgongs pa 'dus pa'i sgos sgrub thod phreng sde lnga gang du'ang sbyar chog pa'i dbang du byas nas gter gzhung dgongs pa bzhin gsal bar byas pa 'di yang bye brag thod phreng lnga so sor nyams su len pa dang*/ dbang bskur dang phrin las bye brag la 'jug pa'i skabs med mi rung ba'i cha rkyen gal che yang rang 'dra'i gzhung don go ba slong mi nus pa rnams kyi don gyi khog mi khrol bas tshig gi kha bsgyur sogs dka' ba'i gnas su mthong la ched du 'jug pa bde phyir/ gter slob tha shal ba gsang sngags bstan 'dzin 'bod pa'i gter chen bla ma'i zhal rgyun sngar nas bri 'dun yod pa'i khar chos kyi mched po mkhan po bsod nams rdor rje mchog nas kyang bla ma skal ldan sogs 'dus dmangs yongs nas dka' ba'i gnad rnams 'grol zhing yig thog du 'beb dgos zhes snga phyir nan bskul yid bzhag thog
e wam̐ gsang sngags gling du rab byung bcu bdun pa'i shing mo bya yi lo smin zla'i dkar pa'i phyogs bzang ba gnyis pa'i tshes la sdeb pa siddhi rastu/

sku gsum dgongs 'dus la: gu ru ratna thod phreng rtsal gyi sgos sgrub bzhugs so: ratna thod phreng rtsal la phyag 'tshal lo: rgyal pa'i phrin las mtha' dag 'grub pa dang : nyams rtogs ye shes rtsal chen rgyas 'dod na: ratna thod phreng rtsal gyi sgrub thabs bstan: sa ma ya: de tshul sbyor ba dngos dang rjes gsum las: sbyor ba'i chos rnams gsang ba'i gzhung bzhin bya: dngos gzhi dam tshig 'khor lo sgom pa ni: oṃ ma hā shū n+ya ta dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ: āḥ stong nyid 'od gsal de bzhin nyid dbyings las: rig pa'i rang rtsal byang chub sems kyi sprin: skad cig mkha' la skar chen shar ba bzhin: bskyed rgyu'i sa bon trām̐ yig ser gsal shar: de las 'od 'phros snod bcud dngos 'dzin sbyangs: e yam̐ bam̐ ram̐ lam̐ las yum lnga'i mkhar: 'byung lnga rim brtsegs ri rab srung 'khor dbus: bhrūm̐ las rang byung lhun grub gzhal med khang : sgo gru rta bab mtshan nyid yongs rdzogs dbus: sna tshogs 'dab bzhi'i lte bar rta mchog khrir: thabs shes zung 'jug nyi zla 'od 'bar steng : trām̐ las gu ru ratna thod phreng ser: zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum zhi 'dzum sgeg: phyag g.yas rin chen 'bar ba thugs kar gtod: phyag g.yon de yi yu ba byas ba yi: dril bu dkur brten rin chen phag mo 'khyud: rin chen dril bu yab kyi sku la 'khril : dar dang ratna rus pa'i rgyan gyis spras: zhabs gnyis rdor skyil 'ja' 'od klong du gsal: rigs kyi bdag po rin chen 'byung ldan shar: phyogs bzhi'i 'dab mar rta mgrin rigs bzhi dang : sgo bzhir tshad med ging chen yab yum sogs: bdag skyob lha dang rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: bsam gyis mi khyab nyi zer rdul ltar 'khrigs: du mar snang yang ngo bo ngang du gcig: rgyas pa'i las mdzad ratna thod phreng rtsal: dran pa tsam gyis srid zhi'i gdung ba sel: sgom pa tsam gyis tshe dang ye shes rgyas:

snang stong sgyu ma chu zla lta bur gsal: gdod nas rnam dag ye shes lngar dbang rdzogs: rgyal kun rdo rje gsum gyi ngo bor dag: trām̐ hūm̐ oṃ hrīḥ.āḥ.a bhi ṣañtsa maṃ: oṃ āḥhūm̐: ye shes kyi 'khor lo spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: yul gyi mi ni rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul: lho phyogs sku la rdzogs pa'i dur khrod nas: rgyas pa'i las la mthar phyin dngos grub brnyes: gu ru ratna thod phreng zhes su grags: 'khor du rig 'dzin dpa' bo mkha' 'gros bskor: gu ru khyed kyi rjes su bdag sgrub kyis: rnal 'byor byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol: tshe bsod ye shes rgyas pa'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru dhāe wa ḍākki nī sarba dzñā na maṇḍal badzra sa mā ya dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs gnyis su med par gyur: phyag dang mchod pa gsang ba'i gzhung bzhin bya: zhes pas/ hoḥ ji ltar chu nyid la ni chu thim ltar: dbyer med lha la lha thim ngo mtshar che: gnyis med chu zla'i gar gyis phyag 'tshal lo: na mo na ma hoḥ mchod pa ni oṃ āḥhūm̐: dngos 'byor yid sprul 'phrul dga'i longs spyod bzhin: phyag rgya gar sogs phyi nang gsang ba yi: kun tu bzang po bla med mchod sprin gyis: rgyas ba'i dkyil 'khor ma lus ma nyes gyur cig: oṃ gu ru dhāe wa dhā ki nī sarba dzñā na maṇḍal sa pā ri wa ra badzra arghaṃsogs nas shabda'i bar gyi phyi mchod dang : oṃ ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta ma hā rakta ma hā ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi:sa nang mchod dang : oṃ bho dhi tsitta ma hā ta na ga ṇa pū dza āḥhūm̐:gis gsang mchod bcas 'bul: bstod pa ni: hrīḥ ma bcos spros bral bla ma chos kyi sku: bde chen longs spyod bla ma chos kyi rje: pad sdong las 'khrungs bla ma sprul pa'i sku: sku gsum dbyer med mchog la phyag 'tshal bstod: trām̐: mnyam nyid ye shes klong nas sku sprul pa: bde chen longs spyod bla ma he ru kaḥ

rgyas pa'i phrin las mthar phyin 'khor lo'i bsgyur: ratna thod phreng rtsal la phyag 'tshal bstod: trām̐: byin rlabs rtsa ba bla ma thod phreng rtsal: dngos grub rtsa ba yi dam hya ghṛ: phrin las rtsa ba dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: bzlas par bsnyen pa'i rnal 'byor ni: thugs dbus padma nyi ma dregs pa'i steng : ratna rta mgrin ye shes sems dpa'i tshul: ser nag nor bu mtshan pa'i gri thod 'dzin: rang 'od yum sbyor dur khrod chas rdzogs 'gying : thugs kar thabs shes nyi zla kha sbyor dbus: trām̐ mthar sngags 'khor 'od kyis zhing kun khyab: rgyas ba sras bcas kun gyi thugs dam bskang : 'gro drug sems can kun gyi las nyon sbyangs: tshur 'dus byin rlabs dngos grub rang la thim: rig stong mi 'gyur ka dag zal thal ngang : oṃ āḥhūm̐: badzra ma hā gu ru ratna thod phreng rtsal sarba siddhi hūm̐: 'bum phrag bzhi bzlas dngos grub thob par 'gyur: slar yang sngar bzhin thugs srog trām̐ ser mthar: sgrub sngags rang sgra sgrog bzhin 'khor ba las: 'od kyis phog pas phyi snod gzhal yas khang : nang bcud sems can lhar gyur sngags kyi sgra: bung ba tshang zhig lta bur di ri ri: grag stong brag chu dran stong 'od gsal dbyings: snang srid gzhir bzhengs ye shes rdzogs par gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru ratna thod phreng rtsal badzra sa mā ya dzaḥsiddhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ 'bum phrag gcig gis dngos grub thob par 'gyur: las sbyor ni: slar yang thugs srog sngags las 'od zer ni: gser mdog sna tshogs nor bu'i rnam pa can: grangs med rab 'phros phyi nang kun tu khyab: tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang 'byor ba dang : legs tshogs yon tan nyams rtogs ye shes kun: yar zla bzhin rgyas tshur 'dus snying khar thim: 'gyur med rig pa'i ye shes rtsal rdzogs gyur: sgrub sngags mthar: sarba dzñā na puṣṭiṃ ku ru swā hā:

khri yis rgyas pa'i phrin las 'grub par 'gyur: rjes kyi las rim phrin las gzhung ltar ro: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: zab rgya: gtad rgya: sbas rgya: gsang rgya: gu hya: ྀatsha: zhes pa'ang 'gro 'dul pad rgyal gling pa'i sbas yul padma bkod kyi chos sde yang dag pa'o// // sku gsum dgongs 'dus las: gu ru ratna thod phreng rtsal gyi g.yang sgrub nor bu 'od 'bar zhes bya ba bzhugs so: gu ru ratna thod phreng rtsal la 'dud: ma 'ongs dus su phyi nang 'byung bcud nyams: dbul phongs mu ges 'gro rnams nyams thag tshe: dgos 'dod kun 'byung nor bu 'od 'bar 'di: padma bdag gis 'gro la brtse bas gdams: sa ma ya: bkra shis g.yang chags rgud skyon ma gos pa'i: g.yang gi rdzas kyis phyur bur bkang ba yi: bkra shis bum bzang bkra shis g.yang rwa'i dbus: sku gsung thugs kyi rten bcas mchod pas spras: bdag gi rnal 'byor bla ma'i las gzhung bsrang : rgab 'dre bskrad cing dam rmug brtsog mnol grib: bsangs khrus dag byed srung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom: mchod brlab rten bskyed spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol dang : phyag mchod bstod bzlas thugs dam bskul ba dang : dngos grub len dang bkra shis g.yang gtad dang : gta' sdom smon lam bkra shis spel ba'o: dang po sgab 'dre bse rag bskrad pa ni: hūm̐: nga ni dbang drag padma he ru kaḥ nyon cig bse rag dbul sri ltogs 'gong tshogs: dbus kyi ri rab lho phyogs 'dzam gling 'dir: spyi mthun chos nor longs spyod spel ba la: rang rang las kyi dbang gis mi 'tshams pa'i: dbul sri mi la bse rag zhes bya ba: gang gi rgyu ni ser sna'i rang gzugs te: rkyen ni rgyu mthun yi dwags yid kyi lus: sna tshogs gzugs su brdzu zhing dpal g.yang rku: snod bcud rten 'brel legs tshogs spel ba la: byung dang mi kha god kha gang stong sogs: rnam kun bar chad sna tshogs rgab 'dre sdang : ltogs 'gong dbul sri 'byung po'i sde tshogs kun:

tshwa raṃ rgog g.yer la sogs mi kha'i rdzas: rang rang yid mthun yas rtags 'di longs la: lan chags bu lon 'brel thag chod par gyis: myur du mtha' yas rgya mtsho'i pha mthar song : bsgo ba'i bka' las 'da' na lus ngag yid: yi dam drag tu khros pa'i ting 'dzin gyis: rdul phran bzhin du brlag par gdon mi za: de bas da lta nyid du phyir dengs shig: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: u tsa ṭa ya phaṭḥ ye shes lnga yi srung 'khor brtan par sgom: gnyis pa dag byed bsang khrus bya ba ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: lha shing bsangs kyis mi bsang gang yang med: chab gtsang khrus kyis mi dag gang yang med: gtsang sme gnyis 'dzin sems kyi 'khrul snang char: brtsog mnol dme yug mi gtsang grib phog pas: phyi nang 'byung 'khrugs rten 'brel nyes tshogs kun: 'byung lnga rnam dag yum lnga'i mkha' dbyings klong : chos nyid rnam dag dbyings su dag gyur cig: oṃ e ho shuddhe shuddhe swā hā: de bzhin du: yam̐ ho? bam̐ ho? lam̐ ho? ram̐ ho? e yam̐ bam̐ lam̐ ram̐ ho shuddhe shuddhe swā hā a a swā hā: gsum pa mchod rdzas la sogs byin rlabs ni: hūm̐: bdag nyid thugs las ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gsum 'phros: ye shes me rlung chu yis dngos 'dzin sbyangs: bhrūm̐ las gnas yul rin chen sems dpa'i zhing : trām̐ las yo byad nor ba'i drwa ba mdzes: hūm̐ las mchod sprin mkha' dbyings gang bar gyur: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: spha ra ṇa phaṭḥ bhrūm̐ trām̐ hūm̐: spha ra ṇa khaṃ: na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhyo bi shwa sogs nam mkha' mdzod kyis sngags rgyas brlabs: bzhi pa mdun rten dam tshig bskyed pa ni: oṃ hya ghṛ wa hūm̐ phaṭḥ las chus bsangs: oṃ ma hā shu n+ya ta dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ: stong nyid 'od gsal de bzhin nyid dbyings las: rig pa'i rang rtsal byang chub sems kyi sprin: mdun du 'byung lnga rim brtsegs ri rab steng : bhrūm̐ las pho brang rin chen gzhal yas khang :

sgo gru rta bab phyi nang mtshan rdzogs dbus: rin chen khri rkang rab mtho pad zla'i gdan: rab tu yangs shing 'od phung 'bar ba'i dbus: bdag gi thugs las trām̐ yig ser po 'phros: 'od zer 'phro 'du phyi nang 'byung bcud 'dus: 'dod 'byung ratna 'od 'bar rnam par gyur: skad cig dran rdzogs yid bzhin nor bu'i sku: o rgyan bla ma ratna thod phreng rtsal: sku mdog ser snum btso ma gser gyi mdog: zhi ma khro nyams rjes chags 'od rab 'bar: zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas pas nor bu dang : g.yon pas nor skyugs ne'u le'i rgyal ba bsnams: padma'i prog zhu dar dang rin chen brgyan: rang 'od rin chen phag mo gnyis med sbyor: rin chen gri thod phyag rgya lnga yis brgyan: spyi bor tshe dpag med mgon rigs kyi bdag: dmar gsal mnyam bzhag tshe bum longs sku'i chas: phyogs bzhir padma 'dab bzhir nor gyi lha: shar du hūm̐ las thugs mchog nor gyi lha: mgon po dzam nag bai ḍūrya yi mdog: gnod sbyin mo mnan bzhengs stabs gsang rdor sgreng : gcer bu khro gtum brjid ldan gsus skyems rgyas: kham nag ral 'khyil sbrul rgyan thod khrag 'dzin: mchan khung g.yon du nor skyu ne'u le bsnams: lho ru trām̐ las yon tan nor gyi lha: mgon po dzam ser 'dzam bu chu gser mdog: zhal gcig phyag gnyis brjid ldan gsus skyems rgyas: phyag g.yas shing 'bras birba rlon pa dang : g.yon pas nor skyug ne'u le rkyal pa 'dzin: rin chen prog gzhu dar dang ratnas brgyan: nub tu hrīḥlas dbang gi nor gyi lha: rig byed dmar mo nyi ma 'char kha'i mdog: dam sri mo mnan bzhengs stabs 'gyings bag ldan: cung zad mche gtsig khro zhing chags pa'i nyams: dbu skra kham nag bsil bas sku rgyab khebs: thod skam rtse phran ratna dar dpyangs mdze: zhal gcig spyan gsum phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis: padmas mtshan pa'i lcags kyu zhags pa dang :

'og ma gnyis kyis padma'i mda' gzhu 'geng: nu ma 'bur zhing stag gi sham thabs spras: bde nyams rus rgyan padma'i chun po dang : dar dang ratna sna tshogs rgyan gyis brgyan: byang du bai las phrin las nor gyi lha: rnam mang thos sras ser smug chu gser mdog: seṅge la bcibs lha yi go khrab brjid: zhal gcig phyag gnyis gzhi brjid nyi ltar 'bar: zhi ma khro nyams brjid chags snum bag ldan: zhal gcig phyag gnyis mdung dmar rgyal mtshan g.yas: g.yon pas nor skyu ne'u le'i rkyal pa 'dzin: dbu la rin chen padma'i prog zhu gsol: snyan cha mgul rgyan nor bu'i do shal mdzes: ye shes las dang 'jig rten las grub pa'i: dngos grub char 'bebs rab 'byams nor lhas bskor: sgo bzhir pad zlar dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥlas: tshad med phrin las rnam bzhi'i lha mo bzhi: shar sgor 'gugs byed dkar mo lcags kyu 'dzin: lho sgor sdom byed ser mo zhags pa 'dzin: nub sgor rmongs byed dmar mo lcags sgrog 'dzin: byang du myos byed ljang mo dril bu 'dzin: gcer bu rus rgyan las bzhi'i nyams ldan gsal: gzhan yang sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang : bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong tshogs: nyi zer rdul ltar 'phro 'du'i rang bzhin gyur: gtso bo'i thugs ka'i 'od kyis dbang gi lha: gdan gsum tshang ba nam mkha' gang ba yis: rdo rje'i glu dang me tog char 'bebs bzhin: bkra shis rnam pa du mas dbang bskur bas: phung po lnga dang rnam dag ye shes lnga: mngon gyur rgyal ba rigs lngas dbu brgyan gyur: trām̐ hūm̐ oṃ hrī āḥ a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ: kun gyi gnas gsum 'bru gsum mtshan pa las: rgyal kun rdo rje gsum gyi ngo bor gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ kā ya wākka tsitta badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ: thugs srog 'od kyis bskul bas ye shes kyis: 'khor lo mdun gyi nam mkhar sa mā dzaḥ lnga pa ye shes 'khor lor spyan 'dren ni:

hūm̐: gling gi gling mchog dag pa rnga yab gling : dpal ri padma 'od kyis gzhal yas nas: rtsa gsum 'dus zhal gu ru yid bzhin nor: thugs rje'i sgyu 'phrul bkod pa bsam yas las: nyam thag 'gro ba'i dbul phongs sel ba'i phyir: rgyas pa'i las mdzad ratna thod phreng rtsal: ye shes 'jig rten las la grub pa yi: rab 'byams nor lha rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas: thugs rje'i dbang gis gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru ratna thod phreng rtsal badzra sa mā ya dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ drug pa gnyis med bzhugs gsol ni: hūm̐: bkra shis 'od 'bar g.yang gi pho brang 'dir: thabs shes nyi zla bzhugs gnas dwangs re spro: gu ru rtsa gsum nor lha rab 'byams tshogs: gang 'dod dngos grub stsol phyir dgyes bzhugs gsol: badzra sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan: bdun pa phyag 'tshal ni: na moḥ skye 'gag 'gyur med phrin las rab 'byams rdzogs: rang byung thugs rjes 'gro ba'i dbul phong sel: dngos grub char 'bebs rtsa gsum nor gyi lha: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal lo: a ti pu ho: pra tītstsha hoḥ brgyad pa mchod pa 'bul ba ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: dngos 'byor yid sprul 'phrul dga'i longs spyod bzhin: nyer spyod 'dod yon bkra shis rdzas rtags sogs: kun tu bzang po bla med mchod sprin gyis: rtsa gsum nor lha'i lha tshogs mnyes gyur cig: oṃ badzra puṣpe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda rū pa shabda gandhe rā sa sparshe dharma dhā tu pū dza hoḥ oṃ ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta bha lingta kha kha khā hi: ma hā ta na ga ṇa pū dza hoḥ

dgu pa rdo rje glu yi bstod pa ni: hūm̐: ma bcos spros bral bla ma chos kyi sku: bde chen logs spyod bla ma chos kyi rje: pad sdong las 'khrungs bla ma sprul pa'i sku: sku gsum rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: thugs rje'i sgyu 'phrul bkod pa bsam yas las: rgyas pa'i las mdzad ratna thod phreng rtsal: dgos 'dod re skong rab 'byams nor lha'i rje: dngos grub char 'bebs khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: thugs kyi nor lha mgon po dzambha la: dbyig gi char 'bebs baiḍūrya yi mdog: gri thod 'dzin cing sbrul gyi chun pos brgyan: dngos grub kun 'byung khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod: trāṃ: yon tan nor lha arya dzambha la: 'dod rgu mchog stsol btso ma gser gyi mdog: shing 'bras ne'u le 'dzin cing ratnas brgyan: 'byor drug rgyas mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod: hrīḥ dbang gi nor lha bcom ldan rig byed yum: khams gsum dbang bsdud padma rā ga'i mdog: lcags kyu zhags pa padma'i mda' gzhu 'geng : mos bzhi dbang mdzad yum la phyag 'tshal bstod: baiḥ phrin las nor lha byang skyong rnam thos sras: rgyas mdzad gser mdog rtsal chen seṅge bzhon: mdung dmar rgyal mtshan nor 'dzin go khrab brjid: 'gro ba'i ro skong khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod: dzaḥ sgo bzhir tshad med phrin las rnam bzhi'i yum: dkar ser dmar ljang rigs kyi phrin las mdog: lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu 'dzin: las bzhi'i dngos grub srung la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: gzhan yang rtsa gsum nor lha'i dkyil 'khor 'dir: dam tshig thugs rje'i dbang gis 'dus pa yi: ye shes 'jig rten rab 'byams nor gyi lha: sprin ltar gtib pa'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: bla ma nor lha'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: rtse gcig gsol btab mchod bstod byin rlabs kyis: 'gro rnams dbul ba'i sdug bsngal las grol te: dpal 'byor longs spyod rgyas par mdzad du gsol:

bcu pa dzap bzla ba ni: hrīḥ rigs bdag tshe dpag med mgon thugs ka ru: zla steng hrīḥdamar mtha' mar rtsa ba'i sngags: g.yas 'khor 'od kyis rgyal mchod dbang byin bsdus: 'khor 'das tshe bcud bdud rtsi'i rnam par drangs: phyag gi bum nang gang nas phyir lud te: bdag gi tshangs bug nas zhugs lus kun gang : nad gdon tshe yi bar chad kun zhi zhing : tshe dang bsod nams ye shes rgyas par bsam: oṃ a ma ra ṇi dzi wante ye swā hā: ci mang bzlas pas nad gdon bar chad zhi: tshe dang bsod nams ye shes rgyas pa dang : dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba bzlog par 'gyur: gtso bo ratna thod phreng thugs ka ru: zla steng rin chen 'od 'bar nang khongs su: trām̐ mthar sngags phreng ser po g.yas su 'khor: 'od 'phros phyogs dus rgyal ba rab 'byams mchod: thams cad gu ru ratna thod phreng gi: lha sngags phyag rgya'i rnam par sib sib byon: bdag mdun rten rdzas la thim gzi 'od 'bar: 'od zer mar 'phros ma dag snod bcud kyi: bcud nyams rgud pa'i dbul phongs sdug bsngal bsal: snod bcud rin chen sems dpa'i zhing du gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru ratna thod phreng rtsal sarba siddhi pha la hūm̐: 'di nyid kho na gtso bor 'bad de bzla: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub ma lus thob: dzam nag thugs kar zla steng hūm̐ mthing mthar: sngags 'khor 'od kyis snod bcud 'byung ba lnga'i: bcud bsdus sna tshogs nor bu'i char bab ste: gnas khang bang mdzod ltem ltem gang bar bsam: oṃ ind+ra ni mu khaṃ sbra ma ri swā hā: zhes bzlas: rin chen dbyig dang nor phyugs 'phel: dzam ser thugs kar zla steng trāṃ ser mthar: sngags 'khor 'od kyis snod bcud rgud pa sel: tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang 'byor pa rgyas: 'bru nor longs spyod shing 'bras birba yi: rnam par char bzhin bsdus te yul khams sa'i: khyon gang 'bru nor longs spyod rgyas par bsam:

oṃ dzambha la dza lend+ra ye swā hā: zhes bzlas: 'bru nor sa bcud longs spyod 'phel: rig byed lha mo'i thugs kar nyi gdan la: padma hrūm̐ḥdamar mtha' mar rang sngags ni: g.yon 'khor 'od kyis 'khor 'das rten g.yo'i khams: rgyal blon btsun mo che rgu gnyan bcu dang : lha klu mi ma yin gyi rgyud bskul nas: khab len rdo yi lcags phye blang ba bzhin: gang mos zas nor 'dod rgu dbang du bsdus: bdag mdun sgrub rdzas rnams la thim par bsam: oṃ ku ru kulle swā hā: zhes bzlas: khams gsum ma lus dbang 'dus 'gyur: rnam sras thugs kar zla steng baiḥser mthar: sngags 'khor 'od kyis rab 'byams nor gyi lha: rgyud bskul 'jig rten khams na srid pa yi: dpal 'byor longs spyod zas nor dbang du bsdus: bdag mdun rten rdzas la thim yid bzhin gyi: nor bu dbang gi rgyal po dngos su gyur: oṃ bai shra ma ṇa ye swā hā: zhes bzlas: 'bru nor longs spyod rkang 'gro 'phel: gtso bo'i thugs ka'i 'od kyis phyogs bzhi yi: lha mo bzhi bskul rang rang phrin las bzhis: phywa g.yang longs spyod 'gugs bstim rgyas gdab te: nam yang mi nyams srung ba'i las byed bsam: oṃ ma ma dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho sarba ba su ratna rakṣantu swā hā: zhes bzlas: phywa g.yang mi nyams srung bar 'gyur: sa ma ya: bcu gcig pa thugs dam bskul ba ni: spos gtul rol mo gdung bas dbyangs kyis bskul: hrīḥ steng gi phyogs nas dngos grub bskul ba'i lha: bcom ldan mgon po ye shes tshe dpag med: sku mdog dmar po padma rā ga'i mdangs: zhal gcig phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag tshe bum 'dzin: mda' dar g.yab cing gdung bas bskul lags na: sngon gyi thugs dam ma g.yel dbyings nas bzhengs: phyag 'tshal mchod pa 'bul lo dngos grub stsol: tshe dang ye shes dpag med 'phel ba dang : mi 'gyur rdo rje tshe yi dngos grub stsol: oṃ a ma ra ṇ-i dzi wante ye swā hā:

oṃ tshe bhrūm̐ g.yu bhrūm̐ g.yu tshe bhrūm̐ dzñā na puṣṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: hūm̐: dbus kyi phyogs nas dngos grub bskul ba'i lha: rgyas pa'i las mdzad ratna thod phreng rtsal: sku mdog ser po gtso ma gser gyi mdog: zhal gcig phyag gnyis rin chen nor skyug 'dzin: mda' dar g.yab cing gdung bas bskul lags na: sngon gyi thugs dam ma g.yel dbyings nas bzhengs: phyag 'tshal mchod pa 'bul lo dngos grub stsol: phyogs bcu'i nor dang longs spyod bcud bsdusal: dbul phongs 'jigs las sgrol ba'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru ratna thod phreng rtsal sarba siddhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ oṃ ratna pun+yai swasti siddhi pha la bā su ratna na na kha dhi sarba 'du 'du bhrūm̐ pā shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: hūm̐: shar gyi phyogs nas dngos grub bskul ba'i lha: thugs kyi nor lha mgon po dzambha la: sku mdog sngon po baiḍūrya yi mdog: zhal gcig phyag gnyis thod khrag ne'u le 'dzin: mda' dar g.yab cing gdung bas bskul lags na: sngon gyi thugs dam ma g.yel dbyings nas bzhengs: phyag 'tshal mchod pa 'bul lo dngos grub stsol: rin chen sna tshogs dbyig nor char bzhin phob: gang 'dod bsod nams longs spyod 'phel bar mdzod: oṃ ind+ra ni mu khaṃ bhya ma ri swā hā: oṃ ratna pun+yai swasti siddha pha la bā su ratna na na kha dhi sarba 'du 'du bhrūm̐ pā shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: hūm̐: lho yi phyogs nas dngos grub bskul ba'i lha: yon tan nor lha mgon po dzambha la: sku mdog ser smug 'dzam bu chu gser mdangs: zhal gcig phyag gnyis shing 'bras ne'u le 'dzin: mda' dar g.yab cing gdung bas bskul lags na: sngon gyi thugs dam ma g.yel dbyings nas bzhengs: phyag 'tshal mchod pa 'bul lo dngos grub stsol: phyogs bcu'i 'bru nor longs spyod char bzhin bsdus: sa bcud lo thog 'bru rigs rgyas par mdzod:

oṃ dzambha la dza lend+ra ye swā hā: oṃ ratna pun+yai swasti siddha pha la bā su ratna na na kha dhi sarba 'du 'du bhrūm̐ pā shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: hūm̐: nub kyi phyogs nas dngos grub bskul ba'i lha: gsung gi nor lha bcom ldan rig byed ma: sku mdog dmar ser nyi ma 'char kha'i mdangs: zhal gcig phyag bzhi lcags kyu zhags pa dang : rab mdzes utpal mtshan pa'i mda' gzhu 'geng : mda' dar g.yab cing gdung bas bskul lags na: sngon gyi thugs dam ma g.yel dbyings nas bzhengs: phyag 'tshal mchod pa 'bul lo dngos grub stsol: lha 'dre mi gsum srog snying gnad nas bskul: khams gsum dbang bsdus zas nor char 'bebs mdzod: oṃ ku ru kulle hrīḥswā hā: oṃ ratna pun+yai swasti siddhi pha la bā su ratna na na kha dhi sarba 'du 'du bhrūm̐ pā shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: hūm̐: byang gi phyogs nas dngos grub bskul ba'i lha: phrin las nor lha rgyal chen rnam thos sras: sku mdog gser po lha yi go khrab brjid: seṅge la bcibs mdung dmar rgyal mtshan 'dzin: mda' dar g.yab cing gdung bas bskul lags na: sngon gyi thugs dam ma g.yel dbyings nas bzhengs: phyag 'tshal mchod pa 'bul lo dngos grub stsol: gling bzhi srid pa'i longs spyod kun bsdus la: rta drel gnag lug rkang bzhi 'phel rgyas mdzod: oṃ bai shra ma ṇa ye swā hā: oṃ ratna pun+yai swasti siddhi pha la bā su ratna na na kha dhi sarba 'du 'du bhrūm̐ pā shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: dzaḥ dkyil 'khor sgo bzhir dngos grub bskul ba'i lha: tshad med rnam bzhi dag pa'i lha mo bzhi: dkar ser dmar ljang las bzhi'i nyams dang ldan: lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu 'dzin: mda' dar yab cing gdung bas bskul lags na: sngon gyi thugs dam ma g.yel dbyings nas bzhengs: phyag 'tshal mchod pa 'bul lo dngos grub stsol: phywa g.yang longs spyod 'gugs bstim rgyas thob la:

mi nyams gta' sdom srung ma'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ ma ma dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho sarba bā su ratna rakṣantu swā hā: oṃ ratna pun+yai swasti siddhi pha la bā su ratna na na kha dhi sarba 'du 'du bhrūm̐ pā shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: hūm̐: gzhan yang phyogs bcu kun na legs bzhugs pa'i: 'gro ba'i don la dgongs mdzod dkon mchog gsum: bka' sdod phyogs bcu'i dkar phyogs skyong ba'i tshogs: dpag med rdzu 'phrul mnga' ba'i srung ma rnams: mda' dar g.yab cing gdung bas bskul lags na: sngon gyi thugs dam ma g.yel dbyings nas bzhengs: phyag 'tshal mchod pa 'bul lo dngos grub stsol: phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thugs rje'i g.yang : rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams kyi byin rlabs g.yang : yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi dngos grub g.yang : de ring bkra shis gnas 'dir g.yang du len: g.yang des srid pa'i mtsho las bsgrol bar mdzod: ma mo mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i phrin las g.yang : rdo rje chos skyong rnams kyi mthu rtsal g.yang : dkar phyogs skyong ba rnams kyi sdong grogs g.yang : de ring bkra shis gnas 'dir g.yang du len: g.yang des bsam don chos bzhin 'grub par mdzod: steng phyogs lha gnas rnams kyi dpal gyi g.yang : 'og phyogs klu yi yul gyi 'byor pa'i g.yang : bar phyogs gling bzhi mi yi chos nor g.yang : de ring bkra shis gnas 'dir g.yang du len: g.yang des dpal 'byor tshe bsod rgyas par mdzod: mi dbang rgyal blon stobs 'byor mnga' thang g.yang : mkhas grub rtogs ldan rnam dpyod rig pa'i g.yang : btsan phyug phan dang 'dzoms pa dpal gyi g.yang : de ring bkra shis gnas 'dir g.yang du len: g.yang des 'dod rgu phun sum tshogs par mdzod: 'chi ba med pa rdo rje tshe yi g.yang : na ba med pa rgas med lang tsho'i g.yang : sdug bsngal med pa mi tshe bde ba'i g.yang : de ring bkra shis gnas 'dir g.yang du len: g.yang des bde skyid phun sum tshogs par mdzod:

snod kyi bcud 'phel 'bru rigs 'khrungs pa'i g.yang : bcud la g.yang 'phel 'dzad med zas gos g.yang : bsod nams g.yang 'phel rkang bzhi phyugs kyi g.yang : de ring bkra shis gnas 'dir g.yang du len: g.yang des snod bcud dge legs 'phel rgyas mdzod: phan bde'i 'byung gnas sangs rgyas bstan pa'i g.yang : der 'dzin skye mchog 'phags tshogs dge 'dun g.yang : zhabs tog phun tshogs khyim bdag 'byor ldan g.yang : de ring bkra shis gnas 'dir g.yang du len: g.yang des don gnyis bsam rgu lhun 'grub shog: oṃ ya dharma sogs nas shra ma ṇa: oṃ ratna pun+yai swasti siddhi pha la bā su ratna na na kha dhi sarba 'du 'du bhrūm̐ pā shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: bcu gnyis pa dngos grub len pa ni: hūm̐: yid bzhin nor lhar 'gro ba'i re skong ba'i: bla ma nor lha'i lha tshogs dgongs su gsol: sku gsung thugs kyi bha ga yangs pa nas: phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub dang : las bzhi grub brgyad thun mong las rab 'byams: tshe bsod snyan grags stobs dpal mnga' thang dang : zas nor longs spyod 'dod rgu 'byung ba yi: dngos grub ma lus bstsal zhing brtan par mdzod: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru ratna thod phreng rtsal sarba siddhi pha la hūm̐ phaṭḥ kā ya wākka tsitta sarba karma siddhi pha la hūm̐: zhes bskul dngos grub blang zhing rdzas la rol: tshogs kyi 'khor los mchod cing nyams chags skor: bcu gsum bkra shis dngos grub g.yang gtad ni: sbyin bdag khrus dbyung srung ba'i 'khor lor sgom: skyabs sems sdom sbyin bsags sbyang sngon du btang : lhar bskyed byin dbab ye shes brtan par byas: gter bum thogs la: hūm̐: bkra shis gang zhig 'dod 'byung bum bzang 'di: 'dzad med 'dod rgu yun gyi dpal ster ba: bkra shis des kyang sbyin pa'i bdag po la: 'dzad med gter la spyod pas bkra shis shog: oṃ ratna kam bha a bhi ṣiñtsa siddhi hoḥ

rten snying brjod de spyi bor bzhag cing lag tu gtad: g.yang gtor thogs la: hūm̐: bkra shis gang zhig sgrub gtor rin chen 'bar: g.yang zhag 'khyil bas bsod nams longs spyod 'phel: bkra shis des kyang sbyin pa'i bdag po la: zas nor 'dod rgu 'byung bas bkra shis shog: rten snying dang : swasti bha lingta maṅga laṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa siddhi hoḥ gnas gsum bzhag la ras ma longs su spyod: g.yang chang thogs la: hūm̐: bkra shis gang zhig tshe yi dza gad 'dis: 'byung ba'i bcud 'phel 'chi med tshe la dbang : bkra shis des kyang sbyin pa'i bdag po la: tshe ring nad med bde bas bkra shis shog: rten snying dang : ma hā pañtsa ma dā na maṅga laṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa siddhi hoḥ btung bcug: g.yang dar thogs la: hūm̐: bkra shis gang zhig tshe yi mda' dar 'di: mi 'gyur tshe rten srog gi ka ba brtan: bkra shis des kyang sbyin pa'i bdag po la: 'chi bdag bdud las rnam rgyal bkra shis shog: rgya gram spyi bor bkod la lag tu gtad: rten snying dang : oṃ maṅga laṃ tsitta tiṣṭha badzra ye a bhi ṣiñtsa siddhi hoḥ zhes lag tu gtad: 'khor lo thogs la: hūm̐: bkra shis gang zhig 'khor lo rin po che: rtsibs stong ldan pas 'khor ba'i mtsho las bsgrol: bkra shis des kyang sbyin pa'i bdag po la: theg dgu'i chos kyi 'khor lo bkra shis shog:

rten snying dang : oṃ maṅga laṃ tsakra ratna a bhi ṣiñtsa siddhi hoḥ zhes lag tu gtad: nor bu thogs la: hūm̐: bkra shis gang zhig nor bu rin po che: dgos 'dod kun 'byung sbyin pa'i phar phyin rdzogs: bkra shis des kyang sbyin pa'i bdag po la: bsod nams tshogs gnyis mthar phyin bkra shis shog: rten snying dang : oṃ maṅga laṃ ma ṇi ratna a bhi ṣiñtsa siddhi hoḥ zhes lag tu gtad: btsun mo thogs la: bkra shis gang zhig btsun mo rin po che: dga' bzhi dpal gter bde stong ye shes bskyed: bkra shis des kyang sbyin pa'i bdag po la: rnam kun mchog ldan rdzogs pa'i bkra shis shog: rten snying dang : oṃ maṅga laṃ pra dzñā ratna a bhi ṣiñtsa siddhi hoḥ zhes lag tu gtad: blon po thogs la: hūm̐: bkra shis gang zhig blon po rin po che: blo gros rnam dpyod rig pa'i rtsal dang ldan: bkra shis des kyang sbyin pa'i bdag po la: gzungs spobs blo gros rnam 'phel bkra shis shog: rten snying dang : oṃ maṅga laṃ ma ti ratna a bhi ṣiñtsa siddhi hoḥ zhes lag tu gtad: glang po thogs la: hūm̐: bkra shis gang zhig glang po rin po che: stobs rtsal shugs ldan ri ltar rab tu brten: bkra shis des kyang sbyin pa'i bdag po la: bsod nams stobs bskyed dpal gyi bkra shis shog: rten snying dang : oṃ maṅga laṃ ha ti ratna a bhi ṣiñtsa siddhi hoḥ zhes lag tu gtad: rta mchog thogs la: hūm̐: bkra shis gang zhig rta mchog rin po che: rdzu 'phrul shugs 'chang sa lam skad cig bgrod: bkra shis des kyang sbyin pa'i bdag po la: gang 'dod gnas mchog bgrod pa'i bkra shis shog: oṃ maṅga laṃ a shwa ratna a bhi ṣiñtsa siddhi hoḥ zhes lag tu gtad: dmag dpon thogs la: hūm̐: bkra shis gang zhig dmag dpon rin po che: dpa' bo thabs mkhas bdud bzhi'i dpung 'dzoms pa: bkra shis des kyang sbyin pa'i bdag po la: phyogs las rnam rgyal stobs bcu'i bkra shis shog:

rten snying dang : oṃ maṅga laṃ khaṅga ratna a bhi ṣiñtsa siddhi hoḥ zhes lag tu gtad: rtags brgyad thogs la: hūm̐: bkra shis gang zhig dge legs rtags mchog brgyad: sangs rgyas bsod nams chen po'i mthu las grub: bkra shis des kyang sbyin pa'i bdag po la: mtshan dpe rab rdzogs sku mchog thob par shog: rten snying dang : oṃ maṅga laṃ ka ya ṣṭaran+ya a bhi ṣiñtsa siddhi hoḥ zhes lag tu gtad: rdzas brgyad thogs la: hūm̐: bkra shis gang zhig bde legs rdzas mchog brgyad: ston pa nyid kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i rdzas: bkra shis des kyang sbyin pa'i bdag po la: don gnyis bsam pa ma lus mthar phyin shog: rten snying dang : oṃ maṅga laṃ sarba karma ku ru a bhi ṣiñtsa siddhi hoḥ zhes lag tu gtad: bcu bzhi pa gta' sdom rgyas gdab ni: dngos grub rdzas rnams bang mdzod phug tu sbas: mda' dar g.yab la sgo bzhi'i pho nya bskul: rten snying brjod cing rten la bzhugs par gsol: de la rigs lnga'i phyag rgya gdab la: hūm̐: 'gyur ba med pa rnam snang sku yi rgya: 'gag pa med pa snang mtha' gsung gi rgya: 'khrul pa med pa rdor sems thugs kyi rgya: dgos 'dod 'byung ba yon tan nor bura'i rgya: lhun gyis grub pa phrin las don grub rgya: shin tu rnam dag ye shes lnga yi rgya: 'byung lnga rnam dag yum lnga'i mkha' la gdab: rten snying dang : oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā: bhrūm̐ mūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐ sarba maṅga laṃ dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ: bco lnga pa smon lam gdab pa ni: hūm̐: g.yang 'dis bde gshegs bstan pa rgyas par shog: g.yang 'dis bstan pa'i mnga' thang 'phel bar shog: g.yang 'dis sde gnyis thugs mthun khrims gtsang shog: g.yang 'dis bla ma'i sku tshe brtan par shog: g.yang 'dis mdzad phrin phyogs bcur rgyas par shog: g.yang 'dis 'jig rten khams kun bde bar shog: g.yang 'dis nad mug 'khrug rtsod zhi bar shog:

g.yang 'dis lha mi'i dam tshig mthun par shog: g.yang 'dis phyi nang 'byung ba snyoms par shog: g.yang 'dis dus char phun tshogs 'bebs par shog: g.yang 'dis 'bru nor longs spyod rgyas par shog: g.yang 'dis khams gsum zas nor 'du bar shog: g.yang 'dis bar chad g.yul las rgyas par shog: g.yang 'dis bsam don lhun gyis 'grub par shog: g.yang 'dis 'brel tshad don dang ldan par shog: g.yang 'dis mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par shog: bcu drug pa bkra shis ni: me tog 'thor la rten snying sngon du 'gro bas: hūm̐ bhrūm̐ swā hā: dkon mchog rin chen gsum gyi byin rlabs dang : bde gshegs rtsa ba gsum gyi thugs rje dang : bden gnyis rnam dag bslu med bden pa dang : bla med gsang sngags zab mo'i rten 'brel gyis: nad 'don 'jigs brgyad zhi ba'i bkra shis shog: tshe bsod dpal 'byor rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog: snang sems dbang du 'du ba'i bkra shis shog: log 'dren tshar gcod drag po'i bkra shis shog: mi la dpal 'phel tshe yi bkra shis shog: nor la phywa 'phel g.yang gi bkra shis shog: zas la bcud 'phel 'byor pa'i bkra shis shog: bde skyid lha dang mnyam pa'i bkra shis shog: ka dag klong yangs lta ba'i bkra shis shog: dmigs med mtha' bral sgom pa'i bkra shis shog: don gnyis lhun grub spyod pa'i bkra shis shog: mthar thug mngon sangs rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog: snang zhen lha skur rdzogs pa'i bkra shis shog: sgra grag sngags su dag pa'i bkra shis shog: dran rtog chos skur smin pa'i bkra shis shog: 'ja' lus thang thal chen po'i bkra shis shog: sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog: sems can bde skyid 'phel ba'i bkra shis shog: snod bcud dpal yon rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog: sbyin bdag phywa g.yang 'phel ba'i bkra shis shog: nad mug mtshon bskal zhi ba'i bkra shis shog: rdzogs ldan lang tsho rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog:

yangs pa'i rgyal khams bde ba'i bkra shis shog: 'gal rkyen mtha' dag zhi ba'i bkra shis shog: mthun rkyen phun sum tshogs pa'i bkra shis shog: tshe dpal chos 'byor rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog: dbang thang snyan grags 'phel ba'i bkra shis shog: 'khor ba'i gcong nad zhi ba'i bkra shis shog: 'phags nor bdun gyis 'byor pa'i bkra shis shog: sa lam yon tan rdzogs pa'i bkra shis shog: bsam don chos bzhin 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog: rtag tu bde ba thob pa'i bkra shis shog: rten snying sngags brjod bkra shis rgya cher spel: snod bcud dus kyi rgud pa rab zhi nas: 'byung ba'i bcud 'phel phyi nang dpal yon rgyas: lha 'dre mi gsum mos bzhi rang dbang bsgyur: bsam don lhun 'grub dge legs mthar phyin 'gyur: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gu hya: ྀatsha: ces pa'ang 'gro 'dul pad rgyal gling pa'i sbas yul padma bkod kyi chos sde yang dag pa ste mi lo nyer bzhi'i bar du gsang ba'i dam tshig la gnas pas slar chu phag zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes bdun bzang por seng rdzong gu ru'i bzhugs khri'i ke'u tshang nas gtan la phab pa siddhi rastu// // ྂ/: g.yang gi sgo 'byed gser skyems ni/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum gyis brlabs/ kyai/ rwa ba sgo bzhi g.yang gi srung ma rnams/ /ye shes skyems kyi mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ /dgyes pas zhal ston bkra shis g.yang sgo phyes/ mchan/(slar sdom pa'i tshe bsdom zhes kha bsgyur/) /gzhan du ma yal 'dir bzhugs dngos grub stsol/ / lan gsum gyis mchod cing*/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya pra be sha ya phaṭḥ ces brjod cing rgya rnams phral bar bya'o/ /slar sgo sdom pa'i tshe/ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swā hā: zhes kha bsgyur ba'i khyad par ro/ /ces pa'ang kā ma la rā dzas so// ༄༅/ / sku gsum dgongs 'dus las/ ratna thod phreng rtsal gyi sgo nas bkra shis gter bum sgrub pa'i man ngag 'dod rgu kun 'byung ces bya ba bzhugs so//

na mo gu ru ratna thod phreng rtsal sarba ba su ratna ḍākki nī ye/ ratna thod phreng rtsal gyi g.yang sgrub dang 'brel bar bkra shis rten 'brel chen po'i gter bum sgrub pa'i las kyi rim pa la 'jug par 'dod pas/ ratna thod phreng nyid la brten nas chos nor tshe dpal spel ba dang*/ sa'i lha mo la brten nas sa bcud dpal g.yang spel ba dang*/ klu nor rgyas la brten nas snod bcud dang dpal 'byor bskyed pa gsum gyi dang po ni/ gter gzhung las/ bkra shis g.yang chags rgud skyon ma 'god pa'i: g.yang gi rdzas kyis phyur bur bkang ba yi: bkra shis bum bzang bkra shis g.yang rwa'i dbus: sku gsung thugs kyi rten bcas mchod pas spras: zhes pa'i rin po che'am rdza'i bum pa yul gyi bre gang shong ba las mi chung ba'i nang du/ bkra shis shing yongs su grags pa'i gnas chen rnams kyis rdo shing gi phye ma/ mtsho dang chu chen rnams kyi chu sna/ rin chen phye ma/ klu sman tshad ldan/ gi waṃ/ dkar gsum/ mngar gsum/ 'bru sna'i phye ma/ dar sna tshogs kyi phye ma bsres pa'i 'dag pa las/ ratna thod phreng rtsal yab yum gyi sku g.yang sgrub ltar gtso bo 'chos la mtshon rtsi legs par btang ba'i dbu gtsug tu sangs rgyas kyi ring bsrel lam chos sman/ thugs kar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru ratna thod phreng rtsal sarba bā su ratna siddhi pha la hūm̐ aḥ oṃ ratna pun+yai swasti siddhi pha la bā su ratna na na kha dhi sarba 'du 'du bhrūm̐ pā shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: ces gser ram mtshal sogs kyi 'bris la/ dri bzang gi byug /dbu nas mar dkris te dar zab dang mtshon skud kyi na bza' phul la bcug /phyag gi ne'u le'i nang du'ang bhrūm̐ pā shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: zhes shog dril bcug /gzhan yang sku yi nang du g.yang rdzas ril bu klu sman/ dkar gsum/ rin phye/ spos gtsang*/ 'bru sna/ dar snas bkang*/ de yang rab gnas bskyed bstims bzlas pa ci 'grub dang*/

shis brjod byas la dar snas dril te bum pa'i dbus su gzhug /de ltar mi 'grub pas tsandan nam shugs pa sogs bzang shing gi byang bu rtsa rtse ma nor ba'i mdun ngos su sku dang rgyab ngos su gzungs sngags bri ba dang*/ ci kyang mi 'grub pa'i 'byor ba dman pas gzungs sngags sogs kyi shog dril tsam gzhug pas kyang rung zhing*/ de yang rtsa sngags rkyang pa'i mthar/ rtsa gsum nor lha rten la rtag bzhugs nas: chos nor 'dod rgu 'byung bar mdzad du gsol: gang ltar yang*/ mi 'dzad yun gyi gter mdzod cig / ces dang*/ rten 'brel snying po/ /'bad dang rtsol bas ma gos pa/ / zhes sogs bkra shis/ su pra tiṣṭha sa mtha' brgyan pa bcas gser ram mtshal la rin chen phye ma btab pas bris pa'i shog dril dar gyi na bza' can mgo mjug ma log par bzhag /gong du smos pa'i rdzas thams cad dang*/ bum rdzas nyer lnga'i phye ma rnams 'o ma (mo gsar rigs bzang*/ ra dkar mo/ ba dmar mo gsum gyi )dang bu sbrang gi khu bas sprus la ril bu brgya dang rtsa brgyad byas pa dang*/ chos sman sogs byin rten/ sgrub gter gyi dum bu/ gong gi rdzas khrol bur byas pa dang 'bru sna/ dri bzang gi shing phye rnams kyis lag tshags dam par bkang la dar ser pos kha bcad de mgrin pa dam par bcing*/ mdun rtags nor bu 'bar bas mtshan par bya/ de ltar bca' grub nas sbyongs khrus tshad ldan byas la/ stegs gtsang ma'i dbus su me tog gi tshom bu bkram par bum pa 'god/ mdun gyi g.yang gtor dang gter bum maṇḍal 'bru tshom sogs kyi mkhar bkod la phyi nang mchod pa spyi 'gros ltar dang*/ g.yang rdzas spyan gzigs mtshar du dngar bar byas la sgrub thabs bzhin mngon rtogs gcig gi khyab par byas la sgrub pas bum pa mdzod du sbas la rten bzhugs shis brjod kyis mtha' brgyan pas grub bo/ /de ltar sgrub pa'i phan yon ni/ gter gzhung las/ snod bcud dus kyi rgud pa rab zhi nas:

'byung ba'i bcud 'phel phyi nang dpal 'byor rgyas: lha 'dre mi gsum mos bzhi rang dbang bsgyur: bsam don lhun 'grub dge legs mthar phyin 'gyur: zhes bsngags pa don dang ldan pa'i tha ma'i dus 'dir snod bcud kyi rgud pa sel phyir gces nor du 'chang ste nyams su blang na dgos gal shin tu che bar sna ngo*// ༈ gnyis pa lha mo brten ma la brten nas sa bcud spel ba ni/ rin po che'am rdza'i bum pa yul gyi bre gang shong ba las mi chung ba'i nang du gong gi rdzas rnams kyi phye ma bsres pa'i 'dag pa las lha mo'i gzugs sor bzhi ba gser mdog phyag gnyis nor bu dang bum pa 'dzin pa/ zhi 'dzum dar dang rin po che'i rgyan can/ zhabs skyil krung padma'i gdan la bzhugs par 'chos la tshon rtsi legs par btang ba'i dbu gtsug tu sangs rgyas kyi ring bsrel/ thugs kar/ oṃ tsi ri tsi ri: tsu ru tsu ru: ku ru ku ru: do tsu do tsu: swā hā swā hā: bha sha bha sha swā hā: zhes gser gyis bris ba bcug /nang du klu sman/ rin phye/ dkar gsum/ spos gtsang*/ 'bru sna/ dar snas bkang*/ phyag gi bum par yang sngags snga ma dang rin po ches bkang bar gsungs kyang ma shong na bhrūm̐ yig tsam dang rin phye ma blugs/ rab gnas bskyed bstims bzlas pa ci 'grub dang shis brjod byas la dar snas dril te bum pa'i dbus su gzhug /de ltar mi 'grub pas shug pa sogs bzang shing gi byang bu rtsa rtse ma nor ba'i mdun ngos su lha mo brtan ma'i sku dang rgyab ngos su gzungs sngags bri ba dang*/ ci kyang mi 'grub pa'i 'byor ba dman pas gzungs sngags sogs kyi shog dril tsam bzhugs pas kyang rung zhing*/ de yang rtsa sngags rkyang pa'i mthar/ klu rgyal 'khor bcas rten la rtag bzhugs nas: snod bcud dge legs 'phel bar mdzad du gsol: gang ltar yang*/ mi 'dzad yun gyi gter mdzod cig / ces dang*/ rten 'brel snying po/ 'bad dang rtsol bas ma gos pa/

/ zhes sogs bkra shis su pra tiṣṭha sa mtha' brgyan pa bcas gser ram mtshal la rin chen phye ma btab pas bris pa'i shog dril dar gyi na bza' can mgo 'jug ma log par bzhag /gong du smos pa'i rdzas thams cad dang bum rdzas nyer lnga'i phye ma rnams mo gsar rigs bzang gi nu zho dang*/ ba dkar mo dang*/ dmar zal gyi 'o mas sbrus la ril bu brgya dang rtsa brgyad byas pa dang*/ chos sman sogs byin rten/ sgrub gtor gyi dum bu/ gong gi rdzas khrol bur byas pa dang 'bru sna/ dri bzang gi shing phye rnams kyis lag tshags dam par bkang la dar ser pos bcad de mgrin pa dam par bcing*/ mdun rtags padma'am nor bu 'bar bas mtshan par bya/ de ltar bca' grub nas sbyongs khrus tshad ldan byas la/ stegs gtsang ma'i dbus su me tog gi tshom bu bkram par bum pa 'god/ mdun du dkar mngar sbyar ba'i gtor ma dang*/ mthar chu gnyis nyer spyod lnga bcas bsham la/ khrus dang gtsang sbra'i kun spyod la gnas pas bdag gi rnal 'byor sngon du 'gro bas/ bum pa las sngags kyis bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las bhrūm̐ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i bum pa gzhal yas khang nyams dga' ba/ rtsi shing thams cad rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i ljong shing la/ rin po che'i dgos 'dod 'phro ba'i gseb nas bya rigs sna tshogs kyi skad snyan sgrog shing ri dwags rtse 'jo byed pa/ rin po che dang 'bru bcud zas nor lha klu mi'i longs spyod zad mi shes pas yongs su gang ba/ de'i dbus su padma 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar sa'i lha mo brtan ma sku mdog ser po 'od zer 'phro ba/ rin po che sna tshogs ky-i rgyan dang ldan cing mdzes pa'i gzugs can/ phyag g.yas nor bu dang g.yon bum pa bsnams pas/ zhabs gnyis sems ma'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ mtha' bskor du lha klu gnyan dang sa bdag gzhi bdag pho mo'i tshogs kyi bskor ba/
gtso 'khor rnams kyi gnas gsum 'bru gsum las 'od zer 'phros pas sa'i lha mo 'khor bcas skad cig gi spyan drangs par

bsam zhing*/ hoḥ gson cig dgongs shig mngon shes can/ /ye shes spyan dang ldan pa po/ /byang chub sems ma rdzu 'phrul can/ /lha mo brten ma dgongs su gsol/ /lha 'dre yid kyi mngon shes can/ /yul phyogs 'di la gnas pa yi/ /klu gnyan sa bdag dgongs su gsol/ /de ring bdag dang yon bdag gi /'gal rkyen bar chad zhi ba dang*/ /mthun rkyen legs tshogs rgyas pa'i phyir/ /gter bdag khyed rnams spyan 'dren na/ /thugs rje'i dbang gis gshegs su gsol/ /rin chen sna tshogs gter bum la/ /sku yi rten dang gnas mdzod cig /yul phyogs 'di ru dus rtag tu/ /lo legs 'bru dang rtsa rnams 'phel/ /sa bcud dpal g.yang rgyas pa dang*/ /bdag cag dpon slob yon chod kyi/ kha 'dzin rgyab brten sdong grogs mdzod/ /bde skyid ldan pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /oṃ pṛ thī dhāe wi sarba bhu mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra e hye hi/ badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho/ tiṣṭha lhan/ sa ma ya satwaṃ/ sa ma ya ho/ zhes spyan drangs shing bstim/ mchod gtor rnams/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams su lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod rdzas dang gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus bcud phun sum tshogs pa zad mi shes pa'i longs spyod kyi gter du gyur bsam/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas lan gsum mam bdun gyis spel te/ ho/ zag med bde ba skyed pa'i rdzas/ /thugs la bzhed rgur 'char ba yi/ /mchod gtor longs spyod 'di bzhes la/ /'dod rgu'i dpal 'byor rgyas pa dang*/ /sa bcud 'phel ba'i dngos grub stsol/ /oṃ pṛ thī dhe wi sarba bhu mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ nas shabda sarba pū dza āḥhūm̐/ zhes dang*/ oṃ pṛ thī dhe wi sarba bhu mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ bha lingta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes lan gsum nam bdun gyis phul la/ sa brgyad la gnas sems ma che/

/stong gsum 'jig rten sa yi bdag /sa yi lha mo brtan ma la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ / bstod cing 'dod don gsol/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ dpag tshad brgyad khri bzhi stong tshud chad kyi snod bcud kyi rgud pa thams cad bsal/ dpal dang gzi byin bskyed/ bcud dang dwangs ma thams cad bsdus te mdun gyi rten rdzas rnams la thim pas sa bcud dang dge mtshan thams cad 'phel ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur pa'i mos pas/ oṃ pṛ thī dhe wi sarba siddhi swā hā/ zhes gtso bor bzla zhing*/ spro na/ oṃ tsi ri tsi ri sogs gong gi brtan ma'i rig pa dang*/ oṃ a ka ni ni ka ni a bhi la maṇḍal ma ye swā hā/ zhes nyes sel gyi sngags kyang ci rigs pa bzlas mthar/ sngarabazhin mchod cing bstod la 'dod don gsol/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum dang*/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*/ /gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni/ /bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba/ /de kun khyod kyis bzod mdzad gsol/ / zhes nongs pa bshags/ rten 'brel snying po bzlas pa'i me tog thogs la/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la ma bzhag gi bar du rgyal ba rnams mya ngan las mi 'da' bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ khyad par du gter chen po'i bum pa bzang po 'di rnams la bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs rnams ji srid 'byung ba bzhi'i gnod pas ma zhig gi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas kyang bdag dang sbyin pa'i bdag po la longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa thams cad stsal zhing*/ yul phyogs 'di ru bkra shis pa dang*/ bde legs dpal gyi dngos grub rgyun mi chad par 'byung bar mdzad du gsol/

oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swā hā/ zhes me tog 'thor/ thams cad nam mkha'i mdzod bzhin du/ /longs spyod zad pa med par shog /rtsod pa med cing 'tshe med par/ /rang dbang du ni spyod par shog /lha yang dus su char 'bebs shing*/ /lo tog phun sum tshogs pa shog /rgyal po chos bzhin byed pa dang*/ /'jig rten dag kyang dar bar shog /'bad dang rtsol bas ma gos pa/ /yid bzhin nor bu dpag bsam shing*/ /sems can re ba skong mdzad pa/ /bsam pa 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog /nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs/ /nyi ma'i gung yang bde legs shing*/ /nyin mtshan rtag tu bde legs pa/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis shog / ces sogs bsngo smon dang shis pa brjod pas dge legs su bya/ de lta bu'i sgrub pa zhag bdun ni dus kyi tshad yin la/ rtag ni bud med mdzes ma rgyan can gyis zas nor la sogs ster ba dang*/ gtam bzang po smra ba sogs dge ba'i ltas spyi dang mthun par 'byung ba ste/ gang ltar yang sgrub pa them nas yul gyi dbus sam/ mkhar gyi rtse'am/ zhing sa bzang po'i dkyil sogs gang du sba ba'i sar rlan gyi mi 'jig pa'i chas dang bcas lag tshag dam par byas la gzhug cing*/ hūm̐: 'byung ba lnga ni sangs rgyas dngos: sa yi lha mo mkha' phyes shig: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las kyi: sgrub pa las kyi gter sba'o: rin chen bum pa'i gter sba'o: snying po lnga yi gter sba'o: dar sna lnga yi gter sba'o: sman sna lnga yi gter sba'o: 'bru sna lnga yi gter sba'o: rin chen lnga yi gter sba'o: chu bo bzhi yi gter sba'o: ri rgyal lhun po'i gter sba'o: hūm̐: yid bzhin gter chen 'di sbas pas: rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khos bcas dang : yul ris sa phyogs 'di dag tu: gter mchog khyed kyi byin rlabs kyis: 'dod yon lnga la longs spyod shog: snying po lnga yi gter sbas pas: sku lnga lhun gyis grub par shog: dar sna lnga yi gter sbas pas:

ye shes lnga ldan thob par shog: sman sna lnga yi gter sbas pas: nad kyi bskal pa zhi bar shog: 'bru sna lnga yi gter sbas pas: mu ge'i bskal pa zhi bar shog: rin chen lnga yi gter sbas pas: rin chen gter la longs spyod shog: lcags sogs mtshon gyi gter sbas pas: mtshon gyi bskal pa zhi bar shog: dam rdzas gtor ma'i gter sbas pas: mi zad zas nor 'phel bar shog: chu bo bzhi yi gter sbas pas: char chu dus su 'babs pa dang : lo phyogs rtag tu 'phel bar shog: ri rgyal lhun po'i gter sbas pas: yid bzhin re ba skong ba dang : bsam pa thams cad 'grub gyur cig: rdo rje rin chen padma las: phyag rgya lnga yi rgyas gdab bo: sku gsung thugs kyi rgyas btab bo: tshe dbang phun sum tshogs par shog: bsod nams dam pa thob par shog: badzra ā yu siddhi bhrūm̐: swasti bhrūm̐ maṅga laṃ: zhes brjod cing : rdo leb la rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan bris pas steng nas bkab ste brtan cing 'thas par bya/ rten 'brel snying po bzlas pa'i me tog char dbab la bkra shis rgyas par spel/ des ni brtan g.yo'i rten 'brel log pa'i rgud pa zhi zhing*/ sa bcud dpal g.yang 'byor pa thams cad yar ngo'i zla ba ltar 'phel zhing rgyas par 'gyur ro// // ༈ gnyis pa klu nor rgyas la brten nas snod bcud dpal 'byor bskyed pa'i gter bum sgrub tshul ni/ rab bzhi'i yar ngo gza' skar shis shing khyad par klu thebs yod cing klu ldog med pa'i dus su/ rin po che'am bkra shis pa'i sa las byas pa'i rdza bum so btang ba yul kyi bre gang shong ba yan chad las mi chung ba rtsi dkar po mdun rtags padma nor bu sogs kyis mtshan pa'i nang du/ rin chen klu sman dkar mngar chu sna rnams bsres pa'i spra tshil lam khams las klu nor rgyas sor brgyad pa stod mi la smad sbrul mjug 'khyil ba phyag g.yas rin po che dang g.yon utpal bsnams pa/ sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka bdun yod pa/

yum sor bdun pa thal sbyar nor bu bsnams pa sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka lnga ldan mi lus sbrul mjug /gnyis ka dar dang rin po ches brgyan cing sku mdog ser po bya/ yab la gi waṃ dang sbra tshil ma 'dzom na gnyis ka la sbrang rtsi byugs/ gro ga'am chu shog la rgya snag gtsang mas/ oṃ wa ru ṇa ye hūm̐ swā hā: phuḥ.oṃ ba su ki maṃ swā hā: oṃ wa ru ṇa ye swā hā: oṃ nā ga rā dza ba su puṣṭiṃ sarba maṅga laṃ siddhi swā hā: zhes bris pa yab dang*/ oṃ nā gi ma ṇi mu ku ṭaṃ sarba maṅga laṃ swā hā: phuḥ zhes bris pa yum gyi nang du gzhug /gnyis ka'ang mjug nas dril te dar ser pos dril nas mgo gzhug ma log par bcug /yab yum gnyis zhal sbyar gyi tshul du bum pa'i dbus su bzhag /'bur sku ma 'grub na bzang shing gi byang bu rtsa rtse ma log pa gnyis la tshad sogs snga ma dang 'dra ba'i klu yab yum bris te gi waṃ dang sbrang rtsis byugs/ zhal sbyar du bsdams la dar ser pos dril te bzhag /sku gzugs tshad ldan mi 'grub na dkyus su gzungs dril kho na gzhug pa nyid lag len bde zhing don la gnas phyir legs pas/ rgya shog la gser ram mtshal snag gtsang bas/ oṃ nā ga rā dza ba su ki maṃ siddhi hūm̐ dzaḥ nā ga rā dza buddha bha ga wān nā ga rā tsa sarba he lo siddhi pha la puṣṭiṃ ku ru hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: nā ga ra dza sarba ā yuḥratna siddhi hūm̐: ratna dhe wa ā yuḥratna siddhi sarba pā shaṃ ku ru hūm̐ hūm̐ dzaḥ yul khams gnas khang 'di ru mi nad phyugs nad rims nad god yams god kha sad ser btsa' 'bu mu ge mtshon 'khrug dmag jag dgra kun mi kha sogs mi mthun pa'i phyogs ris ngan pa thams cad zhi zhing*/ tshe bsod dpal 'byor rlung rta bla gza' kha rje dbang thang mi phyugs yul khams 'bru nor longs spyod thos bsam sgom gsum nyams rtogs kyi yon tan legs tshogs bkra shis thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang dngos grub rgyun mi chad par 'byung bar mdzad du gsol/

zhes dbu can tshegs med du bris la/ gser ling ma'am chu rgyun 'bab bzang po'i rde'u la gser gyi phuḥ bri zhing*/ phuḥ yig dang oṃ zhal sbyar te g.yas bskor du dkris pa gong gi sku rgyu'i rdzas rnams spra rtsi'i tshal mar dang sbyar te nor bu'i dbyibs su bcos pa'i nang du bzhugs pa nyid bkra shis pa'i tshigs bcad kyis dril ba mdun rgyab ma nor bar bum par gzhug /sku dang gzungs bsgril gang byed kyang bum pa'i nang du lung pa gsum lnga bdun dgu gcig man chad kyi btsan phyugs 'phan po gnas chen dgon sde bkra shis pa'i sa dang 'bru sna blangs la/ sran ma yungs dkar nag bra bo sogs ma 'dres pa/ sman sna tshogs pa la dug rigs gla rtsi khyung sder tsha ba gsum sogs ma 'dres la/ rin chen sna lnga la lcags ra gan zha nye sogs ma 'dres la/ sha chang sgog btsong ma 'dres pa'i zas sna dang*/ shing tog gi rigs gang 'dzom/ dar sna gos sna dang klu sman gang mang*/ tshwa dang mngar gsum dkar gsum rnams dang*/ ba dkar ra dkar 'o ma mo gsar rigs bzang gi nu zho rnams ril bur byas pas bum pa khengs par bkang la dar dkar pos kha bcad de mgrin pa dam par bcing*/ thi'u sogs kyi rtags gdab/ sbyong khrus spyi mthun yid ches par byas la/ gtsang ma'i stegs bur ras dkar dri ma med pa'i khebs ldan gyi khar 'bras kyi tshom bu dgu bkod pa'i dbus su 'god/ mdun du gtor ma dkar mngar klu sman gyis bran pa dang*/ chu gnyis nyer spyod lnga rnams gtsang zhing mdzes par bsham/ sgrub pa po sha chang spangs te gtsang sgra dang ldan pa'i ngang nas bdag gi rnal 'byor la gnas pas/ bum rdzas byin brlab pa ni/ swa bhā wa lan gsum gyis sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las gter chen po'i bum pa bzang po mgron nams dgyes rgur rol pa'i gnas yul/ 'dzad pa med pa'i longs spyod/ na ba gso ba'i sman/ shi ba slong ba'i bdud rtsi/ 'dod yon nam mkha' mdzod kyi sprin phung*/

sangs rgyas kyi mthu dang byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam las grub pa 'khor ba ji srid rgyun mi chad pa'i rang bzhin du gyur bsam zhing*/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyo bi shwa sogs nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas lan bdun gyis brlab/ mdun rten bskyed pa ni/ bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las bhrūm̐ las bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang phun sum tshogs pa'i zhing gi bkod pa dang zad mi shes pa'i mthun rdzas sna tshogs kyis gang ba/ rin po che'i gling klu'i pho brang nyams dga' ba'i dbus su padma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar phuḥlas klu rgyal nor rgyas sku mdog ser po 'khor los sgyur ba'i cha byad can/ stod mi la smad sbrul mjug tu 'khyil ba sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka bdun dang ldan cing phyag g.yas nor bu rin po che dang*/ g.yon utpal bsnams pa/ de'i mdun du yum klu mo nor bu'i cod pan can sku mdog ser po stod mi la smad sbrul mjug can sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka lnga dang ldan cing phyag gnyis thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du nor bu rin po che 'dzin pa/ yab yum gnyis ka dgyes shing 'dzum pa'i skur gsal ba'i mthar klu chen brgyad dang*/ yul phyogs 'dir gnas kyi klu gnyan sa bdag dang bcas pa rnams rang rang gi yum sras blon 'bangs 'khor tshogs grangs med longs spyod dang bcas pa bsam gyis mi khyab par gyur/ rang nyid yi dam gyi thugs srog sa bon dang mdun gyi klu thugs kar phuḥyig gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros pas rgya mtsho chen po'i klong nas klu rgyal nor rgyas yab yum sras blon 'bangs 'khor pho brang longs spyod dang bcas pa rnams bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba spyan drangs nas bum nang du thim par gyur par bsam la/ spos dkar 'thul zhing lcags kyu'i rgya dang bcas te/ mtha' yi rgya mtsho chen po dang : gsher dang 'byung bar rten bcas pa'i: dad dang 'byor ldan klu yi tshogs:

'khor dang bcas pa spyan 'dren no: padma dkar po'i gdan la bzhugs: oṃ nā ga rā dza ba su ki maṃ siddhi hūm̐ dzaḥ sa pa ri wā ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes lan gsum gyis bkug ste bum nang du bstim/ nā ga rā dza sa pa ri wā ra sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan gyis bzhugs su gsol/ na mo pu ru sha ya hoḥ zhes phyag bya/ oṃ las klu rnams dgyes skyed pa'i/ /mchod sbyin bsam mi khyab par gyur/ /oṃ badzra spha ra ṇa khaṃ/ dwangs bsil rnyogs med yon chab dang*/ /chu skyes thang skyes me tog dang*/ /tsandan nags kyi spos dkar dri/ /dge zhing mun 'joms nor bu'i 'od/ /spos dang sman sbyar chu gtsang dang*/ /dkar gsum mngar gsum gtsang ma'i zas/ /sil snyan rol mo'i bstod pa'i dbyangs/ /rin chen sna bdun gter dang brgyad/ khrus kyi rdzing bu dpag bsam shing*/ /'dod pa'i yon tan rnam pa lnga/ /klu yi rgyal po nor rgyas ni/ /btsun mo sras dang bcas la 'bul/ /gnas 'dir klu nad mi 'byung zhing*/ /bkra shis longs spyod rgyas par mdzod/ /oṃ nā ga rā dza ba su ki maṃ sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ sogs nas/ shabda pra titstsha swā hā/ sman dang dar zab 'bras bu'i tshogs/ /klu rgyal 'khor bcas dgyes byed cing*/ /klu yi nad kun zhi ba'i sman/ /chos dang gang 'dod char pa bzhin/ /klu yis 'bad med lhun grub shog /oṃ nā ga rā dza buddhe bha ga wān/ na mo ratna tra ya yā ha ha hu hu/ a mṛ ta bi shuddhe swā hā/ oṃ a kā ro

gsum gyi gtor ma byin brlab/ oṃ nā ga rā dza ba su ki maṃ siddhi hūm̐ dzaḥ sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ bha liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes lan bdun nam gsum gyis phul la/ klu rgyal 'khor dang bcas pas mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ 'dod pa'i dngos grub thams cad myur ba nyid du stsol zhing bde legs kyi yon tan thams cad 'phel bar mdzod du gsol/ zhes 'dod don gsol/ gdengs ka nor bu 'bar ba'i 'od zer gyis/ /sa 'og mun pa mtha' dag 'joms mdzad pa/ /bstan la rab dga' mthu stobs bsam mi khyab/ /klu rgyal 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod/ / ces bstod/ klu rgyal 'khor bcas kyi thugs kar zla la gnas pa'i phuḥyig ser po sngags kyis g.yas su bskor ba/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin can 'phros/ mdun bskyed 'khor dang bcas pa la phog pas zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can bskyed/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ brtan g.yo'i dwangs bcud ma lus pa bsdus nas mdun gyi rten rdzas rnams la thim pas snod bcud kyi dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa thams cad skyed pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur pa'i mos pas/ oṃ nā ga rā dza ba su ki maṃ siddhi hūm̐ dzaḥ zhes gtso bor bzla zhing*/ skabs su nā ga rā dza buddha bha ga wan sogs gong gi las sngags btags pa'ang bzla/ thun mthar spro na/ tadya thā/ dha ra ṇi dhā ra ṇi uddha ra ṇi/ saṃ pra tiṣṭha te bi dza ya barṇa satya pra ti dzñā sa ha ra/ dzñā na pa ti/ ud pa da ni bi nā ma ni/ i bhi ṣiñtsa ni/ a bhi bya/ hā ra shu bhā ba ti/ a dzi ma/ e hi ku ma pā la/ bā ha ha ra kle shā na/ dhā na pā paṃ/ sho dha ya mārgā nā/ ni ra hi ka dharma ta shuddha lo ka bi ti ma ri rā dza sa du kha/ sha ma na sarba buddha a ba lo ka na a dhi ṣṭhi te pra dzñā na bhe swā hā/ zhes klu la bde ba sbyin pa'i gzungs sngags kyang ci nus bzlas la/

dbyangs gsal rten snying lan gsum gyis kha bskang*/ sngar bzhin mchod cing bstod la/ e maḥ dad dang 'byor ldan klu yi tshogs: ma lus 'khor dang bcas pa la: dgyes pa des kyang bkra shis shog /klu rnams chus srid dbang thang che/ /bkra shis des kyang 'dir 'byung shog /klu chen nor rgyas dngos grub mtsho/ /gnas 'dir 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog /rgya gar rgyal po'i rgyal srid dang*/ /rgya nag rgyal po'i dpal 'byor dang*/ /hor gyi rgyal po'i mthu stobs sogs/ /'dzam gling kun gyi phun tshogs bcud/ /thams cad gnas 'dir 'du bar shog /bde skyid phun sum tshogs par shog /bkra shis de yi bkra shis shog /oṃ sarba sha ba ri pu ru siddhi hūm̐/ nā ga siddhi pha la swasti swasti/ zhes brjod cing*/ g.yam pas thog bkab byi ba sogs srog chags kyi gnod pa dang chus mi 'jig pa'i lag tshag dam par bya/ rtsig gseb lta bur sgor nyi zla mchod rten sogs bkra shis pa'i mtshan ma bri/ shis brjod rgyas par spel/ mchod gtor bya khyis mi za bar bya/ klu thebs skabs sogs su mchod pa la brtson par bya'o/ /de ltar bsgrub pas snod bcud kyi rgud pa ma lus pa zhi zhing*/ dpal 'byor legs tshogs bsam pa'i don thams cad yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po cher gsol ba btab pa ltar 'bad med lhun grub tu 'jo bar 'gyur pa yin no/ /zhes pa'ang nye bar 'kho ba'i yan lag tu mkhan chen 'jam dbyangs rdo rje'i bzhed pa bzhin byin rlabs kyi bab dang khungs dag pa'i skyabs rje 'gro 'dul gling pa'i yig cha sor bzhag ste 'gro 'dul pad rgyal pas 'brug spa gro rin spung rdzong gi gtsug lag khang du rab 'byung bcu bdun pas 'brug zla 8tshes 26shin tu dge bar rang gter man ngag gis zur brgyan te lag len 'jug pa bde ba'i ngag khrid su bsdebs pa dza yantu// // sku gsum dgongs 'dus las: padma buddha thod phreng rtsal gi sgos dbang bzhugs so:

padma thod phreng rtsal la phyag 'tshal lo: dbang mdzad bla ma bskyed bzlas nyams len gyi: snod du rung phyir dbang bskur rim pa bstan: sa ma ya: dben pa'i gnas su tshul bzhin 'dus byas la: maṇḍal dbang rdzas phyi nang mchod pa bkram: bdag mdun dbyer med bskyed bzlas bdag dbang blang : tshogs kyi mchod pas nyams chags bshags bgyid nas: snod ldan slob ma bos la khrus kyis dbyung : mi dbang bgegs bskrad srung ba'i 'khor lor bcings: chos bshad maṇḍal 'bul zhing gsol ba btab: hoḥ dkyil 'khor gtso bo padma thod phreng dang : dbyer med rdo rje slob dpon brtse bas dgongs: dbang mdzad bla ma buddha thod phreng gis: smin byed dbang gi bka' drin bdag la stsol: lan gsum: skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshogs bsags sdom pa bzung : slob ma'i rgyud sbyang lhar bskyed ye shes dbab: de nas rnam rgyal bum pa spyi bor bzhag: hūm̐: rin chen bum pa bzang po gzhal yas khang : dkyil 'khor lha tshogs bdud rtsi'i rnam par gtam: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: padma thod phreng sku yi dbang thob shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma thod phreng rtsal kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: sngags byang mgrin par bzhag la: aḥ ji snyed sgra yi snying po bde chen sngags: bsnyen sgrub phrin las snying po yi ge'i gzugs: chos kyi ring bsrel ye shes sngags kyi dbang : padma thod phreng gsung gi dbang thob shog: gong ltar sngags sham/ wākka a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ me long dwangs gsal bstan la ngo sprod gdab: hūm̐: rang rig mtha' dbus gnyis med zang thal le: 'dus ma byas pa'i mtshon byed tsam gyi brdar: dwangs gsal me long dri med dbang bskur bas: padma thod phreng thugs kyi dbang thob shog: sngags sham: tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: sgrub pa'i gtor sdong gnas bzhir bzhag la myang : oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ gtor gzhong rang byung dbyings kyi gzhal med khang :

gtor ma'i ngo bo rig pa'i ye shes bcud: lha dang dbyer med gtor ma'i dbang bskur bas: padma thod phreng dbang bzhi rdzogs thob shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥbadzra gu ru padma thod phreng rtsal kā ya wākka tsitta sarba a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ de dag mtha' brten ye shes me mchod dbang : dgang blug kha sbyor mar gyis bkang ba gtad: hoḥ dgang gzar rnam pa thabs shes gnyis med sbyor: ngo bo lha tshogs zhar dang gnyis med dag: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la gtad pa yis: rab 'byams dbang gi phrin las myur 'grub shog: bsnyen sgrub las gsum sngags brjod lag tu gtad: spro na sbyin bsreg dag kyang 'bul du bcug: rjes su shis brjod dam tshig khas blang zhing : longs spyod maṇḍal dbul zhing dge ba bsngo: dkyil 'khor rjes chog rim pa spyi ltar bya: de ni gsang ba chen po'i snod ldan 'gyur: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: zab rgya: gtad rgya: sbas rgya: gsang rgya: ྀatsha: sku gsum dgongs 'dus las: padma thod phreng rtsal gyi sgos sgrub dang 'brel ba'i las sbyor dbang gi me mchod bzhugs: padma thod phreng rtsal la phyag 'tshal lo: dbang mdzad bla ma'i sgrub pa la brten nas: 'jig rten khams kyi lha 'dre mi gsum rigs: che rgu gnyan bcu dbang du bsdu 'dod na: rlung ltar myur ba me yi mchod pa bstan: sa ma ya: dge 'dun thab sa (tshong 'du sa'i sa )chang dang smad tshong ma'i: mal 'og sa dang sbyar ba'i stegs bu'i khar: mdog dmar zla gam dbang thab spyi mthun bri: mdog dmar ro skyur shing bu zla gam brtsigs: til mar yam shing dmar po khyad par rdzas: lcags kyu can gyi me tog glang sna dang : ma da na dang shing 'bras 'bru rig dmar: mtshal dang sindhu ra dang lan tshwar lbags: nyer spyod sman raka gtor tshogs tshang bar bshams: bdag gi rnal 'byor bskyed bzlas sngon du btang : hrī dzwa la ram̐ pā shaṃ ku ru hoḥ dge 'dun thab dang chang tshong thab mer spar:

hya ghṛ wa 'i sngags chus thab bsangs shing : swa bhā wa yis sngags kyi stong par sbyang : aḥ stong nyid 'od gsal ngang las mdun gyi thab: dbang gi rang bzhin zla gam 'od dmar 'khyugs: dbang gi me dpung gdod nas gos dkar mo'i: mkha' klong rjes chags bde ba'i rnam par 'bar: ye shes klong yangs 'khyil ba'i me thab dbus: rig pa'i rang rtsal byang chub sems kyi sprin: skad cig mkha' la skar chen shar ba bzhin: bskyed rgyu'i sa bon hrīḥyig dmar gsal shar: de las 'od 'phros snod bcud dngos 'dzin sbyangs: e yam̐ bam̐ ram̐ lam̐ las yum lnga'i mkhar: 'byung lnga rim brtsegs ri rab srung 'khor dbus: sogs nas bstod pa'i bar dang : byon skyems 'bul ba ni: ram̐: ye shes dgang blug thabs shes 'du 'bral med: lha tshogs zhal gyi ngo bor dag pa las: zag med bsreg rdzas byang sems bdud rtsi'i rgyun: dbang mdzad padma thod phreng dkyil 'khor pa: sku gsung thugs kyi dgyes bskong sbyor mtshams nas: bde ba'i rang bzhin 'od dmar rab tu 'phros: 'khor 'das yongs khyab 'khor 'das kun gyi srog: 'od dmar rnam par khab len lcags bzhin bsdus: rab 'byams dbang gi phrin las yongs su rdzogs: don gnyis bsam pa yongs su 'grub par 'gyur: mi 'bral gsum ldan dmigs gnad gsal brtan ngang : rtsa ba'i bsnyen sngags sham du las sngags sbrel: mar khu dang ni yam shing nyer gcig re: dngos gzhir khyad par rdzas la grangs bzung nas: brgya stong khri sogs skabs dang bstun te 'bul: 'dod gsol ni: hoḥ khams gsum snod bcud rgyal blon btsun mo 'bangs: las ldan dge 'dun rigs ldan pho mo dang : dregs ldan lha 'dre sde brgyad mthu chen sogs: rlung sems snang ba legs pa'i yon tan kun: thogs pa med par dbang du 'du bar mdzod: oṃ sarba aḥnṛḥtriḥlo ka pā shaṃ ku ru hoḥ rjes su gtang rag don du mchod bstod dang : tshogs kyis mchod cing gshegs skyems ci rigs phul:

nongs pa bshags shing ye shes dkyil 'khor pa: rten la bzhugs sam chos kyi dbyings su gshegs: dam tshig dkyil 'khor lte ba'i a thung dang : dbyer med gtum mo'i bde drod mchog tu spar: srid zhi'i dbang phyug chen por lam du khyer: thal sol 'bab chu'i gzhung ngam rlung la bskur: des ni thogs med dbang gi las rab 'byams/ myur ba nyid du 'grub cing mthar phyin 'gyur: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: zab rgya: gtad rgya: sbas rgya: gsang rgya: gu hya: ྀatsha: ces pa'ang 'gro 'dul pad rgyal gling pa'i sbas yul padma bkod gyi zab gter gyi gsang ba yang dag pa'o// bde chen zhing mgon chos sku snang mtha' yas/ /snying rje'i gter chen longs sku spyan ras gzigs/ /snang srid zil gnon pad 'byung yab yum la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin rlabs char chen phob/ gangs can phur thog rgyal po gnubs mthu chen/ gar gyi dbang phyug gnam lcags rdo rje rtsal/ sprul pa'i gter ston pad rgyal gling pa la/ gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol stsol/ /yi dam yongs 'dus dbang chen rta mchog dpal/ /rdo rje phag mo gnas gsum mkha' 'gros gtso/ /dpa' bo yab yum dam can chos skyong la/ /gsol ba 'debs so rnam gnyis dngos grub stsol/ /snang grags rig gsum lha sngags chos skur smin/ /don gnyis lhun grub padma rgyal po yi/ /rnam thar rgya mtsho bdag gi yongs grub nas/ /'khor ba dong sprugs nus pa'i rtsal ldan shog /gter slob gu hyas so/ / sku gsum dgongs 'dus las/ gu ru padma thod phreng rtsal gyi sgos sgrub khrigs chogs su bkod pa padma'i chun 'phyang zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ bde stong so sor rtog pa'i ye shes dngos/ /padma thod phreng rtsa gsum 'khor lo'i bsgyur/ /dbyer med rang rig bla ma la btud nas/ /gang gi sgrub phrin bklags chog 'di ru spel/ /de yang padma thod phreng sgrub pa la/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum la/

sbyor ba'i chos mdun rten sku brnyan gtso gtor sman raka mchod pa bcas bshams/ rang mdun nyer mkho yo byad gsang sngags spyi ltar tshogs nas/ dngos gzhi las kyi gzhung bsrang ba la/ thog mar tshig bdun gsol 'debs dang brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs sngon du song nas skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ dang po skyabs sems ni/ rang gi snying kha'i 'od kyis mdun gyi nam mkhar rigs 'dus bla ma thod phreng rtsal dkon mchog rtsa gsum rgya mtsho'i sprin phung 'phro ba badzra sa mā ya dzaḥs sad par mos la/ na moḥ phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i skyabs yul ma lus pa: ye shes gcig gi dbyings su 'dus pa'i dpyid: padma thod phreng dbang chen rtsa gsum lhar: byang chub snying po'i bar du skyabs su mchi: lan gsum/ hoḥ ji ltar sngon gyi bde gshegs sras bcas kyi: 'gro ba'i don du bla med thugs bskyed bzhin: bdag gis nyes spyod kun sdom dge chos sdud: smon 'jug don dam byang sems rtag tu bskyed/ lan gsum/ gnyis pa tshogs bsags ni/ hūm̐: rang rig bla ma rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lhar: gnyis su med pa'i gar gyis phyag 'tshal lo: tshogs drug zhen pa bral ba'i mchod sprin 'bul: gzung 'dzin dri ma lta ba'i klong du bshags: bla med lta sgom spyod la rjes yi rang : brjod med don gyi chos 'khor bskor bar bskul: bde chen 'pho 'gyur bral bar rtag bzhugs gsol: 'khor gsum dmigs mtha' bral ba'i pha mthar bsngo: lhun grub gzhon nu bum skur byang chub shog: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim pas rgyud byin gyis rlabs par gyur bar bsam/ gtor ma bsngo mtshams gcod sogs spro na gzhung ltar dang*/ mchod rdzas byin rlabs ni/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: bdag gi thugs ka'i ye shes me rlung chus: snod bcud dngos 'dzin dri ma dbyings su sbyang : gnas yul rnam dag 'og min mngon dga'i zhing : phyi nang mchod sprin ye shes rol par gyur:

oṃ āḥbadzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐ swā hā: de bzhin du/ dhū pe/ a lo ke /gandhe/ nai wi dye/ shabda āḥhūm̐ swā hā: oṃ ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta bha liṃ ta hūm̐ hrī ṭhaḥ oṃ bho dhi tsitta ma hā ta na ga na pū dza āḥhūm̐: zhes byin rlabs/ dngos gzhi dam tshig 'khor lo sgom pa ni/ oṃ ma hā shū n+ya ta dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ: āḥ stong nyid 'od gsal de bzhin nyid dbyings las: rig pa'i rang rtsal byang chub sems kyi sprin: skad cig mkha' la skar chen shar ba bzhin: bskyed rgyu'i sa bon hrīḥyig dmar gsal shar: de las 'od 'phros snod bcud dngos 'dzin sbyangs: e yam̐ bam̐ ram̐ lam̐ las yum lnga'i mkhar: 'byung lnga rim brtsegs ri rab srung 'khor dbus: bhrūm̐ las rang byung lhun grub gzhal med khang : sgo gru rta bab mtshan nyid yongs rdzogs dbus: sna tshogs 'dab bzhi'i lte bar rma bya'i khrir: thabs shes zung 'jug nyi zla 'od 'bar steng : hrīḥlas gu ru padma thod phreng rtsal: zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum khro 'dzum sgeg: phyag g.yas rab rgyas padma thugs kar gtod: g.yon pas de yi yu ba byas pa yi: dril bu dkur brten padma phag mo 'khril: dar dang ratna rus pa'i rgyan gyis spras: zhabs gnyis rdor skyil 'ja' 'od klong du gsal: rigs kyi bdag po snang ba mtha' yas shar: gtso bo'i thugs dbus pad nyi dregs pa'i steng*/ rta mgrin dmar nag gri thod yum dang sbyor/ phyogs bzhi'i 'dab mar rta mgrin rigs bzhi dang : sgo bzhir tshad med ging chen yab yum sogs: bdag skyob lha dang rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: bsam gyis mi khyab nyi zer rdul ltar 'khrigs: du mar snang yang ngo bo ngang du gcig: dbang gi las mdzad padma thod phreng rtsal: dran pa tsam gyis srid zhi'i gdung ba sel: sgom pa tsam gyis dbang gi phrin las 'grub: snang stong sgyu ma chu zla lta bur gsal: gdod nas rnam dag ye shes lngar dbang rdzogs:

rgyal kun rdo rje gsum gyi ngo bor dag: hrīḥhūm̐ trāṃ oṃ āḥ a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐: ye shes kyi 'khor lo spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐: yul gyi ming ni rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul: nub phyogs padma brtsegs pa'i dur khrod nas: gu ru padma thod phreng zhes su grags: 'khor du rig 'dzin dpa' bo mkha' 'gros bskor: gu ru khyod kyi rjes su bdag sgrub kyi: rnal 'byor byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol: dbang gi phrin las mthar phyin dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe ba dhā ki nī sarba dzñā na maṇḍal badzra sa mā ya dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs gnyis su med par gyur/ bzhugs su gsol la phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hoḥ ji ltar chu nyid la ni chu thim ltar: dbyer med lha la lha thim ngo mtshar che: gdod nas du ma ro gcig dkyil 'khor la: gnyis med chu zla'i gar gyis phyag 'tshal loḥ na mo na ma hoḥ mchod pa ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: dngos 'byor yid sprul 'phrul dga'i longs spyod bzhin: phyag rgya gar sogs phyi nang gsang ba yi: kun tu bzang po bla med mchod sprin gyis: dkyil 'khor rab 'byams ma lus mnyes gyur cig: oṃ gu ru dhāe wa dhā ki nī sarba dzñā na maṇḍal sa pā ri wa ra badzra arghaṃ nas shabda ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi: oṃ bho dhi tsitta ma hā ta na ga ṇa pū dza āḥhūm̐: bstod pa ni/ hrīḥ ma bcos spros bral bla ma chos kyi sku: bde chen longs spyod bla ma chos kyi rje: pad sdong las 'khrungs bla ma sprul pa'i sku sku gsum rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal bstod: hrīḥ sor rtogs ye shes klong nas sku sprul pa: bde chen longs spyod bla ma he ru ka: dbang gi phrin las mthar phyin 'khor lo'i bsgyur: padma thod phreng rtsal la phyag 'tshal bstod: hrīḥ byin rlabs rtsa ba bla ma thod phreng rtsal: dngos grub rtsa ba yi dam hya ghṛ: phrin las rtsa ba dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs:

dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: bzlas par bsnyen pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ thugs dbus padma nyi ma dregs pa'i steng : padma rta mgrin ye shes sems dpa'i tshul/ dmar nag padma'i mtshan pa'i gri thod 'dzin: rang 'od yum sbyor dur khrod chas rdzogs 'gying : thugs kar thabs shes nyi zla kha sbyor dbus: hrīḥmathar sngags 'khor 'od kyis zhing kun khyab: rgyal ba sras bcas kun gyi thugs dam bskong : 'gro drug sems can kun gyi las nyon sbyangs: tshur 'dus byin rlabs dngos grub rang la thim: rig stong mi 'gyur ka dag zang thal ngang : oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra ma hā gu ru padma thod phreng rtsal sarba siddhi hūm̐: 'bum phrag gcig bzlas dngos grub thob par 'gyur: sgrub pa ni: slar yang sngar bzhin thugs srog hrīḥdamar mthar: sgrub sngags rang sgra sgrog bzhin 'khor ba las: 'od kyis phog pas phyi snod gzhal yas khang : nang bcud sems can lhar 'gyur sngags kyi sgra: bung ba tshang zhig lta bur di ri ri: grag stong brag cha dran stong 'od gsal dbyings: snang srid gzhir bzhengs ye shes rdzogs par gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma thod phreng rtsal badzra sa ma ya dza siddhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ 'bum phrag gcig bzlas dngos grub thob par 'gyur: las sbyor ni: slar yang thugs srog sngags las 'od zer ni: rā ga'i mdangs ldan lcags kyu'i rnam pa can: grangs med rab 'phros phyi nang kun tu khyab: dus gsum rgyal ba'i thugs rje'i byin rlabs dang : srid pa gsum gyi lha 'dre mi gsum gyi: rlung sems snang ba mos pa rnam bzhi'i tshogs: khab len lcags bzhin bsdus te snying khar thim: 'gyur med rig pa'i ye shes rtsal rdzogs gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ḥ hrīḥmaḥha ri ṇi sa ra tsa hri ya tsitta hriṃ hriṃ dzaḥsarba lo ka pā shaṃ ku ru swā hā: rjes kyi las rim tshogs mchod bya ba la/ dang po byin rlabs ni/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐:
