bdag gi thugs las 'byung ba'i yi ge 'phros: me rlung chu yis tshogs kyi dngos 'dzin sbyangs: slar yang oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis tshogs rdzas rnams: sbyang rtogs sbar bas ye shes 'khor lor gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ gnyis pa spyan 'dren ni/ hūm̐: o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams: padma ge sar sdong po la: ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes: padma 'byung gnas zhes su grags: 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor: khyed kyi rjes su bdag bsgrub kyi: tshogs kyi 'du bar gshegs su gsol: gnas mchog 'di ru byin phob la: tshogs mchod ye shes bdud rtsi bsgyur: sgrub mchog bdag la dbang bzhi bskur: bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: badzra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ bla med gsang chen sngags kyi dam tshig rdzas: bde chen tshogs kyi 'khor lo e ma rmad: a la la ste thugs dam dbyings su skong : srid zhi mnyam nyid thig le chen po'i dbyings: khams gsum 'khor ba'i sems can thams cad kyi: nyams chag rtog tshogs ma spang rang grol nas: rang rig dag pa sku gsum mngon gyur te: kun bzang gdod ma'i gzhi la sangs rgyas shog: oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyoḥhūm̐: tshogs kyi rtogs pa bskyed cing nyams chag bskang : gsum pa mchod pa ni/ hūm̐: bla med tshogs kyi mchod pa dam pa 'di: dpag med 'dod yon lha mos gar bsgyur bcas: gu ru rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: bzhes nas dbang dang dngos grub bstsal du gsol: ma hā ga ṇa tsakra bha lingta pū dzaḥkhā hi: bzhi pa bshags pa ni/ hoḥ ye thog 'khrul gzhi blang nas da lta'i bar: rig dang ma rig 'khrul pa'i las dbang gis: bcas dang rang bzhin nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs: 'dod yon tshogs kyi 'khor los bskang zhing bshags: badzra sa ma ya shuddhe a: lnga pa bsgral bstab ni/ nṛ tri sarba sha truṃ a karṣa ya dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa 'gugs la/ hūm̐: gzung 'dzin 'khrul ba'i rang gzugs dgra dang bgegs:

stong nyid rnam thar e yi brub khung du: tshad med phyag rgya rnam bzhis dbyer med bstim: rnam shes dbyings sgrol gzugs phung zhal du stob: a spha ra ṇa phaṭḥkyis spar/ dgra bgegs nṛ tri sarba sha truṃ mā ra ya phaṭḥkyis bsgral/ ma hā māṃ sa rakta kiṃ ni ri ti sarba ru tra pra wan tsakra pū dzaḥkha kha khā hi: ha ha ha: hi hi hi: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: gis stabs/ drug pa lhag ma ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: hūm̐ bhyoḥ lhag la dbang ba'i dkyil 'khor mtha' skyong ba: dpal gyi 'khor tshogs badzra a ra li: ma tshogs dbang phyug ging lang 'bar ma'i tshogs: lhag gtor dgyes bzhes rnam bzhi'i phrin las sgrub: utstshi ṭa ba liṃ ta khā hi: spro na chad brtan sogs gzhung ltar dang*/ dngos grub len pa ni/ hoḥ rigs 'dus thod phreng lha tshogs dgongs su gsol: sku gsung thugs kyi bha ga yangs pa nas: phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub dang : thun mong las bzhi grub brgyad 'dod rgu'i char: da lta nyid du bstsal zhing brtan par mdzod: rtsa sngags dang*/ kā ya wākka tsitta sarba siddhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ rjes chog mchod bstod ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhāe wa dhā ki nī sarba dzñā na maṇḍal sa pā ri wa ra badzra arghaṃ nas shabda ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta ba liṃ ta ma hā ta na ga ṇa pū dza āḥhūm̐: hrīḥ byin rlabs rtsa ba bla ma thod phreng rtsal: dngos grub rtsa ba yi dam hya ghṛ: phrin las rtsa ba dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: nongs bshags ni/ hoḥ gsang ba'i sgor zhugs rnal 'byor sgrub pa po'i: bag med dbang gyur ting 'dzin ma gsal zhing : lha sngags ma dag cho gar lhag chad sogs: ye shes lha dang srung mar bzod par gsol: yig brgya bzla/ dkyil 'khor bsdu rim ni/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: snang cha lha sngags 'khor lo dbyings su bsdu: mi gnas thugs kyi thig les rtag mtha' bral: ā ā āḥ

phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ stong nyid rang gdangs thugs rje'i ye shes rtsal: sku gsung thugs kyi 'khor los chad mtha' spangs: oṃ āḥhūm̐: badzra ma ma ka wā tsi rakṣa haṃ: bsngo smon ni/ hoḥ bdag gis dus gsum dge ba ci bsags mthus: nam mkha'i mthar thug gyur pa'i sems can kun: bla med theg mchog sngags kyi snod gyur nas: padma rgyal po'i go 'phang myur thob shog: bkra shis ni/ hrīḥ rnga sgra'i rgyal po gzi brjid 'od dpag med: spyan ras gzigs dbang dbang chen rta skad 'tsher: sgyu 'phrul drwa ba padma rgyal po che: sku gsum lhun grub rgyal ba'i bkra shis shog: ces me tog gi char phab pas dge legs su bya'o/ /zhes gter chen pad rgyal gling pa'i gnas chen padma bkod nas bzhes pa'i zab gter sku gsum dgongs 'dus kyi chos sde chen po'i cha lag thod phreng sde lnga'i sgos sgrub las/ padma thod phreng sgrub pa rtsa ba gter gzhung la/ cho ga'i yan lag phrin las snying po dang sdeb pa'i phyag srol slad med bzhin/ spros med rgyun 'don bde phyir chad brtan sogs phris nas zur yangs par byas pa 'di'ang gter chen bla ma'i zhal snga nas chos bdag gu hyas mtshan can zhes bstsal ba'i gter slob tha shal ba gsang sngags su 'bod pas/ sa mo glang gi lo/ bcu gnyis bdag po bu mo khyim du 'byor ba'i dbang phyogs dga' ba dang po'i tshes la sdeb pa siddhi rastu/

bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: lha mo 'od zer can gyi bsgrub thabs bzhugs so: gsang ba zil gnon lha la 'dud: sa ma ya: bdag 'dra padma 'byung gnas la: lha mo 'od zer can ma yis: gsang bsgrubs 'jigs pa kun skyob bstan: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: lha mo 'od zer can ma yi: 'jigs brgyad zhi bar bsgrubs pa la: bkra shis tshang zhing dge ba'i gnas: yid 'ong mthun spyod dag pa'i grogs: smon lam ldan pa'i sa bcas btsal: dkyil 'khor padma tshom bu'i dbus: rin chen thod pa mtshan ldan nang : lha mo mnyes pa'i gtor ma bshams: gtsang ba'i mda' mo sgro lnga la: dar sna lnga dang rin chen lnga: dngul dkar me long dag gi brgyan: sindhu ra dang sman sna drug: thum bu mda' yi mgul du btags: mdun du mchod pa sna tshogs dang : tshogs dang spyan gzigs sna tshogs bsgrubs: rig ma mtshan ldan dag la ni: khrus bya gos dkar rigs dag bskyon: gnas lngar rigs lnga yab yum lnga'i: sa bon bris shing bgegs kyang bskrad: de nas 'od zer spyan ma bstim: sgrubs sngags brgya dang rtsa brgyad bzlas: sngags chu rig ma de la byug: rang nyid dag kyang khrus byas te: rigs ma lha mor mnga' gsol bya: 'jigs brgyad zhi ba'i phrin las bcol: de nas zung 'jug dbang bzhi blang : 'jigs brgyad zhi ba'i smon lam btabs: lha mo rang la thim par bsam: mtshan ldan lung zin ma snyed na: nyer lnga man dang bcu gsum yin: bsgrub pa'i grogs su shes par bya: de nas phyogs dang gnas kyi sgo: sbas yul dag la 'dzugs pa'i tshe: sna tshogs mda' dar lag tu thogs: rang nyid nyi ma 'od zer bsgoms: mkha' 'gro de yi sron byas te: gser skyems gtong zhing sprin yig bsgrag: tha tshig bshad cing smon lam 'debs: lha bswa bya zhing shel tshig gtor: de phyir rten 'brel ldan pa'i tshe: gnas dang sbas yul sgo 'byed cing : dpa' bo mkha' 'gros bsu ba 'byung :

shing 'bras sman dang 'bru bcud ril: gter dang gnas kyi zab don rtogs: tshe gcig 'ja' lus lam la gshegs: de phyir yang zab sgrubs pa'i mchog: gnas dang sbas yul sgo byed tshe: lde mig lta bu'i gdams pa nyid: lag len rgyud dang ldan par gyis: sa ma ya: de nas sngon 'gro bsgrubs rjes su: dran rdzogs skad cig 'di ltar bsgoms: hūm̐: rang nyid ngang la skad cig dran rdzogs su: padma nyi zla ram̐ gyi gdan steng du: rang nyid skad cig nyi ma 'od zer sku: dmar ser bram gzugs he ru kaḥpa'i chas: khro 'dzum mdzes ldan dbu skra spyi bor bcing : rin chen sna lnga thod phreng cod paṇa dmar: snyan rgyan mgul rgyan phyag gdub zhabs gdub ldan: phyag g.yas rdo rje nyi ma'i zer nas 'dzin: g.yon pas bhandha kha ṭwāṃ gru mor brtan: rus pa'i rgyan ldan zhabs gnyis rol stabs tshul: ye shes ram̐ lnga brtsegs pa'i dbus nas gsal: thugs ka'i hūm̐ mthar sngags phreng zer thags then: 'ja' lus gzi byin snang srid zil gnon gyur: oṃ gu ru surya rasmi yo gi nī dha ra dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ de nas dpa' bo cig bsgrubs sngags ci mang bzla: de nas mdun du lha mo 'od zer can ma bskyed pa ni: hūm̐: rang nyid rig 'dzin nyi ma 'od zer gyis: mdun du rin chen pad zla'am gdan steng du: gsang ba'i lha mo 'od zer can ma dmar: zhal gcig phyag gnyis mdzes 'dzum gzi ldan ma: rin chen rigs lnga dar dpyang cod paṇa 'phur: snyan cha mgul rgyan phyag gdub se mo do: spyi gtsugs 'od zer nyi ma 'bum phrag tshul: phyag g.yas mda' dar lnga ldan me long brgyan: g.yon pas bhandha nyi ma'i zer thags 'dzin: rus pa'i rgyan ldan zhabs gnyis dor stabs tshul: gcer mo bha ga nu ma rab tu rgyas: 'od zer sna lnga'i ye shes klong dkyil du: bdud bzhi 'jigs brgyad zhi ba'i tshul du gsal: de ltar bdag mdun gnas lnga'i 'od zer gyis: steng 'og phyogs bcus gnas chen pho brang nas:

dbyangs can lha mo 'khor bcas spyan drangs gyur: oṃ badzra sa ma ya pheṃ pheṃ dza dzaḥ spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: 'og min dag pa mkha' spyod gnas chen dang : gangs can gnyan gyi ma sring mkha' 'gros tshogs: 'od zer dbyangs can 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol: gsang ba'i dmigs rten ḍākkir thim par mdzod: oṃ badzra dhe wi rasmi gu hya ḍākki dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ de nas bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul ni: hūm̐: gsang ba ḍākki lha mo 'od zer can: 'jigs brgyad zhi phyir 'khor lo'i brten la bzhugs: rtsa khams lha ru gsal ba'i brda phyag 'tshal: dug lnga rnam dag ye shes mchod pa 'bul: sku lnga lhun grub zung 'jug ngang la bzhes: dga' bzhi lhan skyes dngos grub stsal du gsol: oṃ badzra puṣpe dhū pe a lo ke gandha nai wī dya shabda āḥhūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐ pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi: de nas bstod pa bya ba ni: hūm̐: yai shes dbyings phyug lha mo 'od zer can: nyi ma 'bum phrag shar ba'i mdangs ldan ma: shes rab rang bzhin dmar gsal ra ga'i mdog: rin chen rigs lnga brgyan 'chang pu ru ru: spyi bo'i gtsugs nas 'od zer gter 'byed ma: zhi 'dzum mdangs ldan dbyangs can bde stong gzugs: phyag g.yas mda' dar sbas gnas gter sgo 'byed: g.yon pas bdud rtsi rnal 'byor tshe srog bsring : nyi zer drwa bas 'jigs brgyad bdud bzhi bcom: rus pas rgyan ldan ma sring mkha' 'gro bsdud: gcer mo nu 'bur mnyen lcugs gar stabs bsgyur: bha ga rgyas shing bde drod dga' bzhi stsol: rnam thar brgyad kyi lam 'byed mkha' 'gro ma: 'ja' lus mi phyed ye shes ḍākki'i gtso: dbyangs can 'od zer lha mos sku la bstod: bsgrubs pa'i skal ldan rig 'dzin bdag cag la: srog lus dbang thangs stobs bcu yar la spel: zab gsang brda bzhi rten 'brel 'char sgo phyes: 'ja' lus rdo rje 'chi med grogs mdzod cig: oṃ dhe wi rasmi gu hya dzñā na kāau ma ri ma ma dha ra dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ

ces bzla zhing sngags chu lus la byug cing mda' dar bsngags: de nas tshogs bya zhing dga' ston rol: de nas zung 'jug dbang bzhi len pa ni: gsang ba'i rig ma'i phyag na mda' dar bzhag te: hūm̐: ye shes lha mo 'od zer can: gnas gsum mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum: gangs dkar gling dgu nyul ba'i tshe: phrag dog seṅge'i 'jigs pa bsrung : la bzhis rtse mo nyul ba'i tshe: nga rgyal stag gi 'jigs pa bsrung : rnal 'byor bdag gi grogs mo mdzod: bdag nyid nyi ma 'od zer gyis: sbas gnas zab gter 'byed pa'i tshe: srid gsum nam mkha'i dbyings klong nas: 'byung ba tsha grang 'thab pa yi: gnam lcags thog rgod 'jigs pa srung : sbas gnas ma sring 'khor bcas rnams: rtsib bzhi rong chen nyul ba'i tshe: zhe sdang sbrul gyi 'jigs pa bsrung : klung bzhi thang chen 'grim pa'i tshe: gti mug glang gi 'jigs pa bsrung : brag rngam chu 'gyu nyul ba'i tshe: nyon mongs mi rgod 'jigs pa bsrung : gaṅga na ra bgrod pa'i tshe: ma rig klu yi 'jigs pa skyob: yul dang gnas la 'brel pa'i tshe: las ngan rgyal pos 'jigs pa skyob: chu dang shing 'bras rol pa'i tshe: sna tshogs dug gi 'jigs pa skyob: lam 'phrang g.yang la 'grim pa'i tshe: bdud rigs chom po'i 'jigs pa skyob: bya tshal grong gling 'grim pa'i tshe: skal ngan dgra yi 'jigs pa skyob: 'jags skya'i klong du chags pa'i tshe: bdud srin mo yi 'jigs pa skyob: kha char mun rub gtib pa'i tshe: lam log lam gol 'jigs pa skyob: skyi g.ya' tshal chen 'grim pa'i tshe: sna tshogs gtsan 'jigs pa skyob(cha): lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul bstan pa'i tshe: las ngan rkyen dbang 'jigs pa skyob: hūm̐: gsang ba ye shes mkha' 'gro ma: phyi yi bdud dgra'i bar chad bzlog: nang gi 'byung bzhi 'khrugs pa skyob: ye shes 'khor lo'i rtsa rlung phyes: zab gter brda yi sgo mo phyes: sbas gnas sna tshogs sgo mo phyes:

rten 'brel ye shes 'char sgo phyes: dga' bzhi bde stong gsang sgo phyes: grol lam 'ja' lus pho nya rtsol: 'ja' lus dga' bzhi'i dbang bzhi stsol: gsang ba mchog gi dbang bzhi stsol: ye shes dga' bral dbang bzhi stsol: ngos sprod lhan skyes dga' bzhi stsol: oṃ arya ma ri tsyai rasmi bha wa su khaṃ siddhi dzaḥ ma ma rakṣa ku ru hūm̐: ces dar thag ye shes kyi 'od zer lnga ru gyur nas: de'i rgyud nas tshur 'dus te: 'od zer can ma bdag gi bar chad bdud bzhi sel ba'i rig mar gyur par bsgoms: de nas rang nyid nyi ma 'od zer du gyur pa'i yum lha mo 'od zer can byon te: dpang du zung 'jug 'khril bar bsgoms: dbang gi chu bo bzhi bab te: ldogs pa'i 'khrul 'khor kyis drangs bde stong mkha' la bkrams: ye shes bzhi yi rnal 'byor shes par bya: hūm̐: rang nyid nyi ma 'od zer sku: thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'phro 'du yi: lha mo 'od zer spyan drangs gyur: zung 'jug bde stong yum du gyur: 'khor lo lnga yi dbang bzhi stsol: dga' bzhi ye shes mngon gyur cig: oṃ dhe wi rasmi tsakra pañtsa gu hya a bhi ṣiñtsa dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rig ma dpang du blang te ye shes lnga yi rang zhal ngo bo skyongs: de nas rgyas 'debs smon lam ni: hūm̐: bla med gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro yi: dkyil 'khor dbang bzhi 'dzin pa'i dus: brgyad khri nyon mongs 'jigs las skyob: zab gsang 'khor lo'i sgo phyes nas: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro mchod pa dang : ma rgyud dbang du sdud mdzad pa: 'chi med rdo rjes srog sgrubs nas: 'ja' lus chos sku thob gyur cig: oṃ badzra dzñā na dharma bī shwa rasmi hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces bdud rtsis bcud blang te: 'chi med tshe yi rig 'dzin thob par bsgom: sa ma ya: de nas gser skyems btang ba ni: hūm̐: slob dpon padma thod phreng gis: dam tshig bka' la gnas pa yi: ye shes 'jig rten srung ma dang : dregs chen lha srin gzhi bdag rigs:

khyad par gnas dang sbas yul gyis: rig 'dzin padma'i gter srungs rnams: gser skyems gtor ma 'di bzhes la: gnas dang gter gyi lung bstan rtsol: sbyin bdag snang srid lha 'dre'i tshogs: a ti bla ma'i bka' la nyon: dus gsum sangs rgyas dam tshig spyod: bdag kyang yul 'dis gnas gter bdag: khyed kyang yul 'dis sa srung ste: sngags 'chang nyi ma 'od zer dang : las kyi ḍākki gzi ldan gyis: sdong grogs rogs dan phrin las mdzod: oṃ bhrum̐ mi pa ti sa pā ri wa ra i daṃ bha lingta kha kha khā hi: ces gtor ma 'bul zhing phrin las bcol: rgyun du gar 'gros par mda' dar dang ma bral bar bya: dam tshig gtsang zhing bsangs dang mchod pa bya: gdug 'dre drag po 'dug na ar gtad bya zhing dam la bzhag: 'di nyid gnas dang gter sgo 'byed pa'i dus min kyang : dam tshig gi phyag rgya bsten na: dbang bskur zhing lha mo'i byin gyis rlabs te: za yig sbyin pas sha za gson 'dre nag mo dang srin mo dngos med yin kyang dam thogs du 'gyur ba ma rtogs bar chad mi 'byung bar 'gyur ro: de phyir rdo rje theg pa rtsa rgyud nyams su len pa rnams lha mo 'di nyid sgrubs pa shin tu gtso che: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: e ma kho bo bdag 'dra padma 'byung gnas kyis: phyi rab rig 'dzin sbas gnas 'grims pa dang : gsang sngags nyams len brtson pa'i skal ldan don: phyi yi 'jigs brgyad bar chad zhi ba dang : nang gi bdud bzhi nyon mongs zhi ba'i phyir: 'od zer lha mos bsgrubs pa shin tu zab: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal mi brjed gzung thobs ste: phyi rab thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo padma gter bdag gling pas sbas tshal nas gdan drangs shing padma chos gling du shog ser nas bod yig tu zhal bshus so:: bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: rten dang dkyil 'khor rab gnas rde rje'i ri bo bzhugs so:

gsang ba zil gnon lha la 'dud: sa ma ya: bdag 'dra padma 'byung gnas kyis: rten 'brel zab pa'i las rim ste: rab tu gnas pa'i gdams pa bzhag: las 'phro can la 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: de yang rab gnas zhes pa ni: gdon dang bgegs rnams mi gnas cing : ye shes rab tu gnas par bya: sku gsung thugs yon mchod khang rnams: rab gnas dgos dang mi dgos rigs: rab gnas med pa'i skyon dag ni: sku la rab tu ma gnas na: gdon bgegs gab pa'i sri khang 'dra: gsung la rab tu ma gnas na: 'khor ba sgas po'i bstan chos 'dra: mchod rten rab tu ma gnas na: skyes bu med pa'i sku mkhar 'dra: gtsug lag rab tu ma gnas na: rgyal 'gong chags pa'i lha ra 'dra: ci phyir zhe na: sku gsung thugs kyis rten rnams kyang : byin rlabs rab gnas med pa rnams: khyi yul ri mo bkra lag kyang : mi rnams rnam shes bral ba dang : sgra tshig nyams pa'i 'o ded dang : byi sba sku mkhar brtsegs dang mtshungs: ci te rten 'brel ma 'tshogs skyon: ces so: rab tu gnas pa'i yon tan ni: sku la rab gnas gdung rig gso: ye shes lha bstim gnyis su med: gsung gi rab gnas sgra tshig 'grubs: rgyal ba kun gyi smon lam ldan: thugs kyi rab gnas ting 'dzin 'char: nyon mongs log pa'i bdud dang bral: gtsug lag rab gnas bzhal yas khang : mi shigs sra bsten yul bgegs bcoms: de phyir rab tu gnas par bya: rab gnas mi dgos rnam pa lnga: grub thob skyes bu drang srong tshogs: rgyal tshab sprul sku bden gnyis 'grubs: sngags pa mthu chen bden pa tshangs: bsgoms chen tshul ldan ting 'dzin dang : rab byung tshul ldan dam tshig dag: de rnams rang bzhin rab tu gnas: de dag rnams ni bzhengs pa'i: sku gsung thugs brten gtsug lag khang : rab gnas med kyang bgegs mi zhugs: 'on kyang rab gnas rten 'brel dgos: nyams pa yod na gso pa'i khyad: de phyir rab gnas shin tu gces:

mi nag phal pas bzhengs pa'i: sku gsung thugs brten gtsug lag rnams: bzhengs nas rab gnas med pa rnams: bgegs bskrad tshar gcod med pa la: rab gnas mang bzhin gdon gyi grog: ka cha rigs rnams gnod par 'gyur: ci phyir zhe na: dam tshig log pa'i chos pa de: stong gsum kun gyi ru trar skyed: gdon gyis bdag po sku gsung brten: 'chang tshad gnod pa'i rdzas ngan yin: rab gnas nyams pa'i gtsug lag khang : dam sri 'tshogs pa'i bsha' ra yin: de phyir bgegs bskrad drag po skyes: sa ma ya: rab gnas bya ba'i rim pa ni: bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa gdan drangs la: dkyil 'khor bzhengs shing rten de'i byang du yod par bya: sngon 'gro'i gtor ma bsang shing : gu gul bdug: thun drag po'i brab: las byang gzhung bsrangs la sngags la rkyal te: li yi sku yin na: bra zin sku la bril shing : bag sdul dang gnod byed thams cad dbyer med bsam zhing : sla nga ru me hom byas la bsregs: oṃ badzra ram̐ gnod byed sarba ha na ha na dzwa la ram̐: ces bsregs: de nas bgegs bskrad pa ni: hūm̐: nga ni khro chen he ru kaḥ nyon cig bgegs dang log 'dren tshogs: sku gsung thugs yon gtsug lag khang : 'di la chags cing gnod pa yis: rgyal 'gong dam sri 'byung pos rigs: mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la: so so rang rang gnas su dengs: dengs 'dir rten la ma chags cig: ci ste mi 'gro 'dug gyur na: khyed kyi lus ngag yid gsum rnams: rdul phran bzhin du brlag par byed: drag sngags tshwa tshwa 'u ru ru: rdo thun nyung thun chi li li: mgo bo tshal pa brgya ru 'gas: lus ni dum bu steng du gtor: de bas rang rang gnas su dengs: oṃ badzra he ru kaḥkro ta kro ti badzra kī li kī la ya gnod byed 'byung po dzwa la ram̐ mas ya rbad rbad:

sumbha ni brjod cing bgegs bskrad: de nas srung ba'i gur khang bsgom pa ni: hūm̐: khro rgyal thugs las sprul pa'i me dpung 'phros: phyi nang steng 'og me'i srung 'khor gyur: oṃ badzra dzwa la ram̐ tsakra rakṣa: hūm̐: khro rgyal sku las rdo rje'i ral gri 'phros: phyi nang steng 'og ral gri gur khang gyur: oṃ badzra kharga rakṣa: hūm̐: khra rgyal gsung las rdo rje'i ral gri 'phros: phyi nang hūm̐ dang rdo rje'i bsrung 'khor gyur: oṃ badzra hūm̐ ḍa ḍa tsakra rakṣa rakṣa: zhes srung 'khor bsgoms: de nas bum rdzas sna tshogs kyi chu'i dngos su bkru 'am: bris thang sogs yin na me long dang sbyar te bkru: rten gsar yin na lha rang rang mngon rtogs med kyang dbang lha sogs rtag tu bstim: hūm̐: 'og min lhun grub chos dbyings pho brang nas: sangs rgyas byang sems tshogs bcas spyan 'dren no: sku gsung thugs rten 'di la brten par bzhugs: ma 'gags longs spyod rdzogs sku'i pho brang nas: yi dam dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho spyan 'dren no: sku gsung thugs rten 'di la brten par bzhugs: rang rang gnas dang rigs mthun pho brang nas: dam can chos skyong gter bdag spyan 'dren no: sku gsung thugs rten 'di la brten par bzhugs: oṃ badzra sa ma ya pheṃ pheṃ a we sha ya a āḥ tiṣṭha lhan: rang gis thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang lha rgyal ba rigs lnga spyan drangs: bum pa'i chu dang dbyer med par gyur: oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrī āḥ mūṃ laṃ maṃ paṃ taṃ dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ces gsol ba btab pas dbang gis lha rnams kyi bum par khrus byas dri ma thams cad dag par gyur: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥhūm̐: de nas khrus bya ba ni: me long thogs ste: hūm̐: chos dbyings lhun grub bum pa ru: skye 'gags gnyis med bum chus bskangs: dri bzang sna tshogs ngad ldan pa: dengs 'dir sku khrus rtsal du gsol:

oṃ na ma sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ṣa te sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: chos kyi sku la mtshan 'dzin dri bral yang : sems can snang lus bag chags sbyangs slad du: sku la khrus gsol lus sgrib dag par shog: oṃ na ma sarba ta thā? 'gags med gsung la sgrib pa'i skyon bral yang : sems can tshig gis sgra 'dzin sbyang slad du: gsung la khrus gsol ngag sgrib dag par shog: oṃ na ma sarba ta thā? chos kyi thugs la smra brjod blo 'das kyang : sems can gnyis 'dzin a 'thas sbyangs slad du: thugs la khrus gsol yid sgrib dag par shog: oṃ na ma sarba ta thā ga t āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: sku gsung thugs yon nyon mongs sgrib bral yang : sems can rigs drug bag chags sbyangs slad du: khrus gsol sems can sgo gsum sgrib dag shog: oṃ na ma sarba ta thā ga ta sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: de nas dar dkar gyis phyes zhing : hūm̐: rgyal ba'i sku la mtshan ma'i dbya' bral yang : sems can ma rig gol sa gcod pa'i phyir: dar dkar sman dang ldan pas sku phyi'o: oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrī āḥbhi shwa dha ye swā hā: dri bzang gis chus khyab par byug la: hūm̐: chos kyis sku la bzang ngan ris med kyang : sems can dri zhim blo dang ldan pa'i phyir: rgyal ba'i sku la dri zhim chag chag byug: oṃ badzra puṣpe pū dza hoḥ de nas ye shes lnga'i na bza' 'bul zhing : hūm̐: chos kyi sku la reg bya'i rtsol bral kyang : sems can 'jam legs gos la spyod pa'i phyir: gos bzang rgyan ldan nam mkha'i khyon bskang 'bul: oṃ badzra parshe āḥhūm̐: de nas gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya thogs la: hūm̐: chos kyi sku la gzung 'dzin mi mnga' yang : sems can mdzes brnyan dri zhim longs spyod phyir: rgyal ba'i sku la gzugs sgra dri ro 'bul: oṃ badzra rū pa shabda gandhe rā sa a ra pa hūm̐: de nas lha zhi ba yin na mdzes rgyan thogs ste: hūm̐: chos kyi sku la rgyan gos mi mnga' yang :

sems can nyon mongs tshad gdung skyobs phyir du: cod paṇa mdzes rgyan stod g.yog smad dkris 'bul: oṃ badzra ku mu ḍa parshe āḥhūm̐: de nas khro bo yin na dpal chas thogs la: hūm̐: longs sku'i rtsal la rgyan 'phyang spros med kyang : sems can 'jigs skrag bar do skyob pa'i phyir: dur khrod chas brgyad dpal gyi chas bcu 'bul: oṃ badzra shrī he ru ka āḥhūm̐: de nas mchod yon yin na: hūm̐: yang dag thugs las 'khrul pa ka dag kyang : sems can bsod nams 'joms gos spyod slad du: gdugs dang rgyal mtshan na bza' cod paṇa 'bul: oṃ badzra ratna shi ra shwa na āḥhūm̐: gsung rab la: hūm̐: rgyal ba'i gzungs la sgra zur mi mnga' yang : sems can snyan grags chos 'khor bskor ba'i phyir: dar mtshon na bza' glegs shing sku rigs 'bul: oṃ badzra dharma shi ra shi me kha la āḥhūm̐: sngags kyi bla ma'i sku yin na: hūm̐: skyon bral sprul sku tshogs drug mi dmigs kyang : sems can re blo bsod nams rdzogs phyir du: pad zhwa ber phod chos gos rgyan ldan 'bul: oṃ badzra po ti dharma la sha āḥhūm̐: rab 'byung bla ma la: hūm̐: rnam dag dge slong chos gos 'dzin bral yang : sems can 'gogs lam rnam rtog bcol phyir du: chos gos shams thabs sku regs rnam gsum 'bul: oṃ dharma la sha sha kha le ṣṭa tsi sti āḥhūm̐: gtsug lag khang yin na: hūm̐: rgyal ba'i pho brang 'jigs bral rdo rje yang : sems can zhing khams lam mchog bstan phyir du: gser rtog rgya phig gdugs dang rgyan 'tshogs 'bul: oṃ so na ma ṇi a ru pa āḥhūm̐: ka dag khrig ldan spyod gos la: hūm̐: tshogs brgyad rnam shes bag chags sgrubs mnga' yang : sems can mos blo'i re kha sbyang phyir du: bkrag mdangs bkram bsten rab tu gnas gyur cig: oṃ badzra pra bha tiṣṭha hoḥ de nas ye shes pa spyan drangs la bstim te me tog 'thor zhing : hūm̐:rab tu gnas par gyur cig:

āḥmi shig brten par gyur cig: oṃ:khams gsum don du gnas shig: hoḥ gtsug lag khang dang sku gsung thugs rten rnams: ji srid bskal pa ma stong gis bar du brten par bzhugs su gsol: oṃ tiṣṭha badzra sa ma ya lhan: ye dharma dang dbyangs gsal rten 'brel snying po'i rab gnas bya: de nas chos skyong gang yin rtags du spyan drangs la gnyer gtad: hūm̐: sngon tshe rgyal ba'i spyan snga ru: ji ltar khas blang dam bcas pa'i: dam can chos skyong srung ma rnams: dam la ma 'da' gnas 'dir byin: sku gsung thugs kyi rten rnams dang : gtsug lag chos 'khor bsrung mar bkos: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: dengs nas byang chub ma thob par: phyi nang srung ba'i bya ra mdzod: sangs rgyas bstan pa yun du bsring : gtsug lag chos 'khor rgyas par gyis: oṃ dharma pā la ya tiṣṭha lhan: ces gtang rag tshogs 'khor bzang po bya: chos skyong la gnyer byang gtad la bstim: de nas bkra shis smon lam bya: me tog 'thor: hoḥ chos sku khyab brdal longs sku rtsal chen brjid: sprul sku gsang sngags bstan 'dzin yun ring rgyas: 'gro kun sems can 'dod dgu phun tshogs nas: bde dga' dpal la spyod pa'i bkra shis shog: sman lam ni: hūm̐: sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun rtsa ba gsum: gsang sngags rigs sngags ting 'dzin bden tshig gi: gtsug lag sku gsung thugs rten 'di nyid mchog: nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam brten cing mchod gnas shog: oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swā hā: ces rab tu gnas par bya: sa ma ya: bdag 'dra padma 'byung gnas kyi: phyi rabs sems can don gyi slad: rten cing rab tu gnas pa bzhag: yi ger thobs la gter du sbos: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: padma gter bdag gling pas sbas tshal padma'i klong nas gdan drangs shing : padma chos 'byung gling du shog ser nas bsgyur ba'o::

༁ྂ: bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: ri bstod gses mkhar lha khang brtsegs pa'i gsol mchod bkra shis lha'i ghandhi bzhugs pa'i dbu phyogs so: gsang ba zil gnon lha la 'dud: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: e ma: bdag 'dra padma 'byung gnas kyi: lha brten 'dzug pa'i gdams pa bstan: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal gzungs kyis zungs: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: ye shes 'jig rten 'khor ba'i phyir: lha khang gses mkhar brtsegs pa ni: 'di nyid dgos dang mi dgos ste: shin tu bas kyang dgos pa'o: dper na ye shes 'jig rten rnams: kun kyang dbyings la 'gyu mod kyang : chag rten med pa rlung dang 'dra: bem po med pa'i rnam shes 'dra: sku mkhar lha khang ldan gyur na: skyes bu mkhar rdzongs 'phrad pa 'dra: yul der chags pa'i rten du 'gyur: chos skyong dang ni yul lha rnams: gnas dang lha brten dag la dgyes: mkhar 'dzin brten pa'i rten 'brel ste: lha brten gser mkhar bstod pa'o: de dag brtsegs pa'i rnam dbye ni: mtho zhing rgyas pa'i ri bo rtser: de la gses mkhar brtsegs gyur na: khams gsum dbang du 'du ba dang : snyan grags che ba'i rten 'brel yod: rgyab ri la sogs las stan la: ri bstod gses mkhar brtsegs gyur na: rang mgo mi 'go mi 'chor ba'i: lha 'khor gnas brten rten 'brel yod: spyir ni g.ya' spangs gangs gi ri: brag shing skyed mo'i klu yi gnas: rang rang yul lam gang rung du: rten 'brel lha brten brtsegs pa ni: sde brgyad lha srin de ru 'khor: nang du bum gter bzhag gyur na: longs skyod phywa g.yang phun sum tshogs: longs sku bla brten bri gyur na: sbad bskul bden pa mdor brtsam chog: de phyir sde brgyad lha brten rten 'brel gnas: sa ma ya: de yang lha brten brtsegs pa ni: rten 'brel che ba'i sa gnad gdams: gnas dang sa rtags che ba ru: bsang bya tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor:

dang po zhi rgyas dbang drag gis: rdo sna bzhi la gzhi byas ste: phrin las bzhi ldan tshul du brtsegs: de yang gzhi la gru bzhi la: de steng gru gsum dag tu brtsegs: de steng zla gam dbyibs su brtsegs: de steng zlum po'i dbyibs su brtsegs: de steng nor bu'i dbyibs su brtsegs: yang na zhi rgyas gnyis su brtsegs: nang du rin chen bum pa ru: gro ga 'am ni shing shun la: rang rang gsol kha sngags kyang bzhag: yang na srog yig sngags kyang bzhag: rang rang zhi drag ci bzhin ru: tsandan dkar dmar byug pa dang : seng ldeng skyer pa tsher ma ste: zhi rgyas gang yin srog shing la: srog sngags yi ge bri bar bya: shing yang ri rab dbyibs dag la: nyi zla nor bu tshangs bar bya: yang na g.ya' ma legs po la: sku'am gzugs bris byas kyang chog: bum pa rin chen sna lnga la dang : khrus sman sna tshogs dar zab sogs: legs par bkang te snying du bzhags: de dag mi rul thabs cig bya: steng du lha gzhung rang rang gi: srog yig rlung rta nag po dang : rang gi dpal bskyed rlung rta 'dzugs: de steng rnga thug rgyal mtshan dang : rtogs dang mtshon cha rgyas par 'dzugs: dkar dmar lha mdog mtshon kyang byug: de nas thams cad 'grubs rjes su: 'byung po nag po mi gnas phyir: bgegs bskrad drag po dag kyang bya: srung 'khor dag ni med kyang rung : chos skyong spyi yi srog sngags ni: oṃ dharma pā la dza dzaḥ oṃ kṣe ṭa pā la dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ pa ra mi ta sha la kum pa de bi dza tiṣṭha tsanḍa lhan: maṅga la a nu ta ra pra bha wa ti swā hā: chos skyong rang gzhung yod na so sor bsgyur: gzhi bdag yin na: oṃ bhruṃ mi pa ti na ga ra tsa lokka pa la pa te be sha dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya tiṣṭha lha: maṅga la swā hā: ces bris: dar chos la yang de ltar bris: rang gi rlung rta dar chos ni: sna tshogs gang rung ras dag la: lte bar sngags 'di klag nas bris: oṃ badzra sarba dharma ma hā kā la ma ni ratna ma ma siddhi pha la hoḥ

oṃ e yam̐ ram̐ kham̐ sum̐ bhrūm̐ hūm̐: cha3lt;!TCC Tibetan character 3,148 undefined in unicode!>ཻ'i srog lus dbang thang spar sme chos dang mnga' thang longs spyod kha rje dbang thang bkrag gzi mdangs thams cad yar la bskyed cig: oṃ sarba dharma ma hā ya na pā ri wa ra ye swā hā: khyung 'brug stag seng gdan yar bskyed: oṃ sarba maṅga laṃ siddhi hoḥ oṃ ga ga na maṅga la saṃ bha ro sa pā ri wa ra ye swā hā: ces gong la nyi zla dang gdan la byol song gi steg kyang bris: mi tha mal ba la gdan mi 'os so: rnga thug nang du chos skyong ba'i srog yig kyang bzhag: sa ma ya: de nas sku mkhar chos skyong ltar bskyed pa ni: dang po oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi byin gyis rlabs: chos skyong rang gi gtor ma mdun du bshams: hūm̐: e las 'byung ba rim brtsegs lhun po'i dbus: ma bcos rang byung drag po'i pho brang ni: gru bzhi sgo bzhi zhi rgyas dbang drag tshangs: rtsigs pa ka gdung rgyan kun lhun gyis grub: dur khrod rang bzhin bkod pa yongs su rdzogs: me 'od gur dang rnga thug mtshon cha gzing : rgyan dang bla re 'phan rtogs dbyings dang mnyam: srog yig bla 'khor gzhi bdag rlung rta brgyan: rgyal srid rin chen bkra shis rdzas kyi spras: gter bum ldan zhing ma tshangs med pa'i dbus: sna tshogs pad nyi bam ro'i gdan steng su: de nas lha gang yin gyi mngon rtog ltar bskyed: las byang yin na tshogs kyang btang : gtor 'bul sngon du rten brtsug ni: gser skyems dang ni gtor ma 'bru bcud 'bras chang sbreng zhing rol mo bya rkang gling brtser: dbyangs snyan po dang bcas nas 'di skad do: hūm̐: dur khrod pho brang rgyan rtogs mdzes pa 'di: drag rtsal chos skyong chen po'i rten du 'dzug: brten la 'khor zhing pho brang gnas 'dir bzhugs: mthu rtsal 'gyed phyir gses mkhar gnyen po bstod: sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas phyir lha khang brtsegs:

dkon mchog dbu 'phang rten phyir brten du btsug: rgyud 'dzin bu bzhin skyongs la bstan pa bsrungs: gsol lo gsol lo mchod do lha gsol lo: hūm̐: rnga thug dar gdung rtse gsum gzeng ba 'di: drag rtsal chos skyong chen po'i brten du 'bul: rten la 'khor zhing pho brang ? mthu rtsal 'gyed? sangs rgyas bstan p dkon mchog dbu 'phang ? rgyud 'dzin bu bzhin? gsol lo gsol lo mchod do lha gsol lo: hūm̐: ru mtshon ba dan rgyan ldan phyar ba 'di: drag rtsal chos skyong chen po'i brten du 'bul: sogs gsol lo? hūm̐: bkra shis rdzas rtags rin chen rgyan ldan 'di: drag rtsal chos skyong sogs: hūm̐: gter bum bla 'khor srog gi yi ge 'di: drag rtsal chos skyong chen po'i sogs gsol lo? hūm̐: zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las bzhi ldan 'di: drag rtsal chos skyong sogs gsol lo? hūm̐: phyi nang bkod pa sprin ltar gtib pa 'di: drag rtsal sogs gsol lo? hūm̐: sngon tshe rgyal ba'i spyan snga ru: khas blangs dam la gnas pa yis: chos skyong dam can gter bdag rnams: gser skyems phud dang gtor ma bzhes: rnal 'byor dpon slob 'khor bcas rnams: mtho ba dgongs la reg pa yi: dbu 'phang gnyen po yar la bstod: pha rol dgra bgegs cham la phob: sa brten srung la yul brten skyongs: snyan grags mnga' thang chos srid spel: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: oṃ sarba dharma pā la bha lingta kha kha khā hi:

ces gtor ma 'bul: gzhan yang lha so so'i gtor 'bul rgyas pa bya: bkra shis rab tu gnas: sa ma ya: de nas gzhi bdag gnas la lha bstod gses mkhar ni: dkar gtor lnga bshams rdzas sogs byin rlabs ltar bya la: mdun bskyed ni: hūm̐: mdun du bhrūm̐ las byung ba yi: rin chen pho brang las grubs pa'i: pho brang gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa: sna tshogs gdugs dang dar dpyang mdzes: zhi rgyas dbang drag bzhi ru grub: phyi nang 'ja' 'od gur du 'khyil: rin chen sna tshogs dag kyi spras: 'phen gdug rgyal mtshan mkha' la sbreng : ba dan co paṇa phyogs bcur spyod: rnga mi rtogs dang dar mdung sbreng : nang na bkra shis rdzas brgyad bkod: bla 'khor gter bum yid mthun phyug: kun bzang tshangs pho brang chen po'i dbus: sna tshogs rin chen khri steng su: gzhi bdag so so'i mngon rtogs yod na spyan drangs: med na: hūm̐: lha klu gzhi bdag sde brgyad tshogs: yid 'ong pho brang dbus su bzhugs: 'dod yon rin chen bsang mchod 'bul: so so'i yid kyi mchod pas tshig: dgos 'dod lha'i rdzas ltar gyur: spro dga' dgyes pa'i ngang la bzhugs: hūm̐: gzhi bdag lha srin sde brgyad la: sku mkhar srog rten phul ba ni: yid 'ong pho brang gzhal yas 'di: lha srin gzhi bdag brten du btsugs: dbu 'phang bstod pa'i gses mkhar brtsegs: bstan pa bsrungs ba'i lha brten 'dzugs: sa skyongs yul 'dzin mkhar du 'bul: rnal 'byor snyan grags dbu 'phang bstod: hūm̐: gdugs dang rgyal mtshan gser rtog 'di: lha srin gzhi bdag rten? dbu 'phang bstod pa'i? bstan pa srung ba'i? sa skyong yul? rnal 'byor snyan grags? hūm̐: dar mdung rlung rta sna tshogs 'di: lha srin gzhi bdag rten du? dbu 'phang bstod pa'i? gong 'gres so: hūm̐: 'phen dar dar dpyangs sna tshogs 'di: lha srin gzhi bdag rten? dbu 'phang bstod pa'i? hūm̐: pho brang zhi rgyas dbang drag 'di:

lha srin gzhi bdag? hūm̐: rnga phod ru dar gzengs ba 'di: lha srin gzhi bdag rten? hūm̐: sna tshogs mdung dang ba dan 'di: lha srin gzhi? hūm̐: bkri shis rdzas rtags sna tshogs 'di: lha srid gzhi bdag? hūm̐: bla rten srog yig sku 'bag 'di: lha srin gzhi? hūm̐: mi bzad gter bum longs spyod 'di: lha srin gzhi? hūm̐: phyi nang mchod pa sna tshogs 'di: lha srin gzhi bdag rten du 'bul: dbu 'phang ? bstan bsrung ? sa skyong yul 'dzin? rnal 'byor snyan grags dbu 'phang bstod: de nas dkar gtor 'bul: gzhan yang lha rang rang la gsol ka yod na 'di'i 'tshams su 'bul: hūm̐: lha srin gzhi bdag sde brgyad rnams: gser skyems phud dang gtor ma 'bul: sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyen po bsrungs: rnal 'byor dpon slob 'khor bcas rnams: dbu 'phang dgongs dang mnyam par bstod: nyin mtshan srung ba'i bya ra gyis: gdug pa'i dgra bgegs cham la phob: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grubs par mdzod: oṃ lo ka pā la bhrum̐ mi pa ti sa pā ri wa ra ye i daṃ bha lingta kha kha khā hi khā hi: ces gtor ma 'bul zhing phrin las bcol: bkra shis brjod cing rab tu gnas: bsangs mgron so sor gshegs na yang : lha brten dag ni mi gshegs so: rten 'brel dge legs sna tshogs bya: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: bdag 'dra padma 'byung gnas kyi: sa brten yul skyong 'dzug thabs bzhag: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal gzungs kyi zungs: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo padma gter bdag gling pas lcags byi lor padma sbas tshal nas gdan drangs zhing gsang sngags chos 'byung gling du shog ser las bsgyur ba'o:: ༁ྂ: ༁ྂ: bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: gtum po khyung shams can bsgrubs thabs klu 'dul nag po bzhugs so: gsang ba zil gnon lha la 'dud: sa ma ya: e ma bdag 'dra padma thod phreng gis:

man ngag kun gyi mthar thug las: gtum po klu 'dul nag po bstan: dbyangs can brda'i ri mor gzugs: rin chen gsang ba'i gter du sbos: las 'phro can la 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: gtum po bsgrubs pa'i man ngag ni: 'di ni spros med kho na te: rang nyid lha yi rnal 'byor bsgoms: ma yengs drag sngags thor thor bzlas: khyad par mdze nad la sogs dag: gso zhing sman gyi bcun pa las: shu dag dbang lag me ru rtse: klu brgyad rdo rje tha dkar rdo rje dang : gri sha 'dra khrag gla rtsi dang : lcags phye zangs phye dngul phye dang : 'dzin pa phran bu bse zhos bcas: zhib 'thags ril bu dril la bsngags: lto stong dri mus phul te btang : yang na bshal skug ltar mos na: thar nu dur byed lcags sbrul bsres: dpe ni nad kyang gshang sgor don: ci phyir snying rus ldan pa yi: sngags rdzas 'di nyid btson gyur na: mdzes pho rkang lag chad kyang 'byor: phran bus klu nad lta ci smos: ma 'ongs klu bdud kha rlangs dar: gdug pa'i nad rigs dar gyur na: 'di nyid cig mgo sa ma ya: dang po dran rdzogs bskyed rim ni: hūm̐ khroṃ: skad cig gnam lcags khro chu khol ma yi: pho brang dbus su klu srin brgyal ba'i steng : bdag nyid gtum chen klu 'dul nag po'i sku: mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis me zer 'phye: g.yas pas khyung khra g.yon pas sbrul zhags 'dzin: dur khrod chas rdzogs spu gri'i sgro bshogs brgyang : klu bdud 'dul mdzad zhabs gnyis dor stabs gsal: hūm̐: spyi bor bya khyung mthing nag ga ru ḍa: me gshogs rdeb cing zangs ra gnam du gzing : rdo rje'i mchu brdar chu srin sder mo bsgrad: klu srin gdol pa pho mo zhal du gsol: kram traṃ sgra sgrogs sa bdag snying rtsa 'gas: 'joms byed chen mo me dpung klong du gsal: hūm̐: klu 'dul gtum po bya khyung thugs ka ru: hūm̐ dang khroṃ la sngags phreng 'khor ba yis: phyi nang nad gdon bgegs tshogs 'byung po bcoms:

ba spu'i bu gar bya khyung grangs med gtams: de las 'od 'phros snang srid me yi khengs: tshwa tshwa khol zhing bar med khyab pa yis: klu gnyen sa bdag tshar bcad las grubs gyur: oṃ badzra kro ta khroṃ ram̐ ga ru ḍa nā ga bi na ya bi na ya bhuṃ mi tsitta gzer thum trig thum swā hā: zhes pa rtsa sngags go: bsad sngags ni: oṃ dza tri me tri klu bdud kyis snying la rbad rbad: oṃ tsi tri tsi tri sa bdag kyis srog la gzer gzer: oṃ khroṃ ram̐ ga ru ḍa klu gnyen sa bdag gi snying rtsa gtor gtor 'ur 'ur shig shig swā hā: mdze nad sngags ni: oṃ dza tri ya: mdze (dpe cha mi 'dug) rol ni: thang phrom dang ni phag mkhris gnyis: rtsa sngags de yi mang nan nas: snod du rdo bzhag bsregs te 'dug: kha bcad smyugs sbug rgyud nas drangs: des ni stod mdze sel bar 'gyur: lte 'og sor bzhi mu kha'i steng : mkhal rtsa gnyis dang 'bol gong gnyis: me tshugs brgyab nas rkang khrag phyung : de yi smad mdze sel bar 'gyur: khyad par mdze rigs lnga 'byung ste: srog 'dzin log nas sna sbugs 'gags: khyab byed log na ngo gdong sbos: bde mnyam log na sma shu 'gyams: gyen rgyu log na rna ba 'on: thur ser log na rtsa rgyus skrangs: lpags mdze yin na sha mdog skya: rus mdzes yin na mig rtsa dmar: khrag mdze yin na dbang po 'gags: sha mdze yin na yan lag 'dzin: kun kyang tshangs na mdze nag zer: kun kyang tshangs na las nad ste: bsnyen bsgrub phran bu'i phan par dka': de sogs rtag dang bcos rim ste: phra zhib lag len ldan pa gces: ci ltar bsnyen bsgrubs ldan gyur na: byang nges de la the tshom med: de bas zab thig sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyis rgya mtsho'i lcags byi lor bal yul yang le shod nas gdan drangs shing chos gling du shog ser nas zhal bsgyur ba'o: bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las:

'dzam lha dkar phyogs kyis gsur mchod bzhugs so: gsang ba zil gnon lha la 'dud: sa ma ya: dkar gsur 'dzam lha mchod thabs ni: ka ra bu ram sbrang rtsi dang : dkar kra phud dang a ka ru: legs par sbyar ba'i bsregs rdzas rtsam: mchod pa'i dus ni nyin phyed ste: gyang grags dung gis spyan 'dren bya: byin rlabs sngags kyi rab tu sbyangs: 'jam pa'i shing gis me la bsregs: sa ma ya: dang po: na mo: theg mchog 'bras bu mngon 'gyur dkon mchog gsum: longs spyod 'phel phyir gus pas skyabs su mchi: 'gro kun dbul ba'i 'jigs las rab grol ste: dga' bde bsod nams rgya mtsho thob par shog: gnyis pa: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: hūm̐: zhi thab dkar po zlum 'khyil mdzes pa'i dbus: dkar gsum bsreg rdzas mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i tshogs: dkar phyogs nor lha dgyes pa bskyed phyir spel: oṃ āḥhūm̐: sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta pū dzaḥme gha hūm̐: gsum pa: hūm̐: rang nyid thugs mchog yang dag he ru kaḥ zhal gcig phyag gnyis mthing nag khro 'dzum mdzes: phyag gnyis rdo rje dril bu thugs kar bsnol: dur khrod chas ldan shwa ri dpang du 'khyung : zhabs gnyis brkyangs bskum gar dgus nyams kyi bzhugs: oṃ badzra ma hā kro ta shrī he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐: thugs ka'i sa bon 'od zer 'phro 'du yis: 'dzam lha nor bdag 'khor bcas spyan drangs gyur: oṃ badzra sa ma ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ padma ratna sa ma ya tiṣṭha satwaṃ: bzhi pa: hūm̐: byang phyogs lhun grub gter gyis pho brang nas: nor gyi dbang phyug dpal ldan 'dzam bha lha: padma rgyal po ārya re manta: rnam sras skya brgyad 'dzam lha nag po dang : rta bdag brgyad dang lug bdag ku be ra: nor bu bzang po gang ba bzang po dang : nor rgyun ma dang phyugs gis ma lha brgyad: lha bu tshe 'dzin rgyal mo bu rdzi ma: thab lha yul mo zhing lha tshangs pa dang : sgo rdzi lha g.yag la sogs phyugs kyis bdag: srid pa'i lha rgan phyugs po mgon dkar dang :

longs spyod nor gyis bdag po thams cad la: 'dod yon sna tshogs dkar mngar bsregs pa yis: mnyes pa'i dri gsur mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'bul: mnyes zhing tshims nas bsgrubs pa'i rig 'dzin la: bsod nams nor dang longs spyod char bzhin phobs: don gnyis mthar phyin gter la spyod par shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ bai shra ma ṇa ya sa pā ri wa ra ye swā hā: lnga pa: hoḥ bdag gi bsod nams nor lha'i tshogs bcas la: zab chos mchod sbyin bsreg mchod phul ba'i mthus: pha ma rigs drug sems can ma lus pa: mi zad longs spyod gter la spyod par shog: drug pa: hoḥ yid bzhin nor bu dbang gi 'khor lo can: longs spyod char gyis 'gro rnams ces bsgyur ba: 'byor drug 'dod don lhun grub spyod pa yis: dge legs rtags du rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog: bdun pa: hoḥ mi zad khyon gyis bdag po nor gyis lha: dkyil 'khor bzung 'jug bde chen klong du hoḥ sarba maṅga laṃ bha wantu swā hā: ces phrin las bcol dgos gang yod 'dod gsol sbyar du rung : thun tha ma mi zad rgyun gyis 'khor lo bzhugs: sa ma ya: e ma bdag 'dra pad 'byung kyis: nor bdag mchod thabs sbyin bsregs bzhugs: 'di nyid bgyis pa'i skal ldan la: bsod nams mi zad gter la spyod: dgos 'dod 'byung ba the tshom med: man ngag gdams pa khyad par 'phags: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo padma gter bdag gling pas lcags byi lor sbas tshal nas gdan drangs zhing shog sel las zhal bshus so:: ༁ྂ: bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: dmar gsur dregs pa'i tshims byed bzhugs so: gsang ba zil gnon lha la bstod: sa ma ya: dmar gsur bya ba'i rim pa ni: sha chen bzhi'i gtso byas pa'i: sha sna snying sna 'dzoms tshad bsags: zhibs du 'thags nas phye ma bya: rkang dang tshil bu'i khu bar sbyar: dmar chen glan yang cung zad bsre:

gsur mchod btad pa'i dus tshod dag: srod 'phros lha 'dre 'gyu ba'i dus: thab su bsregs ste byin gyis rlabs: mgron rnams gri rkang gling bus 'bod: rang nyid yi dam lha gsal nas: ye shes 'jig rten mgron la sbyin: 'di yi yon tan bsam mi khyab: yi dam drag po mchod pa dgyes: ma sring mkha' 'gro gsur la mnyes: chos skyong sha khrag dmar gyi tshim: nag phyogs dregs pa'i de kha khengs: las byed phrin las gang bcol bsgrubs: 'jig rten mi rnams dbang du 'du: longs spyod dkor cha rnams kyang skyongs: dgra la rbad na phye mar brlag: mkhu ldog bka' chad rnams kyang byang : sa ma ya: dang po skyabs yul gsol 'debs ni: hūm̐: chos kyis dbyings nas rang byung sprul pa'i lha: gsang ba zil gnon dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: mchod sbyin rtsam phyir gus pas skyabs su mchi: 'gro kun bde ldan sdug bsngal kun bral shog: gnyis pa byin rlabs ni: hūm̐: stong pa'i ngang las drag po'i me thab dbus: sha khrag rdzas chen bsregs pa'i dri yi mchog: drag po'i dkyil 'khor mchod pa'i rdzas su gyur: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ ma hā māṃ sa tsitta rakta go ro tsa na bha su ta dzwa la a hu ti bi sho oṃ āḥhūm̐: gsum pa: hūm̐: rang nyid skad cig che mchog he ru kaḥ smug nag zhal gsum phyag drug dpa' zhing dgyes: g.yas gsum rdo rje g.yon gsum bhan dmar 'dzin: dur khrod chas ldan bsgro bshog mkha' la brgyang : zhabs bzhi dor stabs lha chen pho mo brdzis: ye shes me 'od 'khrugs pa'i klong du gsal: oṃ badzra ma hā kro ta padma kro ti shwa ri badzra kī li kī la ya ma hā yakṣa kā la rū pa karma ram̐ ram̐ dzwa la ram̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐: thugs kyis sa bon me long lcags kyu ltar: 'phros pas phyogs bcu rab 'byams gnas mchog nas: ye shes 'jig rten bsrung ma spyan drangs nas: rang rang mthun pa'i ldan la dgyes par bzhugs:

oṃ badzra sa ma ya dza dza pheṃ pheṃ: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ padma kā ma la ti ra baṃ tiṣṭha lhan: bzhi pa: hūm̐: khrag 'thung chen po dkyil 'khor dgu'i lha: zhi khro rab 'byams bka' sdod gter bsrungs la: sna tshogs sha chen khrag chen rkang dmar tshil: bcud dang khu bar sbyar ba'i rdzas chen po: bsregs pa'i mchod sprin bun ltar g.yo ba 'di: 'bul lo bzhes shing thugs dam bskang gyur nas: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub dam pa rtsol: oṃ a hu ti kha kha khā hi: hūm̐: dur khrod rngams chen me rlung 'tshubs ma'i klongs: thod mkhar dmar nag pho brang so so'i dbus: bstan pa'i bka' srung las mdzad mi bsrun pa: legs ldan mgon po phyag bzhi phyag drug dang : ma ning dang ni gdong bzhi bram gzugs can: las mgon seng gdong srog bdag bya rog gdong : gri gug bing chen dmar nag krag shad dang : gur mgon a gho ra dang stag zhon pa: ber nag can dang seng zhon mdung thung can: khyed par gza' bdud king kang rā hu la: srog bdag ma mo dam can rdo rje legs: btsan rgod khrag 'thung shan pa mdung dmar can: drag po dge gnyen klu dang bdud kyis rjes: ging chen pho mo sha za bye ba 'bum: rgyal chen dpe dkar la sogs gter bsrung dang : sde dpon sum bcu dregs byed yang 'khor la: sha khrag gsur gyis mchod pa 'di 'bul lo: bzhes nas sangs rgyas pa bsrungs ba dang : bsgrubs pa'i rig 'dzin bdag la bu bzhin skyong : snang srid lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du bsdud: skye 'gro 'jig rten pho mo'i snying bsgul la: zas nor longs spyod gnas 'dir char bzhin phobs: snyan grags mnga' thangs dpal 'byor rgyas pa dang : bdag la sdang zhing 'tshe ba'i dgra bgegs bsgrol: bcol ba'i phrin las thog med 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: khyed par lo zla zhag dus bdag po dang : gangs can yul ljongs skyongs ba'i dregs pa che: yul 'dis gtsug lag dben rir gnas pa yis:

sha khrag dmar la dgyes pa'i lha srin rnams: bsregs rdzas zag med mchod sbyin 'di bzhes la: ko long phrag dog gdug sems zhi ba dang : tshe rab sngon las 'phral rkyen gyur pa yis: lan chags sha mkhon thams cad dag par mdzod:

lnga pa: hūm̐: phyi nang dkyil 'khor lha'i tshogs rnams la: bla med bsregs rdzas mchod pa phul ba'i mthus: ma gyur 'gro rnams rigs drug sems can rnams: sha khrag mchod sbyin tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs nas: skyes gnas ngan pa bzhi'i sgo chod ste: bla med byang chub 'bras bu thob par shog: oṃ a ti bho dhi tsitta hrī dha ya swā hā: drug pa: hūm̐: zab yang nam mkha'i dus gsum rgyal ba'i thugs: 'od gsal nyi ma 'bum kyis 'khyud pa'i dpal: srid gzhi ma rig mun pa'i smag bsal nas: zil gnon dkyil 'khor lha'i bkra shis shog: bdun pa: hoḥ bskyed pa'i lha tshogs bsrungs ma rgya mtsho'i tshogs: ka dag rang gnas ye shes klong du gshegs: ma 'gags rol rtsal rgya yan sgyu mar bsdu: oṃ badzra mū: ces mgron thams cad mnyes shing tshims nas bstan pa'i las mdzad cing: bsgrubs pa po yi phrin las bsgrubs par bsam: rjes shes mi dmigs stong pa'i ngang du bzhag: sa ma ya: e ma bdag 'dra padma 'byung gnas kyi: dmar mchod gsur gyis rim pa bzhag: tshogs rdzogs bar chod zhi ba'i gnad: zab pa'i mthar thug khyad par 'phang : las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rya: bdag 'dra padma gter bdag gling pas lcags byi lor sbas tshal nas gdan drangs pa'o:: dpal chen dregs pa zil gnon las/ gtor bzlog gi las rim 'grigs chags su bkod pa gnam lcags thog rgod ces bya ba bzhugs so/ na mo gu ru badzra pā ṇi ye/ gsang ba'i bdag po gtum chen 'bar ba'i gar/ /dpal chen dregs pa zil gnon rtsal la 'dud/ /gang de'i phrin las mngon spyod dmod pa'i dbal/ /srung bzlog bsad pa'i 'phrul 'khor 'dir 'god bya/ de'ang dpal chen dregs pa zil gnon gyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas rang gzhan gyi 'gal rkyen mtha' dag zlog pa dang*/ khyad par du snyigs ma lnga bdo'i mar sham 'di ru/ steng gi gza' rgyu skar dang*/

'og gi klu sa bdag gi gnod 'tshe shin tu che ba la/ ches cher bsngags pa'i gter kha gong 'og thams cad nas/ zab cing sbas pa shin tu 'byung bar dkon pa'i zab rgya gsang ba'i yang zhun 'di nyid kyi sgo nas/ mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las brtson pa la/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes kyi rim pa'o/ dang po sbyor ba yo byad bsham tshul ni/ dus tshod nyi ma lho bgrod lta bur/ gter srung khra tsha dang*/ gza' klu dngos su rgyu ba gza' skar rtsub cing dgu gsum mam/ mar ngo'i dus kyi tshes lta bur/ bdag bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor gong du/ gtor ma gdan gru bzhi gsum brtsegs steng*/ 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi nyi zla'i gdan/ dpal gtor zur gsum rtse thon dbal so can la pad 'dab pad tshab bzhi re/ g.yas g.yon du sman raka /mdun du bka' srung gza' la dmar gtor g.yas gcus la 'khor gsum gyis bskor ba/ dge bsnyen dmar gtor sbrul mgo can la sbrul gyis dkris pa 'khor brgyad kyis bskor ba/ klu mo la bshos bu sngon po sbrul dkris can/ mthar zan chod grangs mang*/ gzhan yang chos srung gi gsol kha rgyas bsdus gang 'grub dang*/ mdun bskyed bzlog pa la 'bru nag dug khrag chang gis sbrus pa la/ gdan 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi'i steng chos 'byung bsnol ma/ dmar gtor gdong zhal can la 'khor bzhis bskor ba/ mdun rgyab gnyis su dmar gtor re/ mtheb skyu dang zan chod grangs mang*/ rtsang dang rgyu rlon gyi drwa ba/ mtshe nyungs/ sha dum liṅga sogs drag rgyan rngams brjid dang ldan pa la/ dar mthing gi gdugs phub/ zor bzhi ni/ gtor zor/ kong zor/ rdo zor/ thod zor bzhi la grub na dug khrag gis bran/ mtshe nyungs sogs thun rdzas kyi rigs btab/ khram shing bris dang dpal 'bar bcas 'dzug pa bzlog pa'i zur du bkod/ bzlog pa'i g.yas g.yon du sman raka /bdag bskyed zhi mchod kyi mgo g.yas dang*/ mdun bskyed kyi mchod mgo g.yon nas brtsam pa la/

khrag gi arghaṃ/ dug chu'i zhabs bsil/ dbang lnga'i me tog /sha chen dang 'dre 'jigs kyi spos/ tshil chen gyi mar me/ mkhris pa'i dri chab/ sha rus kyi zhal zas/ rkang gling thod rnga'i rol mo/ de dag gi bar mtshams rnams su 'bul gtor sogs dmar gtor dang*/ liṅga che chung grangs mang*/ dkar bgegs/ dbang lnga/ drag bshos/ tshogs kyi yo byad/ bskul gtso 'khor dgu/ chad mdo gtso 'khor drug /brtan ma/ sgo dbye dkar gtor/ zhal zas/ phur pa/ g.yab dar/ thun rdo dang thun rdzas sogs 'og tu dgos pa'i yo byad thams cad tshang bar 'du bya'o/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi cho ga'i las rim la bdag gi rnal 'byor sgrub pa dang*/ las kyi sbyor ba'o/ thog mar tshig bdun gsol 'debs sogs rang lugs brgyud 'debs spyi ltar song nas/ dpal chen dregs zil gyi gsol 'debs ni/ e ma ho/ gnas mchog lcang lo can gyi pho brang du/ /sangs rgyas thugs kyi sprul pa rdo rje 'dzin/ /dpal chen phyag na rdo rjer gsol ba 'debs/ /steng 'og phyogs bzhir thugs kyis 'gro don mdzad/ /ye shes sprul pa'i bya khyung la gsol ba 'debs/ /gang 'dul der ston thog med rtsal shugs 'chang*/ 'jigs mdzad rā hu la la gsol ba 'debs/ /thugs kyi byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyis bskor/ /dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs lha la gsol ba 'debs/ /de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i byin rlabs kyi/ /gnas skabs 'gal rkyen bar chad zhi ba dang*/ /mthar thug don gnyis 'bad med yid bzhin 'grub/ /gsang ba'i bdag po nyid dang dbyer med shog / ces gsang bdag dregs pa zil gnon gyi cha lag tu 'di bzhin dgos zhes 'phen bla'i ngor sgo blas so// de nas dang po bdag gi rnal 'byor sgrub pa la/ sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi'o/ /thog mar skyabs yul gsal gdab pa ni/ rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis bskul ba'i bla ma gsang bdag rdo rje gtum po'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs phyogs dus rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzaḥ

zhes tshogs zhing gsal btab nas/ dang po skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ na mo: dpal chen kun 'dus dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: sgo gsum rtsol bral ngang gis skyabs su mchi: lan gsum/ gnyis pa sems bskyed pa ni/ hoḥ ma gyur 'gro ba srid bsdus kun gyi ched: bdag gis dpal chen bsgrubs nas go 'phang dgod: gsum pa yan lag bdun pa 'bul ba ni/ hoḥ gsang bdag thugs mchog rgyal ba sras bcas la: phyag mtshal mchod 'bul sdig ltung snying nas bshags: yi rang bskul zhing bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs: dge tshogs 'gro kun byang chub 'thob phyir bsngo: mthar/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho/ tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim par gyur/ dkar gtor btang*/ bzhi pa bgegs bskrad pa la/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis bsang sbyang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ sa byin brlab/ hūm̐: bdag nyid gsang bdag 'bar ba'i pho nya y-i: bden pas gnod byed gtor ma len phyir khug: om̐ badzra ṭākki rā dza hūm̐ dzaḥ gnod byed bgegs tshogs aṅku sha ya dza dzaḥ sa bkug la/ sarba bhighnan ba liṃ ta khā hi/ lan gsum gyis gtor ma bsngos la/ hūm̐: bgegs rnams mchod sbyin gtor mas tshims shing bzhud: bar chod glags lta u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ yungs thun gyis brab cing hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags kyis bskrad la/ lnga pa srung 'khor ni/ hūm̐: rdo rje'i gur khang bla bre phyi nang 'khrigs: log 'dren bgegs kyis rgyu ba mtshams chod cig: badzra tsakra rakṣa rakṣa: drug pa mchod pa byin brlabs ni/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum/ hūm̐: phyi nang gsang ba kho na nyid kyi tshogs: sbyor sgrol spyan gzigs mchod pa bla med gyur: om̐ badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda āḥhūm̐: sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta bha lingta om̐ āḥhūm̐: bdun pa byin 'bebs pa ni/ hūm̐: bla ma yi dam ḍākki dang*/ khyad par gsang bdag gtum po che/ /bka' 'khor dam can chos skyong rnams/ /mi mngon dbyings nas skur bzhengs shig /gnas yul ye shes rol par bsgyur/

/sgrub la dbang bskur byin chen phob/ /bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol/ /mchog thun dngos grub myur du stsol/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gu ru de wa ḍākki nī dzñā na badzra sa ma ya phaiṃ phaiṃ dza dzaḥ spos btul rol mo brdung zhing byin dbab/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la'ang bdun las/ dang po ting 'dzin rnam gsum dang rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor bskyed pa ni/ hūm̐: dang por chos rnams dmigs su med: bar du 'gags med rtsal snang las: tha mar sna tshogs sprul skur sgrub: de las yig 'bru phun sum tshogs: oṃ e yam̐ ram̐ kham̐ suṃ keṃ bhrūm̐: 'byung ba yongs gyur gzhal yas khang : sgo gru mu mtha' tshang ba'i dbus: lha srin sde brgyad khri steng du: padma nyi zla'i steng dbus su: hūm̐ las skyes pa'i dpal chen sku: mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa: g.yas gsum rdo rje 'khor lo gri: g.yon gsum khyung dang kha ṭwāṃ sbrul: sku la dur khrod chas brgyad rdzogs: gtum gshe rngam rgod tshul du gsal: spyi bor thugs kyi bya khyung lding : mdun du gza' mchog glog dmar 'khyugs: ye shes me dpung klong du gsal: de ltar bskyed pa'i gnas gsum las: 'od 'phros 'og min phyogs bcu nas: dpal chen lha tshogs spyan drangs gyur: gnyis pa spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūm̐: 'og min chos dbyings pho brang dang : lcang lo can gyi gnas mchog nas: gtum chen khro rgyal gshegs su gsol: ri rab 'bar ba'i dbus nyid nas: mkha' lding 'bar ba gshegs su gsol: nam mkha'i dbyings kyi 'od klong nas: ki kang gza' mchog gshegs su gsol: om̐ badzra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ gsum pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ hūm̐: bdag nyid thabs kyi bskyed pa'i dam tshig lha: shes rab dbyings nas drangs pa ye shes lha: gdod nas dbyer med du ma ro gcig ngang : 'gyur med rdo rje'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan:

bzhi pa phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūm̐: chos dbyings skye ba med pa las: 'gags med mkhyen brtse'i ye shes shar: 'gro ba'i don du so sor sprul: ye shes lha la phyag 'tshal lo: a ti pū hoḥ pra titstsha hoḥ lnga pa phyi nang gsang mchod 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: phyi mchod gar ma lang ling tshogs kyis mchod: gsang mchod gzugs mdzes dpag med gtibs pas mchod: sbyor mchod zag med bde ba dgyes pas mchod: sman mchod dza gad gser skyems phud kyis mchod: gtor mchod ba liṃ rgyan rdzogs bcud kyis mchod: rakta dgyes pa chags med mdangs ldan mchod: bsgral mchod nyon mongs ye sgrol shes par mchod: mnyam bzhag rang bzhin rdzogs chen kho na'i mchod: mchod yul sbyin mkhan bla med ngo bor mchod: gsang bdag gtum por kun gzhi 'gyur med mchod: bya khyung rgyal por gsal stong 'gags med mchod: gza' mchog rgyal por tshogs drug lhug bzhag mchod: kun kyang chos dbyings ye shes chen po yi: rtsol bral rin chen mchod pas dgyes gyur cig: om̐ badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda rū pa shabda gandhe rā sa sparshe āḥhūm̐: om̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta bha lingta māṃ sa tsitta go ro tsa na kha kha khā hi: om̐ sarba dharma dzñā na pañtsa om̐ āḥhūm̐: drug pa bstod pa ni/ hūm̐: dbyings las ma g.yos dpal chen zil gnon khro: bdud las rab rgyal dregs pa'i rje bo ni: sku mdog mthing nag chos sku 'gyur ba med: dkar dmar mthing bzhad dgyes pa'i khro bo yi: rab 'jigs zhal nas hūm̐ sgra 'brug ltar sgrog: spyan rtsa sdang mig 'khyil bas srid gsum sngangs: dbu skra gyen brdzes lha khams yom zhing 'gul: thod skam dbu rgyan rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas rdzogs: cod pan spras pas zhing khams rgyan 'phyangs rdzogs: phyag g.yas rdo rje ral gri 'khor lo yis: snang srid lha srin zil gyis gnon par byed: phyag g.yon khyung khra kha ṭwāṃ sbrul zhags kyis:

srid gsum gdon bgegs 'byung po 'joms par byed: rdo rje'i sgro gshog dbyings la brgyangs pa yis: ban bon gdug pa'i byad kha zlog par byed: glang ko'i zhing lpags stag sham brjid pa yis: bdud srin dam sri 'gong po 'dul bar byed: rdo rje'i go ldan rus rgyan chu srin gyis: nyon mongs 'khrul 'dzin rtsad nas gcod par byed: sbrul gzugs rgyan phreng rin chen spras pa yis: 'khor 'das rtog pa zil gyis gnon par byed: zhabs bzhis lha srin steng du 'gyings pa yis: che btsan kun gyi nus pa zil gyis gnon: sku la dus mtha'i me dpung 'bar ba yis: stong khams g.yo zhing khyab pa'i gzi brjid mched: bcom ldan dregs pa zil gnon sku la bstod: hūm̐: spyi bor thugs kyi sprul pa ga ru ṭa'iḥ gnam lcags rwa la rdo rje'i mchu sder bgrad: ma rungs klu gnyan sa bdag 'dul bar byed: me gshog rdeb cing gser mig 'khyil ba yis: dregs pa yongs kyi cho 'phrul zlog par byed: dug sbrul gsol zhing gdol pa 'dzin pa yis: ma rungs bdud srin rtsad nas 'joms par byed: bya khyung 'bar ba'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: dzaḥ snang srid dbu ma'i dbyings kyi las byed pa: stong khams 'di ru drag rtsal ldan pa yi: lho nub gnas pa'i ki kang dmar 'od can: pha ni srin po ma ni 'dod chags klu: klu bdud bshos pa rlung khams dud kha'i mdangs: dbu dgus theg pa rim dgu'i bstan pa srung : spyi bor bya rog bstan pa'i bya ra byed: phyag g.yas ral gri gnam lcags thog mda' yis: ma rungs gdug pa'i snying la 'debs par byed: phyag g.yon cod pan sbrul nag zhags pa yis: bdag la sdang ba'i byad ma 'ching bar byed: sku lus thams cad mig gis gang ba yis: dregs pa kun gyi gzi brjid 'phrog par byed: lto bar srid pa las kyi zhal gdangs pas: nyon mongs 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho skem par byed: sbrul mjug rgya mtsho'i klong du 'khyil ba yis:

'byung ba las kyi mnga' dbang bsgyur bar byed: rdzu 'phrul gnam lcags thog ser 'bebs pa yis: bdud sde'i tshogs la mtshon cha'i thog chen 'bebs: gsang sngags bstan pa'i srung mar bdag bstod do: bdun pa bsnyen dmigs ni/ hūm̐: bdag nyid gtum po'i thugs ka ru: gser gyi mchod rten ser po'i dbus: me dpung nyi zla 'khor lo'i steng : hūm̐ mthing tshwa tshwa 'phros pa'i mthar: rtsa sngags g.yas su 'khor ba yis: lus kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib bsregs: yar 'phros phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas mchod: mar 'phros stong gsum dgra bgegs bcom: tshur 'dus gzi byin 'bar bar gyur: rtsa sngags ni/ oṃ badzra tsaṇḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭḥ khyung sngags ni/ oṃ khroṃ ga ru ṭa tsa le tsa le hūm̐ phaṭḥ khyab 'jug gi sngags ni/ om̐ ki kang hrī rā hu la ke ta ke ta hūm̐ dzaḥdzaḥ gtso bo bsnyen sgrub gcig dril kho na rtsal tu bton/ 'khor sngags rnams bcu cha'am skabs dang bstun/ thun mthar dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying mthar/ mchod bstod ni/ hūm̐: snang srid khro bo rol pa'i sku: sgra rnams drag sngags 'ur mched sgra: dran rtog dpa' ngar 'bar ba'i dbyings: rdo rje gsum gyi dkyil 'khor du: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul: bag med 'gal 'khrul nyams chag bshags: rang mdangs rol gar rtsal la bstod: gzhi 'bras gcig pa'i dngos grub stsol: badzra puṣpe

sogs shabda ma hā pañtsa rakta bha lingta khā hi/ zhes pas mchod cing bstod/ snga chog phyi chog so sor bya skabs gter srung khyab 'jug gi gsol kha sogs rang lugs chos skyong gsol mchod rnams 'dir bya la/ thun gcig tu byed tshe mdun bskyed grub pa'i rjes su bya srol ltar gang bde bya'o/ ༈ rtsa ba'i sa bcad gnyis pa las sbyor la gnyis las/ dang po srung ba'i mkhar brtsigs pa ni/ bdag bskyed gtso 'khor bsnyen pa grub ma thag tu/ hūm̐: bdag nyid gsang bdag khro rgyal gsal ba yi: thugs kar hūm̐ y-ig mthing ga'i klong dkyil du: bdag dang bsrung bya thams cad tshud par bsgom: sngags phreng 'khor bas phyi nang 'khor yug kun: bskal pa'i me dpung dum bu gcig tu gyur: su yang bgrod du med pa'i rang bzhin bsgom: oṃ badzra tsanḍa ma hā ro ṣa ni hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ kro dha ra dza bhyo tsa tur mu kha tsakra hūm̐ bhyo phaṭḥ oṃ khroṃ ga ru ṭa tsa le tsa le hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ ki kang hrīḥrā hu la ke ta ke ta hūm̐ phaṭḥ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa la srungs shig rakṣa rakṣa: badzra tsanḍa ṇi ma ma rakṣa rakṣa: nyer gcig sogs gang 'grub bzlas rjes/ mchod bstod sogs ni gong ltar ro// ༈ bzlog pa'i g.yul gshom pa ni/ mdun dkyil mchod pa dang bcas par chab bran la/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum/ hūm̐: phyi nang gsang ba kho na nyid kyi tshogs: sbyor sgrol spyan gzigs mchod pa bla med gyur: om̐ badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda āḥhūm̐: sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta bha lingta om̐ āḥhūm̐: de nas mdun gyi zlog gtor la raktas bran cing*/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ hūm̐: stong pa'i ngang las snang srid drag po'i zhing : gtum drag 'byung ba bang rim bsnol mar brtsegs: sa gzhi smug nag dur khrod me dpung klong : bhrūm̐ las sra mkhregs gnam lcags gzhal yas khang : gru bzhi sgo bzhi sna tshogs rdo rje'i tog:

de dbus nyi zla ti ra bam chen steng : mthing nag hūm̐ las gsang bdag gtum po'i sku: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril mche gtsigs spyan rtsa g.yo: sma ra smin ma dbu skra me ltar 'bar: bhandha skam po'i rigs lngas dbu la brgyan: tshwa tshwa 'khrugs pa'i dar nag cod pan 'phur: dug sbrul rigs lngas skra bcing lhu tshigs brgyan: g.yas gsum rdo rje 'khor lo ral gri phyar: za byed rngam pa'i khro bo me ltar 'bar: g.yon gsum khyung dang kha ṭwāṃ sbrul zhags 'phen: gsod byed khro mo sha za chu ltar khol: stobs bcu'i dur khrod chas brgyad sku la rdzogs: zhabs bzhi dor stabs bgegs dpung sa la bsgyil: sku la stong khams sreg pa'i me dpung 'khrigs: 'jigs byed dpa' bo stobs ldan sku ru gsal: spyi bor thugs kyi sprul pa ga ru ṭaḥ lcags ru zangs mchu gser mig sder gshog bgrad: klu dang sa bdag ma rungs zil gyis gnon: mdun du khyab 'jug dud kha dbu dgu pa: phyag bzhi ral gri chu srin mda' gzhu sbrul: sku lus mig brgyan lte zhal sbrul mjug 'khyil: ye shes me dpung 'bar ba'i klong du gsal: hūm̐: shar du ban byed 'joms pa'i stag gdong ma: sku mdog dmar nag rngam pa'i nga ro can: phyag g.yas me zor g.yon pas chu zor bsnams: lho ru bon byed 'joms pa'i dred gdong ma: sku mdog kham nag gdug pa'i mche ba gtsigs: phyag g.yas kong zor g.yon pas thun zor bsnams: nub tu 'dre rgod 'joms pa'i dom gdong ma: sku mdog mthing nag gtum chen drag sngags can: phyag g.yas nyungs zor g.yon pas khram zor bsnams: byang du dgra bgegs 'joms pa'i spyang gdong ma: sku mdog ljang nag sha khrag dgyes pa mo'i: g.yas pas mtshe zor g.yon pas khrag zor bsnams: thams cad gar stabs dur khrod chas kyis brgyan: ha ha dgyes pa'i gad mo 'brug ltar sgrog: pha rol gdug pa'i byad kha 'joms par gsal: de ltar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis:

gsang bdag khro rgyal lha tshogs spyan drangs gyur: spos btul gu gul bdug rol mo dbyangs dang bcas spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐: 'og min lhun grub chos dbyings pho brang nas: dus gsum bde gshegs rgyal ba rab 'byams rnams: 'gro la brtse bas thugs rjes skur bzhengs la: 'jigs pa'i sku dang rngam pa'i rigs sngags sgra: dpa' ba'i thugs kyis ma rung bdud dpung tshogs: gnyis med byang chub sems su shugs kyis sgrol: thugs rje chen po'i tshogs rnams 'dir gshegs la: sgrub mchog bdag la dbang dang dngos grub stsol: oṃ badzra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ phaiṃ phaiṃ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ hūm̐: bdag nyid thabs kyi bskyed pa'i dam tshig lha: shes rab dbyings nas drangs pa ye shes lha: gdod nas dbyer med du ma ro gcig ngang : 'gyur med rdo rje'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan: phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūm̐: chos dbyings skye ba med pa las: 'gags med mkhyen brtse'i ye shes shar: 'gro ba'i don du so sor sprul: ye shes lha la phyag 'tshal lo: a ti pū hoḥ pra titstsha hoḥ phyi mchod 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs las sprul: ye shes gsang ba bde ba'i mchog: mchod yon me tog bdug spos dang : mar me dri chab zhal zas tshogs: rol mo dbyangs snyan nam mkha' gang : phyogs bcu'i dkyil 'khor thams cad pa: khro chen 'bar ba'i tshogs la 'bul: a la la ste bzhes su gsol: badzra arghaṃ? sogs brjod/ nang mchod sman gtor rakta 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: rang byung gdod nas rnam par dag: rtsa brgyad stong la sbyar ba'i sman: rigs lnga dam tshig lnga yi dngos: ye shes lnga rdzogs bsgrub pa'i rdzas: rgyu drug sems can kun grol ba'i: dug lnga sel ba'i bdud rtsi 'di: phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad dang : 'bar ba'i khro bo'i lha la 'bul: gnyis su med par bzhes su gsol: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta khā raṃ khā hi:

hūm̐: bla med mchog gi mchod pa 'di: ye shes lnga yi 'od zer 'phro: 'dod yon lnga yis rab brgyan pa: dpal chen dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: thugs dam bzhin du bzhes su gsol: ma hā bha lingta khā hi: hūm̐: chags med rakta mkha' dbyings rgyun: 'khor ba rnam dag bde chen mtsho: rgyu drug dbyings su sgrol ba'i phyir: khro chen 'bar ba'i lha la 'bul: ma hā rakta khā raṃ khā hi: gsang ba sbyor sgrol gyi mchod pa ni/ hūm̐: thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa: bde chen spros bral thig le'i sku: ye nas gnas pa don gyi chos: 'du 'bral med pa'i mchod pa bzhes: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥpadma yo gi ni a we sha ya āḥ hūm̐: gnyis 'dzin mtshan pa'i chos rnams la: ngo bo cir yang grub pa med: ye nas lhun rdzogs sangs rgyas chos: gnyis su med pa'i mchod pa bzhes: ma traṃ ru dra a pa ra ṇa phaṭḥ mnyam pa nyid kyi mchod pa ni/ hūm̐: mnyam pa'i sgrub rdzas chen po ni: bdag dang mnyam pa'i tshogs la 'bul: bza' bca' btung bgo longs spyod rnams: mi dmigs mnyam pa'i mchod pa bzhes: dharma dhā tu a āḥ de nas bstod pa ni/ hūm̐: gtum chen khro rgyal gsang bdag he ru kaḥ lha srin dregs pa 'dul ba'i mthu stobs can: ma rungs gdug pa'i tshogs rnams tshar gcod pa'i: thugs mchog khro rgyal sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: spyi bor thugs kyi sprul pa ga ru ṭaḥ gnam lcags rwa ldan rdo rje'i mchu sder bgrad: ma rungs sa bdag klu gnyan 'dul bar byed: bya khyung 'bar ba'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: dzaḥ snang srid dbu ma dbyings kyi las byed pa: stong khams 'di ru drag rtsal ldan pa yi: lho nub gnas pa'i ki kang rā hu la: gza' mchog khyab 'jug sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐ bhyoḥ drag shul rngam pa'i dpa' stobs gar dgu'i brgyan: snang srid yongs kyi byad kha dgra la 'bebs: las la chas mdzad srog bdag khro mo'i tshogs: ma rungs rgol ba 'joms mdzad bzhi la bstod:

de nas bsnyen pa bya ba ni/ hūm̐: bdag nyid gtum po'i thugs ka ru/ /gnam lcags rdo rje'i lte ba la/ /me dpung nyi zla 'khor lo'i steng*/ /hūm̐ mthing tshwa tshwa 'phro ba'i mthar/ /rtsa sngags g.yas su 'khor ba yis/ /lus kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib bsregs/ /yar 'phros phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas mchod/ /mar 'phros stong gsum dgra bgegs 'joms/ /tshur 'dus snod kyi gzi brjid thim/ /slar yang 'khor gyi lha la phog /rab 'phros pha rol byad kha zlog /kun kyang gzi brjid ldan par sgom/ gtso bo'i sngags ni/ om̐ badzra tsaṇḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭḥ khro mo'i sngags ni/ oṃ kro ti raṃ bhyo tsa tur mu kha tsakra hūm̐ phaṭḥ bsnyen pa gang 'grub mthar/ byad bzlog gi zor thun sngags ni/ oṃ badzra tsaṇḍa he kro ta ka la se na tsakra lo hi tsakra ti kri tsakra ya gnod byed 'byung po byad ma rnams kyi srog rtsa la rbad rbad: oṃ kro ti ma tri baṃ bhyo tsa tur mu kha raṃ ha la ya pha rol gyi byad zor phur kha ngan pa thams cad bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: lan kha shas bzlas la thun rdzas zor rdzas la ngar gdag /mthar dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying bzla zhing bsnyen bstod ni/ hūm̐: snang srid khro bo rol pa'i sku: sgra rnams drag sngags 'ur mched sgra: dran rtog dpa' ngar 'bar ba'i dbyings: rdo rje gsum gyi dkyil 'khor du: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul: bag med 'gal 'khrul nyams chag bshags: rang mdangs rol gar rtsal du bstod: gzhi 'bras gcig pa'i dngos grub stsol: badzra puṣpe sogs shabda ma hā pañtsa rakta bha lingta khā hi: skong bshags rgyas bsdus gang rung dang*/ rig 'dzin srog sgrub tshig lhug sngon du 'gro bas/ de nas tshogs byin rlabs ni/ hūm̐: bdag nyid dpal chen thugs ka nas: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ dang oṃ āḥhūm̐: dngos 'dzin bsregs gtor bla med spel: tshogs mchod 'dod yon bdud rtsir gyur: dkyil 'khor dgyes pa'i rdzas su gyur:

om̐ dharma shuddhe āḥhūm̐: spyan 'dren ni/ hūm̐: 'og min mkha' spyod pho brang nas: dpal chen gsang bdag gtum po la: sprul pa bka' skyong srung mas bskor: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: om̐ badzra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ tshogs kyi mchod pa ni/ hūm̐: dpal chen dregs pa zil gnon gyi: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs 'khor bcas la: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: bzhes nas mchog thun dngos grub stsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe wa ḍākki nī i daṃ bha lingta kha kha khā hi: gtor bsngos mthar dbyung*/ de nas skong ba bya ba ni/ hūm̐: lcang lo can gyi gnas mchog nas: gtum chen khro rgyal he ru kaḥ gsang bdag dregs pa zil gnon gyi: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs ma lus pa: thugs dam bskang phyir gshegs su gsol: nyi zla bam gyi gdan la bzhugs: phyi nang gsang gsum mchod pa 'bul: dkyil 'khor lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: dpal chen dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kyi: thugs dam bskang ba'i dam rdzas ni: phyi mchod 'dod yon lha mo'i tshogs: nang mchod sman gtor rakta dmar: gsang mchod sbyor sgrol dga' ba bzhi: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya lnga: rten gtor rtag gtor thun gtor dang : ga ṇa tshogs kyi longs spyod rdzas: bdud rtsi su ra chang gi phud: spyan gzigs gzugs 'gros sna tshogs pa: blos blangs dngos 'byor yid sprul nas: ma tshang med pa'i bskang rdzas 'dis: gsang bdag gtum po'i thugs dam bskang : ye shes khyung gi thugs dam bskang : gza' mchog rgyal po'i thugs dam bskang : gter srung dge bsnyen thugs dam bskang : dkyil 'khor thugs dam bskangs gyur nas: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: bskang ba skye med ngang du bskang : mchod du med de gnyis med mchod: sbyor du med de zung 'jug sbyor: sgrol du med de dug lnga sgrol: bshags su med de dbyings su bshags: ye mchod ye grol chen po 'dis: thugs dam gnyan po bskangs gyur cig:

phyi nang dam tshig nyams pa sol: las bzhi'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: phyi nang spyan gzigs mthun rdzas kyis: gsang bdag lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : nyams chag sor chud nyes ltung bshags: phyin chad mi sgrib tshangs par stsol: bshags pa bya ba ni: hūm̐: dpal chen zil gnon lha tshogs dgongs: bdag cag ma rig dbang gyur pa'i: nyams chag nyes ltung ci mchis pa: mthol lo bshags so bzod par gsol: om̐ badzra sogs? sa twa āḥ sogs yig brgya brjod/ de nas drag po'i thugs dam bskul ba ni/ gtor mdos bran/ slob dpon zhwa ber dang bcas dar nag g.yab/ rol mo drag brdung dang bcas/ hūm̐: chos dbyings skye med nam mkha'i klong nyid las: ma 'gag gzugs sku ci yang 'char ba'i gar: ma g.yel bzhengs shig rtsa gsum srung ma'i tshogs: drag po mngon spyod las kyi dpung mdzod cig: de nas slob dpon mdun du liṅga dang thun rdzas/ phur pa bya 'ug sgro/ g.yab dar bsgral chas sogs bkod la/ phyag tu gser skyems phul/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ hūm̐: rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud bla ma dam pa dang : sgyu 'phrul zhi khro rab 'byams dregs 'dul tshogs: gser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'byor mthu dpung skyed: khyad par dpal chen phyag na rdo rje dang : mkha' lding khyab 'jug khro mo rigs bzhi yis: gser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'byor mthu dpung skyed: dpal chen chos srung dam can srung ma'i tshogs: snang srid lha srin sde brgyad yul bdag gnas: gser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'byor mthu dpung skyed: lo zla zhag dus tshes la dbang ba'i lha: mkha' la rgyu ba'i dregs ldan 'khor bcas kyis: gser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'byor mthu dpung skyed: rbad pa'i dam can srung ma mthu ma chung : deng 'dir bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: gzu dpang gsol ba ni/ hūm̐ hrīḥ dkon mchog rtsa ba gsum dang yi dam lha: mkha' 'gro dam can chos skyong srung ma bcas:

khyad par dpal chen khro rgyal lha tshogs dang : sprul pa yang sprul 'khor bcas dgongs su gsol: bdag ni sangs rgyas bstan pa'i sgor zhugs shing : dben par bla ma lha dang yi dam gyi: bsnyen sgrub bskyed sngags rdzogs gsum gzhir bzung nas: phrin las rnam bzhi sgrub par dam bcas kyang : gnod byed dam med 'di yis mi ster ro: dgongs shig kun mkhyen khyed kyis gzigs mdzod la: bdag la gnod pa'i dgra bgegs byad ma sgrol: mthu rtsal nus phyungs mngon spyod phrin las mdzod: hom bskyed pa ni/ phaṭḥ mdun du gnam lcags las grub pa'i btson khang nag po kha dog la: mthil yangs pa: zin na thar pa med pa: nṛ tri las skyes pa'i gnod byed byad ma'i gzugs phung sngo la ham pa skya la rid pa kha ngu ba mig shi mig: yan lag lcags sgrog gis bsdams shing nyam thag pa'i gzugs can du gyur: na mo: drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang : yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang : dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang : chos nyid de bzhin nyid dang chos can rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bka' bden pa dang : khyad par du yang dpal chen phyag na rdo rje dregs 'dul drag sngags kyi bka' bden pa dang : thugs sprul bya khyung 'bar ba'i bka' bden pa dang : gza' mchog dug gdong mgo dgu'i bka' bden pa dang : bka' sdod dregs tshogs dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyi bka' bden pa dang : lha sngags ting 'dzin rten 'brel bslu ba med pa'i bka' bden pa dang : rnal 'byor bdag gi drag sngags dmod pa'i mthu la brten nas: gnod cing 'tshe ba'i gdon bgegs dam sri byad phur mnan gtad ngan sngags byed pa'i dgra gdon mi dang mi min spyir sangs rgyas bstan pa'i spyi dgra: dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i sku dgra: sgos rnal 'byor pa bdag la sdang ba: mdor na bsam sbyor ngan pa 'chang ba'i dgra bgegs byad ma rbod gtong dam log bdud rigs bsgral ba'i zhing du gyur pa'i lha srung mgon byed dang bcas pa thams cad:
skad cig rang dbang med par gzugs liṅga 'di la khug cig: nṛ tri yaṃ dzaḥ

zhes pas 'gugs shing pho nya 'gyed pa ni/ bhyoḥ dzaḥlas rdo rje lcags kyu ma: dgra bo'i snying nas zungs la shog: hūm̐ las rin chen zhags pa ma: dgra bo'i mgul nas chings la shog: baṃ las padma lcags sgrog ma: dgra bo'i yan lag sdoms la shog: hoḥlas karma dril bu ma: dgra bo'i dran pa myos su chug: rang dbang med par khug la shog: rbad pa'i pho nya mthu ma chung : badzra aṅku sha ya dzaḥ pā sha hoḥ spho ṭa baṃḥ ghaṇḍe hoḥ lha dbye bya ba ni bya rog 'ug sgro thogs la/ hūm̐: khā kha mu kha bya rog gdong : phyag na spu gri dmar po bsnams: dam nyams dgra bo lha dang phyes: srung skyob mgon byed phral bar gyis: hu lu mu kha 'ug pa'i mgo: phyag na rlung gi 'khor lo 'dzin: dam nyams dgra bo bdud dang sprod: bcings shing byad du bcug par gyis: om̐ khā kha mu kha dgra bo shag phyes: hu lu mu kha dgra bo rbad thum ril trig nan mā ra ya rbad: de nas phur pa thogs la/ hūm̐: khro rgyal thugs las sprul pa'i sras: gtum chen badzra kī la ya'i: phyag gnyis ri rab phur pa bsgril: rgya mdud 'brug sgra 'u ru ru: 'chang bzung glog dmar khyugs se khyug: chu srin ser ba chi li li: zur gsum thog rgod sha ra ra: rtse mor tshwa tshwa si li li: btab bo badzra kī la ya: dkar nag snying gi rtsa chod la: myur du bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ badzra kī li kī la ya gnod byed 'byung po tshal pa shag gtub mā ra ya rbad rbad: ces pas bsgral zhing rnam shes spar ba ni/ 'o khyod kyi rnam shes āḥyig dkar por gyur nas 'og min gyi gnas su phaṭḥ ces pas 'og min gyi gnas su 'phang*/ de nas thun rdzas btab cing*/ hūm̐: nyungs thun khro bo sha ra ra: dug thun bu yug chi li li: me thun dmar nag lhabs se lhab: khrag thun nad rlangs thibs se thib: rdo thun zi ra khyugs se khyug: mtshe thun las rlung 'u ru ru: rdo rje'i thog rgod sha ra ra:

phur thun drag po hri li li: ral gri mtshon cha skar ltar 'khrugs: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: om̐ badzra tsaṇḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭḥ myog thun tshal pa ya shig shig: gtubs shing 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: gtum chen khro rgyal he ru kaḥ dpal chen phyag rdor lha tshogs kyi: zhal phyes dgra bo'i sha khrag 'bul: dug lnga skye med dbyings su rol: om̐ āḥhūm̐: dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa rakta tsitta go ro tsa na la kha kha khā hi: zhes ling ro bzlog dkyil du stob/ de nas tshogs bsdus grangs bsags nas mthar tshogs la rol/ lhag ma 'bul ba ni/ oṃ a kā ro sa sngags dang*/ lhag ma dam rdzas 'dod yon gyi phung po zad mi shes par nam mkha'i khams gang bar gyur/ e a ra li hriṃ hriṃ phaiṃ phaiṃ dzaḥ zhes bdud rtsis bran la/ hūm̐: dpal gyi bka' nyan gnas nyul lhag sdud ma: mi sdug gzugs 'chang dur khrod tshogs khang 'grim: sha khrag la dgyes ging chen laṅka srin: lhag ma 'di bzhes gdug pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol: om̐ ma tri raksha ṇa yaksha u tsi ta kha kha khā hi: lhag ma phul zhing tshogs bsngo bya/ de nas bzlog pa dngos la/ dang po thugs dam drag tu bskul ba ni/ gzhung las/ dmar gtor liṅga lha grangs bshams: 'gugs gzhug drag po lan gsum bya: rkang gling rol mo dar nag g.yab: sha chen gsur btang raktas bran: gsungs pa bzhin 'gugs pa sngon du 'gro bas mngon spyod drag po'i dpa' gdengs bskyed la/ hūm̐: dpal chen lha tshogs thugs dam dbyings nas bskul: rig 'dzin sgrub pa'i phyi nang 'gal rkyen sol: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: ma rungs byad zor bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ he ru ka kro ti shrī tsaṇḍa a i daṃ bha lingta kha kha khā hi: bzlog bskul ni/ hūm̐: mthing nag me ri 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas: khro rgyal gsang bdag lha tshogs skur bzhengs shig: sha za ḍākki rigs bzhi skur? 'joms byed bya khyung dmag tshogs?

yang sprul pho nya'i dmag tshogs? bka' gter rgyud kyi srung m zhe sdang me ltar 'bar ba'i klong nas bzhengs: 'dod chags khrag mtsho mer ba'i klong ? gti mug mun ltar 'thib pa'i? nga rgyal ri ltar nyil ba'i? phrag dog chu ltar 'tshubs pa'i klong nas bzhengs: hūm̐: mthing nag stobs ldan gsang bdag mthu bo che: dbu skra dmar nag me ri wa la la: phyag drug mtshon gyis stong gsum ru tra bsgral: dur khrod chas brgyad khro bcu'i dmag dpung sdud: zhabs bzhi gyad mdor gling bzhi'i 'byung po sngangs: stobs ldan khro tshogs dmag dpung dgra la bhyoḥ sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: gza' klu rgyal bsen gnod pa zlog tu gsol: hūm̐ bhyoḥ rigs bzhi khro mo khrag 'thung rngams stabs can: za gsod dbug la rngams pa'i sha za mo: dmar ser ral g.yeng tshwa tshwa si li li: dur khrod chas ldan phra man sha ra ra: drag rtsal myur mgyogs gar bsgyur lings se ling : srid gsum ma mo sha za'i dmag tshogs bskyod: sha khrag dmar gyi? snang srid ban bon byad kha dgra la zlog: hūm̐ khroṃ: sprul pa'i mkha' lding bya khyung ga ru ṭaḥ krang kring sgra sgrog klu srin sa bdag 'joms: me gshog sdeb cing dam sri'i snying khrag 'thung : sder mchu bsgrad cing dal yams rtsad nas gcod: 'joms byed bya khyung nag po'i dmag tshogs bskyod: sha khrag dmar gyi? mdze nad zha grum lhog yams rims nad zlog: hūm̐: bka' yi bstan srung chen po mthu rtsal can: ki kang nag po thog 'bebs ljang nag zhal: bdud rje nag po dge bsnyen yab yum sogs: dam nyams dgra la rbad bskul rtsal ma zhan: yang sprul pho nya las mkhan bye ba 'bum: sha khrag dmar? pha rol byad ma bdud rigs bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: bskul lo bzhengs shig khro rgyal 'bar ba'i tshogs: rig 'dzin rnal 'byor bdag gi rgyab brten mdzod: drag po mthu yi gzi byin yar la skyed: dam nyams dgra la las kyi dmag dpung drongs:
