dgra bo'i yul mkhar srung skyobs rten dang phrol: rbad pa'i dam can srung ma mthu ma chung : deng 'dir bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: ces gtor ma phul zhing phrin las bcol/ khro bo'i dmag tshogs bskyed nas bzlog bsgyur gyi las mdzad par bsam/ de nas bzlog mdos raktas bran la sgrub pa'i bar chad zlog par bsams la/ hūm̐: 'og min lhun grub chos dbyings pho brang nas: bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas: de dbus thod mkhar dam sri bsnol ba'i steng : mthing nag hūm̐ las gsang bdag gtum po'i sku: snang srid lha srin 'dul ba'i dbus nas bzhengs: deng 'dir thugs dam bskul zhing dmag dpung bskyed: khro rgyal mngon spyod las la bskul ba'i tshe: sku mdog mthing nag me zer ya la la: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril mche gtsigs spyan rtsa g.yo: sma ra smin ma dbu skra me ltar 'bar: thod pa skam po rigs lngas dbu la brgyan: tshwa tshwa 'khrugs pa'i dar nag cod paṇa 'phur: dug sbrul rigs lngas skra bcings lhu tshig brgyan: phyag g.yas gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs bcu las: za byed rngam pa'i khro bcu me ltar 'bar: g.yon pas me yi 'khor lo rtsibs bcu las: gsod byed khro mo sha za chu ltar khol: stobs bcu dur khrod chas brgyad sku la gsol: zhabs kyis dor stabs bgegs dpungs sa la bsgyel: sku la stong khams bsregs pa'i me dpung 'khrigs: ye shes khro rgyal dmag tshogs bye ba 'bum: dug gsum sha khrag mchod pa 'di bzhes la: bsgrub pa'i bar chad bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: sku mdog mthing nag me zer 'phro ba yis: rtsa rlung 'byung bzhi'i bar chad bzlog tu gsol: khro zhal rngams la gzi brjid dpa' ba yis: bka' chad 'khrul pa'i dbang thag nyams pa bzlog: spyan gsum sdang mig phyogs bcur gzigs pa yis: phyogs skyong bcu yi gnod pa bzlog tu? mche ba dkar po ri ltar brtseigs pa yis:

bsgrub pa'i bar chad gnod pa bzlog? shangs nas drag po'i rlung dmar g.yo ba yis: 'gong po dam sri'i gnod p zhal nas hūm̐ sgra drag po 'brug ltar sgrogs pa yis: ban bon sngags pa'i byad kha bzlog? rig bdag rnam gsum dbu la brgyan pa yis: steng phyogs lha yi bar chad? dug sbrul nag po'i lhu tshig spras pa yis: 'og phyogs klu srin ma rung ? thod skam 'bar ba tshar lngas brgyan pa yis: lha min gdug pa'i dbal kh sma ra smin ma me ltar 'bar ba yis: srid pa las kyi cho 'phrul? phyag g.yas gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs bcu phyar: g.yon pas me yi 'khor lo phyar ba yis: ma yam mkha' 'gro'i bsun m rus pa'i rgyan drug sku la spras pa yis: khro bo khro mo'i bar chad? glang kong zhing lpags stag shams brjid pa yis: srid pa las kyi g.yo 'khrugs? thod phreng khrag zhag tshom bus brgyan pa yis: dam sri 'byung po'i bar chad? stag shams sbrul chun smad g.yog byas pa yis: mi kha dmod tshigs gtad khram? me ri dmar nag klong du bzhugs pa yis: nyon mongs dug lnga'i gdon tshogs? pad nyi ro gdan pho brang chos 'byung ldan: 'og phyogs sa bdag gdon tshogs? dug gsum sha khrag? bsgrub pa'i bar chad bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: shar du ban byed 'joms pa'i stag gdong ma: sku mdog dmar nag rngams pa'i nga ro can: phyag g.yas me zor g.yon pas chu zor bsnams: dug gsum sha khrag? shar nas zhi ba'i bar chad? hūm̐: lho ru bon byed 'joms pa'i dregs gdong ma: sku mdog khams nag gdug pa'i mche ba brtsegs: phyag g.yas kong zor g.yon pas thun zor bsnams: dug gsum? lho ru rgyas pa'i bar chad? hūm̐: nub tu 'dre rgod 'joms pa'i dom gdong ma: sku mdog mthing nag gtum pa'i drag sngags can: g.yas pas nyungs thun g.yon pas khram zor bsnams: dug gsum sha khrag? nub phyogs dbang gi bar chad? hūm̐: byang du dgra bgegs 'joms pa'i spyang gdong ma:

sku mdog ljang nag sha khrag dgyes pa mo: g.yas pas tshe thun g.yon pas khrag zor bsnams: dug gsum sha khrag? byang du drag po'i bar chad bzlog tu gsol: de nas gtso 'khor yongs rdzogs la brten pa'i bzlog byang ni/ hūm̐ bhyoḥ thod mkhar dmar nag me rlung 'khrugs pa'i dbus: khrag mtsho nyi zla bam gyi gdan steng nas: dpal chen dregs pa zil gnon sku bzhengs shig: srog gcod ma mo rigs bzhi? 'joms byed bya khyung nag po skur? gza' mchog king kang nag po? sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: pha rol byad zor bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: dmar chen gtor ma dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i mtshon: pho nya las mkhan shan pa rtsang gis brgyan: myur mgyogs gzer 'debs thun rdzas 'bar bas bskor: dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar ba'i zor chen 'dis: pho rgyud khro bo'i drag sngags bzlog tu gsol: mo rgyud ma mo'i thun sngags? yi dam mkha' 'gro'i bka' chad? sde brgyad dregs pa'i pho ny phyogs skyong bcu yi dmod p gling bzhi skye bo'i mda' zor? yug pa bud med dmod zor? 'dre rgod 'byung po'i brlag lt yul lha gzhi bdag cho 'phrul? ma yi srin mo'i bsun m bande sngags pa'i hoṃ sbr g.yung drung bon gyi mthu gtad? drag sngags sna tshogs sbyor b gza' klu sa bdag gnod p lo zla zhag dus skag rigs? stong phrag brgyad bcu'i bgegs rigs? tshe 'phrang bdud kyi bar chad? mi mthun rkyen ngan sna tshogs? bzlog go dmar nag gtor ma'i dbal gyis bzlog: bsgyur ro zhing bcu tshang ba'i dgra la sgyur: om̐ badzra tsaṇḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐ trig ra dzaḥthun bhyoḥ dgra la bhyoḥ dgra la zlog: raṃ ha la ya mā ra ya bhyo bhyoḥ dgra la bhyoḥ dgra la zlog: krag had pa na ga ye bhyo bhyoḥ dgra la bhyoḥ dgra la bzlog: shag rakta rbad tri ya bhyo bhyoḥ dgra la bhyoḥ dgra la zlog: mā ra ya rbad bhyoḥdun bhyoḥthun bhyoḥraksha bhyoḥ

byad kha rbod gtong thams cad dgra la bhyo bhyoḥ dgra la zlog zlog: ces bzlog sngags lan dgu sogs gang lcogs bya/ de nas rtsang bskul ni/ rtsang phur raktas bran zhing*/ hūm̐: dur khrod pho brang 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas: pho nya rtsang gi lha tshogs skur bzhengs shig: las mkhan shan pas bzlog bsgyur dus la bab: khrag mchod bdud rtsi 'bar ba 'di bzhes la: rkyen ngan bar chad bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: rno dbal zhe sdang drag po'i rtsang phur 'di: chos skyong dam can pho nya 'tshogs pa'i gnas: che chung tshad ni ri rab 'bar ba tsam: mang nyung tshad ni bskal pa'i bye ma tsam: mtho dman tshad ni srid gsum dbyings dang mnyam: rno ngar tshad ni bdun 'gyur chu gri tsam: myur mgyogs tshad ni ki kang 'gyu ba'i gzugs: gtum drag tshad ni gsod byed gshin rje rngam: rtse mor hūm̐ las me ri wa la la: sked par bhyo yig dam can 'tshogs pa'i gnas: rtsa bar dzaḥyig mun pa thibs se thib: las kyi pho nya rngam pa'i rtsang phur khyod: khrag mchod bdud rtsi 'bar ba 'di bzhes la: dam nyams gdug pa'i snying la da thob cig: pha rol byad ma rbod gtong rtsang gi bzlog: hūm̐: rtse mor bya khyung gshog sgra 'u ru ru: skad la lcags sdig skan sgra thags se thag: rtsa bar ngur phag ngur sgra 'u ru ru: yang sprul pho nya dmod pa'i rtsang phur gyi: khrag mchod bdud rtsi 'bar ba 'di bzhes la: dam nyams gdug pa'i snying la da thob cig: sa bdag klu yi dug mda' bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: rtse mor ki kang khyab mjug nag po 'gyu: sked par khyung chen dmag tshogs thibs se thib: rtsa bar dge bsnyen dgra 'dzin khyugs se khyug: gter srung pho nyas dmod pa'i rtsang phur khyod: khrag mchod bdud rtsi 'bar ba 'di bzhes la: dam nyams gdug pa'i snying la da thob cig: log sbyor mi kha gling bzhi bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: gzhan yang bzlog cing bsgyur ba ni: lha srin 'khrugs pa'i cho 'phrul zlog:

gza' dang lha srin bar chod zlog: lo zla zhag dus skag rigs zlog: phyi nang bar chad dgra la zlog: bzlog bsgyur phrin las 'grub par mdzod: bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: rbad myog shag thum baṃ ril mā ra ya zlog zlog: de nas khyung bzlog ni/ hūm̐: srid pa'i ri rab 'bar ba'i rtse mo nas: khro rgyal sprul pa'i bya khyung gha ru ḍa: mi mngon dbyings nas thugs rje'i sku bzhengs shig: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: deng 'dir bzlog sgyur phrin las mdzad du gsol: hūm̐: rnal 'byor bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas la: gzhan gyi bsam sbyor gdug sems sdang ba yi: mtshe zor nyungs zor 'phen pa dgra la zlog: gnam nas dal kha 'bebs pa dgr sa nas dug mda' long b bar nas gri btsan longs b phyogs nas ma mo'i nad yams? bar snang 'byung po'i thod zor dgr gling bzhi skye bo'i mtsho zor? nag mo sug pa'i thal zor? ban bon sngags pa'i hoṃ sbr mnan bsad gtad cing gzer b zhang zhung bon po'i mthu zor? rigs ngan bshan pa'i dmod p rgyal po'i bka' yi chad p yul mi ngan mtshan 'bu shu? brda than ltas ngan sna tshogs? 'dab chags sder chags ltas ngan? god kha phung gyod kha mchu dgr lo zla zhag dus skag rkyen? phyi nang bar chod bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ tri khroṃ ya bhyoḥ dza tri ya bhyoḥ nye lo thun ya bhyoḥ te lo sha ya bhyoḥ ni lo sha ya bhyoḥ rbad tri kha thun nag po dgra la bhyoḥ

bzlog sngags ni/ om̐ badzra tsaṇḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐ trig ra dzaḥthun bhyoḥ dgra la bhyoḥ dgra la zlog: raṃ ha la ya mā ra ya bhyo bhyoḥ dgra la bhyoḥ dgra la zlog: krag had pa na ga ye bhyo bhyoḥ dgra la bhyoḥ dgra la bzlog: shag rakta rbad tri ya bhyo bhyoḥ dgra la bhyoḥ dgra la zlog: mā ra ya rbad bhyoḥdun bhyoḥthun bhyoḥraksha bhyoḥ byad kha rbod gtong thams cad dgra la bhyo bhyoḥ dgra la zlog zlog: bzlog sngags ci nus mthar thal rdeb ni/ na moḥ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te: dkon mchog rin chen rnam pa gsum gyi bka': bla ma yi dam bde gshegs rtsa ba gsum gyi byin rlabs: ting 'dzin sngags rgod rdzas kyi sbyor ba'i nus mthu: chos nyid de bzhin nyid dang chos can rgyu 'bras mi bslu ba'i bden pas: bdag dang rgyu sbyor 'khor dang bcas par: sngon gyi las: 'phral gyi rkyen: pha rol gyi rbod gtong : rigs sngags kyi sbyor ba: mnan bsregs gtad cing gzer ba: bsam ngan sbyor rtsubs: chag che nyams nga ba'i rmi ltas mtshan ma ngan pa thams cad: byad ma rang gshed rang la zug te phyir bzlog par gyur cig: med par gyur cig: zhi bar gyur cig: lan gsum/ oṃ loka kri pā la nan: sā ga pa sha nan: nā ga du du nan: ma maṃ ma maṃ: tsirtsa tsirtsa: baṃ ru lu baṃ ru lu: rbad tra kau sha ya: rbad tra kau sha ya: ho ra ho ra: tsi du tsi du sod: shig lhu ru gtub: ha la pa ti nan: 'khor ba thul: gnod byed dgra bgegs 'byung po kā ba tsir brlag brlag: gnod byed sha truṃ mā ra ya rbad rbad: ces dang*/ bka' ltar mi byed cing dam la mi gnas pa'i rigs thams cad 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du dengs shig: srid pa spyi nas shig cig: srid gsum rming nas rgyel cig: 'khor ba steng phyungs shig: bskal pa'i mes sregs shig: dam tshig dmod pas rdegs shig: bka' yi chad pa chod cig: gnam lcags thog gi ral gris spyi bo'i gtsug nas khos shig:

sumbha ni'i non cig: srid gsum gar gnas kyang sdig chen grogs kyi steng du gnam lcags rdo rjes char phobs zhig: gnod byed sha truṃ mā ra ya phaṭḥ sbyor ba ngan pa 'dis thul cig: ces dang*/ bka' bsgo 'di yi nus pa yis/ thal phye rlung gis gtor ba ltar/ gnod byed de ru gnas mi 'gyur: byad phur rbod gtong rang gshed dbab/ ces pa'i che ba brjod/ gtor 'bul mthar dbyung*/ chad mdo gtong ba ni/ hūm̐: 'og min gnas dang me ri 'bar ba nas: lha srin sde dpon dregs sdes khas blangs bzhin: gtor ma bzhes la gsang sngags bstan pa skyongs: ma rungs dgra bgegs thal ba rdul du rlog: om̐ kro ta kro ti he ru ka la yaksha ya i daṃ bha lingta kha kha khā hi: brtan ma skyong ba ni/ hūm̐: bod khams skyong mdzad brtan ma skyong ba'i tshogs: lhab lhub rgyan spras gar sgyur gtor ma longs: 'dzam gling 'di ru bdag gnas yul gru'i tshogs: tshe chos zas nor longs spyod bkra shis spel: om̐ ma ma ting ting rakmo raksha i daṃ bha lingta kha kha khā hi: rta bro brdung ba la 'gugs pa sngon du 'gro bas/ hūm̐: dpal chen khrag 'thung he ru kas: dam sri bsgral nas rta bro rdung : chem chem dgra bo'i mgo nas rdung : mnan mnan nam yang ma ldang zhig: oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ bhrūm̐ tsakra ya dgra bo nan: gtor gzhong kha yar bzed nas slob dpon gyis 'bru 'thor/ de nas dngos grub 'gugs pa ni/ hūm̐: lcang lo can gyi khyab bdag he ru kaḥ bcom ldan dregs pa zil gnon dkyil 'khor gyi: dbang bskur sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol: lha srin dbang du 'du ba'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ sa ma ya badzra dha ra siddhi pha la hūm̐: tshe 'gugs pa ni/ hūm̐: snang mtha' rig 'dzin 'chi med tshe yi bdag: gsang ba'i bdag po'i lha tshogs 'khor bcas kyis: thugs las sprul pa'i mkha' 'gro mgyogs ma 'bum: phyag na mda' dar tshe yi bum pa 'dzin:

yang sprul mgyogs ma stong khams kheng bar 'phros: phyi nang snod bcud tshe yi bcud bsdus la: skal ldan rnal 'byor bdag gi lus la bstim: tshe yi ril bu 'dod yon srid kyi mchog: 'chi med bdud rtsi 'ja' lus sgrub pa'i rdzas: deng 'dir rnal 'byor bdag gi lus bstim: hrīḥyig dmar po 'od zer ldan par bsgom: snying ga'i dbus su tshe yi gwa'u la: thim pas 'chi med rig 'dzin myur thob shog: oṃ a mi dhe wa ā yurdzñā na ha ri ni sa siddhi hūm̐: tshe yi dngos grub tu rol/ mchod bstod ni/ oṃ badzra pā ṇi sa pa ri wā ra badzra arghaṃ?shabda ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta bha lingta kha kha khā hi/ hūm̐/ dpal chen thugs mchog 'jigs byed gar dgu'i brgyan/ /rdo rje khyung chen dbu rgyan phyag mtshan rdzogs/ /rgyud srung khyab 'jug bya rog gdong can bcas/ /dkyil 'khor sku gsum lha la phyag 'tshal bstod/ bzod gsol ni/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs nas bzod par gsol/ yig brgya dbyangs gsal rten 'brel snying po rnams brjod/ brtan bzhugs spyi ltar bya/ de nas dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni/ hūm̐: snang stong 'ja' tshon chu zla'i dkyil 'khor ltar: mi dmigs lha tshogs dbyings rig klong la thim: dran rig chos sku'i rgyal sa zin gyur nas: ma bcos spros bral ngang la ā ru ldang : a a āḥ bsngo ba smon lam ni/ hoḥ bsngo bya ye nas ma grub sbyin gtong bral: bsngo mkhan byed po ma dmigs gnyug ma'i gshis: bsngo 'bras 'khor gsum yongs dag dge ba bsngo: kun kyang sa bcu'i rtser son byang chub shog: ces pas dge ba bsngo/ bkra shis bya ba ni/ hūm̐: nam mkha'i gos can srid gsum lto bar 'gengs: 'bar ba'i pho nya mkha' lding dbyings la 'gyed: rlung zhags 'gengs pa dbu ma'i pho nya rgyu: zil gnon dkyil 'khor lha tshogs bkra shis shog: ces bkra shis bsngo smon rgyas par bya'o// ༈ nyin tha ma 'phang ba drag po g.yul 'gyed la/

grol nyin brgyud 'debs nas/ bzlog pa grangs bsags nas thal rdeb bar sngar ltar la/ oṃ badzra pā ṇi sa pa ri wā ra badzra arghaṃ?shabda ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta bha lingta kha kha khā hi/ ces bzlog mchod rnams bzlog par stob/ hūm̐/ dpal chen thugs mchog 'jigs byed gar dgu'i brgyan/ /rdo rje khyung chen dbu rgyan phyag mtshan rdzogs/ /rgyud srung khyab 'jug bya rog gdong can bcas/ /dkyil 'khor sku gsum lha la phyag 'tshal bstod/ ces bstod/ mdun bskyed lha tshogs nam mkhar btegs la/ spha ra ṇa phaṭḥ kyis dbye ba'i rgyas: skad cig mdun bskyed gtor ma'i ye shes pa: nam mkhar gshegs shing gzu dpang mdzad par gyur: saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐ gis bsdu rgya bcas: skabs der srung zlog 'khor lo kha bsgyur/ mdun bskyed dmar chen gtor ma'i dam tshig pa: bdag gi snying kha'i hūm̐ la thim par gyur: sa ma ya dgra bgegs ha la ha la hūm̐ phaṭḥ slar yang sngar bzhin gtor chen skad cig gis: khro gtum mi bzad 'bar ba'i sprin 'phro ba: 'phang ba tsam gyis stong gsum brlag nus pa'i: ha la ha la'i sdong po chen por gyur: oṃ badzra tsaṇḍa he kro ta ka la se na tsakra lo hi tsakra ti kri tsakra ya gnod byed 'byung po byad ma rnams kyi srog rtsa la rbad rbad: oṃ kro ti ma tri baṃ bhyo tsa tur mu kha raṃ ha la ya pha rol gyi byad zor phur kha ngan pa thams cad bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: sa ma ya ha la ha la zor ya zor ya thun ya thun ya dgra bgegs nṛ tri: sarba sha truṃ mā ra ya rbad sod phaṭḥ ces grangs mang bzlas shing thun zor gyi rdzas la sngags kyi rno ngar btags/ de ltar gtor chen drag po'i zor du bsgrubs la/ 'gugs gzhug byas te/ thugs dam bskul ba ni/ hūm̐: dpal chen lha tshogs thugs dam dbyings nas bskul: rig 'dzin sgrub pa'i phyi nang 'gal rkyen sol: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: ma rungs byad zor bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod:

oṃ he ru ka kro ti shrī tsaṇḍa a i daṃ bha lingta kha kha khā hi: gtor ma phul/ sde brgyad gser skyems 'don/ sgo phyi ru gser skyems gtor zhing*/ hūm̐: phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba rig 'dzin lha: mi mngon dbyings nas thugs rje'i skur bzhengs shig: rin chen gser skyems gnyen po 'di bzhes la: ma nyes gzu dpang mdzod cig thugs dam can: deng 'dir rnal 'byor bdag gi rgyab brten mdzod: hūm̐: yi dam che mchog phyi nang gsang ba'i lha: mkha' 'gro dam can chos skyong srung ma rnams: rin che gser skyems? ma nyes gzu dpang ? deng 'dir rnal 'byor? hūm̐: dam can gter srung las kyi rdzu 'phrul can: drag rtsal 'chang ba'i myur mgyogs pho nya rnams: rin chen gser skyems? ma nyes gzu dpung mdzod cig thugs dam can: deng 'dir rnal 'byor bdag gi rgyab brten mdzod: hūm̐: lha srin sde brgyad gzhi bdag drag rtsal can: mkha' la 'gyu zhing gdongs la gnas pa dang : lo zla zhag dus chu tshod dbang ba rnams: rin chen gser? de ring drag po gtor ma'i zor lam phyes: gdong du ma sdod g.yas g.yon sku bzur cig: ma rungs dam nyams dgra la zor sna drongs: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: de nas sgo dbye ba ni/ phyag rgya bzhi la/ phyag mtshan bzhi thogs la gser skyems dang bcas/ hūm̐ dzaḥ shar phyogs khro mo stag gdong ma: gser skyems mchod pa 'di? drag po'i pho brang shar sgo phyes: dmag dpung bskyed phyir bzhes su gsol: hūm̐ hūm̐: lho phyogs khro mo dred gdong ma: gser skyems? drag po'i pho brang lho sgo phyes: dmag dpung ? hūm̐ baṃ: nub phyogs khro mo dom gdong ma: gser skyems? drag po'i pho brang nub sgo phyes: dmag dpung ? hūm̐ hoḥ byang phyogs khro mo spyang gdongs ma: gser skyems? drag po'i pho brang byang sgo phyes: dmag dpung bskyed phyir bzhes su gsol: ces sgo dbye zhing gser skyems bteg go

/srung ma'i gtor 'bul mthar dbyung*/ de nas chad mdo bya ba ni/ hūm̐: 'og min gnas dang me ri 'bar ba nas: lha srin sde dpon dregs sdes khas blangs bzhin: gtor ma bzhes la gsang sngags bstan pa skyongs: ma rungs dgra bgegs thal ba rdul du rlog: om̐ kro ta kro ti he ru ka la yaksha ya i daṃ bha lingta kha kha khā hi: chad mdo'i gtor ma bzlog par stob/ zor bskul gser skyems ni/ hūm̐: rgyal ba rig 'dzin srung ma rnams: mi mngon thugs rje'i klong nas bzhengs: dmag dpungs bskyed la ru mtshon phyor: rnal 'byor bdag gi rgyab brten mdzod: zor sna sdang ba'i dgra la drongs: ma mo mched bzhi'i dus la babs: chos skyongs dam can dus la babs: gser skyems mchod 'di bzhes la: dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod: rkang gling sngon du lan gsum btang*/ de nas zhwa gos sbreng 'chor rol mo dang bcas ru dar sgrengs/ gtor chen btegs/ ser sbreng gyis mdun bsus la slob dpon gyis rting bdas nas 'phen sar 'byor ba dang slob dpon gyi phyag tu dar nag dang gser skyems phul la/ spro na 'cham stabs dang bcas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: gtan gyi skyabs gnas dkon mchog rtsa gsum lha: mchod par 'os pa 'jig rten dregs pa'i tshogs: ma lus 'khor bcas gser skyems mchod pa bzhes: deng 'dir rnal 'byor bdag gi gzu dpang mdzod: lan gsum/ bden rdzun gzu dpang gsol ba ni/ hūm̐: phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba rig 'dzin lha: mi mngon dbyings nas thugs rje'i skur bzhengs shig: rin chen gser skyems gnyen po 'di bzhes la: ma nyes gzu dpang mdzod cig thugs dam can: deng 'dir rnal 'byor bdag gi rgyab brten mdzod: hūm̐: yi dam che mchog phyi nang gsang ba'i lha: mkha' 'gro dam can chos skyong srung ma rnams: rin che gser skyems? ma nyes gzu dpang ? deng 'dir rnal 'byor? hūm̐: dam can gter srung las kyi rdzu 'phrul can:

drag rtsal 'chang ba'i myur mgyogs pho nya rnams: rin chen gser skyems? ma nyes gzu dpung mdzod cig thugs dam can: deng 'dir rnal 'byor bdag gi rgyab brten mdzod: hūm̐: lha srin sde brgyad gzhi bdag drag rtsal can: mkha' la 'gyu zhing gdongs la gnas pa dang : lo zla zhag dus chu tshod dbang ba rnams: rin chen gser? de ring drag po gtor ma'i zor lam phyes: gdong du ma sdod g.yas g.yon sku bzur cig: ma rungs dam nyams dgra la zor sna drongs: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: bsgral bya hom khung bskyed pa ni/ bca' 'ben hom tshang du liṅga mgo mjug ldog ste sbyar/ phaṭḥ mdun du gnam lcags las grub pa'i btson khang nag po kha dog la: mthil yangs pa: zin na thar pa med pa: nṛ tri las skyes pa'i gnod byed byad ma'i gzugs phung sngo la ham pa skya la rid pa kha ngu ba mig shi mig: yan lag lcags sgrog gis bsdams shing nyam thag pa'i gzugs can du gyur: 'gugs pa ni/ na mo: drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang : yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang : dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang : chos nyid de bzhin nyid dang chos can rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bka' bden pa dang : khyad par du yang dpal chen phyag na rdo rje dregs 'dul drag sngags kyi bka' bden pa dang : thugs sprul bya khyung 'bar ba'i bka' bden pa dang : gza' mchog dug gdong mgo dgu'i bka' bden pa dang : bka' sdod dregs tshogs dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyi bka' bden pa dang : lha sngags ting 'dzin rten 'brel bslu ba med pa'i bka' bden pa dang : rnal 'byor bdag gi drag sngags dmod pa'i mthu la brten nas: gnod cing 'tshe ba'i gdon bgegs dam sri byad phur mnan gtad ngan sngags byed pa'i dgra gdon mi dang mi min spyir sangs rgyas bstan pa'i spyi dgra:

dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i sku dgra: sgos rnal 'byor pa bdag la sdang ba: mdor na bsam sbyor ngan pa 'chang ba'i dgra bgegs byad ma rbod gtong dam log bdud rigs bsgral ba'i zhing du gyur pa'i lha srung mgon byed dang bcas pa thams cad: skad cig rang dbang med par gzugs liṅga 'di la khug cig: nṛ tri yaṃ dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zor bskul ni/ hūm̐: rgyal ba rig 'dzin srung ma rnams: mi mngon thugs rje'i klong nas bzhengs: dmag dpungs bskyed la ru mtshon phyor: rnal 'byor bdag gi rgyab brten mdzod: zor sna sdang ba'i dgra la drongs: ma mo mched bzhi'i dus la babs: chos skyongs dam can dus la babs: gser skyems mchod 'di bzhes la: dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod: de nas gtor zor thogs la me sgron dang bcas/ hūm̐: rngams byed stag gdong dmar nag dgra la bhyoḥ bhyo bhyoḥbazlog bzlog drag po'i zor chen bhyoḥ myur du las mdzod dgra bo sha ra re: pho rol gdug pa'i byad kha rbod gtong rnams: rdul du brlag nas rjes shul med par mdzod: bhyo bhyo ma tri mu kha ye raṃ ha la ha la bhyo bhyoḥbazlog bzlogaḥ zor bhyoḥ thun bhyoḥ khram bhyoḥ tam bhyoḥ rbad bhyoḥ bhyo bhyo zlog zlog:

ces 'phang ngo*/ kong zor thogs la/ hūm̐: mche gtsig khams nag dred gdong dgra la bhyoḥ bhyo bhyoḥzlog zlog drag po'i zor chen bhyoḥ myur du las mdzod dgra bo shwa ra re: pha rol gdug pa'i byad kha rbod gtong rnams: rdul du brlag nas rjes shul med par mdzod: bhyo bhyo ma tri mu kha ye raṃ ha la ha la bhyo bhyoḥ zlog zlogaḥ zor bhyoḥ thun bhyoḥ khram bhyoḥ tam bhyoḥ rbad bhyoḥ bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: ces 'phang*/ rdo zor thogs la/ hūm̐: gtum pa mthing nag dom gdong dgra la bhyoḥ bhyo bhyoḥzlog zlog drag po'i zor chen bhyoḥ myur du las mdzod dgra bo shwa ra re: pha rol gdug pa'i byad kha rbod gtong rnams: rdul du brlag nas rjes shul med par mdzod: bhyo bhyo ma tri mu kha ye raṃ ha la ha la bhyo bhyoḥ zlog zlogaḥ zor bhyoḥ thun bhyoḥ khram bhyoḥ tam bhyoḥ rbad bhyoḥ bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: ces 'phang*/ thod zor thogs la/ hūm̐: sha za ljang nag spyang gdong dgra la bhyo bhyoḥ bhyo bhyoḥzlog zlog drag po'i zor chen bhyoḥ myur du las mdzod dgra bo shwa ra re: pha rol gdug pa'i byad kha rbod gtong rnams: rdul du brlag nas rjes shul med par mdzod: bhyo bhyo ma tri mu kha ye raṃ ha la ha la bhyo bhyoḥ zlog zlogaḥ zor bhyoḥ thun bhyoḥ khram bhyoḥ tam bhyoḥ rbad bhyoḥ bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: ces 'phang*/ mda' zor thogs la/ hūm̐: gzhu mo khyung chen ga ru ḍa: gzhu breng dge bsnyen ga po ste: mda' mo gnyis med rā hu la: king kang mga' la 'gyu ba ltar: dgra bo'i srog la mā ra ya: oṃ ga ru ḍa nā ga rā tsa ki kang ha la dutstsha dgra la bhyoḥ zhes 'phang*/ gtor chen btegs la dgongs gsol bya ba ni/ hoḥ dgongs su gsol lo: gzigs su gsol lo: gsan du gsol lo: hoḥ 'og min chos dbyings dag pa'i zhing khams nas: zhi khro 'dus pa'i lha tshogs dgongs su gsol lo: rang byung lcang lo can gyi gnas mchog nas:

dpal chen phyag na rdo rje dregs pa zil gnon gyi lha tshogs dgongs su gsol lo: dbus phyogs ri rab 'bar ba'i rtse mo nas: sprul pa'i mkha' lding khyung chen 'bar ba'i lha tshogs dgongs su gsol lo: snang srid dbu ma dbyings kyi pho brang nas: gza' mchog dug gdong 'bar ba'i lha tshogs dgongs su gsol lo: drag shul rngam brjid rol pa'i dur khrod nas: sha za khro mo rigs bzhi'i lha tshogs dgongs su gsol lo: gaṅgā rba klong 'khrugs pa'i gnas mchog nas: gter srung klu yi dge bsnyen dang : gzhan yang phyi nang gsang ba'i lha tshogs rnams gsan cing dgongs su gsol lo: hoḥ zhing bcu tshang ba'i bstan pa'i spyi dgra: dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i sku dgra: rnal 'byor pa bdag la tshad btsugs shing ya bo 'dzin pa: dmag sna rkun sna ston pa'i dgra bo byad ma: ngo log rgyab ston byed pa: bka' las 'gal zhing dam las log pa: mi med lha med zer ba: bsam ngan sbyor rtsub 'chang ba: brnag pa'i dam nyams dgra bgegs 'di: lo zla zhag dus ma bzhag par drag po bka' yi gtor ma 'di dang mnyam por bzhes shig: rol cig kha raṃ khā hi: om̐ badzra ma hā tsaṇḍa ga ru ṭa rā hu la tri dgra bo byad ma mā ra ya rbad rbad chings chings nan nan: hūm̐: mi mngon dbyings nas khro rgyal lha tshogs bzhengs: deng 'dir bdag gi rgyab rten phrin las bskul: sangs rgyas bstan dgra dam nyams byad ma la: drag po'i dmar nag zor chen snying la ya: bsad cing rdul du brlag pa'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ badzra tsaṇḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭḥ byad ma 'byung po 'dre rgod snying la mā ra ya rbad bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: ces drag sngags kyi dmod brjod bzhin gtor chen me hom du 'phang la rol mo drag tu brdung*/ dar nag g.yab/ slar yang drag rol dang bcas/ hūm̐ bhyoḥ thod mkhar dmar nag me rlung 'khrugs pa'i dbus: khrag mtsho nyi zla bam gyi gdan steng nas: dpal chen dregs pa zil gnon sku bzhengs shig:

srog gcod ma mo rigs bzhi? 'joms byed bya khyung nag po skur? gza' mchog king kang nag po? sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: pha rol byad zor bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: dmar chen gtor ma dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i mtshon: pho nya las mkhan shan pa rtsang gis brgyan: myur mgyogs gzer 'debs thun rdzas 'bar bas bskor: dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar ba'i zor chen 'dis: pho rgyud khro bo'i drag sngags bzlog tu gsol: mo rgyud ma mo'i thun sngags? yi dam mkha' 'gro'i bka' chad? sde brgyad dregs pa'i pho ny phyogs skyong bcu yi dmod p gling bzhi skye bo'i mda' zor? yug pa bud med dmod zor? 'dre rgod 'byung po'i brlag lt yul lha gzhi bdag cho 'phrul? ma yi srin mo'i bsun m bande sngags pa'i hoṃ sbr g.yung drung bon gyi mthu gtad? drag sngags sna tshogs sbyor b gza' klu sa bdag gnod p lo zla zhag dus skag rigs? stong phrag brgyad bcu'i bgegs rigs? tshe 'phrang bdud kyi bar chad? mi mthun rkyen ngan sna tshogs? bzlog go dmar nag gtor ma'i dbal gyis bzlog: bsgyur ro zhing bcu tshang ba'i dgra la sgyur: om̐ badzra tsaṇḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐ trig ra dzaḥthun bhyoḥ dgra la bhyoḥ dgra la zlog: raṃ ha la ya mā ra ya bhyo bhyoḥ dgra la bhyoḥ dgra la zlog: krag had pa na ga ye bhyo bhyoḥ dgra la bhyoḥ dgra la bzlog: shag rakta rbad tri ya bhyo bhyoḥ dgra la bhyoḥ dgra la zlog: mā ra ya rbad bhyoḥdun bhyoḥthun bhyoḥraksha bhyoḥ byad kha rbod gtong thams cad dgra la bhyo bhyoḥ dgra la zlog zlog: thal rdeb ni/ na moḥ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te: dkon mchog rin chen rnam pa gsum gyi bka': bla ma yi dam bde gshegs rtsa ba gsum gyi byin rlabs: ting 'dzin sngags rgod rdzas kyi sbyor ba'i nus mthu: chos nyid de bzhin nyid dang chos can rgyu 'bras mi bslu ba'i bden pas:

bdag dang rgyu sbyor 'khor dang bcas par: sngon gyi las: 'phral gyi rkyen: pha rol gyi rbod gtong : rigs sngags kyi sbyor ba: mnan bsregs gtad cing gzer ba: bsam ngan sbyor rtsubs: chag che nyams nga ba'i rmi ltas mtshan ma ngan pa thams cad: byad ma rang gshed rang la zug te phyir bzlog par gyur cig: med par gyur cig: zhi bar gyur cig: lan gsum/ oṃ loka kri pā la nan: sā ga pa sha nan: nā ga du du nan: ma maṃ ma maṃ: tsirtsa tsirtsa: baṃ ru lu baṃ ru lu: rbad tra kau sha ya: rbad tra kau sha ya: ho ra ho ra: tsi du tsi du sod: shig lhu ru gtub: ha la pa ti nan: 'khor ba thul: gnod byed dgra bgegs 'byung po kā ba tsir brlag brlag: gnod byed sha truṃ mā ra ya rbad rbad: ces dang*/ bka' ltar mi byed cing dam la mi gnas pa'i rigs thams cad 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du dengs shig: srid pa spyi nas shig cig: srid gsum rming nas rgyel cig: 'khor ba steng phyungs shig: bskal pa'i mes sregs shig: dam tshig dmod pas rdegs shig: bka' yi chad pa chod cig: gnam lcags thog gi ral gris spyi bo'i gtsug nas khos shig: sumbha ni'i non cig: srid gsum gar gnas kyang sdig chen grogs kyi steng du gnam lcags rdo rjes char phobs zhig: gnod byed sha truṃ mā ra ya phaṭḥ sbyor ba ngan pa 'dis thul cig: ces bskyar la thal mo brdab/ dpon slob kun kha tshur bskor zhing srung gur sgom pa ni/ hūm̐: bdag nyid gsang bdag khro rgyal gsal ba yi: thugs kar hūm̐ y-ig mthing ga'i klong dkyil du: bdag dang bsrung bya thams cad tshud par bsgom: sngags phreng 'khor bas phyi nang 'khor yug kun: bskal pa'i me dpung dum bu gcig tu gyur: su yang bgrod du med pa'i rang bzhin bsgom: oṃ badzra tsanḍa ma hā ro ṣa ni hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ kro dha ra dza bhyo tsa tur mu kha tsakra hūm̐ bhyo phaṭḥ oṃ khroṃ ga ru ṭa tsa le tsa le hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ ki kang hrīḥrā hu la ke ta ke ta hūm̐ phaṭḥ

bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa la srungs shig rakṣa rakṣa: badzra tsanḍa ṇi ma ma rakṣa rakṣa: slar kha phyir bskor nas bzlog sngags ni/ oṃ badzra tsaṇḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐ trig ra dzaḥthun bhyoḥ dgra la bhyoḥ dgra la zlog: raṃ ha la ya mā ra ya bhyo bhyoḥ dgra la bhyoḥ dgra la zlog: krag had pa na ga ye bhyo bhyoḥ dgra la bhyoḥ dgra la bzlog: shag rakta rbad tri ya bhyo bhyoḥ dgra la bhyoḥ dgra la zlog: mā ra ya rbad bhyoḥ dun bhyoḥ thun bhyoḥ raksha bhyoḥ byad kha rbod gtong thams cad dgra la bhyo bhyoḥ dgra la zlog zlog: thal rdeb ni/ na moḥ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te: dkon mchog rin chen rnam pa gsum gyi bka': bla ma yi dam bde gshegs rtsa ba gsum gyi byin rlabs: ting 'dzin sngags rgod rdzas kyi sbyor ba'i nus mthu: chos nyid de bzhin nyid dang chos can rgyu 'bras mi bslu ba'i bden pas: bdag dang rgyu sbyor 'khor dang bcas par: sngon gyi las: 'phral gyi rkyen: pha rol gyi rbod gtong : rigs sngags kyi sbyor ba: mnan bsregs gtad cing gzer ba: bsam ngan sbyor rtsubs: chag che nyams nga ba'i rmi ltas mtshan ma ngan pa thams cad: byad ma rang gshed rang la zug te phyir bzlog par gyur cig: med par gyur cig: zhi bar gyur cig: lan gsum/ oṃ loka kri pā la nan: sā ga pa sha nan: nā ga du du nan: ma maṃ ma maṃ: tsirtsa tsirtsa: baṃ ru lu baṃ ru lu: rbad tra kau sha ya: rbad tra kau sha ya: ho ra ho ra: tsi du tsi du sod: shig lhu ru gtub: ha la pa ti nan: 'khor ba thul: gnod byed dgra bgegs 'byung po kā ba tsir brlag brlag: gnod byed sha truṃ mā ra ya rbad rbad: ces dang*/ bka' ltar mi byed cing dam la mi gnas pa'i rigs thams cad 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du dengs shig: srid pa spyi nas shig cig: srid gsum rming nas rgyel cig: 'khor ba steng phyungs shig: bskal pa'i mes sregs shig: dam tshig dmod pas rdegs shig:

bka' yi chad pa chod cig: gnam lcags thog gi ral gris spyi bo'i gtsug nas khos shig: sumbha ni'i non cig: srid gsum gar gnas kyang sdig chen grogs kyi steng du gnam lcags rdo rjes char phobs zhig: gnod byed sha truṃ mā ra ya phaṭḥ sbyor ba ngan pa 'dis thul cig: ces dang*/ bka' bsgo 'di yi nus pa yis/ /thal phye rlung gis gtor ba ltar/ /gnod byed de ru gnas mi 'gyur/ /byad phur rbod gtong rang gshed dbab/ ces zlog sngags dmigs rim bcas dkyus ltar byas bzlog bsad dmigs pa thal brdeb bcas grub nas mi dmigs pa'i ngang la bzhag par bya ba gal che/ der tho zhig gi ngor khroṃ yig bris pa kha phyir bstan bslangs nas 'di ltar brjod do/ hūm̐: sprul pa'i bya khyung ga ru ṭaḥ 'byung po phyir 'brang khyod la gtad: bskal pa stong du ma shor cig: phyin chad ldang bar ma gyur cig: oṃ khroṃ ga ru ṭa tsa le tsa le hūm̐ phaṭḥ de nas phyi mig mi lta zhing slob dpon dang po byas te sgo drung du slebs pa dang*/ bzlog gzhong sbub la/ brtan ma skyong ba ni/ hūm̐: bod khams skyong mdzad brtan ma skyong ba'i tshogs: lhab lhub rgyan spras gar sgyur gtor ma longs: 'dzam gling 'di ru bdag gnas yul gru'i tshogs: tshe chos zas nor longs spyod bkra shis spel: om̐ ma ma ting ting rakmo raksha i daṃ bha lingta kha kha khā hi: rta bro brdung ba ni 'gugs gzhug bcas/ hūm̐: dpal chen khrag 'thung he ru kas: dam sri bsgral nas rta bro rdung : chem chem dgra bo'i mgo nas rdung : mnan mnan nam yang ma ldang zhig: oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ bhrūm̐ tsakra ya dgra bo nan: zhes rta bro brdung*/ gtor gzhong kha slong me tog 'thor/ de nas/ lha rgyal 'then zhing phye mar dang bzhes skyems sogs phul/ de nas tshe 'gugs pa ni/ bdag nyid gsang bdag gsal ba'i thugs srog sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs dus rgyal ba'i tshe byin 'byung ba bzhi yi dwangs bcud/

'khor 'das skye 'gro'i tshe bsod thams cad 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs pa'i rnam par bsdus te/ bdag mdun sgrub rdzas rnams thim pas bkrag mdangs gzi brjid dang ldan par mos la/ oṃ a mi dhe wa ā yurdzñā na ha ri ni sa siddhi hūm̐: ci nus mthar mda' dar g.yab la/ hūm̐: snang mtha' rig 'dzin 'chi med tshe yi bdag: gsang ba'i bdag po'i lha tshogs 'khor bcas kyis: thugs las sprul pa'i mkha' 'gro mgyogs ma 'bum: phyag na mda' dar tshe yi bum pa 'dzin: yang sprul mgyogs ma stong khams kheng bar 'phros: phyi nang snod bcud tshe yi bcud bsdus la: skal ldan rnal 'byor bdag gi lus la bstim: tshe yi ril bu 'dod yon zas kyi mchog: 'chi med bdud rtsi 'ja' lus sgrub pa'i rdzas: deng 'dir rnal 'byor bdag gi lus bstim: hrīḥyig dmar po 'od zer ldan par bsgom: snying ga'i dbus su tshe yi gwa'u la: thim pas 'chi med rig 'dzin myur thob shog: oṃ a mi dhe wa ā yurdzñā na ha ri ni sa siddhi hūm̐: rgyas gdab ni/ āḥ spros pas srid zhi kun la khyab/ /bsdus pas thig le nyag gcig klong*/ /'pho 'gyur med par rgyas btab pas/ /ye shes chen po'i srog thob gyur/ dharma dhā tu rakṣa rakṣa āḥ tshe bum 'brang rgyas sogs rdzas yod na mched lcam rnams kyi spyi bor bzhag ste/ oṃ a mi dhe wa ā yurdzñā na ha ri ni sa kā ya wākka tsitta sarba siddha hūm̐/ zhes dang gzhung ltar dngos grub bskul la dzap dbyangs dang bcas sgrub gtor rnams gnas gsum du gtugs la dngos grub zhu/ de nas rjes kyi bya ba/ mchod bstod bshags pa brtan bzhugs bsdu rim dang bkra shis bsngo smon rgya yis gdab pa sogs las byang ltar shes par bya'o/ /de dag gis nyin tha ma'i gtor rdzongs kyi rim pa rdzogs so/ /dpal chen gtum po'i phrin las bskal pa'i mes/ /mi mthun nyes brgya'i tshang tshing nags bsregs nas/

/bstan 'dzin zhabs brtan bstan pa'i ba dan bsgrengs/ /'brel tshad rnam mkhyen gdod ma'i rgyur gyur cig /ces pa 'di'ang gter chen mchog gi yang srid dkon mchog phrin las bzang po'am 7rig 'dzin padma phrin las tshe dbang 'dus pa rtsal gyis sngon gnas rjes dran gyi thugs bskyed dus su smin pa ltar/ tshad nan gyis bka'i cod pan spyi bor lhung ba ma bzod nas dad pas gtsug tu mchod de/ phyag rdor dregs zil gyi las byang gnam lcags go cha dang*/ de'i smad las gnam lcags gong mas mdzad pa la gzhi blangs nas/ ma tshangs pa rnams 'khor 'das zil gnon gyi phyag rdor pha rol 'joms byed dang*/ rta mgrin nā ga klu 'dul thugs mchog rdo rje'i nā ga raksha sogs rtsa gsum rang gzhung slad med rnams nas btus shing tshig gi phri bsnan cung zad dang bcas te/ rgan bu 'du gsum pa pradzñā dzñā na kri pas seṅge'i 'gying tshul gyi dpe ltar du zin bris btab cing*/ grogs lhan dang yi ge pa ni ma ṇi'i ming can dang rig 'dzin mchog zung gis bgyis pa la nyes 'gal gyi cha gang mchis rtsa gsum dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs la bshags shing*/ dge bas 'khor lo mgon po gnam sprul rin po che sogs bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu rnams zhabasapad bskal pa rgya mtshor brtan cing*/ bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi byang chub sgrub pa'i bar cad thams cad dang*/ mi mthun dus kyi rgud pa mtha' dag zhi nas/ rigs kun khyab bdag gsang ba'i bdag po'i go 'phang myur du thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig /de ltar dpal chen dregs pa zil gnon gyi gtor bzlog gi las rim 'grigs chags su bkod pa gnam lcags thog rgod ces bya ba 'di pradzñā dzñā na kri pas chog khrigs mdzad pa 'di nyid du smad las kho na las/ bdag gi rnal 'byor sogs phal che ba sogs khongs su bzhag cing*/ 'ga' gzhan du zhal 'phang yang mdzad pa sogs nar mar klog 'don dka' bas chu 'babs su bklag par chog pa zhig byung na legs par snyam ste sogs khong nar gyis bshang zhing zhal 'phang ba rnams dkyus su bcug la/

gzhan yang kha 'gengs dang snon 'phri cung zad dgos pa gter gzhung rtsa ba sogs dang*/ bsdur gshib kyis gsar bsgrigs gal che bar mthong nas sgo chen rgyal ba'i skyes ming 'bod pa gsang sngags bstan 'dzin gyi bgyis pa'i yi ge 'du byed 'phen sprul bstan 'dzin 'gyur med kyis bgyis pa 'dis kyang 'gro kun byad gdon g.yul las rgyal zhing*/ dpal gsang ba'i bdag po'i go 'phang mchog la gzhol ba'i rgyur gyur cig /ces pa'ang rab byung bcu bdun pa lcags stag snron zla'i dmar phyogs dga' ba gsum par bgyis pa dge bar gyur cig /sarba dā ka lya nam bha wantu// //
